examples.en: They tried to salvage the sunken ship.
examples.zh: 他们试图打捞沉船。

examples.en: The salvage from the fire was minimal.
examples.zh: 火灾中抢救出来的财物很少。

definitions.en: v. transmit (a signal) for setting off an appropriate response, as in telecommunication
definitions.zh: vt. 质问, 讯问, 审问

definitions.en: v. pose a series of questions to
definitions.zh: vi. 质问, 讯问

examples.en: The police will interrogate the suspect.
examples.zh: 警察将审问嫌疑人。

examples.en: She had to interrogate the witness carefully.
examples.zh: 她必须仔细讯问证人。

definitions.en: v. terminate, end, or take out
definitions.zh: vt. 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色
[医] 消灭

examples.en: The firefighter helped extinguish the fire.
examples.zh: 消防员帮助扑灭了火。

examples.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes before entering.
examples.zh: 进入前请熄灭所有香烟。

definitions.en: n. someone who is unable to walk normally because of an injury or disability to the legs or back
definitions.zh: n. 跛者, 残废

definitions.en: v. deprive of strength or efficiency; make useless or worthless
definitions.zh: vt. 使跛, 使成残废, 削弱

definitions.en: v. deprive of the use of a limb, especially a leg
definitions.zh: a. 跛的, 残废的

examples.en: The accident could cripple his ability to walk.
examples.zh: 事故可能使他行走能力受损。

examples.en: The storm may cripple the power lines.
examples.zh: 暴风雨可能会破坏电线。

definitions.en: n. vegetation (such as young shoots, twigs, and leaves) that is suitable for animals to eat
definitions.zh: v. 浏览, 吃草

definitions.en: n. reading superficially or at random
definitions.zh: n. 浏览, 吃草

definitions.en: n. the act of feeding by continual nibbling
definitions.zh: [计] 浏览

examples.en: I like to browse the internet for news.
examples.zh: 我喜欢浏览互联网看新闻。

examples.en: Deer browse on leaves in the forest.
examples.zh: 鹿在森林里吃树叶。

definitions.en: v. cause great unhappiness for; distress
definitions.zh: vt. 使苦恼, 折磨

examples.en: The disease afflicts many people each year.
examples.zh: 这种疾病每年折磨许多人。

examples.en: He was afflicted with a bad back pain.
examples.zh: 他遭受了严重的背痛折磨。

definitions.en: a. showing lack of favoritism
definitions.zh: a. 公平的, 不偏不倚的
[法] 公正无私的, 不偏袒的, 公平的

examples.en: A judge must be impartial in court.
examples.zh: 法官在法庭上必须公正。

examples.en: She gave an impartial opinion on the matter.
examples.zh: 她对此事给出了公正的意见。

definitions.en: s. uncertain or unable to decide about what course to follow
definitions.zh: a. 矛盾的, 模棱两可的
[医] 矛盾情绪的

examples.en: She felt ambivalent about moving to a new city.
examples.zh: 她对搬到新城市感到矛盾。

examples.en: His ambivalent response confused everyone.
examples.zh: 他模棱两可的回答让所有人困惑。

definitions.en: n. hoop that covers a wheel
definitions.zh: n. 轮胎, 头饰

definitions.en: v. lose interest or become bored with something or somebody
definitions.zh: vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦, 打扮

definitions.en: v. exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
definitions.zh: vi. 疲劳, 厌倦

examples.en: The tire is flat and needs air.
examples.zh: 轮胎瘪了，需要打气。

examples.en: I need to change the car tire.
examples.zh: 我需要换汽车轮胎。

definitions.en: v. increase in extent or intensity
definitions.zh: vi. 逐步扩大, 逐步升高, 逐步增强
vt. 使逐步上升

examples.zh: 冲突开始迅速升级。

examples.en: We must not let the argument escalate.
examples.zh: 我们不能让争论升级。

definitions.en: s. the rhythmic arrangement of syllables
definitions.zh: a. 整齐的, 慎重的, 基于标准的

examples.en: He spoke in a measured tone of voice.
examples.zh: 他以慎重的语气说话。

examples.en: The measured steps of the dance were precise.
examples.zh: 舞蹈的整齐步伐很精确。

definitions.en: v. commit forever; commit irrevocably
definitions.zh: vt. 交付, 储蓄, 委托, 寄存

definitions.en: v. give over to another for care or safekeeping
definitions.zh: [经] 托卖, 寄存, 寄销

examples.en: She will consign the goods to the warehouse.
examples.zh: 她将把货物交付给仓库。

examples.en: He consigned his old books to the trash.
examples.zh: 他把旧书委托给了垃圾堆。

definitions.en: v. maintain, uphold, or defend
definitions.zh: vt. 辩护, 证明...无辜, 维护

definitions.en: v. clear of accusation, blame, suspicion, or doubt with supporting proof
definitions.zh: [法] 辩护, 辩解, 辩明

examples.en: The evidence will vindicate his innocence.
examples.zh: 证据将证明他的清白。

examples.en: She hopes to vindicate her decision soon.
examples.zh: 她希望很快能证明她的决定正确。

definitions.en: s reflecting optimism
definitions.zh: a. 蔷薇色的, 玫瑰红色的

examples.en: The future looks rosy for the company.
examples.zh: 公司的前景看起来乐观。

examples.en: She had a rosy outlook on life.
examples.zh: 她对生活有乐观的看法。

definitions.en: v. remove completely from recognition or memory
definitions.zh: vt. 擦去, 冲刷(掉), 消灭, 忘掉, 盖销(邮票等)

definitions.en: v. do away with completely, without leaving a trace
definitions.zh: [法] 灭迹, 消灭, 涂抹

examples.en: The bomb could obliterate the entire building.
examples.zh: 炸弹可能消灭整栋建筑。

examples.en: Time can obliterate painful memories.
examples.zh: 时间可以抹去痛苦的记忆。

definitions.en: s. marked by precise accordance with details
definitions.zh: a. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的

examples.en: She is meticulous about her work.
examples.zh: 她对工作一丝不苟。

examples.en: He gave a meticulous description of the event.
examples.zh: 他对事件做了精确的描述。

definitions.en: v. pay close attention to; give heed to
definitions.zh: n. 注意, 留心
v. 注意, 留心

examples.en: You should heed the warning signs.
examples.zh: 你应该注意警告标志。

examples.en: She paid no heed to his advice.
examples.zh: 她没有注意他的建议。

definitions.en: n. violent and needless disturbance
definitions.zh: n. 大破坏, 蹂躏
vt. 严重破坏

examples.en: The storm caused great havoc in the town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨在镇上造成了巨大破坏。

examples.en: Children can wreak havoc in a messy room.
examples.zh: 孩子们能在凌乱的房间里造成大破坏。

definitions.en: v gather, as of natural products
definitions.zh: v. 拾落穗, 收集

examples.en: Farmers glean leftover grain from the fields.
examples.zh: 农民从田地里拾取剩余的谷物。

examples.en: She gleaned useful information from the book.
examples.zh: 她从书中收集了有用的信息。

definitions.en: s. difficult to handle or use especially because of size or weight
definitions.zh: a. 笨重的, 麻烦的, 累赘的

examples.en: This old suitcase is very cumbersome to carry.
examples.zh: 这个旧手提箱携带起来很笨重。

examples.en: The process felt cumbersome and slow.
examples.zh: 这个过程感觉麻烦又缓慢。

definitions.en: n. a pause from doing something (as work)
definitions.zh: n. 暂缓, 缓期执行

definitions.en: n. a pause for relaxation
definitions.zh: vt. 使暂缓

examples.en: We took a short respite from our work.
examples.zh: 我们从工作中短暂休息了一下。

examples.en: The rain gave us a respite from the heat.
examples.zh: 雨水让我们从炎热中暂缓了一下。

definitions.en: v. overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof
definitions.zh: vt. 反驳, 驳斥；驳倒

examples.en: He tried to refute the false accusation.
examples.zh: 他试图驳斥虚假的指控。

examples.en: The scientist will refute the old theory.
examples.zh: 科学家将反驳旧理论。

definitions.en: n. a large indefinite number
definitions.zh: n. 无数, 无数的人(或物)
a. 无数的, 种种的

examples.en: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中有无数颗星星。

examples.en: She faced myriad challenges in her new job.
examples.zh: 她在新工作中面临无数挑战。

definitions.en: n. a stifling cloud of smoke

definitions.en: v. envelop completely
definitions.zh: vi. 窒息, 被抑制

definitions.en: v. deprive of oxygen and prevent from breathing
definitions.zh: n. 浓烟, 窒息状态, 杂乱无章

examples.en: The thick smoke began to smother the room.
examples.zh: 浓烟开始使房间窒息。

examples.en: She tried to smother her laughter during class.
examples.zh: 她试图在课堂上忍住笑声。

definitions.en: v. move as if through a sieve
definitions.zh: vt. 筛, 过滤, 撒, 详查

definitions.en: v. separate by passing through a sieve or other straining device to separate out coarser elements
definitions.zh: vi. 筛, 被筛下, 精选

examples.en: She used a sieve to sift the flour.
examples.zh: 她用筛子筛了面粉。

examples.en: We need to sift through the evidence carefully.
examples.zh: 我们需要仔细筛选证据。

definitions.en: n. money that is risked for possible monetary gain

definitions.en: n. a risky act or venture
definitions.zh: v. 赌博, 孤注一掷

examples.en: He likes to gamble on horse races.
examples.zh: 他喜欢赌马。

examples.en: Starting a business is a big gamble.
examples.zh: 创业是一场大冒险。

definitions.en: n. the state of being anonymous
definitions.zh: n. 匿名, 姓氏不明
[计] 匿名信件

examples.en: He prefers the anonymity of a big city.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢大城市的匿名性。

examples.en: Online anonymity can protect your privacy.
examples.zh: 网络匿名可以保护你的隐私。

definitions.en: n. the point on the celestial sphere toward which the sun and solar system appear to be moving relative to the fixed stars
definitions.zh: n. 顶, 尖端, 最高潮
[医] 尖, 尖端

examples.en: The mountain's apex was covered in snow.
examples.zh: 山顶被雪覆盖。

examples.en: He reached the apex of his career.
examples.zh: 他达到了职业生涯的顶峰。

definitions.en: v. become smaller or lose substance
definitions.zh: vi. 减少, 缩小, 衰落
vt. 使缩小

examples.zh: 食物供应开始迅速减少。

examples.en: Her savings dwindled after she lost her job.
examples.zh: 她失业后储蓄减少了。

definitions.en: v. cause to move back by force or influence

definitions.en: v. be repellent to; cause aversion in
definitions.zh: vi. 使厌恶, 相互排斥

examples.zh: 这种气味能驱赶许多昆虫。

examples.en: His rude behavior will repel others.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的行为会让人反感。

definitions.en: n. doubt about someone's honesty
definitions.zh: n. 疑虑, 不安, 害怕, 担扰, 疑惧

examples.en: She had a misgiving about the plan.
examples.zh: 她对计划有疑虑。

examples.en: His misgiving grew as the deadline approached.
examples.zh: 随着截止日期临近，他的不安增加了。

definitions.en: v. increase in size, volume or significance

vi. 有放大能力

examples.zh: 显微镜能放大微小的物体。

examples.en: Do not magnify your problems too much.
examples.zh: 不要过分夸大你的问题。

definitions.en: s. marked by extreme and violent energy
definitions.zh: a. 残忍的, 凶猛的, 可怕的

examples.zh: 凶猛的狮子在动物园里大声咆哮。

examples.en: A ferocious storm hit the coastal town.
examples.zh: 一场可怕的暴风雨袭击了沿海小镇。

definitions.en: n. (astronomy) a heavenly body's highest celestial point above an observer's horizon
definitions.zh: n. 顶点, 高潮, 最高点

examples.zh: 这个节日是几个月工作的顶点。

examples.en: Winning the award was the culmination of his efforts.
examples.zh: 获奖是他努力的高潮。

definitions.en: n. a place that is scoured (especially by running water)

definitions.en: v. examine minutely

definitions.en: v. rub hard or scrub
definitions.zh: n. 擦, 洗, 腹泻, 洗涤剂

examples.en: She scoured the pan with a brush.
examples.zh: 她用刷子擦洗了锅。

examples.en: The police scoured the area for clues.
examples.zh: 警察仔细搜索了该地区寻找线索。

definitions.en: n. language or behavior intended to mock or humiliate
definitions.zh: n. 嘲笑, 愚弄, 笑柄

definitions.en: v. subject to laughter or ridicule
definitions.zh: vt. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 愚弄

examples.zh: 他们嘲笑他过时的衣服。

examples.en: He faced ridicule for his strange idea.
examples.zh: 他因奇怪的想法而遭到嘲笑。

definitions.en: n. fine-toothed power saw with a narrow blade; used to cut curved outlines
definitions.zh: n. 线锯
vt. 用线锯锯

examples.en: She completed the jigsaw puzzle in one hour.
examples.zh: 她在一小时内完成了拼图。

examples.en: He used a jigsaw to cut the wood.
examples.zh: 他用线锯切割木头。

definitions.en: v use up, consume fully
definitions.zh: vt. 花费, 消耗, 用光

examples.zh: 我们绝不能消耗太多精力。

examples.en: They expend a lot of time on this project.
examples.zh: 他们在这个项目上花费了大量时间。

definitions.en: n. needy people collectively

examples.zh: 慈善机构帮助城市里的贫困家庭。

examples.en: We should donate food to the needy.
examples.zh: 我们应该向贫困者捐赠食物。

definitions.en: n. a comedy characterized by broad satire and improbable situations
definitions.zh: n. 闹剧, 滑稽剧, 胡闹

examples.zh: 会议变成了一场彻底的闹剧。

examples.en: The play was a hilarious farce about family life.
examples.zh: 这部剧是关于家庭生活的滑稽闹剧。

definitions.en: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work
definitions.zh: vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻

definitions.en: v. exchange positions without a change in value
definitions.zh: vi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往

examples.en: She commutes to work by train every day.
examples.zh: 她每天乘火车通勤上班。

examples.en: His commute takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 他的通勤时间大约一小时。

definitions.en: n a situation in which no progress can be made or no advancement is possible
definitions.zh: n. 停止, 停顿

definitions.en: n an interruption of normal activity
definitions.zh: [医] 停顿

examples.en: Traffic came to a standstill after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后交通陷入停顿。

examples.en: The negotiations reached a standstill yesterday.
examples.zh: 谈判昨天陷入了停顿。

definitions.en: n. a distinctive characteristic or attribute
definitions.zh: n. 纯度检验证明, 品质证明
vt. 加盖纯度检验证明

examples.en: Honesty is the hallmark of a good friend.
examples.zh: 诚实是好朋友的标志。

examples.en: The ring has a hallmark on the inside.
examples.zh: 戒指内侧有纯度检验证明。

definitions.en: v. reduce the amplitude (of oscillations or waves)
definitions.zh: vt. 弄湿, 使沮丧

definitions.en: v. make vague or obscure or make (an image) less visible
definitions.zh: vi. 变湿, 丧气

examples.en: The rain will dampen the dry ground.
examples.zh: 雨水会弄湿干燥的地面。

examples.en: Bad news can dampen your spirits quickly.
examples.zh: 坏消息会很快使你的情绪沮丧。

definitions.en: v be a mystery or bewildering to
definitions.zh: a. 令人困惑的, 使人昏乱的

examples.en: The instructions were completely bewildering to me.
examples.zh: 这些说明对我来说完全令人困惑。

examples.en: She faced a bewildering array of choices.
examples.zh: 她面临一系列令人困惑的选择。

definitions.en: n. a remote or indirect consequence of some action
definitions.zh: n. 弹回, 反响, 反射
[医] 消退[法], 消肿[法], 浮动诊胎法

examples.en: His actions had serious repercussions for everyone.
examples.zh: 他的行为对每个人都有严重的反响。

examples.en: The decision caused many unexpected repercussions.
examples.zh: 这个决定引起了许多意想不到的后果。

definitions.en: n a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation
definitions.zh: n. 英勇, 勇敢, 超凡技术

examples.en: She showed great prowess in the competition.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中展现了超凡技术。

examples.en: His athletic prowess impressed all the coaches.
examples.zh: 他的运动英勇给所有教练留下了深刻印象。

definitions.en: s no longer in use
definitions.zh: a. 荒废的, 成废物的, 陈旧的, 老式的
n. 废词, 废物

examples.en: This old computer is now completely obsolete.
examples.zh: 这台旧电脑现在完全过时了。

examples.en: Many technologies become obsolete very quickly.
examples.zh: 许多技术很快就变得陈旧。

definitions.en: v find repugnant
definitions.zh: vt. 厌恶, 憎恶

examples.zh: 我厌恶早上早起。

examples.en: She loathes the taste of bitter medicine.
examples.zh: 她厌恶苦药的味道。

definitions.en: v. draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible

definitions.en: v. write, engrave, or print as a lasting record
definitions.zh: [电] 书写

examples.zh: 他们把名字刻在奖杯上。

examples.en: She inscribed a message in the book.
examples.zh: 她在书里题写了一则信息。

definitions.en: s. not capable of sin

examples.en: Her manners are always impeccable at dinner.
examples.zh: 她的举止在晚餐时总是无懈可击。

examples.en: He has an impeccable record of honesty.
examples.zh: 他有无可挑剔的诚实记录。

definitions.en: s causing fear or dread or terror
definitions.zh: a. 可怕的, 骇人的, 不得了的

examples.en: The accident caused horrendous damage to the car.
examples.zh: 事故对汽车造成了可怕的损坏。

examples.en: They experienced horrendous weather during the trip.
examples.zh: 他们在旅途中经历了可怕的天气。

definitions.en: s. spoken with emphasis
definitions.zh: a. 语调强的, 着重的, 强调了的

examples.zh: 她对提议给出了一个强调的“不”。

examples.en: His emphatic speech convinced everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他着重的演讲说服了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: v take away a part from; diminish
definitions.zh: vi. 减去, 贬低
vt. 转移, 分散

examples.en: His rude comments detract from the discussion.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的评论贬低了讨论。

examples.en: Small mistakes should not detract from your success.
examples.zh: 小错误不应该减损你的成功。

definitions.en: v turn up, loosen, or remove earth
definitions.zh: v. 探究, 查考
n. 坑, 穴

examples.zh: 她深入探究旧书寻找答案。

examples.en: He delved deeper into the mystery of the case.
examples.zh: 他更深入地探究案件的谜团。

definitions.en: s. quick to understand
definitions.zh: a. 惴惴不安的, 敏悟的, 知晓的

examples.en: She felt apprehensive before the big exam.
examples.zh: 她在重要考试前感到惴惴不安。

examples.en: He was apprehensive about meeting new people.
examples.zh: 他对见新朋友感到不安。

definitions.en: a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
definitions.zh: a. 神智健全的, 稳健的, 没病的, 合理的
[医] 精神健全的

examples.en: He remained sane despite all the stress.
examples.zh: 尽管压力很大，他仍保持神智健全。

examples.en: It's a sane decision to take a break.
examples.zh: 休息一下是个合理的决定。

definitions.en: n. the quality of a color as determined by its dominant wavelength
definitions.zh: n. 样子, 色度, 色彩, 叫声, 色调

definitions.en: v. take on color or become colored
definitions.zh: [计] 色调

examples.en: The sky turned a beautiful orange hue.
examples.zh: 天空变成了美丽的橙色色调。

examples.en: She painted the room in a soft blue hue.
examples.zh: 她把房间漆成了柔和的蓝色色调。

definitions.en: s. in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
definitions.zh: a. 睡眠状态的, 静止的

definitions.en: a. (of e.g. volcanos) not erupting and not extinct
definitions.zh: [医] 休眠的, 不活动的, 休止的

examples.en: The volcano has been dormant for years.
examples.zh: 这座火山休眠多年了。

examples.en: Seeds remain dormant until spring arrives.
examples.zh: 种子在春天到来之前一直处于休眠状态。

definitions.en: n. an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining
definitions.zh: n. 病痛, 疾病
[医] 疾病

examples.en: He suffers from a common stomach ailment.
examples.zh: 他患有常见的胃病。

examples.en: The doctor treated her minor skin ailment.
examples.zh: 医生治疗了她轻微的皮肤疾病。

definitions.en: n. intense anger (usually on an epic scale)
definitions.zh: n. 愤怒, 激怒, 愤怒的举动, (自然现象等)严酷

examples.en: He feared the king's wrath.
examples.zh: 他害怕国王的愤怒。

examples.en: Her wrath was clear from her face.
examples.zh: 她的愤怒从脸上就能看出来。

definitions.en: a. established or decided beyond dispute or doubt
definitions.zh: a. 固定的, 决定的, 持续的, 难以消除的

definitions.en: a. established in a desired position or place; not moving about
definitions.zh: [经] 付讫的, 固定的, 结过帐的

examples.en: They have a settled routine every morning.
examples.zh: 他们每天早上有固定的习惯。

examples.en: After moving, she finally felt settled in her home.
examples.zh: 搬家后，她终于在家里感到安定了。

definitions.en: a. recurring in scattered and irregular or unpredictable instances
definitions.zh: a. 偶尔发生的, 零星发生的, 分散的
[医] 散在的, 散发的

examples.en: There were sporadic showers throughout the day.
examples.zh: 全天有零星阵雨。

examples.en: His attendance at class was sporadic this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期他上课出勤是零星的。

definitions.en: s. stopping and starting at irregular intervals
definitions.zh: a. 间歇的, 断断续续的
[化] 间歇的; 间断的

examples.en: The rain was intermittent all day.
examples.zh: 雨断断续续地下了一整天。

examples.en: He suffers from intermittent back pain.
examples.zh: 他患有间歇性背痛。

definitions.en: v disturb the composure of
definitions.zh: vt. 使移动, 搅乱, 使动摇, 使不安宁
vi. 动荡不定, 离开固定位置

examples.en: The strange noise began to unsettle the children.
examples.zh: 奇怪的声音开始使孩子们不安。

examples.en: Sudden changes can unsettle even calm people.
examples.zh: 突然的变化甚至能让冷静的人不安。

definitions.en: v. limit in quality or quantity
definitions.zh: a. 不充分的, 不足的
vt. 减少, 吝啬, 限制, 藐视, 忽略

examples.en: There is scant evidence to support his claim.
examples.zh: 支持他主张的证据不足。

examples.en: She paid scant attention to the warning.
examples.zh: 她对警告注意不足。

definitions.en: v. solidify, firm, or strengthen
definitions.zh: vt. 使实体化, 证实
[经] 确证

examples.en: Can you substantiate your claim with facts?
examples.zh: 你能用事实证实你的主张吗？

examples.en: The report failed to substantiate the allegations.
examples.zh: 报告未能证实这些指控。

definitions.en: v. make (to feel) fresh
definitions.zh: vt. 使清新, 使恢复, 使生气蓬勃

definitions.en: v. make fresh again
definitions.zh: vi. 提起精神, 恢复精神, 吃点心, 喝饮料
vt. 刷新, 重新整理

examples.en: A cold drink will refresh you quickly.
examples.zh: 一杯冷饮会让你迅速恢复精神。

examples.en: Let me refresh the page to see updates.
examples.zh: 让我刷新页面看看更新。

definitions.en: v. spread or diffuse through
definitions.zh: vt. 弥漫, 渗透, 充满, 影响, 感染
vi. 透入, 散布

examples.en: The smell of coffee permeated the room.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味弥漫了整个房间。

examples.en: Water can permeate through the soil.
examples.zh: 水能渗透土壤。

definitions.en: s being or having the character of a miracle
definitions.zh: a. 奇迹的, 不可思议的

examples.en: Her recovery was truly miraculous.
examples.zh: 她的康复真是奇迹般的。

examples.en: The rescue team made a miraculous save.
examples.zh: 救援队完成了一次不可思议的救援。

definitions.en: n. a sudden short attack
definitions.zh: vi. 侵略, 劫掠, 袭击

definitions.en: n. an initial attempt (especially outside your usual areas of competence)
definitions.zh: n. 侵掠, 侵略, 攻击

examples.en: He made a foray into the forest.
examples.zh: 他闯入森林进行了一次突袭。

examples.en: Her first foray into cooking was successful.
examples.zh: 她第一次尝试烹饪很成功。

definitions.en: a. expressing much in few words
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 简明的

examples.en: Her speech was clear and concise.
examples.zh: 她的演讲清晰而简洁。

examples.en: Please give a concise answer to the question.
examples.zh: 请对问题给出简洁的回答。

definitions.en: s. contented to a fault with oneself or one's actions
definitions.zh: a. 满足的, 自满的, 得意的

examples.en: He became complacent after winning the game.
examples.zh: 他在赢得比赛后变得自满。

examples.en: Don't be complacent about your progress.
examples.zh: 不要对自己的进步自满。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to a phenomenon
definitions.zh: a. 现象的, 能知觉的, 异常的, 显著的, 惊人的

examples.en: The singer gave a phenomenal performance.
examples.zh: 这位歌手献上了一场惊人的表演。

examples.en: Her memory is absolutely phenomenal.
examples.zh: 她的记忆力绝对惊人。

definitions.en: s. dark or gloomy
definitions.zh: a. 黝暗的, 阴沉的, 朦胧的

examples.en: The water in the pond was murky.
examples.zh: 池塘里的水很浑浊。

examples.en: The future looks murky for the company.
examples.zh: 这家公司的前景看起来暗淡。

definitions.en: n. a social club for male undergraduates
definitions.zh: n. 友爱, 互助会, 大学生联谊会

examples.en: He joined a fraternity at college.
examples.zh: 他在大学加入了一个兄弟会。

examples.en: The fraternity held a party last night.
examples.zh: 兄弟会昨晚举办了一场派对。

definitions.en: n a person who goes before or announces the coming of another
definitions.zh: n. 先驱, 前兆

examples.en: This invention was a forerunner of modern computers.
examples.zh: 这项发明是现代计算机的先驱。

examples.en: Dark clouds are a forerunner of rain.
examples.zh: 乌云是下雨的前兆。

definitions.en: n. a courteous expression (by word or deed) of esteem or regard
definitions.zh: n. 顺从, 尊重

examples.en: He showed deference to his elders.
examples.zh: 他对长辈表示尊重。

examples.en: In deference to her wishes, we stayed home.
examples.zh: 出于对她的意愿的尊重，我们待在家里。

definitions.en: n. the sound of heavy treading or stomping
definitions.zh: n. 践踏(声), 蹂躏

definitions.en: v. injure by trampling or as if by trampling
definitions.zh: v. 践踏, 无视

examples.en: Don't trample on the flowers.
examples.zh: 不要践踏花朵。

examples.en: The crowd trampled the grass flat.
examples.zh: 人群把草踩平了。

definitions.en: v. spread by scattering ("straw" is archaic)
definitions.zh: vt. 散播, 撒满

examples.en: She strewed flowers on the path.
examples.zh: 她在小路上撒满了花。

examples.en: Papers were strewn all over the floor.
examples.zh: 文件散落了一地。

definitions.en: a. having the nature of or resulting from malice
definitions.zh: a. 怀恶意的, 恶毒的

examples.en: He made a malicious comment about her.
examples.zh: 他对她做了恶意的评论。

examples.en: That was a malicious rumor spread online.
examples.zh: 那是在网上传播的恶毒谣言。

definitions.en: n. the face or front of a building
definitions.zh: n. 建筑物的正面, 外观, 表面

examples.en: The building has a beautiful facade.
examples.zh: 这座建筑有漂亮的正面。

examples.en: Behind his calm facade, he was nervous.
examples.zh: 在他平静的外表下，他很紧张。

definitions.en: s. lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
definitions.zh: a. 土褐色的, 单调的

examples.en: The room was painted a drab color.
examples.zh: 房间漆成了单调的颜色。

examples.en: Her life felt drab and boring.
examples.zh: 她的生活感觉单调乏味。

definitions.en: n. a small waterfall or series of small waterfalls
definitions.zh: n. 小瀑布, 瀑布状物

definitions.en: n. a succession of stages or operations or processes or units
definitions.zh: vi. 成瀑布落下

definitions.en: v. rush down in big quantities, like a cascade
definitions.zh: [计] 层叠, 级联

examples.en: Water cascaded down the rocks.
examples.zh: 水像瀑布一样从岩石上流下。

examples.en: The news caused a cascade of reactions.
examples.zh: 这个消息引发了一连串的反应。

definitions.en: n. a state of extreme happiness
definitions.zh: n. 福佑, 天赐的福
[计] 实现系统软件的基本语言

examples.en: They lived in a state of bliss.
examples.zh: 他们生活在幸福之中。

examples.en: The couple enjoyed marital bliss.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇享受着婚姻的幸福。

definitions.en: n. (physics) the tendency of a body to maintain its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force
definitions.zh: n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝
[化] 惯性

examples.en: Inertia keeps the car moving forward.
examples.zh: 惯性使汽车继续向前移动。

examples.en: He overcame his inertia and started exercising.
examples.zh: 他克服了惰性，开始锻炼。

definitions.en: n. a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends
definitions.zh: n. 阴谋, 复杂的事

definitions.en: n. a clandestine love affair
definitions.zh: vi. 密谋, 私通

definitions.en: v. cause to be interested or curious
definitions.zh: vt. 激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得

examples.en: The mystery novel is full of intrigue.
examples.zh: 这本神秘小说充满了阴谋。

examples.en: Her story intrigued me very much.
examples.zh: 她的故事让我非常感兴趣。

definitions.en: a. perceptible by the senses or intellect
definitions.zh: a. 看得清的, 可看出的, 可辨别的, 辨别得出的

definitions.en: s. capable of being perceived clearly
definitions.zh: [计] 可识别的

examples.en: There was a discernible change in his mood.
examples.zh: 他的情绪有可察觉的变化。

examples.en: The outline was barely discernible in the dark.
examples.zh: 轮廓在黑暗中几乎看不清。

definitions.en: n. a violently fast stream of water (or other liquid)
definitions.zh: n. 奔流, 倾盆大雨, 倾注, 迸发

examples.en: A torrent of water flooded the street.
examples.zh: 一股奔流淹没了街道。

examples.en: He faced a torrent of angry questions.
examples.zh: 他面临一连串愤怒的质问。

definitions.en: n. something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty;
definitions.zh: n. 没收物, 罚金, 丧失

definitions.en: n. a penalty for a fault or mistake that involves losing or giving up something
definitions.zh: vt. 没收, 丧失

definitions.en: n. the act of losing or surrendering something as a penalty for a mistake or fault or failure to perform etc.
definitions.zh: a. 丧失了的

examples.en: He had to forfeit the game due to injury.
examples.zh: 他因伤不得不放弃比赛。

examples.en: If you break the rules, you forfeit your prize.
examples.zh: 如果你违反规则，就会丧失奖品。

definitions.en: v. remove or force out from a position
definitions.zh: vt. 逐出, 使移动, 驱逐

definitions.en: v. remove or force from a position of dwelling previously occupied
definitions.zh: vi. 离开原位

examples.en: She tried to dislodge the stone from her shoe.
examples.zh: 她试图把石头从鞋里弄出来。

examples.en: The storm dislodged several roof tiles.
examples.zh: 暴风雨掀掉了好几片屋顶瓦。

definitions.en: n. a person afflicted with paranoia
definitions.zh: a. (似)患妄想狂的, (似)患偏执狂的

definitions.en: s. suffering from paranoia
definitions.zh: n. 患妄想狂的人

examples.en: He became paranoid about being watched.
examples.zh: 他变得偏执，觉得被人监视。

examples.en: She has paranoid thoughts about her coworkers.
examples.zh: 她对同事有妄想狂的想法。

definitions.en: v consider or describe as similar, equal, or analogous
definitions.zh: vt. 比喻, 比拟

examples.en: She likened his smile to sunshine.
examples.zh: 她把他的微笑比作阳光。

examples.en: He likened the experience to a dream.
examples.zh: 他把这次经历比作一场梦。

definitions.en: n. a person (such as an author) of enduring fame
definitions.zh: n. 不朽人物, 神仙

definitions.en: a. not subject to death
definitions.zh: a. 永远的, 不死的, 长久的

examples.en: The ancient gods were believed to be immortal.
examples.zh: 古代的神被认为是不朽的。

examples.en: Shakespeare's works are immortal.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的作品是不朽的。

definitions.en: n state of violent mental agitation
definitions.zh: n. 疯狂, 狂暴, 狂怒
[医] 暴怒, 狂乱

examples.en: The crowd was in a frenzy of excitement.
examples.zh: 人群陷入一阵狂热的兴奋。

examples.en: He worked himself into a frenzy.
examples.zh: 他让自己陷入疯狂状态。

definitions.en: n. the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors
definitions.zh: n. 对立, 敌对, 敌意

definitions.en: n. an actively expressed feeling of dislike and hostility
definitions.zh: [化] 拮抗作用; 消效作用

examples.en: There was open antagonism between the two groups.
examples.zh: 两个群体之间公开敌对。

examples.en: His words were filled with antagonism.
examples.zh: 他的话充满了敌意。

definitions.en: v. make a more or less disguised reference to
definitions.zh: vi. 暗指, 提及

examples.en: She alluded to the problem without naming it.
examples.zh: 她暗指了这个问题，但没有点名。

examples.en: He alluded to his past in the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中提及了他的过去。

definitions.en: s. highly skilled
definitions.zh: a. 完成的, 实现的, 有造诣的, 熟练的, 善社交的

examples.en: She is an accomplished pianist.
examples.zh: 她是一位有造诣的钢琴家。

examples.en: He felt accomplished after finishing the project.
examples.zh: 完成项目后，他感到很有成就感。

definitions.en: n. an act of honor or courteous recognition
definitions.zh: vi. 行礼, 致意, 问候, 放礼炮

definitions.en: n. a formal military gesture of respect
definitions.zh: vt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬

definitions.en: n. an act of greeting with friendly words and gestures like bowing or lifting the hat
definitions.zh: n. 招呼, 敬礼, 礼炮

examples.en: The soldier gave a smart salute.
examples.zh: 士兵行了一个利落的敬礼。

examples.en: We salute the brave firefighters today.
examples.zh: 今天我们向勇敢的消防员致敬。

definitions.en: n. a loud low dull continuous noise
definitions.zh: n. 隆隆声, 辘辘声

definitions.en: n. a servant's seat (or luggage compartment) in the rear of a carriage
definitions.zh: vi. 发隆隆声, 辘辘响

definitions.en: n. a fight between rival gangs of adolescents
definitions.zh: vt. 使隆隆响, 低沉地说

examples.en: The thunder rumbled in the distance.
examples.zh: 雷声在远处隆隆作响。

examples.en: His stomach rumbled with hunger.
examples.zh: 他的肚子饿得咕咕叫。

definitions.en: v. rule against
definitions.zh: vt. 统治, 威压, 打败, 驳回
[法] 否决, 驳回, 批驳

examples.en: The judge overruled the objection.
examples.zh: 法官驳回了反对意见。

examples.en: The manager overruled my decision.
examples.zh: 经理否决了我的决定。

definitions.en: a. being in force or having or exerting force
definitions.zh: a. 动作的, 运转的, 有效的, 关键的, 手术的

definitions.en: s. effective; producing a desired effect
definitions.zh: n. 技工, 侦探

examples.en: The new law becomes operative next month.
examples.zh: 新法律下个月生效。

examples.en: He is a skilled operative in the field.
examples.zh: 他是该领域的一名熟练技工。

definitions.en: n. a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
definitions.zh: n. 命令者, 独裁者

examples.en: The dictator ruled the country with fear.
examples.zh: 独裁者用恐惧统治国家。

examples.en: People protested against the cruel dictator.
examples.zh: 人们抗议残酷的独裁者。

definitions.en: n. a flock of coots
definitions.zh: a. 隐蔽的, 偷偷摸摸的, 隐密的

definitions.en: a. secret or hidden; not openly practiced or engaged in or shown or avowed
definitions.zh: n. 树丛, 隐藏处

examples.en: The agency conducted a covert operation.
examples.zh: 该机构进行了一次秘密行动。

examples.en: He gave her a covert glance.
examples.zh: 他偷偷地瞥了她一眼。

definitions.en: v. hunt illegally
definitions.zh: vt. 水煮(蛋), 偷猎, 侵入, 窃取

definitions.en: v. cook in a simmering liquid
definitions.zh: vi. 偷猎, 陷入泥中

examples.en: They poach eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他们早餐煮荷包蛋。

examples.en: He was caught poaching deer in the forest.
examples.zh: 他在森林里偷猎鹿被抓。

definitions.en: v. cause to break up or cease to function
definitions.zh: vt. 解散, 遣散

definitions.en: v. stop functioning or cohering as a unit
definitions.zh: vi. 被解散

examples.en: The group decided to disband after the tour.
examples.zh: 巡演结束后，这个团体决定解散。

examples.en: The army was disbanded after the war.
examples.zh: 战争结束后军队被解散。

definitions.en: v. become smaller
definitions.zh: n. 减少, 衰微, 败落, 亏缺, 月亏

definitions.en: v. decrease in phase
definitions.zh: vi. 变小, 亏缺, 衰落, 消逝, 退潮

examples.en: The moon began to wane after the full moon.
examples.zh: 满月之后月亮开始亏缺。

examples.en: His interest in the project started to wane.
examples.zh: 他对这个项目的兴趣开始减弱。

definitions.en: n. place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective)
definitions.zh: n. 优势, 有利情况

examples.en: From this vantage point, you can see the whole city.
examples.zh: 从这个有利位置，你可以看到整个城市。

examples.en: He had a vantage over his competitors.
examples.zh: 他比竞争对手有优势。

definitions.en: n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor
definitions.zh: n. 名望, 名气, 声望
vt. 认为, 以为

examples.en: She is a scientist of high repute.
examples.zh: 她是一位声望很高的科学家。

examples.en: The hotel is held in good repute.
examples.zh: 这家酒店享有良好的声誉。

definitions.en: v spread or diffuse through
definitions.zh: vt. 弥漫于, 遍及于, 流行于, 蔓延, 渗透于, 充满

examples.en: A sense of calm pervaded the room.
examples.zh: 一种平静的感觉弥漫在房间里。

examples.en: The smell of coffee pervaded the kitchen.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味弥漫在厨房里。

definitions.en: n. a cry of sorrow and grief
definitions.zh: n. 悲叹, 悔恨, 恸哭, 挽歌, 悼词

definitions.en: v. express grief verbally
definitions.zh: vt. 哀悼
vi. 悔恨, 悲叹

examples.en: She lamented the loss of her friend.
examples.zh: 她哀悼朋友的去世。

examples.en: He wrote a lament for the fallen soldiers.

definitions.zh: a. 孤独的, 悲惨的, 凄凉的

examples.en: The lost puppy looked forlorn.
examples.zh: 迷路的小狗看起来很凄凉。

examples.en: She felt forlorn after her friend left.
examples.zh: 朋友离开后她感到孤独。

definitions.en: v. entrap
definitions.zh: vt. 使纠缠, 卷入, 使混乱

examples.en: The wires entangle easily.
examples.zh: 电线容易纠缠在一起。

examples.en: He got entangled in a legal dispute.
examples.zh: 他被卷入一场法律纠纷。

definitions.en: s. unaffected by self-interest
definitions.zh: a. 无私欲的, 廉洁的, 公平的

examples.en: A judge must be disinterested.
examples.zh: 法官必须公正无私。

examples.en: She gave disinterested advice to her friend.
examples.zh: 她给朋友提供了公正的建议。

definitions.en: n. a proposition obtained by conversion
definitions.zh: n. 相反的事物, 倒, 逆向

definitions.en: v. carry on a conversation
definitions.zh: a. 相反的, 逆向的, 颠倒的

definitions.en: s. of words so related that one reverses the relation denoted by the other
definitions.zh: vi. 交谈, 谈话

examples.en: They converse in English every day.
examples.zh: 他们每天用英语交谈。

examples.en: The converse of that statement is true.
examples.zh: 那个陈述的反面是正确的。

definitions.en: s. meanly avaricious and mercenary
definitions.zh: a. 肮脏的, 贪婪的, 卑鄙的, 恶劣的, 暗淡的
[医] 污色的

examples.en: The room was sordid and dirty.
examples.zh: 房间肮脏不堪。

examples.en: He told a sordid story about greed.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个关于贪婪的卑鄙故事。

definitions.en: s not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
definitions.zh: a. 无情的, 冷酷的

examples.en: The march of time is inexorable.
examples.zh: 时间的流逝是无情的。

examples.en: Her inexorable determination scared them.
examples.zh: 她无情的决心吓到了他们。

definitions.en: n a particular environment or surrounding influence
definitions.zh: n. 周围环境, 气氛

examples.en: The restaurant has a cozy ambience.
examples.zh: 餐厅有一种舒适的气氛。

examples.en: Soft music adds to the ambience.
examples.zh: 轻柔的音乐增添了气氛。

definitions.en: n. an apparatus consisting of an object mounted so that it swings freely under the influence of gravity
definitions.zh: n. 钟摆, 摇锤, 摇摆不定的事态(或局面)
[化] 摆

examples.en: The pendulum swings back and forth.
examples.zh: 钟摆来回摆动。

examples.en: He watched the pendulum of the clock.
examples.zh: 他看着时钟的钟摆。

definitions.en: n. reasoning that involves the formation of conclusions from incomplete evidence
definitions.zh: n. 推测, 猜想, 揣摩
v. 推测, 猜想, 揣摩
[计] 推测; 猜测

examples.en: That is just a conjecture, not fact.
examples.zh: 那只是推测，不是事实。

examples.en: We can only conjecture what happened.
examples.zh: 我们只能推测发生了什么。

definitions.en: s tiresomely long; seemingly without end
definitions.zh: a. 无限的, 冗长的

examples.en: The meeting seemed interminable.
examples.zh: 会议似乎没完没了。

examples.en: He gave an interminable speech.
examples.zh: 他做了一个冗长的演讲。

definitions.en: v. take the place of
definitions.zh: vt. 篡夺, 侵占, 夺取
vi. 篡夺, 侵占

examples.en: He tried to usurp the throne.
examples.zh: 他试图篡夺王位。

examples.en: The new manager usurped her authority.
examples.zh: 新经理篡夺了她的权力。

definitions.en: s. spreading out in different directions
definitions.zh: a. 蔓生的, 不规则地伸展的

examples.en: The city is sprawling in all directions.
examples.zh: 城市向四面八方不规则地扩展。

examples.en: He has a sprawling handwriting.
examples.zh: 他的字迹潦草。

definitions.en: n. discretion in practical affairs
definitions.zh: n. 审慎, 慎重, 精明, 节俭

examples.en: Prudence is important in financial matters.
examples.zh: 审慎在财务问题上很重要。

examples.en: She acted with prudence and care.
examples.zh: 她行事审慎小心。

definitions.en: n. a reminder of past events
definitions.zh: n. 纪念物, 令人回忆的东西

examples.en: This photo is a memento of our trip.
examples.zh: 这张照片是我们旅行的纪念物。

examples.en: He kept the ticket as a memento.
examples.zh: 他把票留着作为纪念。

definitions.en: n. an affront to one's dignity or self-esteem
definitions.zh: n. 侮辱
[法] 侮辱的言行, 无礼, 有伤尊严

examples.en: He suffered the indignity of being fired.
examples.zh: 他遭受了被解雇的侮辱。

examples.en: The treatment was an indignity to her.
examples.zh: 这种待遇对她是一种侮辱。

definitions.en: a. not admitting of passage or capable of being affected
definitions.zh: a. 透不过的, 不易损坏的, 无动于衷的, 不受影响的
[医] 不能透过的

examples.en: This material is impervious to water.
examples.zh: 这种材料不透水。

examples.en: He remained impervious to criticism.
examples.zh: 他对批评无动于衷。

definitions.en: v. suffuse with color
definitions.zh: vt. 使感染, 灌输, 使浸透

examples.en: Her speech imbued us with hope.
examples.zh: 她的演讲使我们充满希望。

examples.en: The artist imbues his work with emotion.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家将情感注入作品。

definitions.en: s. produced or growing in extreme abundance
definitions.zh: a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的
[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的

examples.en: The garden was exuberant with flowers.
examples.zh: 花园里繁花似锦。

examples.en: She gave an exuberant laugh.
examples.zh: 她发出了充满活力的笑声。

definitions.en: v avoid and stay away from deliberately; stay clear of
definitions.zh: vt. 避开, 远避

examples.en: He eschews violence in all situations.
examples.zh: 他在所有情况下都避免暴力。

examples.en: She eschews processed foods for health.
examples.zh: 为了健康，她避开加工食品。

definitions.en: v. prove to be false
definitions.zh: vt. 证明...是不对的, 提出...的反证, 反驳
[法] 证明...不成立, 反驳, 驳斥

examples.en: New evidence disproved the old theory.
examples.zh: 新证据推翻了旧理论。

examples.en: They tried to disprove his claim.
examples.zh: 他们试图反驳他的说法。

definitions.en: a. conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being
definitions.zh: a. 有益健康的, 合乎卫生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生气的, 审慎的

examples.en: Eating fruits is wholesome for your health.
examples.zh: 吃水果对你的健康有益。

examples.en: She enjoys wholesome family activities.
examples.zh: 她喜欢有益健康的家庭活动。

definitions.en: n. a passage by which a bodily fluid (especially blood) is diverted from one channel to another
definitions.zh: vt. 使转轨, 使分流, 回避讨论, 推延

definitions.en: n. a conductor having low resistance in parallel with another device to divert a fraction of the current
definitions.zh: vi. 转向一边, 转轨, 往返

definitions.en: n. implant consisting of a tube made of plastic or rubber; for draining fluids within the body
definitions.zh: n. 转轨, 分流

examples.en: The train was shunted to a side track.
examples.zh: 火车被转到侧轨上。

examples.en: They shunted the blame onto someone else.
examples.zh: 他们把责任推给了别人。

definitions.en: a. aged or processed
definitions.zh: a. 经验丰富的, 老练的

examples.en: A seasoned chef knows all the tricks.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的厨师知道所有诀窍。

examples.en: He is a seasoned traveler.
examples.zh: 他是一位老练的旅行者。

definitions.en: v. use a surgical instrument to hold open (the edges of a wound or an organ)
definitions.zh: v. 缩回, 收回, 取消, 撤消

examples.en: The cat can retract its claws.
examples.zh: 猫能缩回爪子。

examples.en: He retracted his statement after the backlash.
examples.zh: 他在强烈反对后收回了声明。

definitions.en: v extend out or project in space
definitions.zh: vi. 伸出, 突出

definitions.en: v bulge outward
definitions.zh: vt. 使伸出, 使突出

examples.en: A nail protrudes from the wooden board.
examples.zh: 一颗钉子从木板上突出。

examples.en: His teeth protrude slightly.
examples.zh: 他的牙齿稍微突出。

definitions.en: n rule of personal conduct
definitions.zh: n. 规诫, 规矩, 格言, 训令

definitions.en: n a doctrine that is taught
definitions.zh: [经] 告诫, 指令

examples.en: Follow the precept of honesty.
examples.zh: 遵守诚实的准则。

examples.en: This precept guides our daily actions.
examples.zh: 这条训诫指导我们的日常行为。

definitions.en: s. belonging to some prior time
definitions.zh: adv. 以前, 往昔地
a. 以前的, 往昔的

examples.en: He is an erstwhile colleague of mine.
examples.zh: 他是我以前的一位同事。

examples.en: The erstwhile capital is now a small town.
examples.zh: 昔日的首都现在是一个小镇。

definitions.en: a. having or revealing keen insight and good judgment
definitions.zh: a. 有眼力的, 敏锐的, 有辨别能力的, 有洞察力的

examples.en: She is a discerning art collector.
examples.zh: 她是一位有眼力的艺术收藏家。

examples.en: His discerning eye caught the mistake.
examples.zh: 他敏锐的眼睛发现了错误。

definitions.en: n. a disorder in one's mental state
definitions.zh: n. 离开正路, 偏离, 畸变, 光行差, 心理失常, 色差

definitions.en: n. an optical phenomenon resulting from the failure of a lens or mirror to produce a good image
definitions.zh: [化] 光行差; 像差

examples.en: His rude behavior was an aberration.
examples.zh: 他的粗鲁行为是一种失常。

examples.en: The lens has a slight optical aberration.
examples.zh: 这个镜头有轻微的光学像差。

definitions.en: n. the process whereby heat changes something from a solid to a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 融解, 融化, 解冻时期

definitions.en: n. warm weather following a freeze; snow and ice melt
definitions.zh: vt. 使融解, 使缓和

definitions.en: n. a relaxation or slackening of tensions or reserve; becoming less hostile
definitions.zh: vi. 融化, 解冻

examples.en: The ice will thaw in the spring sun.
examples.zh: 冰会在春天的阳光下融化。

examples.en: Let the frozen meat thaw before cooking.
examples.zh: 让冷冻肉在烹饪前解冻。

definitions.en: n. drawing position in chess: any of a player's possible moves would place his king in check
definitions.zh: n. 僵持状态, 僵局, 陷于困境, 胶着状况

definitions.en: v. subject to a stalemate
definitions.zh: vt. 将...逼和, 使僵持, 使陷入困境

examples.en: The negotiations ended in a stalemate.
examples.zh: 谈判以僵局告终。

examples.en: The chess game resulted in a stalemate.
examples.zh: 这盘棋以和棋结束。

definitions.en: v. grow rapidly
definitions.zh: vi. 增殖, 激增, 扩散

definitions.en: v. cause to grow or increase rapidly
definitions.zh: vt. 使激增

examples.en: Rumors proliferate quickly on social media.
examples.zh: 谣言在社交媒体上迅速扩散。

examples.en: The cells proliferate at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 细胞以惊人的速度增殖。

definitions.en: n. United States tennis player who dominated women's tennis in the 1920s and 1930s (1905-1998)
definitions.zh: a. 心情不稳的, 郁郁寡欢的, 喜怒无常的

examples.en: He is moody and often changes his mind.
examples.zh: 他喜怒无常，经常改变主意。

examples.en: The moody weather made everyone feel tired.
examples.zh: 阴晴不定的天气让每个人都感到疲倦。

definitions.en: v place in a grave or tomb
definitions.zh: vt. 埋葬
prep. 在中间

examples.en: They interred the soldier with full honors.
examples.zh: 他们以最高荣誉埋葬了那位士兵。

examples.en: The remains were interred in the cemetery.
examples.zh: 遗骸被埋葬在公墓里。

definitions.en: n. very light rain; stronger than mist but less than a shower
definitions.zh: n. 细雨

definitions.en: v. rain lightly
definitions.zh: v. 下毛毛雨

examples.en: A light drizzle began to fall.
examples.zh: 开始下起了毛毛雨。

examples.en: It will drizzle all morning.
examples.zh: 整个早上都会下毛毛雨。

definitions.en: s. no longer in force or use; inactive
definitions.zh: a. 死的, 不能使用的

definitions.en: s. having ceased to exist or live
definitions.zh: n. 死者

examples.en: The company is now defunct.
examples.zh: 这家公司现在已经倒闭了。

examples.en: That old law is defunct.
examples.zh: 那条旧法律已经失效了。

definitions.en: a. troubled emotionally and usually deeply
definitions.zh: a. (表现出)不安/焦虑的, (被)激烈辩论的, (被)热烈讨论的, 颤抖的

definitions.en: a. physically disturbed or set in motion
definitions.zh: [医] 激越的

examples.en: She became agitated when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她听到消息后变得焦虑不安。

examples.en: The agitated crowd shouted loudly.
examples.zh: 激动的人群大声喊叫。

definitions.en: n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity
definitions.zh: a. 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的

definitions.en: a. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
definitions.zh: n. 联谊会

examples.en: He is a very sociable person.
examples.zh: 他是一个非常好交际的人。

examples.en: We had a sociable evening with friends.
examples.zh: 我们和朋友度过了一个愉快的社交之夜。

definitions.en: s. having a clear mind
definitions.zh: a. 明晰的, 清澈的, 透明的, 透彻的
[医] 清明的, 透明的, 清醒的

examples.en: Her explanation was clear and lucid.
examples.zh: 她的解释清晰明了。

examples.en: He had a lucid dream last night.
examples.zh: 他昨晚做了一个清醒梦。

definitions.en: n. a stopping
definitions.zh: n. 停止
[法] 中止, 中断, 停止

examples.en: They called for a cessation of hostilities.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁停止敌对行动。

examples.en: The cessation of rain allowed us to go out.
examples.zh: 雨停了，我们可以出去了。

definitions.en: s. functioning in a supporting capacity
definitions.zh: n. 辅助者, 辅助物, 附属机构, 助动词
a. 辅助的, 备用的

examples.en: The hospital has an auxiliary power generator.
examples.zh: 医院有一台辅助发电机。

examples.en: She works as an auxiliary nurse in the clinic.
examples.zh: 她在诊所里做辅助护士。

definitions.en: n. an unsophisticated country person
definitions.zh: n. 乡下人, 乡巴佬
a. 乡村的, 纯朴的, 手工粗糙的

examples.en: They live in a rustic cabin in the woods.
examples.zh: 他们住在林间一座乡村风格的小屋里。

examples.en: The rustic furniture is simple but charming.
examples.zh: 这些乡村风格的家具简单而迷人。

definitions.en: n. a wooden or metal staff that fits under the armpit and reaches to the ground; used by disabled person while walking
definitions.zh: n. 拐杖, 支撑, 依靠

definitions.en: n. anything that serves as an expedient
definitions.zh: vt. 支撑

examples.en: He walks with a crutch after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后他拄着拐杖走路。

examples.en: She used her friend as an emotional crutch.
examples.zh: 她把朋友当作情感上的依靠。

definitions.en: v remove from customary environment or associations
definitions.zh: a. 疏远的, 分离的, 隔离的

examples.en: He became estranged from his family.
examples.zh: 他与家人疏远了。

examples.en: The estranged couple rarely spoke.
examples.zh: 这对分居的夫妇很少说话。

definitions.en: s. occurring with no delay
definitions.zh: a. 即时的, 瞬间的, 猝发的
[机] 瞬时的

examples.en: The reaction was almost instantaneous.
examples.zh: 反应几乎是瞬间的。

examples.en: She gave an instantaneous reply to him.
examples.zh: 她立即给了他回复。

definitions.en: s carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
definitions.zh: a. 警觉的, 警戒的, 警惕的
[法] 警醒的, 警戒的, 注意的

examples.en: Stay vigilant against potential threats.
examples.zh: 对潜在威胁保持警惕。

examples.en: The guard was vigilant all night.
examples.zh: 警卫整夜保持警觉。

definitions.en: s lacking justification or authorization
definitions.zh: [计] 未经调整的, 未对齐的

examples.en: His anger was completely unjustified.
examples.zh: 他的愤怒完全没有道理。

examples.en: The criticism seemed unjustified to me.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这种批评是不合理的。

definitions.en: v to go back over again
definitions.zh: vt. 追溯, 折回, 绕回

definitions.en: v reassemble mentally
definitions.zh: [电] 返驰

examples.en: We retraced our steps to find the key.
examples.zh: 我们原路返回去找钥匙。

examples.en: She retraced the route in her mind.
examples.zh: 她在脑海中重新追溯了路线。

definitions.en: n extreme excess
definitions.zh: n. 过多, 过剩, 多血症
[医] 多血[症]

examples.en: There is a plethora of options to choose from.
examples.zh: 有太多的选择可供挑选。

examples.en: The book contains a plethora of information.
examples.zh: 这本书包含了过多的信息。

definitions.en: s shockingly repellent; inspiring horror
definitions.zh: a. 可怕的, 令人毛骨悚然的, 阴森的

examples.en: The movie had a gruesome murder scene.
examples.zh: 这部电影有一个可怕的谋杀场景。

examples.en: They found a gruesome sight in the basement.
examples.zh: 他们在地下室发现了令人毛骨悚然的景象。

definitions.en: n. rules governing socially acceptable behavior
definitions.zh: n. 礼仪, 礼节, 成规
[法] 规则, 成规, 礼节

examples.en: Table etiquette is important in formal dinners.
examples.zh: 餐桌礼仪在正式晚宴中很重要。

examples.en: She knows the proper etiquette for the event.
examples.zh: 她知道这个活动的适当礼节。

definitions.en: v. put into a rage; make violently angry
definitions.zh: vt. 激怒, 使暴怒

examples.en: His rude comment enraged her.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的评论激怒了她。

examples.en: The unfair decision enraged the workers.
examples.zh: 不公平的决定激怒了工人们。

definitions.en: v. extricate from entanglement
definitions.zh: vi. 解开纠结, 松开, 解决
vt. 解开, 松开

examples.en: She tried to disentangle the knots in her hair.
examples.zh: 她试图解开头发上的结。

examples.en: It took time to disentangle the truth from lies.
examples.zh: 从谎言中理清真相需要时间。

definitions.en: a. suitable to your needs
definitions.zh: a. 协调的, 一致的, 适意的, 趣味相同的

examples.en: We found a congenial atmosphere in the café.
examples.zh: 我们在咖啡馆找到了宜人的氛围。

examples.en: He is a congenial companion for the trip.
examples.zh: 他是一个适合同行的愉快伙伴。

definitions.en: a. worthy of trust or belief
definitions.zh: a. 可信赖的

definitions.en: s. taking responsibility for one's conduct and obligations
definitions.zh: [法] 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信赖的

examples.en: She is a trustworthy friend.
examples.zh: 她是一位值得信赖的朋友。

examples.en: The news source is not trustworthy.
examples.zh: 这个新闻来源不可靠。

definitions.en: n sordid dirtiness
definitions.zh: n. 肮脏, 贫穷, 不干净

examples.en: They lived in terrible squalor.
examples.zh: 他们生活在极其肮脏的环境中。

examples.en: The poverty and squalor shocked the visitors.
examples.zh: 贫穷和肮脏让访客感到震惊。

definitions.en: s morally degraded
definitions.zh: a. 污秽的, 肮脏的, 悲惨的, 可怜的, 卑劣的

examples.en: The squalid room was full of trash.
examples.zh: 那个肮脏的房间堆满了垃圾。

examples.en: They lived in squalid conditions.
examples.zh: 他们生活在污秽的环境中。

definitions.en: s. moderate to inferior in quality
definitions.zh: a. 不好不坏的, 通常, 平凡的

examples.en: The movie was mediocre at best.
examples.zh: 这部电影充其量只是平庸。

examples.en: He gave a mediocre performance in the test.
examples.zh: 他在测试中表现平平。

definitions.en: n. an ambiguity (especially one in the text of a law or contract) that makes it possible to evade a difficulty or obligation
definitions.zh: n. 枪眼, 小窗, 换气孔

examples.en: The lawyer found a loophole in the contract.
examples.zh: 律师在合同中发现了一个漏洞。

examples.en: This tax loophole allows companies to save money.

examples.en: He was arrested for industrial espionage.
examples.zh: 他因工业间谍活动被捕。

examples.en: Espionage is a serious crime in many countries.
examples.zh: 间谍活动在许多国家是严重的犯罪。

definitions.en: v. take on duties or office
definitions.zh: vi. 同意, 正式加入, 就任, 继任

examples.en: The prince acceded to the throne last year.
examples.zh: 王子去年继承了王位。

examples.en: She acceded to our request for help.
examples.zh: 她同意了我们寻求帮助的请求。

definitions.en: v levy a tax on
definitions.zh: a. 繁重的, 费力的

definitions.en: v set or determine the amount of (a payment such as a fine)
definitions.zh: [法] 征税的, 评定的负担颇重的

examples.en: The long hike was very taxing on my legs.
examples.zh: 长途徒步对我的腿来说非常费力。

examples.en: This job is mentally taxing but rewarding.
examples.zh: 这份工作精神上很繁重但有回报。

definitions.en: a. pertaining to or containing or consisting of semen
definitions.zh: a. 精液的, 种子的, 生殖的
[医] 种子的; 精液的

examples.en: His book was a seminal work in biology.
examples.zh: 他的书是生物学领域的开创性著作。

examples.en: The scientist made a seminal discovery.
examples.zh: 那位科学家做出了开创性的发现。

definitions.en: v. become feeble
definitions.zh: vi. 憔悴, 凋萎, 苦思

examples.en: The plant languished without enough water.
examples.zh: 植物因缺水而凋萎。

examples.en: He languished in prison for many years.
examples.zh: 他在监狱中憔悴了许多年。

definitions.en: v. force into some kind of situation, condition, or course of action
definitions.zh: vt. 使卷入, 牵连

examples.en: She was embroiled in a heated argument.
examples.zh: 她被卷入了一场激烈的争论。

examples.en: Don't embroil me in your problems.
examples.zh: 别把我牵连进你的问题里。

definitions.en: s often used as intensifiers
definitions.zh: a. 名副其实的, 真实的, 确实的, 真的

examples.en: The garden was a veritable paradise.
examples.zh: 那个花园简直是名副其实的天堂。

examples.en: He is a veritable expert on the subject.
examples.zh: 他是这个主题上名副其实的专家。

definitions.en: v. tie with a tether
definitions.zh: n. 系绳, 系链, 界限, 范围
vt. 栓, 束缚, 限制

examples.en: The farmer tethered the goat to a tree.
examples.zh: 农夫把山羊拴在树上。

examples.en: She felt tethered to her desk all day.
examples.zh: 她感觉整天被束缚在办公桌前。

definitions.en: v. do away with
definitions.zh: vt. 除去, 排除, 使成为不必要, 避免

examples.en: Good planning can obviate many problems.
examples.zh: 好的计划可以避免许多问题。

examples.en: This new tool obviates the need for manual work.
examples.zh: 这个新工具使手工劳动成为不必要。

definitions.en: n. any of various plants of various genera of the family Compositae having flowers that can be dried without loss of form or color
definitions.zh: a. 永恒的, 持久的
n. 上帝, 神

examples.en: They promised everlasting love to each other.
examples.zh: 他们向彼此承诺永恒的爱。

examples.en: The beauty of nature seems everlasting.
examples.zh: 大自然的美似乎是永恒的。

definitions.en: v bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin by neglect or misuse
definitions.zh: a. 破坏的；荒废的, 要塌似的

examples.en: The old house was dilapidated and unsafe.
examples.zh: 那栋旧房子破败不堪且不安全。

examples.en: They lived in a dilapidated building.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋荒废的楼房里。

definitions.en: v. dip a foot or hand briefly into a liquid
definitions.zh: vi. 玩水, 拨弄, 涉猎

definitions.en: v. play in or as if in water, as of small children
definitions.zh: vt. 溅湿

examples.en: She likes to dabble in painting on weekends.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在周末涉猎绘画。

examples.en: The children dabble their feet in the water.
examples.zh: 孩子们把脚浸在水里玩水。

definitions.en: s. fully detailed and specific about particulars
definitions.zh: a. 依照情况的

examples.en: The evidence was only circumstantial.
examples.zh: 证据只是间接的。

examples.en: He gave a circumstantial account of the event.
examples.zh: 他对事件做了详细的描述。

definitions.en: s. moving quickly and lightly
definitions.zh: a. 敏捷的, 灵活的, 机敏的

examples.en: The agile cat jumped over the fence.
examples.zh: 那只敏捷的猫跳过了篱笆。

examples.en: She is an agile thinker in meetings.
examples.zh: 她在会议中思维机敏。

definitions.en: n a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
definitions.zh: n. 荣誉, 赞美, 骑士爵位的授予礼, 连谱号

examples.en: She received an accolade for her work.
examples.zh: 她因工作获得了荣誉。

examples.en: The award was a great accolade for the team.
examples.zh: 这个奖项是对团队极大的赞美。

definitions.en: v. let off the hook
definitions.zh: vt. 宣告...无罪, 赦免, 免除
[经] 免偿(债务), 解除

examples.en: The court absolved him of all charges.
examples.zh: 法庭宣告他无罪，免除所有指控。

examples.en: She absolved herself from the responsibility.
examples.zh: 她解除了自己的责任。

definitions.en: s having a short and solid form or stature
definitions.zh: a. 矮胖的, 健壮结实的

examples.en: The stocky man lifted the heavy box easily.
examples.zh: 那个矮胖结实的男人轻松地举起了重箱子。

examples.en: He has a stocky build from years of labor.
examples.zh: 他因多年劳动而身材健壮结实。

definitions.en: n feeling a need to see others suffer
definitions.zh: n. 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物

definitions.en: n malevolence by virtue of being malicious or spiteful or nasty
definitions.zh: vt. 故意刁难, 欺侮

examples.en: He did it out of pure spite.
examples.zh: 他这么做纯粹出于恶意。

examples.en: She broke the toy just to spite her brother.
examples.zh: 她弄坏玩具就是为了刁难她弟弟。

definitions.en: v. come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
definitions.zh: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼

examples.en: The dictator used force to oppress the people.
examples.zh: 独裁者用武力压迫人民。

examples.en: Do not oppress those who are weaker than you.
examples.zh: 不要压迫比你弱小的人。

definitions.en: s. attracting or delighting
definitions.zh: a. 动人的, 迷人的, 有魅力的

examples.en: She has an engaging smile that lights up the room.
examples.zh: 她有迷人的微笑，照亮了整个房间。

examples.en: The story was so engaging that I couldn't stop reading.
examples.zh: 故事如此引人入胜，我无法停止阅读。

definitions.en: v. force to drink
definitions.zh: vt. 使湿透, 使充满

definitions.en: v. cover with liquid; pour liquid onto
definitions.zh: n. 滂沱大雨, 弄湿

examples.en: The rain drenched us completely.
examples.zh: 雨水把我们完全湿透了。

examples.en: He drenched the plants with water.
examples.zh: 他用水浇透了植物。

definitions.en: v. to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :"She forced him to take a job in the city"
definitions.zh: vt. 强制, 强迫

examples.en: They tried to coerce him into signing the contract.
examples.zh: 他们试图强迫他签署合同。

examples.en: No one should coerce you to do something wrong.
examples.zh: 没有人应该强迫你做错事。

definitions.en: n. a detested person
definitions.zh: n. 令人厌恶的人, 强烈的遣责, 诅咒, 咒逐, 革出教门

examples.en: Lying is anathema to her.
examples.zh: 撒谎是她最厌恶的事。

examples.en: The idea was anathema to the community.
examples.zh: 这个想法对社区来说是可憎的。

definitions.en: s inspiring mixed contempt and pity
definitions.zh: a. 慈悲的, 可怜的, 令人同情的, 可鄙的

examples.en: The abandoned puppy looked pitiful.
examples.zh: 被遗弃的小狗看起来很可怜。

examples.en: His pitiful excuse did not convince anyone.
examples.zh: 他可鄙的借口没有说服任何人。

definitions.en: n. state of being gratified or satisfied
definitions.zh: n. 令人满足的事(或物), 满足, 喜悦

definitions.en: n. the act or an instance of satisfying
definitions.zh: [医] 愿望满足, 满意

examples.en: Eating chocolate gives me instant gratification.
examples.zh: 吃巧克力给我即时的满足。

examples.en: She felt gratification after finishing the project.
examples.zh: 完成项目后她感到喜悦。

definitions.en: a. morally excellent
definitions.zh: a. 品德高尚的, 公正的, 贞洁的, 有效力的

examples.en: She is a virtuous person who always helps others.
examples.zh: 她是一个品德高尚的人，总是帮助别人。

examples.en: He led a virtuous life full of good deeds.
examples.zh: 他过着充满善行的正直生活。

definitions.en: n. an irrational but irresistible motive for a belief or action
definitions.zh: n. 狂躁, 热衷, 狂热

definitions.en: n. a mood disorder; an affective disorder in which the victim tends to respond excessively and sometimes violently
definitions.zh: [医] 躁狂, 狂

examples.en: He has a mania for collecting stamps.
examples.zh: 他对集邮有狂热的爱好。

examples.en: The mania for social media is widespread.
examples.zh: 对社交媒体的狂热很普遍。

definitions.en: v go against, as of rules and laws
definitions.zh: vt. 违反, 触犯, 否认, 反驳, 抵触, 与...冲突

definitions.en: v deny the truth of
definitions.zh: [法] 触法, 违反, 否定

examples.en: His actions contravene the company's rules.
examples.zh: 他的行为违反了公司的规定。

examples.en: This law contravenes the constitution.
examples.zh: 这条法律与宪法相抵触。

definitions.en: n. a barrier (usually thrown up hastily) to impede the advance of an enemy
definitions.zh: n. 路障, 障碍

definitions.en: v. render unsuitable for passage
definitions.zh: vt. 设路障于, 阻碍

examples.en: The police set up a barricade on the street.
examples.zh: 警察在街上设置了路障。

examples.en: They barricaded the door to keep intruders out.
examples.zh: 他们用障碍物堵住门以防入侵者。

definitions.en: n. largest anthropoid ape; terrestrial and vegetarian; of forests of central west Africa
definitions.zh: n. 大猩猩, 残暴的男人, 歹徒

examples.en: The gorilla is a strong and intelligent animal.
examples.zh: 大猩猩是一种强壮而聪明的动物。

examples.en: We saw a gorilla at the zoo yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天在动物园看到了一只大猩猩。

definitions.en: n. coarse food (especially for livestock) composed of entire plants or the leaves and stalks of a cereal crop
definitions.zh: n. 饲料, 草料, 素材, 弹药

definitions.en: v. give fodder (to domesticated animals)
definitions.zh: vt. 喂

examples.en: The farmer stored hay as fodder for the cows.
examples.zh: 农夫储存干草作为奶牛的饲料。

examples.en: The scandal provided fodder for the media.
examples.zh: 丑闻为媒体提供了素材。

definitions.en: a. characterized by friendship and good will
definitions.zh: a. 友善的, 友好的
[法] 友好的, 和睦的, 温和的

examples.en: They reached an amicable agreement.
examples.zh: 他们达成了友好的协议。

examples.en: The divorce was surprisingly amicable.
examples.zh: 离婚出乎意料地友好。

definitions.en: n. (usually plural) a destructive action
definitions.zh: n. 破坏, 蹂躏
v. 毁坏, 破坏, 掠夺

examples.en: The storm ravaged the coastal town.
examples.zh: 风暴破坏了沿海城镇。

examples.en: War ravaged the country for years.
examples.zh: 战争蹂躏了这个国家多年。

definitions.en: n. correct or appropriate behavior
definitions.zh: n. 礼貌, 规矩, 适当
[计] 专有权

examples.en: She always acts with propriety at formal dinners.
examples.zh: 她在正式晚宴上总是举止得体。

examples.en: Propriety demands we dress appropriately for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 礼节要求我们为仪式穿着得体。

definitions.en: s so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
definitions.zh: a. 庞大的, 惊人的, 异常的

examples.en: The storm caused prodigious damage to the coast.
examples.zh: 风暴对海岸造成了巨大的破坏。

examples.en: He has a prodigious talent for playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他有弹钢琴的惊人天赋。

definitions.en: v. contain or include
definitions.zh: vt. 把...归入, 把...纳入, 把...列入某一类, 把...归类

examples.en: This rule subsumes all the previous guidelines.
examples.zh: 这条规则包含了所有以前的指导方针。

examples.en: The new category subsumes several older ones.
examples.zh: 新类别将几个旧类别归入其中。

definitions.en: s. completely clear and fine
definitions.zh: a. 宁静的, 沉着的, 安详的, 晴朗的
n. 晴朗, 平静

examples.en: The lake looked serene in the morning light.
examples.zh: 湖面在晨光中显得宁静。

examples.en: She remained serene despite the chaos around her.
examples.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，她依然保持平静。

definitions.en: n. a whip used to inflict punishment (often used for pedantic humor)
definitions.zh: n. 鞭, 苦难根源, 灾祸

definitions.en: v. punish severely; excoriate
definitions.zh: vt. 鞭打, 痛斥, 蹂躏

examples.en: War is a terrible scourge for humanity.
examples.zh: 战争是人类可怕的灾祸。

examples.en: The dictator used his power to scourge the people.
examples.zh: 独裁者用他的权力蹂躏人民。

definitions.en: a. foretelling events as if by supernatural intervention
definitions.zh: a. 预言的, 先知的, 预示的

examples.en: His words turned out to be prophetic.
examples.zh: 他的话后来证明是有预见性的。

examples.en: The dream felt strangely prophetic to her.
examples.zh: 这个梦对她来说奇怪地具有预言性。

definitions.en: n a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
definitions.zh: vt. 提供, 贡献, 提议

definitions.en: v present for acceptance or rejection
definitions.zh: n. 提供, 提议

examples.en: He proffered his seat to the elderly woman.
examples.zh: 他把座位让给了那位老妇人。

examples.en: She proffered a solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个解决问题的方案。

definitions.en: a. making claim to or creating an appearance of (often undeserved) importance or distinction
definitions.zh: a. 自负的, 自命不凡的, 夸耀的

examples.en: His speech was full of pretentious words.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了自命不凡的言辞。

examples.en: She found his art too pretentious for her taste.
examples.zh: 她觉得他的艺术太浮夸，不合她的口味。

definitions.en: s. horrible in fierceness or savagery
definitions.zh: a. 火烧似的, 苍白的, 华丽的, 可怕的

examples.en: The newspaper gave a lurid account of the accident.
examples.zh: 报纸对事故进行了耸人听闻的报道。

examples.en: The sky turned a lurid red before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨前天空变成了可怕的红色。

definitions.en: n. an imaginary place for lost or neglected things
definitions.zh: n. 地狱边缘, 监狱, 忘却

definitions.en: n. (theology) in Roman Catholicism, the place of unbaptized but innocent or righteous souls (such as infants and virtuous individuals)
definitions.zh: [法] 监狱, 拘禁, 忘却

examples.en: The project is stuck in limbo waiting for approval.
examples.zh: 项目处于不确定状态，等待批准。

examples.en: He felt like his soul was in limbo after the loss.
examples.zh: 失去后，他感觉自己的灵魂处于地狱边缘。

definitions.en: s. showing curiosity
definitions.zh: a. 好问的, 想知道的, 好追根究底的

examples.en: The inquisitive child asked many questions.
examples.zh: 那个好奇的孩子问了很多问题。

examples.en: She has an inquisitive mind and loves to learn.
examples.zh: 她有一颗好奇的心，热爱学习。

definitions.en: s uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
definitions.zh: a. 不断的, 不绝的, 无尽的

examples.en: The incessant rain ruined our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 连绵不断的雨毁了我们野餐的计划。

examples.en: Her incessant chatter made it hard to concentrate.
examples.zh: 她不停的闲聊让人难以集中注意力。

definitions.en: n. the act of displaying something ostentatiously
definitions.zh: n. 炫耀, 飘扬

definitions.en: v. display proudly; act ostentatiously or pretentiously
definitions.zh: v. 炫耀, 飘扬

examples.en: He likes to flaunt his wealth in public.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在公共场合炫耀他的财富。

examples.en: She flaunted her new dress at the party.
examples.zh: 她在派对上炫耀她的新裙子。

definitions.en: s. unhappy in love; suffering from unrequited love
definitions.zh: a. 缺少的, 丧失的, 失去亲人的
bereave的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: She felt bereft after her best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 她最好的朋友搬走后，她感到失落。

examples.en: The family was bereft of hope after the tragedy.
examples.zh: 悲剧发生后，这个家庭失去了希望。

definitions.en: r. at or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship
definitions.zh: adv. 在高处, 在上

examples.en: The flag flew aloft in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 旗帜在强风中高高飘扬。

examples.en: He held the trophy aloft for everyone to see.
examples.zh: 他把奖杯高高举起，让每个人都能看到。

definitions.en: n the act of walking with a slow heavy gait
definitions.zh: n. 沉重的步伐, 辛勤工作

definitions.en: v walk heavily and firmly, as when weary, or through mud
definitions.zh: vi. 沉重地走, 辛勤工作, 孜孜从事
vt. 沉重缓慢地走

examples.en: He plodded through the mud after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后他在泥泞中艰难行走。

examples.en: She plodded along with her homework all evening.
examples.zh: 她整个晚上都在埋头做作业。

definitions.en: n. a deaf person who is unable to speak
definitions.zh: n. 哑子, 哑音字母, 弱音器

definitions.en: n. a device used to soften the tone of a musical instrument
definitions.zh: a. 哑的, 无声的, 沉默的

definitions.en: s. expressed without speech
definitions.zh: vt. 减弱...的声音

examples.en: He remained mute during the entire meeting.
examples.zh: 他在整个会议期间保持沉默。

examples.en: Please mute your phone during the movie.
examples.zh: 看电影时请把手机调成静音。

definitions.en: n. flesh of any of various American and European flatfish
definitions.zh: vi. 挣扎, 折腾；错乱地做事或说话

examples.en: The fish floundered on the deck of the boat.
examples.zh: 鱼在船甲板上挣扎。

examples.en: He floundered during his speech and forgot his lines.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中慌乱失措，忘了台词。

definitions.en: a. confined to and understandable by only an enlightened inner circle
definitions.zh: a. 秘教的, 奥秘的, 秘传的
[医] 体内的, 内部的, 隐的

examples.en: The book discusses esoteric philosophical ideas.
examples.zh: 这本书讨论了深奥的哲学思想。

examples.en: Only a few people understand his esoteric jokes.
examples.zh: 只有少数人理解他那些晦涩的笑话。

definitions.en: v add details to
definitions.zh: vt. 修饰, 装饰, 润色

examples.en: She embellished the story with extra details.
examples.zh: 她用额外的细节润色了故事。

examples.en: He embellished the room with beautiful paintings.
examples.zh: 他用美丽的画作装饰了房间。

definitions.en: s. expressing extreme contempt
definitions.zh: a. 轻蔑的, 鄙视的, 瞧不起人的

examples.en: She gave him a contemptuous look.
examples.zh: 她给了他一个轻蔑的眼神。

examples.en: His contemptuous tone made her angry.
examples.zh: 他鄙视的语气让她生气。

definitions.en: v. bring up a topic for discussion
definitions.zh: n. 烧肉叉, 凿子, 钻头
vt. 用凿子修琢(石块), 钻孔
vi. 露出水面

examples.en: She decided to broach the topic of salary.
examples.zh: 她决定提出薪水这个话题。

examples.en: He broached the idea of a vacation to his boss.
examples.zh: 他向老板提出了休假的想法。

definitions.en: n. a mild rebuke or criticism
definitions.zh: n. 责备, 耻辱

definitions.en: n. disgrace or shame
definitions.zh: vt. 责备, 申斥, 使丢脸
