examples.zh: 请按字母顺序列出名字。

examples.en: The dictionary is arranged alphabetically.
examples.zh: 字典是按字母顺序排列的。

definitions.en: n. an obstruction in a pipe or tube
definitions.zh: n. 封锁, 妨碍

definitions.en: n. the act of blocking
definitions.zh: [化] 堵塞

examples.en: A blockage in the pipe caused a flood.
examples.zh: 管道堵塞导致了水灾。

examples.en: The doctor removed the artery blockage.
examples.zh: 医生清除了动脉堵塞。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or used in cooking
definitions.zh: a. 厨房的, 烹调用的

examples.en: She enjoys learning culinary skills.
examples.zh: 她喜欢学习烹饪技巧。

examples.en: This knife is a culinary tool.
examples.zh: 这把刀是烹饪工具。

definitions.en: s. characterized by massiveness and rigidity and total uniformity
definitions.zh: a. 独石的, 完全统一的, 整体的
[化] 整体(铸,烧结)的; 龟甲网衬里; 单片; 单块

examples.en: The company has a monolithic structure.
examples.zh: 这家公司有单一的结构。

examples.en: The building is a monolithic block of stone.
examples.zh: 这座建筑是一整块巨石。

definitions.en: v. gain knowledge of (an area not known or experienced) by extrapolating
definitions.zh: v. 推断, 外推

examples.en: We can extrapolate future trends from data.
examples.zh: 我们可以从数据推断未来趋势。

examples.en: Scientists extrapolate results from experiments.
examples.zh: 科学家从实验中推断结果。

definitions.en: n. light teasing repartee
definitions.zh: n. 戏谑, 嘲弄
v. 戏弄, 开玩笑

examples.en: They exchanged light banter at lunch.
examples.zh: 他们在午餐时互相轻松地开玩笑。

examples.en: His banter made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 他的玩笑让大家都笑了。

definitions.en: v. divide into slivers or splinters
definitions.zh: n. 裂片, 薄片, 梳毛

definitions.en: v. form into slivers
definitions.zh: vt. 切成长片
vi. 剖开, 分裂

examples.en: A sliver of glass cut his finger.
examples.zh: 一片玻璃碎片割伤了他的手指。

examples.en: She ate a sliver of cake.
examples.zh: 她吃了一小块蛋糕。

definitions.en: n. a small and inadequate amount
definitions.zh: n. 缺乏, 不足, 缺少
[经] 缺乏, 不足

examples.en: Water scarcity is a serious problem here.
examples.zh: 水资源短缺在这里是一个严重问题。

examples.en: The scarcity of food caused high prices.
examples.zh: 食物短缺导致价格高涨。

definitions.en: n. a substance that produces a fragrant odor when burned
definitions.zh: n. 香, 香气, 奉承

definitions.en: n. the pleasing scent produced when incense is burned
definitions.zh: vi. 焚香
vt. 用香焚, 使发怒

examples.en: We burned incense during the meditation session.
examples.zh: 我们在冥想时焚烧了香。

examples.en: The incense filled the room with a sweet smell.
examples.zh: 香使房间里充满了甜美的气味。

definitions.en: s marked by refinement in taste and manners
definitions.zh: a. 有教养的, 上流的, 优雅的

examples.en: She comes from a genteel family.
examples.zh: 她出身于一个优雅的家庭。

examples.en: His manners are very genteel.
examples.zh: 他的举止非常文雅。

definitions.en: v. treat with contemptuous disregard
definitions.zh: n. 嘲笑, 愚弄, 笑柄, 食品
v. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 贪吃, 狼吞虎咽地吃

examples.en: Don't scoff at his ideas; they are good.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑他的想法；它们很好。

examples.en: She scoffed at the suggestion immediately.
examples.zh: 她立即嘲笑了这个建议。

definitions.en: v. make public
definitions.zh: vt. 宣传

examples.en: The company will publicize the new product.
examples.zh: 公司将宣传新产品。

examples.en: They publicize the event on social media.
examples.zh: 他们在社交媒体上宣传这个活动。

definitions.en: n. (astronomy) an arbitrarily fixed date that is the point in time relative to which information (as coordinates of a celestial body) is recorded
definitions.zh: n. 新纪元, 时代, 时期

examples.en: The discovery marked a new epoch in science.
examples.zh: 这一发现标志着科学的新纪元。

examples.en: We live in a digital epoch of technology.
examples.zh: 我们生活在数字技术的时代。

definitions.en: n. the quality of wearisome constancy, routine, and lack of variety
definitions.zh: n. 单调, 缺乏变化

examples.en: The monotony of the job bored him.
examples.zh: 工作的单调让他感到无聊。

examples.en: She tried to break the monotony of her day.
examples.zh: 她试图打破一天的单调。

definitions.en: s. not strict
definitions.zh: a. 宽大的, 温和的, 慈悲为怀的

definitions.en: s. characterized by tolerance and mercy
definitions.zh: [法] 宽大的, 仁慈的

examples.en: The teacher was lenient with late homework.
examples.zh: 老师对迟交作业很宽容。

examples.en: The judge gave a lenient sentence.
examples.zh: 法官做出了宽大的判决。

definitions.en: n. a hollow filled with mud
definitions.zh: n. 泥沼, 沼泽, 蜕下的皮, 腐肉

definitions.en: n. a stagnant swamp (especially as part of a bayou)
definitions.zh: vt. 使陷入泥沼, 使沉沦, 脱落, 抛弃

definitions.en: n. any outer covering that can be shed or cast off (such as the cast-off skin of a snake)
definitions.zh: vi. 在泥浆中跋涉, 蜕皮, 脱落

examples.en: The snake sloughs off its old skin.
examples.zh: 蛇蜕掉了旧皮。

examples.en: He walked through the muddy slough.
examples.zh: 他走过泥泞的沼泽。

definitions.en: n. (folklore) a corpse that rises at night to drink the blood of the living
definitions.zh: n. 吸血鬼
[医] 吸血蝙蝠

examples.en: The vampire comes out at night.
examples.zh: 吸血鬼在夜晚出现。

examples.en: She read a book about vampires.
examples.zh: 她读了一本关于吸血鬼的书。

definitions.en: v. put a law into effect by formal declaration
definitions.zh: vt. 发布, 公布, 发表, 传播
[法] 颁布, 公告, 散播

examples.en: The government promulgated a new law.
examples.zh: 政府颁布了一项新法律。

examples.en: They promulgated the rules to the public.
examples.zh: 他们向公众公布了规则。

definitions.en: v. wander and feed
definitions.zh: n. 粮草, 饲料, 搜寻粮草
vt. 喂, 掠夺, 搜寻粮秣
vi. 搜寻粮草, 掠夺

examples.en: The deer forage for food in winter.
examples.zh: 鹿在冬天寻找食物。

examples.en: They forage for berries in the forest.
examples.zh: 他们在森林里搜寻浆果。

definitions.en: s. having important issues or results
definitions.zh: a. 作为结果的, 随之发生的, 推论的, 间接的, 重大的, 自大的, 傲慢的, 自傲的
[法] 结果的, 相应而生的, 接着发生的

examples.en: The decision was highly consequential.
examples.zh: 这个决定非常重要。

examples.en: He suffered consequential damages.
examples.zh: 他遭受了间接损失。

definitions.en: n meat from a mature domestic sheep
definitions.zh: n. 羊肉

examples.en: We had mutton stew for dinner last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚晚餐吃了羊肉炖菜。

examples.en: Mutton is a common meat in some countries.
examples.zh: 羊肉在一些国家是常见的肉类。

definitions.en: s. enough to be estimated or measured
definitions.zh: a. 可感知的, 可评估的

examples.en: There was an appreciable difference in quality.
examples.zh: 质量上有明显的差异。

examples.en: The change in temperature was appreciable.
examples.zh: 温度的变化是可感知的。

definitions.en: n. the quality of unselfish concern for the welfare of others
definitions.zh: n. 利他主义, 利他

examples.en: Her altruism inspired many people.
examples.zh: 她的利他主义激励了许多人。

examples.en: Altruism is rare in today's world.
examples.zh: 在当今世界，利他主义很罕见。

definitions.en: n. a person who is very poor
definitions.zh: n. 贫民, 靠救济度日者, 穷人, 乞丐
[法] 贫民, 穷人

examples.en: The pauper begged on the street.
examples.zh: 那个穷人在街上乞讨。

examples.en: He died a pauper with no money.
examples.zh: 他身无分文地死于贫困。

definitions.en: n. a public act of denouncing
definitions.zh: n. 谴责, 告发
[经] 废止合同(契约), 宣告合同(契约等)无效

examples.en: His denunciation of corruption was strong.
examples.zh: 他对腐败的谴责很强烈。

examples.en: The speech was a denunciation of war.
examples.zh: 这次演讲是对战争的谴责。

definitions.en: s. easily diffused or spread as from one person to another
definitions.zh: a. 触染性的, 会蔓延的
[医] (接)触(传)染的

examples.en: The flu is highly contagious.
examples.zh: 流感具有高度传染性。

examples.en: Her laughter was contagious.
examples.zh: 她的笑声很有感染力。

definitions.en: n. a person who makes or repairs shoes
definitions.zh: n. 皮匠, 补鞋匠, 笨工匠

examples.en: The cobbler repaired my shoes.
examples.zh: 鞋匠修好了我的鞋。

examples.en: He works as a cobbler in the town.
examples.zh: 他在镇上做鞋匠。

definitions.en: n. any liquid suitable for drinking
definitions.zh: n. 饮料
[化] 饮料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)

examples.en: Tea is a popular beverage in China.
examples.zh: 茶是中国受欢迎的饮料。

examples.en: Would you like a cold beverage?
examples.zh: 你想要一杯冷饮吗？

definitions.en: s. proceeding from natural feeling or impulse without external stimulus
definitions.zh: a. 冲动的, 受感情驱使的, 任性的

definitions.en: s. without forethought
definitions.zh: [医] 冲动的

examples.en: He made an impulsive decision to quit.
examples.zh: 他冲动地决定辞职。

examples.en: She is impulsive and acts without thinking.
examples.zh: 她很冲动，做事不假思索。

definitions.en: n. a small lightweight carriage; drawn by a single horse
definitions.zh: a. 多虫的

definitions.en: s. infested with bugs
definitions.zh: n. 双轮单座轻马车, 四轮单座马车

examples.en: The software is buggy and crashes often.
examples.zh: 这个软件有很多漏洞，经常崩溃。

examples.en: They rode in a horse-drawn buggy.
examples.zh: 他们乘坐了一辆马拉的轻便马车。

definitions.en: n. reciprocal action and reaction
definitions.zh: n. 互相作用, 互相影响
vi. 互相作用

examples.en: The interplay of light and shadow is beautiful.
examples.zh: 光影的相互作用很美。

examples.en: There is an interplay between mind and body.
examples.zh: 身心之间存在相互作用。

definitions.en: v become bloated or swollen or puff up
definitions.zh: a. 发胀的, 浮肿的, 傲慢的

examples.en: He felt bloated after eating too much.
examples.zh: 吃太多后他感到腹胀。

examples.en: The bloated budget was criticized.
examples.zh: 膨胀的预算受到了批评。

definitions.en: n. a protective covering (as for a knife or sword)
definitions.zh: n. 鞘, 叶鞘, 翅鞘

definitions.en: n. an enveloping structure or covering enclosing an animal or plant organ or part
definitions.zh: [化] 护套

examples.en: He put the knife back in its sheath.
examples.zh: 他把刀放回鞘中。

examples.en: The cable has a protective sheath.
examples.zh: 电缆有保护套。

definitions.en: v to look at critically or searchingly, or in minute detail
definitions.zh: vt.vi. 细看, 仔细检查, 审查, 细阅

definitions.en: v examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification
definitions.zh: [法] 细看, 细阅, 仔细检查

examples.en: The teacher scrutinized the student's work.
examples.zh: 老师仔细检查了学生的作业。

examples.en: We must scrutinize the contract carefully.
examples.zh: 我们必须仔细审查合同。

definitions.en: n. one of several parallel sloping beams that support a roof
definitions.zh: n. 椽, 筏夫

definitions.en: v. provide (a ceiling) with rafters
definitions.zh: vt. 装椽于

examples.en: The rafter supports the roof of the house.
examples.zh: 椽子支撑着房子的屋顶。

examples.en: Birds nest in the rafters of the barn.
examples.zh: 鸟在谷仓的椽子上筑巢。

definitions.en: n. knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote
definitions.zh: n. 知识, 眼光

examples.en: Ancient lore is passed down through stories.
examples.zh: 古老的知识通过故事传承下来。

examples.en: He is an expert in local folklore.
examples.zh: 他是当地民间传说的专家。

definitions.en: v devote (oneself) fully to
definitions.zh: vt. 用大字体书写, 独占(市场), 使全神贯注

definitions.en: v consume all of one's attention or time
definitions.zh: [法] 正式誊写, 以大字写, 囤积

examples.en: The book engrossed her completely.
examples.zh: 这本书完全吸引了她。

examples.en: He was engrossed in his work.
examples.zh: 他全神贯注于工作。

definitions.en: n. the statement of a theme in notes of lesser duration (usually half the length of the original)
definitions.zh: n. 减少, 缩小, 减低
[医] 减少, 减小

examples.en: There was a diminution in sales this year.
examples.zh: 今年销售额有所减少。

examples.en: The diminution of noise helped her sleep.
examples.zh: 噪音的减少帮助她入睡。

definitions.en: n. the act of prowling (walking about in a stealthy manner)
definitions.zh: n. 潜行, 徘徊, 悄悄踱步

definitions.en: v. move about in or as if in a predatory manner
definitions.zh: vi. 潜行以觅食, 徘徊

definitions.en: v. loiter about, with no apparent aim
definitions.zh: vt. 徘徊

examples.en: The cat prowls around the house at night.
examples.zh: 猫晚上在房子周围潜行。

examples.en: He went on a prowl for food.
examples.zh: 他出去寻找食物。

definitions.en: n great merriment
definitions.zh: n. 欢笑, 欢乐, 愉快

examples.en: Her joke caused great mirth among us.
examples.zh: 她的笑话让我们非常开心。

examples.en: The room was filled with mirth and laughter.
examples.zh: 房间里充满了欢笑和快乐。

definitions.en: n. doubt about the truth of something
definitions.zh: n. 不轻信, 怀疑, 疑心

examples.en: She stared at him with incredulity.
examples.zh: 她难以置信地盯着他。

examples.en: His story was met with incredulity.
examples.zh: 他的故事遭到了怀疑。

definitions.en: v. convert code into ordinary language
definitions.zh: vt. 解码, 译解
[计] 译码

examples.en: Can you decode this secret message?
examples.zh: 你能解码这条秘密信息吗？

examples.en: The spy tried to decode the file.
examples.zh: 间谍试图解码文件。

definitions.en: n. exact opposite
definitions.zh: n. 对偶, 对照, 对立面

examples.en: Love is the antithesis of hate.
examples.zh: 爱是恨的对立面。

examples.en: His actions were the antithesis of kindness.
examples.zh: 他的行为与善良截然相反。

definitions.en: n. a leopard in the black color phase
definitions.zh: n. 豹, 黑豹, 美洲豹

examples.en: A black panther is a powerful and stealthy cat.
examples.zh: 黑豹是一种强大而隐秘的猫科动物。

examples.en: The panther moved silently through the jungle.
examples.zh: 黑豹无声地穿过丛林。

definitions.en: v make clear and (more) comprehensible
definitions.zh: vt. 阐明, 说明

examples.en: The teacher elucidated the difficult concept.
examples.zh: 老师阐明了这个难懂的概念。

examples.en: He elucidated his plan in detail.
examples.zh: 他详细说明了他的计划。

definitions.en: n. money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage
definitions.zh: n. 嫁妆
[法] 陪嫁物, 嫁妆

examples.en: The bride's family provided a large dowry.
examples.zh: 新娘家提供了丰厚的嫁妆。

examples.en: She brought a small dowry to the marriage.
examples.zh: 她带了一小笔嫁妆结婚。

definitions.en: n. something considered choice to eat
definitions.zh: a. 秀丽的；美味的；讲究的；挑剔的

examples.en: She wore a dainty little dress.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条秀丽的连衣裙。

examples.en: The cake was small and dainty.
examples.zh: 蛋糕小巧而美味。

definitions.en: n a dense growth of bushes
definitions.zh: n. 丛林, 草丛

examples.en: The rabbit hid in the thicket.
examples.zh: 兔子躲在灌木丛中。

examples.en: We walked through a dense thicket.
examples.zh: 我们穿过一片茂密的丛林。

definitions.en: n. one who reveals confidential information in return for money
definitions.zh: n. 密告者, 控告者, 通知者
[法] 控告人, 通知者, 告密者

examples.en: The informer gave the police a tip.
examples.zh: 告密者向警方提供了线索。

examples.en: He was a secret informer for the FBI.
examples.zh: 他是联邦调查局的秘密线人。

definitions.en: n. an implement used to propel or steer a boat
definitions.zh: n. 桨, 桨手, 搅棒
vi. 划桨
vt. 划动

examples.en: He used an oar to row the boat across the lake.
examples.zh: 他用桨划船穿过湖面。

examples.en: The oar broke during the stormy weather.
examples.zh: 桨在暴风雨天气中折断了。

definitions.en: n. flesh of any of various grouse of the family Tetraonidae; usually roasted; flesh too dry to broil
definitions.zh: n. 松鸡, 牢骚

definitions.en: n. popular game bird having a plump body and feathered legs and feet
definitions.zh: vi. 埋怨

examples.en: We saw a grouse in the forest.
examples.zh: 我们在森林里看到一只松鸡。

examples.en: He likes to grouse about the weather.
examples.zh: 他喜欢抱怨天气。

definitions.en: v pose a threat to; present a danger to
definitions.zh: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地

examples.en: Don't jeopardize your health by smoking too much.
examples.zh: 不要因吸烟过多而危害你的健康。

examples.en: His actions could jeopardize the entire project.
examples.zh: 他的行为可能危及整个项目。

definitions.en: n. a horse's manner of moving
definitions.zh: n. 步法, 步态

definitions.en: n. a person's manner of walking
definitions.zh: vt. 训练...的步法

examples.en: The horse had a smooth gait.
examples.zh: 那匹马步态平稳。

examples.en: She walked with a confident gait.
examples.zh: 她以自信的步态行走。

definitions.en: n. building material used as siding or roofing
definitions.zh: n. 墙面板, 小招牌

examples.en: The roof was covered with shingles.
examples.zh: 屋顶覆盖着墙面板。

examples.en: He hung a shingle outside his office.
examples.zh: 他在办公室外挂了一块小招牌。

definitions.en: n. (law) an interest in an estate that reverts to the grantor (or his heirs) at the end of some period (e.g., the death of the grantee)
definitions.zh: n. 回复, 复原, 归还, 继承权

definitions.en: n. (genetics) a return to a normal phenotype (usually resulting from a second mutation)
definitions.zh: [化] 返硫

examples.en: The land reversion occurred after his death.
examples.zh: 他死后土地归还了。

examples.en: The mutation caused a reversion to normal.
examples.zh: 突变导致回复到正常状态。

definitions.en: n. a moderate purple
definitions.zh: n. 苯胺紫, 淡紫色

definitions.en: s. of a pale to moderate greyish violet color
definitions.zh: a. 淡紫色的

examples.en: She painted the room a soft mauve.
examples.zh: 她把房间刷成了柔和的淡紫色。

examples.en: The flowers were a beautiful mauve color.
examples.zh: 花朵是美丽的淡紫色。

definitions.en: n. a native or inhabitant of Bohemia in the Czech Republic
definitions.zh: n. 波希米亚人, 波希米亚语, 放浪者

definitions.en: n. a nonconformist writer or artist who lives an unconventional life
definitions.zh: a. 波希米亚人的, 放浪的, 波希米亚语的

examples.en: He lived a bohemian lifestyle in Paris.
examples.zh: 他在巴黎过着放浪的生活。

examples.en: She is a bohemian artist from Prague.
examples.zh: 她是一位来自布拉格的波希米亚艺术家。

definitions.en: s. purported; commonly put forth or accepted as true on inconclusive grounds
definitions.zh: a. 推定的, 被公认的
[法] 被公认的, 推定的, 假定的

examples.en: The putative father was not the real one.
examples.zh: 推定的父亲并非真正的父亲。

examples.en: The blight destroyed the tomato plants.
examples.zh: 枯萎病毁掉了番茄植株。

examples.en: Poverty blighted their childhood.
examples.zh: 贫困破坏了他们的童年。

definitions.en: n. a group of animals (a herd or flock) moving together
definitions.zh: n. 畜群

definitions.en: n. a moving crowd
definitions.zh: drive的过去式

examples.en: A drove of cattle crossed the road.
examples.zh: 一群牛穿过了马路。

examples.en: Tourists came in droves to see the sight.
examples.zh: 游客成群结队地来看这个景点。

definitions.en: a. willing to be taught or led or supervised or directed
definitions.zh: a. 容易教的, 温顺的

examples.en: The dog is very docile and friendly.
examples.zh: 这只狗很温顺友好。

examples.en: She is a docile student who follows instructions.
examples.zh: 她是个温顺的学生，听从指示。

definitions.en: v affect with wonder
definitions.zh: vt. 使惊骇, 使大惊

examples.en: The magician's trick astounded the audience.
examples.zh: 魔术师的把戏使观众震惊。

examples.en: I am astounded by her talent.
examples.zh: 我对她的才华感到震惊。

definitions.en: s. having inner resources; adroit or imaginative
definitions.zh: a. 资源丰富的, 策略的, 机智的
[法] 资源丰富的, 善于遂机应变的, 足智多谋的

examples.en: She is resourceful and solves problems quickly.
examples.zh: 她足智多谋，能迅速解决问题。

examples.en: A resourceful person can handle any situation.
examples.zh: 一个机智的人能应对任何情况。

definitions.en: s. worthy of religious veneration
definitions.zh: a. 神圣化的, 神圣的

examples.en: This is a hallowed place for many people.
examples.zh: 对许多人来说，这是一个神圣的地方。

examples.en: They walked through the hallowed halls of the temple.
examples.zh: 他们走过寺庙神圣的大厅。

definitions.en: s not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
definitions.zh: a. 事与愿违的, 麻烦的, 困难的, 不幸的

examples.en: Nothing untoward happened during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中没有发生任何麻烦事。

examples.en: His untoward behavior surprised everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 他在聚会上的不当行为让所有人惊讶。

definitions.en: n. a puddle where animals go to wallow
definitions.zh: vi. 打滚, 沉迷, 颠簸

definitions.en: n. an indolent or clumsy rolling about
definitions.zh: n. 打滚, 泥坑, 堕落

examples.en: The pig likes to wallow in the mud.
examples.zh: 猪喜欢在泥里打滚。

examples.en: Don't wallow in self-pity for too long.
examples.zh: 不要长时间沉浸在自怜中。

definitions.en: n. the act of sustaining life by food or providing a means of subsistence
definitions.zh: n. 生活资料, 生计, 食物, 支持
[法] 营养物, 维持, 支持

examples.en: Food provides sustenance for our bodies.
examples.zh: 食物为我们的身体提供营养。

examples.en: They needed sustenance after the long hike.
examples.zh: 长途徒步后他们需要食物。

definitions.en: s. showing effects of planning or manipulation
definitions.zh: a. 人造的, 勉强的, 不自然的

examples.en: The plot of the movie felt contrived.
examples.zh: 电影的情节感觉不自然。

examples.en: Her smile seemed contrived and fake.
examples.zh: 她的微笑显得做作而虚假。

definitions.en: s not fanciful or imaginative
definitions.zh: a. 散文的, 散文体的, 平凡的

examples.en: His writing style is very prosaic and plain.
examples.zh: 他的写作风格非常平淡无奇。

examples.en: She found the lecture too prosaic to enjoy.
examples.zh: 她觉得讲座太乏味，无法享受。

definitions.en: v make unfashionable, outdated, or obsolete
definitions.zh: a. 过时的, 废弃的

definitions.en: s out of fashion
definitions.zh: [经] (式样等)过时的, 废弃了的

examples.en: This old computer is completely outmoded now.
examples.zh: 这台旧电脑现在完全过时了。

examples.en: Outmoded ideas can hold back progress.
examples.zh: 过时的想法会阻碍进步。

definitions.en: n. the feeling of lively and cheerful joy
definitions.zh: n. 令人高兴, 愉快

examples.en: She felt a sense of exhilaration after winning.
examples.zh: 获胜后她感到一阵兴奋。

examples.en: The roller coaster ride brought pure exhilaration.
examples.zh: 过山车带来了纯粹的愉悦。

definitions.en: v. fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 大洪水, 泛滥
vt. 使泛滥

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a deluge in the city.
examples.zh: 大雨在城市里引发了洪水。

examples.en: They received a deluge of emails after the announcement.
examples.zh: 公告后他们收到了大量电子邮件。

definitions.en: v. inflict severe punishment on
definitions.zh: vt. 惩罚, 苛评, 修订

examples.en: The teacher castigated the student for being late.
examples.zh: 老师因学生迟到而严厉批评了他。

examples.en: He was castigated for his careless mistake.
examples.zh: 他因粗心的错误而受到惩罚。

definitions.en: v exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
definitions.zh: a. 制成的, 精细的

definitions.en: v be employed
definitions.zh: work的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The artist wrought a beautiful sculpture from stone.
examples.zh: 艺术家用石头制作了一件美丽的雕塑。

examples.en: Great changes were wrought by the new law.
examples.zh: 新法律带来了巨大的变化。

definitions.en: n a drawback or difficulty that is not readily evident
definitions.zh: n. 暗机关

definitions.en: n something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known
definitions.zh: vt. 耍花招改变, 使暗机关

examples.en: The product's success was just a marketing gimmick.
examples.zh: 这个产品的成功只是一个营销噱头。

examples.en: Don't fall for that cheap gimmick.
examples.zh: 不要被那个廉价的花招所欺骗。

definitions.en: n subtly skillful handling of a situation
definitions.zh: n. 策略, 手段, (桥牌中的)飞牌
v. 用计谋处理, 出小牌

examples.en: She handled the difficult situation with great finesse.
examples.zh: 她以高超的技巧处理了困难局面。

examples.en: His finesse in negotiation impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中的策略给所有人留下了深刻印象。

definitions.en: s. poor enough to need help from others
definitions.zh: a. 穷困的, 缺乏的

examples.en: The family was left destitute after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾后这个家庭变得一无所有。

examples.en: Many people in the area are destitute and need help.
examples.zh: 该地区许多人穷困潦倒，需要帮助。

definitions.en: v be false to; be dishonest with
definitions.zh: vt. 迷惑, 蛊惑

examples.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking it's easy.
examples.zh: 不要欺骗自己认为这很容易。

examples.en: He deluded her with false promises.
examples.zh: 他用虚假的承诺欺骗了她。

definitions.en: n a quarrel about petty points
definitions.zh: vi. 争吵, 口角

definitions.en: v argue over petty things
definitions.zh: n. 争吵, 口角

examples.en: The children squabbled over the toy.
examples.zh: 孩子们为玩具争吵起来。

examples.en: They had a silly squabble about nothing.
examples.zh: 他们为一点小事发生了愚蠢的口角。

definitions.en: v. spin,wind, or twist together
definitions.zh: v. (使)纠缠, (使)缠绕

examples.en: The vines intertwine around the old tree.
examples.zh: 藤蔓缠绕在老树上。

examples.en: Their lives became intertwined after they met.
examples.zh: 他们相遇后生活变得交织在一起。

definitions.en: v. deprive of status or authority
definitions.zh: vt. 使摆脱, 使脱去, 夺去

definitions.en: v. reduce or dispose of; cease to hold (an investment)
definitions.zh: [经] 取消权力

examples.en: The company decided to divest its unprofitable division.
examples.zh: 公司决定剥离其不盈利的部门。

examples.en: He was divested of his authority after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻后他被剥夺了权力。

definitions.en: s showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
definitions.zh: a. 精明的, 谨慎的, 节约的

examples.en: She is a canny investor who never loses money.
examples.zh: 她是一个精明的投资者，从不亏钱。

examples.en: His canny decision saved the company from bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 他精明的决定使公司免于破产。

definitions.en: v make obsolete or old-fashioned
definitions.zh: a. 陈旧的, 过时的, 年老的

examples.en: The school uses antiquated teaching methods.
examples.zh: 这所学校使用过时的教学方法。

examples.en: This antiquated machine needs to be replaced.
examples.zh: 这台陈旧的机器需要更换。

definitions.en: v give in, as to influence or pressure
definitions.zh: vi. 变宽厚, 变温和, 动怜悯之心

examples.en: The storm finally relented after three days.
examples.zh: 暴风雨终于在三天后减弱了。

examples.en: She refused to relent and kept her strict rules.
examples.zh: 她拒绝让步，坚持严格的规定。

definitions.en: a. deriving pleasure or sexual gratification from inflicting pain on another
definitions.zh: a. 虐待狂的, 残酷成性的

examples.en: His sadistic behavior shocked everyone.
examples.zh: 他虐待狂的行为震惊了所有人。

examples.en: The villain in the movie was cruel and sadistic.
examples.zh: 电影中的反派残忍且残酷成性。

definitions.en: s causing disapproval or protest
definitions.zh: a. 可憎的, 使人不愉快的, 令人讨厌的

examples.en: His obnoxious attitude made him unpopular.
examples.zh: 他令人讨厌的态度使他不受欢迎。

examples.en: The obnoxious noise kept everyone awake.
examples.zh: 令人讨厌的噪音让所有人都睡不着。

definitions.en: n. an inoffensive or indirect expression that is substituted for one that is considered offensive or too harsh
definitions.zh: n. 委婉说法, 委婉语

examples.en: They used a euphemism to avoid saying the truth.
examples.zh: 他们用委婉语来避免说出真相。

examples.en: Passed away is a euphemism for died.
examples.zh: 去世是死亡的委婉说法。

definitions.en: n. an acute insufficiency
definitions.zh: n. 缺乏, 粮食不足, 饥馑

examples.en: There is a dearth of clean water in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区缺乏清洁水。

examples.en: The dearth of jobs caused many problems.
examples.zh: 工作机会的缺乏导致了许多问题。

definitions.en: s (usually followed by `to') strongly opposed
definitions.zh: a. 不愿意的, 反对的

examples.en: He is averse to taking any risks.
examples.zh: 他反对承担任何风险。

examples.en: She is not averse to trying new foods.
examples.zh: 她不反对尝试新食物。

definitions.en: s. large in volume or bulk
definitions.zh: a. 卷数多的, 大部头的, 著书多的, 长篇的, 庞大的, 很多的, 盘绕的

examples.en: She wore a voluminous dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件宽松的连衣裙去参加聚会。

examples.en: The author wrote a voluminous history book.
examples.zh: 这位作者写了一部大部头的历史书。

definitions.en: a. not pleasant or acceptable to the taste or mind
definitions.zh: a. 不可口的, 味道差的, 不好吃的

examples.en: The food was unpalatable and bland.
examples.zh: 食物不可口且淡而无味。

examples.en: The truth can sometimes be unpalatable.
examples.zh: 真相有时可能令人难以接受。

definitions.en: s. tending to discourage (especially of prices)
definitions.zh: a. 禁止的, 禁止性的
[经] 禁止性的, 抑制的

examples.en: The cost of the car was prohibitive for them.
examples.zh: 汽车的价格对他们来说高得令人望而却步。

examples.en: Prohibitive laws prevented the sale of alcohol.
examples.zh: 禁止性的法律阻止了酒精销售。

definitions.en: n. joyful enthusiasm
definitions.zh: n. 茂盛, 茂盛的生长物, 丰富

examples.en: The children's exuberance filled the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子们的活力充满了操场。

examples.en: Her exuberance was contagious to everyone.
examples.zh: 她的热情感染了每个人。

definitions.en: n. an event resulting in great loss and misfortune
definitions.zh: n. 灾难, 不幸事件

examples.en: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
examples.zh: 地震是一场可怕的灾难。

examples.en: They survived the calamity with great courage.
examples.zh: 他们以巨大的勇气幸免于这场灾难。

definitions.en: v cause to seem less serious; play down
definitions.zh: vt. 轻视, 贬低

examples.en: Don't belittle his efforts; he tried hard.
examples.zh: 不要贬低他的努力；他尽力了。

examples.en: She felt belittled by her boss's comments.
examples.zh: 她感到被老板的评论轻视了。

definitions.en: s. of the most contemptible kind
definitions.zh: a. 绝望无助的, 可怜的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的

definitions.en: s. most unfortunate or miserable
definitions.zh: [法] 卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可怜的

examples.en: He lived in abject poverty for many years.
examples.zh: 他多年生活在赤贫中。

examples.en: The abject apology did not satisfy her.
examples.zh: 卑微的道歉没有让她满意。

definitions.en: n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 20 grains
definitions.zh: n. 踌躇, 犹豫, 微量

definitions.en: n. uneasiness about the fitness of an action
definitions.zh: vi. 踌躇, 有顾忌

examples.en: He had no scruple about lying to get ahead.
examples.zh: 他对为了成功而撒谎毫无顾忌。

examples.en: She scrupled to accept the money without working.
examples.zh: 她对于不劳而获地接受这笔钱感到犹豫。

definitions.en: v. have a long or continuing effect
definitions.zh: vi. 回响, 反响, 被反射

definitions.en: v. be reflected as heat, sound, or light or shock waves
definitions.zh: vt. 使反响, 使回响, 反射

definitions.en: v. treat, process, heat, melt, or refine in a reverberatory furnace
definitions.zh: a. 回响的, 反射的

examples.en: The sound of the bell reverberated through the hall.
examples.zh: 钟声在大厅里回响。

examples.en: The news reverberated across the entire country.
examples.zh: 这个消息在全国引起了反响。

definitions.en: v declare invalid
definitions.zh: vt. 使无效, 废弃, 取消

definitions.en: v show to be invalid
definitions.zh: [化] 使等于零; 作废

examples.en: The new law will nullify the old one.
examples.zh: 新法律将废除旧法律。

examples.en: The court decided to nullify the contract.
examples.zh: 法院决定宣布合同无效。

definitions.en: s. skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
definitions.zh: a. 敏捷熟练的, 灵巧的

examples.en: The surgeon's deft hands performed the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生灵巧的双手进行了手术。

examples.en: She gave a deft reply to the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她对那个难题给出了巧妙的回答。

definitions.en: n. someone who censures or condemns
definitions.zh: n. 检查员

definitions.en: n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
definitions.zh: vt. 检查, 审查, 删改

examples.en: The censor removed some scenes from the film.
examples.zh: 审查员删除了电影中的一些场景。

examples.en: They censor all letters before sending them.
examples.zh: 他们在寄出前审查所有信件。

definitions.en: s chronologically misplaced
definitions.zh: a. 时代错误的

examples.en: Using a quill pen today seems anachronistic.
examples.zh: 今天使用羽毛笔似乎不合时宜。

examples.en: The movie had an anachronistic scene with a smartphone.
examples.zh: 电影中有一个出现智能手机的时代错误场景。

definitions.en: v. give new life or energy to
definitions.zh: vt. 使有生气, 赋予生命

definitions.en: a. belonging to the class of nouns that denote living beings
definitions.zh: a. 有生命的, 有生气的

examples.en: Her smile seemed to animate her whole face.
examples.zh: 她的微笑似乎让她整张脸都生动起来。

examples.en: The cartoon characters are animated by computers.
examples.zh: 卡通角色由电脑赋予生命。

definitions.en: v do without or cease to hold or adhere to
definitions.zh: vt. 摒绝, 放弃

examples.en: I will forgo dessert to save calories.
examples.zh: 我将放弃甜点以节省热量。

examples.en: They decided to forgo the trip due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气不好，他们决定放弃旅行。

definitions.en: v attract; cause to be enamored
definitions.zh: vt. 迷住, 迷惑

examples.en: The beautiful music captivated the audience.
examples.zh: 优美的音乐迷住了观众。

examples.en: Her story captivated everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的故事吸引了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: v. make keen or more acute
definitions.zh: n. 磨, 开胃小吃

definitions.en: v. sharpen by rubbing, as on a whetstone
definitions.zh: vt. 磨, 磨快, 刺激, 促进

examples.en: He used a stone to whet the knife.
examples.zh: 他用一块石头磨刀。

examples.en: The story will whet your appetite for adventure.
examples.zh: 这个故事会激起你对冒险的渴望。

definitions.en: s invulnerable to fear or intimidation
definitions.zh: a. 无畏的, 勇猛的

examples.en: The intrepid explorer climbed the highest mountain.
examples.zh: 无畏的探险家爬上了最高的山。

examples.en: She is an intrepid journalist reporting from war zones.
examples.zh: 她是一名在战区报道的无畏记者。

definitions.en: n an indirect (and usually malicious) implication
definitions.zh: n. 讽刺, 暗讽
vi. 说讽刺话
vt. 暗示

examples.en: His comment was full of innuendo about her past.
examples.zh: 他的评论充满了对她过去的暗讽。

examples.en: She ignored the innuendo and continued her work.
examples.zh: 她无视了暗讽，继续她的工作。

definitions.en: v. remove surgically
definitions.zh: vt. 切断, 删除

examples.en: The doctor had to amputate his leg to save him.
examples.zh: 医生不得不截掉他的腿来救他。

examples.en: They will amputate the infected finger tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他们明天将截掉感染的手指。

definitions.en: n a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
definitions.zh: n. 格言, 谚语

examples.en: The old adage says time heals all wounds.
examples.zh: 老谚语说时间能治愈一切创伤。

examples.en: She lives by the adage 'honesty is the best policy'.
examples.zh: 她遵循‘诚实为上策’这句格言生活。

definitions.en: v. toss, roll, or rise and fall in an uncontrolled way
definitions.zh: vi. 翻滚, 滚动, 沉溺, 浸湿, 起伏

definitions.en: v. be immersed in
definitions.zh: n. 翻滚, 汹涌, 混乱, 起伏, 重量级骑手

examples.en: The ship weltered in the stormy sea.
examples.zh: 船在暴风雨的海上翻滚。

examples.en: He weltered in a sea of paperwork all day.
examples.zh: 他整天沉溺于一大堆文书工作中。

definitions.en: n. an implement for practical use (especially in a household)
definitions.zh: n. 器皿, 用具

examples.en: A knife is a useful kitchen utensil.
examples.zh: 刀是一种有用的厨房用具。

examples.en: She washed every utensil after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后她洗了每一件器皿。

definitions.en: s brief and to the point; effectively cut short; `yes'"
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 扼要的

examples.en: His terse reply was just 'yes' or 'no'.
examples.zh: 他简洁的回答只是‘是’或‘不是’。

examples.en: She gave a terse summary of the meeting.
examples.zh: 她对会议做了一个简洁的总结。

definitions.en: n. comfort in disappointment or misery
definitions.zh: n. 安慰, 安慰之物
vt. 安慰, 抚慰, 给与安慰, 使轻松

examples.en: Music provides solace during difficult times.
examples.zh: 音乐在困难时期提供安慰。

examples.en: She found solace in her friend's kind words.
examples.zh: 她在朋友善意的话语中找到了安慰。

definitions.en: n. a crosspiece between the legs of a chair
definitions.zh: n. (梯子)踏步, 横档, 轮辐, 粗棍
ring的过去分词

examples.en: He stepped on the bottom rung of the ladder.
examples.zh: 他踩在梯子的最底横档上。

examples.en: The chair's rung broke when he sat down.
examples.zh: 他坐下时椅子的横档断了。

definitions.en: s incongruous; inviting ridicule
definitions.zh: a. 反常的, 乖戾的, 荒谬的, 首末倒置的

examples.en: That idea is completely preposterous and impossible.
examples.zh: 那个想法完全荒谬且不可能。

examples.en: She laughed at his preposterous suggestion.
examples.zh: 她嘲笑他荒谬的建议。

definitions.en: n. a passage selected from a larger work
definitions.zh: n. 摘录

definitions.en: v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy
definitions.zh: v. 引用, 摘录

examples.en: He read an excerpt from the novel aloud.
examples.zh: 他大声朗读了小说的一段摘录。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to excerpt key points.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们摘录关键点。

definitions.en: v. kill one in every ten, as of mutineers in Roman armies
definitions.zh: vt. 每十人杀一人, 大批杀害

examples.en: The disease could decimate the entire population.
examples.zh: 这种疾病可能大批杀害整个种群。

examples.en: The army was decimated in the fierce battle.
examples.zh: 军队在激烈的战斗中遭受重创。

definitions.en: v. give personal assurance; guarantee
definitions.zh: vi. 担保, 保证, 证明, 确定地说

definitions.en: v. summon (a vouchee) into court to warrant or defend a title
definitions.zh: vt. 担保, 证明, 断定, 传唤...出庭作证

examples.en: I can vouch for his honesty and hard work.
examples.zh: 我可以担保他的诚实和勤奋。

examples.en: She will vouch that he was at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她会证明他当时在会议上。

definitions.en: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
definitions.zh: n. 高手, 专家

definitions.en: a of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill
definitions.zh: a. 精通的, 熟练的

examples.en: She is proficient in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 她精通弹钢琴。

examples.en: He became proficient at using computers.
examples.zh: 他变得熟练使用电脑。

definitions.en: n. an instance of intense argument (as in bargaining)
definitions.zh: vi. 争论, 杀价

definitions.en: v. wrangle (over a price, terms of an agreement, etc.)
definitions.zh: vt. 乱砍, 乱劈
n. 杀价, 讨论, 争论

examples.en: They haggled over the price of the car.
examples.zh: 他们就汽车的价格讨价还价。

examples.en: She hates to haggle at the market.
examples.zh: 她讨厌在市场里杀价。

definitions.en: s. giving only major points; lacking completeness
definitions.zh: a. 概略的, 草草完成的

examples.en: The report was too sketchy to be useful.
examples.zh: 报告太概略了，没什么用。

examples.en: He gave a sketchy description of the event.
examples.zh: 他对事件做了一个概略的描述。

definitions.en: a. difficult to use or handle or manage because of size or weight or shape
definitions.zh: a. 难处理的, 笨大难使用的, 笨拙的

examples.en: The box was too unwieldy to carry alone.
examples.zh: 箱子太笨重了，一个人搬不动。

examples.en: The new software is unwieldy and difficult to use.
examples.zh: 新软件笨拙难用。

definitions.en: s briefly giving the gist of something
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 紧缩的

examples.en: Her speech was succinct and very clear.
examples.zh: 她的演讲简洁明了。

examples.en: He gave a succinct answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他对问题给出了一个简洁的回答。

definitions.en: v. recall the past
definitions.zh: vt. 追忆说
vi. 追忆往事, 话旧

examples.en: They reminisced about their childhood together.
examples.zh: 他们一起追忆童年往事。

examples.en: She likes to reminisce about her college days.
examples.zh: 她喜欢追忆她的大学时光。

definitions.en: n. (Greek mythology) the goddess of healing; daughter of Aesculapius and sister of Hygeia
definitions.zh: n. 万能药, 灵丹妙药

definitions.en: n. hypothetical remedy for all ills or diseases; once sought by the alchemists
definitions.zh: [医] 万应药

examples.en: There is no panacea for all problems.
examples.zh: 没有能解决所有问题的万能药。

examples.en: People often seek a panacea for their troubles.
examples.zh: 人们常常为烦恼寻找灵丹妙药。

definitions.en: a. favorable to life and growth
definitions.zh: a. 好客的, 招待周到的

examples.en: The local people are very hospitable to visitors.
examples.zh: 当地人对游客非常热情好客。

examples.en: They live in a hospitable climate.
examples.zh: 他们生活在宜人的气候中。

definitions.en: s. stubbornly unyielding
definitions.zh: a. 顽固的, 顽强的

examples.en: His dogged determination helped him succeed.
examples.zh: 他顽强的决心帮助他成功了。

examples.en: She showed dogged persistence in her studies.
examples.zh: 她在学习中表现出顽强的毅力。

definitions.en: n. violent uncontrollable contractions of muscles
definitions.zh: n. 震动, 震撼, 动乱, 惊厥, 痉挛

definitions.en: n. a violent disturbance
definitions.zh: [医] 惊厥, 抽搐

examples.en: The patient had a convulsion and fell down.
examples.zh: 病人抽搐了一下，倒在地上。

examples.en: The country was in a convulsion after the war.
examples.zh: 战后这个国家陷入了动乱。

definitions.en: v. adjust or accustom to; bring into harmony with
definitions.zh: vt. 为乐器调音, 使协调, 使合拍

examples.en: She tried to attune her ears to the music.
examples.zh: 她试图让耳朵适应音乐。

examples.en: We must attune our plans to the new rules.
examples.zh: 我们必须使计划与新规则协调。

definitions.en: n persistent determination
definitions.zh: n. 固执, 不屈不挠, 顽固, 黏性, 韧性
[机] 坚轫

examples.en: Her tenacity helped her finish the marathon.
examples.zh: 她的坚韧帮助她完成了马拉松。

examples.en: He showed great tenacity in solving the problem.
examples.zh: 他在解决问题时表现出极大的不屈不挠。

definitions.en: n. a party of guests wearing costumes and masks
definitions.zh: n. 化装舞会, 伪装

definitions.en: n. making a false outward show
definitions.zh: vi. 参加化装舞会, 伪装, 假装

examples.en: They attended a masquerade ball last night.
examples.zh: 他们昨晚参加了一个化装舞会。

examples.en: His kindness was just a masquerade for greed.
examples.zh: 他的善良只是贪婪的伪装。

definitions.en: s. suitable for cutting or piercing
definitions.zh: a. 敏锐的, 机敏的, 激烈的, 切入的, 锋利的
[医] 切牙的, 切的

examples.en: She made an incisive comment about the issue.
examples.zh: 她对这个问题发表了敏锐的评论。

examples.en: His incisive analysis impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 他敏锐的分析给所有人留下了印象。

definitions.en: a. not precise
definitions.zh: a. 不严密的, 不精确的, 不明确的

examples.en: The measurements were imprecise and unreliable.
examples.zh: 测量不精确且不可靠。

examples.en: His imprecise language caused confusion.
examples.zh: 他不精确的语言造成了混乱。

definitions.en: v keep from happening or arising; make impossible
definitions.zh: vt. 预先阻止, 先...一步行动, 占先一步, 垄断, 阻碍

definitions.en: v act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
definitions.zh: [法] 先采取行动预防或阻止, 垄断

examples.en: They acted quickly to forestall any problems.
examples.zh: 他们迅速行动以预先阻止任何问题。

examples.en: She forestalled his criticism by apologizing first.
examples.zh: 她先道歉，阻止了他的批评。

definitions.en: n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
definitions.zh: n. 木材, 破旧家俱, 废物, 隆隆声

definitions.en: v. move heavily or clumsily
definitions.zh: vt. 砍伐木材, 乱堆
vi. 笨拙地移动, 喧闹地向前走, 隆隆地移动

examples.en: They used lumber to build the house.
examples.zh: 他们用木材建造房子。

examples.en: The bear began to lumber through the woods.
examples.zh: 熊开始笨重地穿过树林。

definitions.en: s. marked by strong resentment or cynicism
definitions.zh: a. 尖刻的, 讥讽的, 激烈的

examples.en: The debate became acrimonious and personal.
examples.zh: 辩论变得尖刻且针对个人。

examples.en: They had an acrimonious divorce settlement.
examples.zh: 他们有一个尖刻的离婚协议。

definitions.en: s. without cause
definitions.zh: a. 免费的, 无理由的

definitions.en: s. unnecessary and unwarranted
definitions.zh: [经] 无代价的

examples.en: The movie contained gratuitous violence.
examples.zh: 电影包含了无理由的暴力。

examples.en: His gratuitous advice was not appreciated.
examples.zh: 他无理由的建议不被欣赏。

definitions.en: n. English aeronautical engineer who invented the jet aircraft engine (1907-1996)
definitions.zh: vt. 逐渐削薄, 削整, 削弱, 削减

definitions.en: v. cut small bits or pare shavings from
definitions.zh: vi. 削木头
n. 大刀, 屠刀

examples.en: He likes to whittle wood into small figures.
examples.zh: 他喜欢把木头削成小雕像。

examples.en: They whittled down the list to ten candidates.
examples.zh: 他们把名单削减到十个候选人。

definitions.en: v. move unsteadily, with a rocking motion
definitions.zh: vi. 步履不稳地走动, 踉跄, 摇晃, 摇摆不定, 摇摇欲坠, 玩跷跷板
n. 踉跄, 摇摆, 跷跷板

examples.en: The child teetered on the edge of the bed.
examples.zh: 孩子在床沿上摇摇晃晃。

examples.en: The company is teetering on the brink of bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 公司正摇摇欲坠地处于破产边缘。

definitions.en: s being essentially equal to something
definitions.zh: a. 同等的, 相等的, 相当于...的
[法] 相等的, 相当的, 同等的

examples.en: His silence was tantamount to admitting guilt.
examples.zh: 他的沉默等同于承认有罪。

examples.en: Refusing help is tantamount to giving up.
examples.zh: 拒绝帮助等同于放弃。

definitions.en: v. throw away, of something encumbering
definitions.zh: n. 投弃, 投弃货物

definitions.en: v. throw as from an airplane
definitions.zh: [经] 抛弃, 船货投海

examples.en: The plane had to jettison fuel to land safely.
examples.zh: 飞机不得不抛弃燃料以安全着陆。

examples.en: They jettisoned the old plan for a new one.
examples.zh: 他们抛弃了旧计划，采用新计划。

definitions.en: s excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
definitions.zh: a. 发狂的, 狂热的
n. 发狂者

examples.en: The frenetic pace of city life exhausted her.
examples.zh: 城市生活狂热的节奏让她筋疲力尽。

examples.en: He worked at a frenetic speed to finish on time.
examples.zh: 他以狂热的速度工作以按时完成。

definitions.en: s. occurring by happy chance
definitions.zh: a. 偶然的
[医] 偶然的, 机会的

examples.en: Their meeting was entirely fortuitous.
examples.zh: 他们的相遇完全是偶然的。

examples.en: A fortuitous discovery led to a new invention.
examples.zh: 一个偶然的发现导致了一项新发明。

definitions.en: v mar or spoil the appearance of
definitions.zh: vt. 毁损...的外形, 玷污, 损害, 毁损...的容貌
[法] 损毁容颜, 破相

examples.en: The accident disfigured his face badly.
examples.zh: 事故严重毁损了他的容貌。

examples.en: Graffiti can disfigure public buildings.
examples.zh: 涂鸦会玷污公共建筑的外观。

definitions.en: n. adroitness in using the hands
definitions.zh: n. 灵巧, 机敏

examples.en: She showed great dexterity in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 她在弹钢琴时表现出极大的灵巧。

examples.en: The surgeon's dexterity saved the patient's life.
examples.zh: 外科医生的灵巧救了病人的命。

definitions.en: n. an equal exchange
definitions.zh: n. 物物交换, 实物交易

definitions.en: v. exchange goods without involving money
definitions.zh: v. 物物交换, 交换

examples.en: They used barter to trade goods without money.
examples.zh: 他们用物物交换来交易货物，不用钱。

examples.en: In some villages, people still barter for food.
examples.zh: 在一些村庄，人们仍然用物物交换换取食物。

definitions.en: s. shockingly brutal or cruel
definitions.zh: a. 残暴的, 凶恶的

examples.en: The crime was atrocious and shocked everyone.
examples.zh: 罪行残暴，震惊了所有人。

examples.en: The weather was atrocious during the entire trip.
examples.zh: 整个旅行期间天气恶劣。

definitions.en: s. dependable
definitions.zh: n. 健壮的人

definitions.en: s. used especially of persons
definitions.zh: a. 高大结实的, 坚定的

examples.en: He is a stalwart supporter of the team.
examples.zh: 他是球队的坚定支持者。

examples.en: The stalwart guard stood at the door.
examples.zh: 那个健壮的警卫站在门口。

definitions.en: a. ready for service or able to give long service
definitions.zh: a. 有用的, 耐用的

definitions.en: s. capable of being put to good use
definitions.zh: [化] 能操作的

examples.en: This old car is still serviceable.
examples.zh: 这辆旧车仍然耐用。

examples.en: She wore a serviceable coat for hiking.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件耐用的外套去徒步。

definitions.en: n. a deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture)
definitions.zh: n. 计策, 谋略, 诡计
[法] 诡计, 计策

examples.en: His excuse was just a clever ruse.
examples.zh: 他的借口只是个聪明的计策。

examples.en: She used a ruse to avoid the party.
examples.zh: 她用了一个诡计来避开派对。

definitions.en: v. beat through cleverness and wit
definitions.zh: vt. 瞒骗, 以智取胜

examples.en: The fox outwitted the hunter easily.
examples.zh: 狐狸轻松地以智取胜了猎人。

examples.en: She outwitted her opponent in the game.
examples.zh: 她在游戏中以智取胜了对手。

definitions.en: n. a laborer who moves from place to place as demanded by employment
definitions.zh: a. 巡回的

definitions.en: s. traveling from place to place to work
definitions.zh: n. 巡回者

examples.en: The itinerant worker moved from farm to farm.
examples.zh: 那个巡回工人从一个农场搬到另一个。

examples.en: He lived as an itinerant musician for years.
examples.zh: 他作为巡回音乐家生活了多年。

definitions.en: v cause to seem less serious; play down
definitions.zh: vt. 使变黑, 玷污, 诋毁

examples.en: Do not denigrate your coworkers publicly.
examples.zh: 不要公开诋毁你的同事。

examples.en: He tried to denigrate her achievements.
examples.zh: 他试图诋毁她的成就。

definitions.en: v. fuse or cause to grow together
definitions.zh: vi. 合并, 联合, 合生
[计] 结合

examples.en: The two groups coalesced into one team.
examples.zh: 这两个团体合并成了一个团队。

examples.en: Their ideas coalesced into a clear plan.
examples.zh: 他们的想法合并成了一个清晰的计划。

definitions.en: n. engraving or carving in low relief on a stone (as in a brooch or ring)
definitions.zh: n. 刻有浮雕的宝石或贝壳

examples.en: She wore a beautiful cameo brooch.
examples.zh: 她戴了一枚美丽的浮雕宝石胸针。

examples.en: The actor made a cameo in the movie.
examples.zh: 那位演员在电影中客串了一个角色。

definitions.en: n. the state of being under the control of a force or influence or abstract power
definitions.zh: n. 奴役, 束缚

definitions.en: n. the state of being under the control of another person
definitions.zh: [法] 束缚, 监禁, 奴隶

examples.en: They lived in bondage for many years.
examples.zh: 他们在奴役中生活了许多年。

examples.en: He escaped from the bondage of debt.
examples.zh: 他摆脱了债务的束缚。

definitions.en: s disposed to seek revenge or intended for revenge
definitions.zh: a. 有报仇心的, 怀恨的, 惩罚的

definitions.en: s showing malicious ill will and a desire to hurt; motivated by spite
definitions.zh: [法] 报复的, 有报仇心的, 复仇的

examples.en: She gave him a vindictive look after the argument.
examples.zh: 争吵后她给了他一个怀恨的眼神。

examples.en: His vindictive actions only made things worse.
examples.zh: 他报复性的行为只会让事情更糟。

definitions.en: v. color lightly
definitions.zh: n. 色彩, 浅色
vt. 染色于

examples.en: She added a blue tint to the paint.
examples.zh: 她在颜料中加入了一点蓝色色彩。

examples.en: The windows have a slight green tint.
examples.zh: 窗户带有一点浅绿色。

definitions.en: s produced or growing in extreme abundance
definitions.zh: a. 引起骚扰的, 暴乱的, 放荡的

examples.en: The party was riotous and full of laughter.
examples.zh: 派对很喧闹，充满了笑声。

examples.en: Riotous behavior is not allowed in school.
examples.zh: 学校里不允许有暴乱行为。

definitions.en: n. descriptive word or phrase
definitions.zh: n. 浑名, 绰号, 称号

examples.en: He earned the epithet 'the Brave'.
examples.zh: 他赢得了“勇敢者”的称号。

examples.en: She used a rude epithet in anger.
examples.zh: 她愤怒中用了粗鲁的绰号。

definitions.en: n. (music) a gradual increase in loudness
definitions.zh: n. 声音渐强

examples.en: The music reached a loud crescendo.
examples.zh: 音乐达到了响亮的声音渐强。

examples.en: The crowd's cheers grew to a crescendo.
examples.zh: 人群的欢呼声逐渐增强。

definitions.en: v. treat or speak of with contempt
definitions.zh: vt. 嘲弄, 嘲笑

examples.en: They deride his efforts to learn English.
examples.zh: 他们嘲笑他学习英语的努力。

examples.en: Do not deride others for their mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑别人的错误。

definitions.en: n. reclaimed wool fiber
definitions.zh: a. 用长弹毛做的, 以次充好的
n. 长弹毛, 软再生毛, 赝品

examples.en: The shoddy workmanship disappointed everyone.
examples.zh: 以次充好的工艺让所有人失望。

examples.en: He bought a shoddy product that broke quickly.
examples.zh: 他买了一个以次充好的产品，很快就坏了。

definitions.en: n. fabric comprising a fitted part at the top of a garment
definitions.zh: n. 轭, 牛轭, 束缚

definitions.en: n. an oppressive power
definitions.zh: vt. 给...上轭, 连接, 结合, 使匹配

definitions.en: n. a pair of draft animals joined by a yoke
definitions.zh: vi. 结合, 匹配

examples.en: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen.
examples.zh: 农夫给牛套上轭。

examples.en: They tried to yoke the two ideas together.
examples.zh: 他们试图把这两个想法结合起来。

definitions.en: s. without or almost without hope
definitions.zh: a. 丧气的, 失望的, 没有精神的

examples.en: She felt despondent after failing the test.
examples.zh: 考试失败后她感到丧气。

examples.en: He became despondent about his future.
examples.zh: 他对自己的未来变得失望。

definitions.en: n. a garment made of motley (especially a court jester's costume)
definitions.zh: a. 杂色的, 穿杂色衣的, 杂乱的, 混杂的

definitions.en: n. a multicolored woolen fabric woven of mixed threads in 14th to 17th century England
definitions.zh: n. 杂色, 杂色衣服, 混杂, 小丑

examples.en: The crowd was a motley group of people.
examples.zh: 人群是一群混杂的人。

examples.en: He wore a motley coat of many colors.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件杂色的外套。

definitions.en: a. characterized by lack of decision and firmness
definitions.zh: a. 非决定性的, 犹豫不决的, 不明确的

examples.en: She is too indecisive to choose a restaurant.
examples.zh: 她太犹豫不决，无法选择餐厅。

examples.en: His indecisive nature frustrates his friends.
examples.zh: 他犹豫不决的性格让朋友沮丧。

definitions.en: a. giving careful attention to detail; hard to please; excessively concerned with cleanliness
definitions.zh: a. 难取悦的, 挑剔的, 苛求的

examples.en: She is fastidious about her appearance.
examples.zh: 她对她的外表很挑剔。

examples.en: He is a fastidious eater who dislikes mess.
examples.zh: 他是个挑剔的食客，不喜欢杂乱。

definitions.en: s. of an incalculable amount
definitions.zh: a. 未说过的, 未透露的, 未加叙述的, 数不清的, 无限的, 不可计量的, 无数的
[法] 未说明的, 未方露的, 未说出的

examples.en: The storm caused untold damage to the city.
examples.zh: 风暴给城市造成了数不清的损失。

examples.en: She has untold wealth hidden away.
examples.zh: 她藏有数不清的财富。

definitions.en: s having great beauty and splendor
definitions.zh: a. 辉煌的, 灿烂的

examples.en: The palace was resplendent with gold decorations.
examples.zh: 宫殿因金色装饰而辉煌灿烂。

examples.en: She looked resplendent in her wedding dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着婚纱看起来辉煌灿烂。

definitions.en: s in deplorable condition
definitions.zh: a. 象要倒的, 摇晃的, 放荡的

examples.en: They lived in a ramshackle old house.
examples.zh: 他们住在一间摇晃的老房子里。

examples.en: The ramshackle fence fell down in the wind.
examples.zh: 摇晃的篱笆在风中倒下了。

definitions.en: a. capable of being perceived; especially capable of being handled or touched or felt
definitions.zh: a. 可感知的, 明显的, 触摸得到的

definitions.en: s. can be felt by palpation
definitions.zh: [医] 可触知的

examples.en: The tension in the room was palpable.
examples.zh: 房间里的紧张气氛是可感知的。

examples.en: There was a palpable sense of relief.
examples.zh: 有一种明显的解脱感。

definitions.en: v. persist stubbornly
definitions.zh: a. 倔强的, 顽固的, 不让步的

examples.en: The obstinate child refused to eat vegetables.
examples.zh: 这个倔强的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。

examples.en: He is obstinate and never changes his mind.
examples.zh: 他很顽固，从不改变主意。

definitions.en: s. feeling or showing extreme anger
definitions.zh: a. 发怒的, 生气的

examples.en: The irate customer demanded a refund.
examples.zh: 发怒的顾客要求退款。

examples.en: She was irate about the delayed flight.
examples.zh: 她对航班延误感到生气。

definitions.en: s. not far removed from or suggestive of nature
definitions.zh: a. 土的, 土质的, 土味的

examples.en: The wine has an earthy flavor.
examples.zh: 这酒有一种土味。

examples.en: He has an earthy sense of humor.
examples.zh: 他有种土气的幽默感。

definitions.en: n. a person from your own country
definitions.zh: n. 同国人
a. 同国的, 同胞的

examples.en: I met a compatriot while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 我在国外旅行时遇到了一位同胞。

examples.en: My compatriot helped me understand the local culture.
examples.zh: 我的同胞帮我理解了当地文化。

definitions.en: n. an alloy of mercury with another metal (usually silver) used by dentists to fill cavities in teeth; except for iron and platinum all metals dissolve in mercury and chemists refer to the resulting mercury mixtures as amalgams
definitions.zh: n. 汞合金, 汞齐

definitions.en: n. a combination or blend of diverse things
definitions.zh: [化] 汞齐; 汞合金

examples.en: The team was an amalgam of different skills.
examples.zh: 这个团队是不同技能的混合体。

examples.en: Dentists use amalgam for fillings.
examples.zh: 牙医使用汞合金做填充物。

definitions.en: n a cruel and brutal fellow
definitions.zh: n. 好吵闹的人

definitions.en: s disturbing the public peace; loud and rough
definitions.zh: a. 吵闹的

examples.en: The rowdy children ran through the hall.
examples.zh: 吵闹的孩子们跑过大厅。

examples.en: A rowdy crowd gathered outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 一群吵闹的人聚集在体育场外。

definitions.en: s. so strong as to be irresistible
definitions.zh: a. 无法抵抗的, 压倒性的, 强烈得使人无法忍受的

examples.en: The smell of garlic was overpowering.
examples.zh: 大蒜的气味无法抵抗。

examples.en: She felt an overpowering urge to sleep.
examples.zh: 她感到一种无法抵抗的睡意。

definitions.en: v. make politically neutral and thus inoffensive
definitions.zh: vt. 使中立, 使成中立地带, 使中和, 抵销

definitions.en: v. make ineffective by counterbalancing the effect of
definitions.zh: vi. 中立化, 变无效, 中和

examples.en: The medicine helps neutralize the acid.
examples.zh: 这种药有助于中和酸。

examples.en: They tried to neutralize the threat quickly.
examples.zh: 他们试图迅速消除威胁。

definitions.en: s tastelessly showy
definitions.zh: a. 穿着花哨的, 炫耀的, 过分装饰的

examples.en: The garish colors hurt my eyes.
examples.zh: 花哨的颜色刺痛了我的眼睛。

examples.en: She wore a garish dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件花哨的裙子去派对。

definitions.en: n. a word acted out in an episode of the game of charades
definitions.zh: n. 字谜游戏

examples.en: They played charade at the party.
examples.zh: 他们在派对上玩字谜游戏。

examples.en: His apology was just a charade.
examples.zh: 他的道歉只是个伪装。

definitions.en: n. a mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something (especially on a person's body)
definitions.zh: n. 污点, 缺点

definitions.en: v. mar or impair with a flaw
definitions.zh: vt. 弄脏, 玷污, 损害

examples.en: She had a small blemish on her cheek.
examples.zh: 她脸颊上有一个小污点。

examples.en: The accident blemished his perfect record.
examples.zh: 那次事故玷污了他的完美记录。

definitions.en: r. without delay; in a summary manner
definitions.zh: adv. 概要地, 概略地, 立刻

examples.en: He was summarily dismissed from his job.
examples.zh: 他被立刻解雇了。

examples.en: The judge summarily rejected the appeal.
examples.zh: 法官立刻驳回了上诉。

definitions.en: a. relating to or involving ships or shipping or navigation or seamen
definitions.zh: a. 海上的, 航海的, 船员的

examples.en: He loves nautical adventures on the sea.
examples.zh: 他喜欢海上的航海冒险。

examples.en: The room had a nautical theme with anchors.
examples.zh: 房间有航海主题，装饰着锚。

definitions.en: a. showing unselfish concern for the welfare of others
definitions.zh: a. 利他的, 无私心的

examples.en: Her altruistic nature made her help others.
examples.zh: 她利他的天性让她帮助他人。

examples.en: He performed an altruistic act of kindness.
examples.zh: 他做了一件无私的善举。

definitions.en: n. a state of great suffering and distress due to adversity
definitions.zh: n. 苦恼, 折磨, 苦恼的事由

examples.en: He suffered from a painful affliction.
examples.zh: 他遭受了一种痛苦的折磨。

examples.en: Poverty is a common affliction in many areas.
examples.zh: 贫困是许多地区的常见苦恼。

definitions.en: n. a predisposition in favor of something
definitions.zh: n. 嗜好, 偏爱

examples.en: She has a predilection for spicy food.
examples.zh: 她对辣食有偏爱。

examples.en: His predilection for jazz music is well known.
examples.zh: 他对爵士乐的偏爱是众所周知的。

definitions.en: n an insufficient quantity or number
definitions.zh: n. 少数, 少量, 缺乏

examples.en: There is a paucity of clean water here.
examples.zh: 这里缺乏干净的水。

examples.en: The paucity of evidence led to his release.
examples.zh: 证据的缺乏导致他被释放。

definitions.en: v force somebody to do something
definitions.zh: a. 乐于施惠的, 体贴的, 有礼貌的

examples.en: The obliging waiter helped us with the menu.
examples.zh: 乐于施惠的服务员帮我们看菜单。

examples.en: She is an obliging person who always assists.
examples.zh: 她是个乐于施惠的人，总是帮忙。

definitions.en: v. harass or assault sexually; make indecent advances to
definitions.zh: vt. 妨碍, 干扰, 调戏
[法] 调戏, 作弄, 恶意干涉

examples.en: It is wrong to molest anyone.
examples.zh: 骚扰任何人都是错误的。

examples.en: The law punishes those who molest others.
examples.zh: 法律惩罚那些骚扰他人的人。

definitions.en: s. greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
definitions.zh: a. 过度的, 过高的, 过分的

examples.en: The price of that car is exorbitant.
examples.zh: 那辆车的价格过高。

examples.en: They charged an exorbitant fee for the service.
examples.zh: 他们对这项服务收取了过高的费用。

definitions.en: n. willful negligence
definitions.zh: n. 玩忽职守, 抛弃物
[法] 抛弃, 遗弃, 放弃

examples.en: His dereliction of duty caused problems.
examples.zh: 他的玩忽职守导致了问题。

examples.en: The guard was fired for dereliction.
examples.zh: 那名警卫因玩忽职守被解雇。

definitions.en: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious
definitions.zh: n. 单调乏味, 沉闷

examples.en: The long meeting was full of tedium.
examples.zh: 漫长的会议充满了单调乏味。

examples.en: She tried to escape the tedium of daily life.
examples.zh: 她试图逃避日常生活的单调乏味。

definitions.en: n. an opening that allows the passage of liquids or grain
definitions.zh: n. 喷口, 从喷口流出的水, 水落管, 水龙卷
vt. 喷出, 喷射, 滔滔不绝说出, 典押
vi. 喷射, 高谈阔论

examples.en: Water came out of the teapot spout.
examples.zh: 水从茶壶的壶嘴流出来。

examples.en: The whale spouted water into the air.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼向空中喷水。

definitions.en: n. a fabric with a nap that is longer and softer than velvet
definitions.zh: n. 长毛绒, 长毛绒裤
a. 长毛绒制的, 豪华的

examples.en: The hotel room had plush carpets.
examples.zh: 酒店房间铺有长毛绒地毯。

examples.en: She bought a plush toy for her child.
examples.zh: 她给孩子买了一个长毛绒玩具。

definitions.en: v. arrange for sexual partners for others
definitions.zh: vi. 勾引, 怂恿, 卑劣地迎合
n. 拉皮条者, 怂恿者, 助恶者

examples.en: He would not pander to their bad habits.
examples.zh: 他不愿迎合他们的坏习惯。

examples.en: The movie panders to the lowest tastes.
examples.zh: 这部电影迎合最低级的趣味。

definitions.en: n. young bird that has just fledged or become capable of flying
definitions.zh: n. 羽毛初长的雏鸟, 刚会飞的幼鸟, 无经验的人

examples.en: The fledgling bird tried to fly.
examples.zh: 那只刚会飞的鸟试图飞翔。

examples.en: He is a fledgling in this business.
examples.zh: 他在这个行业是个新手。

definitions.en: n a person who is tricked or swindled
definitions.zh: n. 傻瓜, 易受骗的人

definitions.en: v fool or hoax
definitions.zh: vt. 欺骗, 愚弄

examples.en: He was a dupe of the scam artist.
examples.zh: 他是那个骗子的受骗者。

examples.en: They tried to dupe her into buying fake goods.
examples.zh: 他们试图欺骗她购买假货。

definitions.en: n. a compensating equivalent
definitions.zh: vt. 使平均, 使平衡, 使弥补
n. 平衡量, 平衡力, 势均力敌

examples.en: The weights counterbalance each other.
examples.zh: 这些砝码相互平衡。

examples.en: Her kindness is a counterbalance to his temper.
examples.zh: 她的善良是对他脾气的平衡。

definitions.en: s. changeable
definitions.zh: a. 反复无常的, 多变的, 任性的

examples.en: The weather here is very capricious.
examples.zh: 这里的天气非常反复无常。

examples.en: She is capricious and changes her mind often.
examples.zh: 她反复无常，经常改变主意。

definitions.en: n. a tapering point
definitions.zh: n. 敏锐, 聪明

examples.en: Her business acumen is impressive.
examples.zh: 她的商业头脑令人印象深刻。

examples.en: He has great acumen for solving problems.
examples.zh: 他有很强的解决问题能力。

definitions.en: n. a blood-red color
definitions.zh: a. 血红色的, 满怀希望的, 乐观的

definitions.en: s. confidently optimistic and cheerful
definitions.zh: n. 血红色, 红粉笔
vt. 用血沾污, 血染

examples.en: She is sanguine about the future.
examples.zh: 她对未来持乐观态度。

examples.en: He had a sanguine outlook on life.
examples.zh: 他对生活抱有乐观的看法。

definitions.en: v. bestow glory upon
definitions.zh: vt. 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌

examples.en: They glorify the achievements of their team.
examples.zh: 他们赞美团队的成就。

examples.en: The movie tries to glorify war and violence.
examples.zh: 这部电影试图美化战争和暴力。

definitions.en: n. an inscription on a tombstone or monument in memory of the person buried there
definitions.zh: n. 墓志铭, 碑文

examples.en: The epitaph on the tombstone was simple.
examples.zh: 墓碑上的墓志铭很简单。

examples.en: He wrote a beautiful epitaph for his friend.
examples.zh: 他为朋友写了一篇优美的墓志铭。

definitions.en: n. powerful and effective language
definitions.zh: n. 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩
[法] 善辩, 口才

examples.en: Her eloquence moved the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她的口才让全体观众感动落泪。

examples.en: He spoke with great eloquence at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议上以极大的雄辩发言。

definitions.en: a. corresponding in size or degree or extent
definitions.zh: a. 同量的, 同等的, 相称的

examples.en: Her salary is commensurate with her experience.
examples.zh: 她的薪水与她的经验相称。

examples.en: The punishment should be commensurate with the crime.
examples.zh: 惩罚应与罪行相称。

definitions.en: n. a mixture of mashed malt grains and hot water; used in brewing
definitions.zh: n. 碎麦芽, 饲料, 糊状物

definitions.en: n. mixture of ground animal feeds
definitions.zh: vt. 调情, 捣碎

examples.en: She mashed the potatoes for dinner.
examples.zh: 她把土豆捣碎做晚餐。

examples.en: The baby ate a bowl of mashed fruit.
examples.zh: 婴儿吃了一碗水果泥。

definitions.en: v. give up, such as power, as of monarchs and emperors, or duties and obligations
definitions.zh: vt. 正式放弃
vi. 退位, 退出, 辞职

examples.en: The king decided to abdicate the throne.
examples.zh: 国王决定退位。

examples.en: He abdicated his responsibility as a leader.
examples.zh: 他放弃了作为领导者的责任。

definitions.en: s. based on sound reasoning or evidence
definitions.zh: a. 可守的, 站得住(脚)的, 合理的, 成立的

examples.en: His argument is not tenable in court.
examples.zh: 他的论点在法庭上站不住脚。

examples.en: The theory remains tenable after new evidence.
examples.zh: 这个理论在新证据后仍然成立。

definitions.en: v. be teeming, be abuzz
definitions.zh: vi. 充满, 充足, 倾注
vt. 倒出

examples.en: The river teems with fish.
examples.zh: 这条河里鱼很多。

examples.en: The market teems with shoppers on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末市场里挤满了购物者。

definitions.en: n. a temporary stay (e.g., as a guest)
definitions.zh: n. 逗留, 旅居

definitions.en: v. spend a certain length of time; reside temporarily
definitions.zh: vi. 逗留, 旅居

examples.en: They had a brief sojourn in Paris.
examples.zh: 他们在巴黎短暂逗留。

examples.en: He sojourned in the mountains for a month.
examples.zh: 他在山里旅居了一个月。

definitions.en: v. restore to good health or strength
definitions.zh: vt. 恢复, 使复原, 使恢复健康, 使恢复精神

definitions.en: v. get over an illness or shock
definitions.zh: vi. 复原, 恢复健康, 挽回损失

examples.en: She needs time to recuperate after surgery.
examples.zh: 她手术后需要时间恢复。

examples.en: He is recuperating at home from the illness.
examples.zh: 他正在家养病恢复。

definitions.en: v. urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate
definitions.zh: vt. 推动, 激励, 驱使, 迫使

examples.en: Curiosity impelled her to explore the cave.
examples.zh: 好奇心驱使她探索洞穴。

examples.en: Hunger impelled him to find food.
examples.zh: 饥饿迫使他去寻找食物。

definitions.en: a. not in good condition; damaged or decayed
definitions.zh: a. 不健全的, 有病的, 腐烂的, 谬误的, 不牢靠的

definitions.en: a. not sound financially
definitions.zh: [医] 不健康的, 不健全的, 有病的

examples.en: The bridge is structurally unsound.
examples.zh: 这座桥结构不牢固。

examples.en: His argument is unsound and illogical.
examples.zh: 他的论点不健全且不合逻辑。

definitions.en: s not arrogant or presuming
definitions.zh: a. 谦逊的, 不装腔作势的

examples.en: He is a kind and unassuming man.
examples.zh: 他是一个善良而谦逊的人。

examples.en: Her unassuming manner made her popular.
examples.zh: 她谦逊的态度使她受欢迎。

definitions.en: s so great in size or force or extent as to elicit awe
definitions.zh: a. 惊人的, 巨大的

examples.en: The view from the mountain was stupendous.
examples.zh: 从山上看去的景色壮观极了。

examples.en: They made a stupendous effort to win.
examples.zh: 他们付出了巨大的努力去赢。

definitions.en: s not worth considering
definitions.zh: a. 不足取的, 琐碎的, 可鄙的

examples.en: He offered a paltry sum of money.
examples.zh: 他提供了一笔微不足道的钱。

examples.en: That is a paltry excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 那是一个迟到的可鄙借口。

definitions.en: v. represent falsely
definitions.zh: vt. 不如实地叙述(或说明), 不称职地代表

examples.en: The article misrepresents the facts.
examples.zh: 这篇文章歪曲了事实。

examples.en: He misrepresented his qualifications on the form.
examples.zh: 他在表格上虚报了自己的资历。

definitions.en: n a line that indicates a boundary
definitions.zh: vt. 量, 测量, 分配
n. 边界, 界石

examples.en: The judge will mete out a fair punishment.
examples.zh: 法官将给予公平的惩罚。

examples.en: They meted out justice to the criminals.
examples.zh: 他们对罪犯施以正义。

definitions.en: v. make drunk (with alcoholic drinks)
definitions.zh: vt. 使陶醉, 使喝醉

examples.en: The wine began to intoxicate him.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒开始让他陶醉。

examples.en: The music intoxicated the crowd.
examples.zh: 音乐使人群陶醉。

definitions.en: n. exemption from punishment or loss
definitions.zh: n. 不受惩罚, 无事, 无患
[法] 不受刑罚, 免罚, 免罪

examples.en: He broke the rules with impunity.
examples.zh: 他违反规则却不受惩罚。

examples.en: No one can commit crimes with impunity.
examples.zh: 没有人可以犯罪而不受惩罚。

definitions.en: n. a whetstone made of fine gritstone; used for sharpening razors
definitions.zh: n. 磨刀石, 抱怨, 想念

definitions.en: v. sharpen with a hone
definitions.zh: vt. 用磨刀石磨, 磨练

examples.en: He honed his skills through practice.
examples.zh: 他通过练习磨练了技能。

examples.en: She used a stone to hone the knife.
examples.zh: 她用磨刀石磨刀。

definitions.en: v. raise in rank, character, or status
definitions.zh: vt. 提升, 提高, 赞扬, 使得意
vi. 使人兴奋, 使人得意

examples.en: They exalt the virtues of hard work.
examples.zh: 他们赞扬勤奋的美德。

examples.en: The king was exalted above all others.
examples.zh: 国王被提升到高于所有人的地位。

definitions.en: v. move out of position
definitions.zh: vt. 脱臼, 弄乱

examples.en: He dislocated his shoulder playing football.
examples.zh: 他踢足球时肩膀脱臼了。

examples.en: The accident dislocated the traffic flow.
examples.zh: 事故打乱了交通流。

definitions.en: v. support with evidence or authority or make more certain or confirm
definitions.zh: vt. 巩固, 确证
[法] 确证, 确定, 证实

examples.en: The evidence corroborates his story.
examples.zh: 证据证实了他的说法。

examples.en: Can you corroborate her alibi?
examples.zh: 你能证实她的不在场证明吗？

definitions.en: s. noisy and lacking in restraint or discipline
definitions.zh: a. 猛烈的, 喧闹的, 狂暴的

examples.en: The children were boisterous at the party.
examples.zh: 孩子们在聚会上喧闹。

examples.en: A boisterous crowd filled the stadium.
examples.zh: 喧闹的人群挤满了体育场。

definitions.en: v. take to task
definitions.zh: vt. 警告, 劝告, 训诫, 告诫

examples.en: The teacher admonished the student for talking.
examples.zh: 老师因学生讲话而训诫他。

examples.en: She admonished him to drive carefully.
examples.zh: 她告诫他要小心驾驶。

definitions.en: v. yield (to); give satisfaction to
definitions.zh: vt. 使满足

examples.en: The good news gratified her greatly.
examples.zh: 好消息使她非常满足。

examples.en: He gratified his curiosity by reading the book.
examples.zh: 他通过读这本书满足了好奇心。

definitions.en: v indicate by signs
definitions.zh: vt. 成为前兆, 预示

examples.en: Dark clouds foreshadow a storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
