examples.en: His warnings sounded apocalyptic.
examples.zh: 他的警告听起来像是末日预言。

definitions.en: n small crude shelter used as a dwelling
definitions.zh: n. 棚屋

examples.en: They lived in a small shanty by the river.
examples.zh: 他们住在河边的一个小棚屋里。

examples.en: The shanty was made of old wood.
examples.zh: 棚屋是用旧木头搭成的。

definitions.en: n. a person who is stranded (as on an island)
definitions.zh: n. 逃亡黑人奴隶, 褐紫红色, 爆竹

definitions.en: n. a dark purplish-red to dark brownish-red color
definitions.zh: a. 褐紫红色的

definitions.en: n. an exploding firework used as a warning signal
definitions.zh: vt. 放逐到无人岛上, 使孤立

examples.en: She wore a beautiful maroon dress.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的褐紫红色裙子。

examples.en: The sailors were marooned on an island.
examples.zh: 水手们被放逐在一个岛上。

definitions.en: n. an artist of consummate skill
definitions.zh: n. 音乐大师, 大音乐家

examples.en: The maestro conducted the orchestra beautifully.
examples.zh: 音乐大师优美地指挥了管弦乐队。

examples.en: He is a true maestro of the piano.
examples.zh: 他是真正的钢琴大师。

definitions.en: v kill in large numbers
definitions.zh: vt. 消灭, 废止

examples.en: The army was annihilated in the battle.
examples.zh: 军队在战斗中被消灭了。

examples.en: The virus could annihilate the entire crop.
examples.zh: 这种病毒可能消灭整个庄稼。

definitions.en: n. a substance having the tendency to cause corrosion (such a strong acids or alkali)
definitions.zh: a. 腐蚀的, 腐蚀性的, 有害的

definitions.en: s. spitefully sarcastic
definitions.zh: n. 腐蚀物, 腐蚀剂

examples.en: Acid is a highly corrosive substance.
examples.zh: 酸是一种高度腐蚀性的物质。

examples.en: His corrosive comments hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他尖刻的评论伤害了她的感情。

definitions.en: n. an episode of such pastoral or romantic charm as to qualify as the subject of a poetic idyll
definitions.zh: n. 叙事诗, 田园景色, 田园诗, 田园乐曲, 牧歌

examples.en: Their life on the farm was an idyll.
examples.zh: 他们在农场的生活是一首田园诗。

examples.en: The vacation was a perfect idyll.
examples.zh: 假期是一段完美的田园时光。

definitions.en: n the use of tricks to deceive someone (usually to extract money from them)
definitions.zh: n. 诡计, 狡猾
vt. 引诱, 诱骗, 消遣

examples.en: She used her wiles to get what she wanted.
examples.zh: 她用诡计得到了她想要的东西。

examples.en: He fell for her clever wiles.
examples.zh: 他中了她的狡猾诡计。

definitions.en: s not initiated; deficient in relevant experience
definitions.zh: a. 外行的, 缺少经验的

examples.en: The uninitiated may find this confusing.
examples.zh: 外行可能会觉得这令人困惑。

examples.en: This book is for the uninitiated reader.
examples.zh: 这本书是为缺少经验的读者写的。

definitions.en: s curved or curving in and out
definitions.zh: a. 弯弯曲曲的, 迂回的, 运动柔软的
[医] 纡曲的

examples.en: The river followed a sinuous path through the valley.
examples.zh: 这条河沿着弯弯曲曲的路径穿过山谷。

examples.en: Her sinuous dance movements captivated the audience.
examples.zh: 她柔软的舞蹈动作迷住了观众。

definitions.en: v. talk in a noisy, excited, or declamatory manner
definitions.zh: v. 咆哮, 痛骂
n. 咆哮, 大话

examples.en: He began to rant about the unfair rules.
examples.zh: 他开始咆哮着说不公平的规则。

examples.en: His rant lasted for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 他的咆哮持续了十分钟。

definitions.en: n. a trite or obvious remark
definitions.zh: n. 单调, 平凡, 陈腐, 陈词滥调

examples.en: His speech was full of platitudes.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调。

examples.en: She ignored his platitude and asked a real question.
examples.zh: 她忽略了他的陈词滥调，问了一个真正的问题。

definitions.en: n a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends
definitions.zh: n. 阴谋, 图谋, 策划
[法] 诡计, 奸计, 阴谋

examples.en: The villain's machination was finally exposed.
examples.zh: 恶棍的阴谋最终被揭露了。

examples.en: They discovered a secret machination against the company.
examples.zh: 他们发现了一个针对公司的秘密阴谋。

definitions.en: s. defying imitation; matchless
definitions.zh: a. 无法仿效的, 独特的, 无比的

examples.en: Her inimitable style made her famous.
examples.zh: 她独特的风格让她出名。

examples.en: He has an inimitable way of telling stories.
examples.zh: 他有一种无法仿效的讲故事方式。

definitions.en: v. assume or act the character of
definitions.zh: vt. 模仿, 扮演, 体现, 使人格化

definitions.en: v. represent another person with comic intentions
definitions.zh: [法] 体现, 模仿, 拟人

examples.en: He tried to impersonate a police officer.
examples.zh: 他试图模仿警察。

examples.en: She can impersonate many famous singers.
examples.zh: 她能模仿许多著名歌手。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being so overabundant that prices fall
definitions.zh: n. 大量, 供过于求
vt. 使充满, 使吃饱, 过多供应
vi. 吃得过多, 狼吞虎咽

examples.en: The market has a glut of cheap goods.
examples.zh: 市场上充斥着廉价商品。

examples.en: They glutted themselves with food at the party.
examples.zh: 他们在派对上大吃大喝。

definitions.en: s. showing inappropriate levity
definitions.zh: a. 轻率的, 没礼貌的, 嘴碎的

examples.en: His flippant remark offended his teacher.
examples.zh: 他轻率的言论冒犯了老师。

examples.en: Don't be flippant about serious matters.
examples.zh: 不要对严肃的事情轻率。

definitions.en: s. unaffected by strong emotion or prejudice
definitions.zh: a. 冷静的, 不带感情的

examples.en: A judge must be dispassionate in court.
examples.zh: 法官在法庭上必须冷静。

examples.en: She gave a dispassionate analysis of the problem.
examples.zh: 她对问题进行了冷静的分析。

definitions.en: v cause or allow (a solid substance) to flow or run out or over
definitions.zh: vt. 吐出, 流注, 被迫交出

definitions.en: v eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
definitions.zh: vi. 呕吐

examples.en: The pipe disgorged dirty water into the river.
examples.zh: 管道将脏水排入河中。

examples.en: He felt sick and disgorged his meal.
examples.zh: 他感到恶心，吐出了食物。

definitions.en: v influence or urge by gentle urging, caressing, or flattering
definitions.zh: vt. 以甜言蜜语哄骗, 勾引

examples.en: She cajoled her son into doing his homework.
examples.zh: 她用甜言蜜语哄儿子做作业。

examples.en: He tried to cajole the guard into letting him in.
examples.zh: 他试图哄骗警卫让他进去。

definitions.en: s repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
definitions.zh: a. 老一套的, 陈腐的, 用坏的

examples.en: The movie's plot was trite and boring.
examples.zh: 这部电影的情节陈腐乏味。

examples.en: He avoided using trite phrases in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中避免使用陈腐的短语。

definitions.en: v. make a travesty of
definitions.zh: n. 拙劣的模仿作品, 嘲弄, 滑稽模仿
vt. 滑稽地模仿, 歪曲

examples.en: The trial was a travesty of justice.
examples.zh: 这场审判是对正义的嘲弄。

examples.en: His performance was a travesty of the original play.
examples.zh: 他的表演是对原剧的拙劣模仿。

definitions.en: s quick to take offense
definitions.zh: a. 易怒的, 难以取悦的, 过于敏感的

examples.en: He is very touchy about his height.
examples.zh: 他对自己的身高非常敏感。

examples.en: Don't ask her about her job; she's touchy today.
examples.zh: 别问她工作的事，她今天易怒。

definitions.en: n an instance of driving away or warding off
definitions.zh: n. 击退, 拒绝

definitions.en: v force or drive back
definitions.zh: vt. 厌恶, 击退, 拒绝

examples.en: The army repulsed the enemy attack.
examples.zh: 军队击退了敌人的进攻。

examples.en: She repulsed his advances politely.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了他的追求。

definitions.en: v. do one's shopping at; do business with; be a customer or client of
definitions.zh: vt. 保护, 支援, 赞助, 庇护, 惠顾

examples.en: She likes to patronize local shops.
examples.zh: 她喜欢惠顾当地商店。

examples.en: He felt patronized by her tone of voice.
examples.zh: 他感到她的语气带有屈尊俯就的意味。

definitions.en: n. an optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects
definitions.zh: n. 海市蜃楼, 幻景, 妄想

examples.en: The desert mirage looked like a lake.
examples.zh: 沙漠中的海市蜃楼看起来像湖。

examples.en: His dream of wealth was just a mirage.
examples.zh: 他的财富梦想只是幻景。

definitions.en: a. given to examining own sensory and perceptual experiences
definitions.zh: a. 内省的
[医] 内省的

examples.en: She became more introspective after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后她变得更加内省。

examples.en: His introspective nature makes him a good writer.
examples.zh: 他内省的性格使他成为好作家。

definitions.en: v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
definitions.zh: vt. 下狱, 监禁, 禁闭
[法] 监禁, 使下狱, 禁闭

examples.en: The court decided to incarcerate the criminal.
examples.zh: 法院决定监禁这名罪犯。

examples.en: He was incarcerated for five years.
examples.zh: 他被监禁了五年。

definitions.en: s. tediously repetitious or lacking in variety; all work and no play"
definitions.zh: a. 平凡的, 单调的, 令人厌烦的
n. 平凡, 单调, 无聊
vi. 单调令味地进行

examples.en: His humdrum life made him feel bored.
examples.zh: 他单调的生活让他感到无聊。

examples.en: She wanted to escape the humdrum routine.
examples.zh: 她想逃离平凡的日常。

definitions.en: s emitting or filled with bubbles as from carbonation or fermentation
definitions.zh: a. 有泡的, 起泡的, 多泡的

examples.en: The coffee had a frothy top.
examples.zh: 咖啡上面有一层泡沫。

examples.en: The frothy waves crashed on the shore.
examples.zh: 起泡的波浪拍打着海岸。

definitions.en: n. elaborate or showy attire and accessories
definitions.zh: n. (华丽的)装饰, (华丽的)服饰, 鲜艳服装, 幽雅, 精炼炉
[化] 木炭吹炼炉; 木炭精炼炉

examples.en: She wore her finest finery to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着最华丽的服饰去参加派对。

examples.en: The bride looked beautiful in her finery.
examples.zh: 新娘穿着华丽的服饰看起来很漂亮。

definitions.en: s. tending to hinder the achievement of a goal
definitions.zh: a. 反生产的；使达不到预期目标的

examples.en: Working too hard can be counterproductive.
examples.zh: 工作太努力可能适得其反。

examples.en: His angry response was counterproductive.
examples.zh: 他愤怒的反应是反效果的。

definitions.en: n. a lump of material formed from the content of a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 凝块, 一团

definitions.en: v. change from a liquid to a thickened or solid state
definitions.zh: v. (使)凝结, (使)聚集

examples.en: A blood clot can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 血凝块可能很危险。

examples.en: The milk started to clot in the heat.
examples.zh: 牛奶在高温下开始凝结。

definitions.en: v. become pale and sickly
definitions.zh: a. 苍白的, 无血色的, 病态的, 暗淡的

definitions.en: s. lacking vitality as from weariness or illness or unhappiness
definitions.zh: v. (使)变苍白
[计] 广域网

examples.en: She looked wan after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病后她看起来苍白。

examples.en: His wan smile showed his exhaustion.
examples.zh: 他苍白的微笑显示出疲惫。

definitions.en: v. guarantee financial support of
definitions.zh: vt. 签名于下, 给...保险
vi. 经营保险业

examples.en: The bank agreed to underwrite the project.
examples.zh: 银行同意为该项目提供资金支持。

examples.en: They need an insurer to underwrite the policy.
examples.zh: 他们需要一家保险公司承保这份保单。

definitions.en: v. make solid or more solid; cause to solidify
definitions.zh: v. (使)凝固, (使)团结, 巩固

examples.en: Water will solidify into ice when frozen.
examples.zh: 水冻结时会凝固成冰。

examples.en: The plan began to solidify after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后计划开始巩固。

definitions.en: s. full of fighting spirit
definitions.zh: a. 杂凑的, 不连贯的, 爱打架的, 坚决的

examples.en: The scrappy little dog fought bravely.
examples.zh: 这只爱打架的小狗勇敢地战斗。

examples.en: He gave a scrappy performance in the game.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中表现出坚决的斗志。

definitions.en: v. get into a prostrate position, as in submission
definitions.zh: a. 拜倒的, 降伏的, 俯卧的, 衰竭的, 沮丧的

definitions.en: v. render helpless or defenseless
definitions.zh: vt. 弄倒, 使屈服, 使俯伏, 使平卧

examples.en: He lay prostrate before the king.
examples.zh: 他俯卧在国王面前。

examples.en: The heat prostrated the workers.
examples.zh: 炎热使工人们筋疲力尽。

definitions.en: n. a person who refuses to face reality or recognize the truth (a reference to the popular notion that the ostrich hides from danger by burying its head in the sand)
definitions.zh: n. 鸵鸟

examples.en: Don't be an ostrich; face the problem.
examples.zh: 别像鸵鸟一样，面对问题吧。

examples.en: He is an ostrich who ignores the truth.
examples.zh: 他是个逃避现实的鸵鸟。

definitions.en: n. a heavy long-handled hammer used to drive stakes or wedges
definitions.zh: n. 大槌

definitions.en: v. split (wood) with a maul and wedges
definitions.zh: vt. 打伤, 粗手粗脚地摆弄, 抨击

examples.en: The bear mauled the hiker badly.
examples.zh: 熊严重打伤了徒步者。

examples.en: He used a maul to split the wood.
examples.zh: 他用大槌劈开木头。

definitions.en: v. shift from one side of the ship to the other
definitions.zh: vi. 嘲笑, 一致
vt. 转帆, 嘲笑
n. 嘲笑

examples.en: His story didn't jibe with the facts.
examples.zh: 他的说法与事实不一致。

examples.en: She made a jibe about his cooking.
examples.zh: 她嘲笑他的厨艺。

definitions.en: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a metal plate that is struck with a softheaded drumstick
definitions.zh: n. 铜锣, 皿形钟

definitions.en: v. sound a gong
definitions.zh: vt. 鸣锣召唤

examples.en: The gong sounded to start the ceremony.
examples.zh: 锣声响起，仪式开始。

examples.en: He gonged the bell to call the students.
examples.zh: 他鸣锣召唤学生。

definitions.en: n. sediment that has settled at the bottom of a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 少量；渣滓；沉淀物（dreg的复数）

examples.en: He drank the coffee down to the dregs.
examples.zh: 他把咖啡喝到只剩渣滓。

examples.en: The dregs of society were in that bar.
examples.zh: 社会的渣滓都在那个酒吧里。

definitions.en: v. renounce a legal claim or title to
definitions.zh: v. 放弃, 弃权, 拒绝承认

examples.en: He disclaimed any knowledge of the crime.
examples.zh: 他否认对犯罪知情。

examples.en: The company disclaimed responsibility for the accident.
examples.zh: 公司拒绝承认对事故负责。

definitions.en: s. marked by rude or peremptory shortness
definitions.zh: a. 唐突的, 直率的

examples.en: His brusque manner upset the customers.
examples.zh: 他唐突的态度让顾客不高兴。

examples.en: She gave a brusque reply and left.
examples.zh: 她给了个唐突的答复然后离开了。

definitions.en: n. any of various aromatic resinous substances used for healing and soothing
definitions.zh: n. 镇痛软膏, 香膏
[化] 香树膏; 香脂

examples.en: The balm soothed his sunburned skin.
examples.zh: 香膏舒缓了他晒伤的皮肤。

examples.en: Her kind words were a balm to his heart.
examples.zh: 她亲切的话语是对他心灵的慰藉。

definitions.en: n. an ornament that resembles a spray of leaves or flowers
definitions.zh: n. 小树枝, 无头钉
vt. 用小树枝装饰, 用钉子钉上, 使蔓生

examples.en: She added a sprig of mint to the drink.
examples.zh: 她在饮料里加了一小枝薄荷。

examples.en: The vase held a sprig of flowers.
examples.zh: 花瓶里插着一小枝花。

definitions.en: v. avoid dealing with
definitions.zh: vi. 溜掉, 逃避, 推卸
vt. 逃避

examples.en: He tried to shirk his responsibilities.
examples.zh: 他试图逃避责任。

examples.en: Don't shirk your duties at work.
examples.zh: 不要逃避工作中的职责。

definitions.en: n. violently angry and destructive behavior
definitions.zh: n. 乱闹, 乱冲, 暴跳

definitions.en: v. act violently, recklessly, or destructively
definitions.zh: vi. 乱闹, 狂暴

examples.en: The fans went on a rampage after the loss.
examples.zh: 球迷在失利后乱闹。

examples.en: The elephant rampaged through the village.
examples.zh: 大象狂暴地穿过村庄。

definitions.en: n. a controversy (especially over a belief or dogma)
definitions.zh: a. 争辩的, 好争论的

definitions.en: s. of or involving dispute or controversy
definitions.zh: n. 争论, 辩论, 辩论者

examples.en: His book is a polemic against modern art.
examples.zh: 他的书是对现代艺术的争辩。

examples.en: She engaged in a heated polemic with him.
examples.zh: 她与他进行了激烈的辩论。

definitions.en: n. semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation
definitions.zh: n. 软膏, 油膏
[化] 软膏; 药膏

examples.en: Apply this ointment to the burn twice daily.
examples.zh: 每天两次将这种药膏涂在烧伤处。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an ointment for my rash.
examples.zh: 医生为我的皮疹开了一种软膏。

definitions.en: v. teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions
definitions.zh: vt. 反复灌输, 谆谆教诲

examples.en: Parents inculcate good manners in their children.
examples.zh: 父母向孩子反复灌输良好的礼仪。

examples.en: Teachers inculcate a love of learning in students.
examples.zh: 老师向学生谆谆教诲对学习的热爱。

definitions.en: n. an encircling or ringlike structure
definitions.zh: n. 腰带, 围绕物

definitions.en: n. a band of material around the waist that strengthens a skirt or trousers
definitions.zh: vt. 用腰带束缚, 围绕

examples.en: She wore a leather girdle around her waist.
examples.zh: 她腰间系着一条皮带。

examples.en: The mountains girdle the small valley.
examples.zh: 群山环绕着这个小山谷。

definitions.en: v touch or stroke lightly in a loving or endearing manner
definitions.zh: vt. 爱, 爱抚, 溺爱
vi. 爱抚

examples.en: She fondled the kitten gently in her arms.
examples.zh: 她温柔地爱抚着怀中的小猫。

examples.en: He fondled the soft fabric of the scarf.
examples.zh: 他轻轻抚摸围巾柔软的布料。

definitions.en: a. capable of being explicated or accounted for
definitions.zh: a. 可说明的, 可解释的

examples.en: His strange behavior is easily explicable.
examples.zh: 他奇怪的行为很容易解释。

examples.en: The error in the report was explicable.
examples.zh: 报告中的错误是可以解释的。

definitions.en: n. a heavy block of iron or steel on which hot metals are shaped by hammering
definitions.zh: n. 铁砧
[医] 砧骨; 铁砧

examples.en: The blacksmith hammered the hot iron on the anvil.
examples.zh: 铁匠在铁砧上锤打热铁。

examples.en: He shaped the metal using a heavy anvil.
examples.zh: 他用沉重的铁砧塑造金属。

definitions.en: n. a very tall building with many stories
definitions.zh: n. 摩天楼, 三角形天帆

examples.en: The skyscraper touches the clouds.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼触及云端。

examples.en: We saw a tall skyscraper in the city.

definitions.en: s marked by casual disrespect

examples.zh: 那个无礼的男孩顶撞老师。

examples.zh: 她侮慢的言论激怒了所有人。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to infants or infancy

definitions.en: n. a person who is uninterested in intellectual pursuits

examples.zh: 她对艺术庸俗的态度令人失望。

definitions.en: n. payment or reward (as for service rendered)

definitions.en: n. the act of compensating for service or loss or injury

examples.zh: 她因努力工作得到了报偿。

examples.zh: 公司将赔偿你的损失。

definitions.en: n a state of extreme confusion and disorder

definitions.en: s. lacking zest or vivacity

examples.zh: 炎热的天气让每个人都倦怠无力。

examples.zh: 婴儿出生后皮肤看起来有黄疸。

examples.en: He has a jaundiced view of modern politics.

definitions.en: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness

examples.zh: 重复的任务让他感到厌烦。

examples.en: Her constant complaints became irksome.

definitions.en: v give encouragement to

examples.zh: 好消息激励了整个团队。

examples.en: Her words of support heartened me greatly.
examples.zh: 她支持的话语极大地激励了我。

examples.zh: 她教导式的教学风格非常有效。

definitions.en: n. a plant or animal naturalized in a region

examples.zh: 她的评论与讨论非常贴切。

examples.zh: 这幅画看起来业余且画得不好。

examples.zh: 他外行的烹饪尝试失败了。

definitions.zh: a. 贪吃的, 狼吞虎咽的, 贪婪的

examples.zh: 他是一个贪婪的读书者。

examples.en: The voracious eater finished the whole cake.
examples.zh: 贪吃的食客吃完了整个蛋糕。

definitions.en: n. a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)
definitions.zh: n. 拖网

definitions.en: n. a conical fishnet dragged through the water at great depths
definitions.zh: v. 用拖网捕鱼

examples.en: The fishermen trawl the sea for fish.
examples.zh: 渔民们用拖网在海里捕鱼。

examples.en: They used a trawl to catch shrimp.
examples.zh: 他们用拖网捕虾。

definitions.en: v. alter the nature of (elements)
definitions.zh: vt. 使变形, 使变质
vi. 变形, 变质

examples.en: Alchemists tried to transmute lead into gold.
examples.zh: 炼金术士试图把铅变成金。

examples.en: Time can transmute sorrow into wisdom.
examples.zh: 时间能把悲伤变成智慧。

definitions.en: a. presenting favorable circumstances; likely to result in or show signs of success
definitions.zh: a. 顺利的, 适合的, 吉祥的, 慈悲的

examples.en: The weather is propitious for the picnic.
examples.zh: 天气适合野餐。

examples.en: This is a propitious time to start a business.
examples.zh: 这是创业的吉祥时机。

definitions.en: v. change completely the nature or appearance of
definitions.zh: vt. 使变形, 使变态, 使变质
vi. 变形, 变质

examples.en: A caterpillar metamorphoses into a butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫变形为蝴蝶。

examples.en: The city has metamorphosed into a modern hub.
examples.zh: 这座城市已变成现代中心。

definitions.en: s vigorously passionate
definitions.zh: a. 健壮的, 精力充沛的

examples.en: The baby gave a lusty cry.
examples.zh: 婴儿发出健壮的哭声。

examples.en: He is a lusty young man full of energy.
examples.zh: 他是一个精力充沛的健壮年轻人。

definitions.en: v. praise, glorify, or honor
definitions.zh: n. 赞美, 称赞
vt. 赞美, 称赞

examples.en: They laud her for her charitable work.
examples.zh: 他们称赞她的慈善工作。

examples.en: The critics lauded the new film.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞了这部新电影。

definitions.en: s marked by up-to-dateness in dress and manners
definitions.zh: a. 快活的, 活泼的, 轻快的

examples.en: He wore a jaunty hat at an angle.
examples.zh: 他歪戴着一顶轻快的帽子。

examples.en: Her jaunty walk showed her confidence.
examples.zh: 她活泼的步伐显示了她的自信。

definitions.en: n. understanding with difficulty
definitions.zh: a. 抓的, 握的, 贪婪的

examples.en: He is a grasping person who wants more money.
examples.zh: 他是一个贪婪的人，想要更多钱。

examples.en: Her grasping nature made her unpopular.
examples.zh: 她贪婪的本性让她不受欢迎。

definitions.en: v. issue an injunction
definitions.zh: vt. 吩咐, 命令, 嘱咐, 禁止
[法] 责成, 命令, 嘱咐

examples.en: The judge enjoined him from leaving the country.
examples.zh: 法官禁止他离开这个国家。

examples.en: She enjoined her students to study hard.
examples.zh: 她嘱咐学生们努力学习。

definitions.en: n. a very intense and uncontrolled fire
definitions.zh: n. 大火灾, 大火, 冲突
[化] 暴燃; 快速燃烧

examples.en: The conflagration destroyed the entire forest.
examples.zh: 大火烧毁了整片森林。

examples.en: A small spark caused a huge conflagration.
examples.zh: 一个小火花引发了一场大火灾。

definitions.en: a. resembling a uncle in kindness or indulgence
definitions.zh: a. 叔伯的, 叔伯似的

examples.en: He gave me avuncular advice about life.
examples.zh: 他给了我叔伯般的人生建议。

examples.en: His avuncular manner made him easy to talk to.
examples.zh: 他叔伯似的态度让人容易交谈。

definitions.en: n a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
definitions.zh: n. 试金石, 检验标准

examples.en: Honesty is the touchstone of a good friend.
examples.zh: 诚实是好朋友的试金石。

examples.en: This test is a touchstone for student ability.
examples.zh: 这次测试是学生能力的检验标准。

definitions.en: n a trinket or piece of jewelry usually hung about the neck and thought to be a magical protection against evil or disease
definitions.zh: n. 护身符, 驱邪物, 法宝

examples.en: She wore a talisman for good luck.
examples.zh: 她戴了一个护身符以求好运。

examples.en: The old ring was a family talisman.
examples.zh: 这枚旧戒指是家族的驱邪物。

definitions.en: v. expand and contract rhythmically; beat rhythmically
definitions.zh: vi. 搏动, 悸动, 震动

definitions.en: v. move with or as if with a regular alternating motion
definitions.zh: [医] 搏动

examples.en: His heart began to pulsate rapidly.
examples.zh: 他的心脏开始快速搏动。

examples.en: The music made the room pulsate with energy.
examples.zh: 音乐让房间充满活力地悸动。

definitions.en: n. the product of percolation
definitions.zh: vt.vi. 滤, 滤过, 渗开, (使)渗透, (使)渗滤

definitions.en: v. spread gradually
definitions.zh: n. 滤过液, 渗出液

definitions.en: v. prepare in a percolator
definitions.zh: vt. 用渗滤壶煮(咖啡)

examples.en: Coffee percolates through the filter.
examples.zh: 咖啡通过过滤器渗滤。

examples.en: News percolates slowly through the village.
examples.zh: 消息在村庄里慢慢传开。

definitions.en: s expressing disapproval
definitions.zh: a. 贬损的, 轻蔑的
n. 轻蔑语, 贬义词

examples.en: He used a pejorative term for the group.
examples.zh: 他对那个群体用了贬损的术语。

examples.en: Her comment was pejorative and hurtful.
examples.zh: 她的评论是轻蔑且伤人的。

definitions.en: n a feeling of extreme joy
definitions.zh: n. 欢呼, 喜欢, 庆祝

examples.en: The crowd's jubilation was loud and clear.
examples.zh: 人群的欢呼声清晰响亮。

examples.en: Jubilation filled the room after the win.
examples.zh: 胜利后房间里充满了喜悦。

definitions.en: s. characteristic of informal spoken language or conversation
definitions.zh: a. 会话的, 口语的, 口语体的

examples.en: He used colloquial language with his friends.
examples.zh: 他和朋友说话时用了口语化的语言。

examples.en: Colloquial expressions are common in daily talk.
examples.zh: 口语表达在日常对话中很常见。

definitions.en: a. morally pure (especially not having experienced sexual intercourse)
definitions.zh: a. 贞洁的, 纯洁的, 朴素的

examples.en: She lived a chaste and simple life.
examples.zh: 她过着纯洁而简朴的生活。

examples.en: The chaste design of the room was elegant.
examples.zh: 房间朴素的设计很优雅。

definitions.en: s. marked by care and persistent effort
definitions.zh: a. 勤勉的, 刻苦的

examples.en: The assiduous student studied every night.
examples.zh: 那个勤奋的学生每晚都学习。

examples.en: Her assiduous effort led to great success.
examples.zh: 她刻苦的努力带来了巨大的成功。

definitions.en: v. assume a prim appearance
definitions.zh: a. 整洁的, 端正的, 规规矩矩的, 呆板的, 拘谨的

definitions.en: v. contract one's lips
definitions.zh: vt. 弄整齐, 使显出一本正经的表情

definitions.en: v. dress primly
definitions.zh: vi. 作出一本正经的样子

examples.en: She sat primly with her hands folded.
examples.zh: 她拘谨地坐着，双手交叉。

examples.en: His prim appearance made him seem strict.
examples.zh: 他整洁的外表让他显得很严格。

definitions.en: n. a depression scratched or carved into a surface
definitions.zh: n. 切口, 切割, 雕刻, 切入

definitions.en: n. the cutting of or into body tissues or organs (especially by a surgeon as part of an operation)
definitions.zh: [医] 切口, 切开, 缺口(叶)

examples.en: The doctor made a small incision in the skin.
examples.zh: 医生在皮肤上切了一个小口。

examples.en: A clean incision helps the wound heal faster.
examples.zh: 干净的切口有助于伤口更快愈合。

definitions.en: n. an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off
definitions.zh: n. 磨擦, 磨损, 磨损处

definitions.en: n. erosion by friction
definitions.zh: [化] 磨耗; 磨蚀

examples.en: He had a minor abrasion on his knee.
examples.zh: 他膝盖上有一处轻微擦伤。

examples.en: The abrasion on the pipe caused a leak.
examples.zh: 管道上的磨损导致了泄漏。

definitions.en: n. a long pointed tooth specialized for fighting or digging; especially in an elephant or walrus or hog
definitions.zh: n. 长牙, 獠牙, 尖物

definitions.en: v. remove the tusks of animals
definitions.zh: vt. 以长牙刺戳, 以长牙掘

examples.en: The elephant used its tusk to dig for water.
examples.zh: 大象用它的长牙挖水。

examples.en: A walrus has two long tusks on its face.
examples.zh: 海象脸上有两根长长的獠牙。

definitions.en: n. an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections
definitions.zh: n. 遁词, 双关语

definitions.en: v. evade the truth of a point or question by raising irrelevant objections
definitions.zh: vi. 吹毛求疵, 争吵, 说模棱两可的话

definitions.en: v. argue over petty things
definitions.zh: vt. 对...诡辩

examples.en: Don't quibble over small details in the plan.
examples.zh: 不要对计划中的小细节吹毛求疵。

examples.en: His quibble about the time wasted everyone's time.
examples.zh: 他对时间的挑剔浪费了大家的时间。

definitions.en: s easily irritated or annoyed
definitions.zh: a. 任性的, 暴躁的, 易生气的, 难以取悦的

examples.en: The petulant child refused to eat his dinner.
examples.zh: 那个任性的孩子拒绝吃晚饭。

examples.en: She gave a petulant reply when asked to help.
examples.zh: 当被要求帮忙时，她给出了暴躁的回答。

definitions.en: v impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
definitions.zh: vt. 处刑, 对...处罚(刑), 使不利
[法] 处罚, 对...处以刑事惩罚

examples.en: The referee will penalize any player who cheats.
examples.zh: 裁判会处罚任何作弊的球员。

examples.en: The new law will penalize companies that pollute.
examples.zh: 新法律将处罚污染环境的公司。

definitions.en: s covered with or smelling of mold
definitions.zh: a. 发霉的, 霉臭的, 落伍的

examples.en: The old book smelled musty and damp.
examples.zh: 那本旧书闻起来发霉潮湿。

examples.en: The basement had a musty odor from the rain.
examples.zh: 地下室因雨水有股霉味。

definitions.en: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness
definitions.zh: n. 失眠症
[医] 失眠[症]

examples.en: He suffers from insomnia and cannot sleep well.
examples.zh: 他患有失眠症，睡不好觉。

examples.en: Insomnia often makes people feel tired during the day.
examples.zh: 失眠常常让人白天感到疲倦。

definitions.en: v. attribute or credit to
definitions.zh: vt. 归罪, 使负责, 嫁祸于

examples.en: They impute the mistake to his carelessness.
examples.zh: 他们把错误归咎于他的粗心。

examples.en: Do not impute bad motives to her actions.
examples.zh: 不要将不良动机归因于她的行为。

definitions.en: a. curving inward
definitions.zh: a. 凹的
[医] 凹的, 凹面的

examples.en: The mirror has a concave surface that bends light.
examples.zh: 这面镜子有凹面，能弯曲光线。

examples.en: A concave lens is thinner at the center than edges.
examples.zh: 凹透镜中心比边缘薄。

definitions.en: n. biennial Eurasian plant usually having a swollen edible root; widely cultivated as a food crop
definitions.zh: n. 甜菜(根)

definitions.en: n. round red root vegetable
definitions.zh: [化] 甜菜

examples.en: She added sliced beet to the salad.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉里加了切好的甜菜。

examples.en: Beet is a root vegetable that is often red.
examples.zh: 甜菜是一种通常为红色的根茎蔬菜。

definitions.en: n. a canopy made of canvas to shelter people or things from rain or sun
definitions.zh: n. 遮篷, 雨篷

examples.en: The awning provided shade from the hot sun.
examples.zh: 遮篷提供了躲避烈日的阴凉。

examples.en: We sat under the awning during the rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间我们坐在遮篷下。

definitions.en: n. pen made from a bird's feather
definitions.zh: n. 羽根, 大翎毛, 羽毛笔

definitions.en: n. a stiff hollow protective spine on a porcupine or hedgehog
definitions.zh: vt. 刺穿

examples.en: He wrote the letter with a quill pen.
examples.zh: 他用羽毛笔写了那封信。

examples.en: The porcupine raised its quills when scared.
examples.zh: 豪猪受惊时竖起了它的刺。

definitions.en: n. an advanced student or graduate in medicine gaining supervised practical experience (`houseman' is a British term)
definitions.zh: n. 实习生, 被拘留者

definitions.en: v. deprive of freedom
definitions.zh: vi. 作实习医师(教师、实习生)

definitions.en: v. work as an intern
definitions.zh: vt. 拘留, 扣留

examples.en: The intern works at the hospital.
examples.zh: 这名实习生在医院工作。

examples.en: They intern the prisoners during war.
examples.zh: 战争期间他们拘留了囚犯。

definitions.en: n. a tool with a flat blade attached at right angles to a long handle
definitions.zh: n. 锄头

definitions.en: v. dig with a hoe
definitions.zh: v. 用锄耕地, 锄

examples.en: He used a hoe to weed the garden.
examples.zh: 他用锄头给花园除草。

examples.en: She will hoe the soil before planting.
examples.zh: 她会在种植前用锄耕地。

definitions.en: n. a disloyal person who betrays or deserts his cause or religion or political party or friend etc.
definitions.zh: n. 背弃者, 脱党者, 逃亡者

definitions.en: n. a person who abandons their duty (as on a military post)
definitions.zh: [法] 逃犯, 逃亡者, 逃兵

examples.en: The deserter left the army without permission.
examples.zh: 逃兵未经允许离开了军队。

examples.en: They called him a deserter for abandoning his team.
examples.zh: 他们称他为背弃者，因为他抛弃了团队。

definitions.en: n. formal or perfunctory politeness
definitions.zh: n. 礼貌, 礼仪

examples.en: Civility is important in any conversation.
examples.zh: 礼貌在任何对话中都很重要。

examples.en: He spoke with civility even when angry.
examples.zh: 即使生气时，他也礼貌地说话。

definitions.en: n. bright-colored; a float attached by rope to the seabed to mark channels in a harbor or underwater hazards
definitions.zh: n. 浮标, 航标, 救生圈

definitions.en: v. float on the surface of water
definitions.zh: vt. 使浮起, 鼓励

examples.en: The buoy floated on the water to mark the channel.
examples.zh: 浮标浮在水面上标记航道。

examples.en: Good news can buoy your spirits for the day.
examples.zh: 好消息能让你一整天精神振奋。

definitions.en: n. painting done in a range of tones of a single color
definitions.zh: n. 单色画, 单色, 黑白
a. 单色的, 黑白的
[计] 单色

examples.en: The photo was in monochrome, only black and white.
examples.zh: 那张照片是单色的，只有黑白两色。

examples.en: He prefers monochrome paintings to colorful ones.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢单色画而非彩色画。

definitions.en: n. very small European freshwater fish common in gravelly streams
definitions.zh: n. 鲤科淡水小鱼

examples.en: The minnow swam quickly in the shallow stream.
examples.zh: 小鱼在浅溪中快速游动。

examples.en: He caught a small minnow with his net.
examples.zh: 他用网捕到了一条小鲤科鱼。

definitions.en: n. a person who holds religious beliefs in conflict with the dogma of the Roman Catholic Church
definitions.zh: n. 异教徒, 异端者

examples.en: The heretic was punished for his beliefs.
examples.zh: 异教徒因其信仰而受到惩罚。

examples.en: In history, a heretic often faced severe consequences.
examples.zh: 历史上，异端者常常面临严重后果。

definitions.en: n. a mass of precious metal
definitions.zh: n. 金银, 金银块, 纯金

definitions.en: n. gold or silver in bars or ingots
definitions.zh: [经] 金银锭

examples.en: The bank stores gold bullion in its vault.
examples.zh: 银行在金库中储存金条。

examples.en: Bullion is often traded as bars or ingots.
examples.zh: 金银通常以条或锭的形式交易。

definitions.en: s. fit for habitation
definitions.zh: a. 适于居住的, 可居住的

examples.en: The house is habitable after the repairs.
examples.zh: 房子修理后可以居住了。

examples.en: Scientists search for habitable planets in space.
examples.zh: 科学家在太空中寻找适宜居住的行星。

definitions.en: n. a substance capable of reducing friction by making surfaces smooth or slippery
definitions.zh: a. 润滑的
n. 润滑物, 润滑油, 润滑剂

examples.en: Use lubricant to reduce friction in the engine.
examples.zh: 使用润滑油减少发动机的摩擦。

examples.en: The mechanic applied lubricant to the squeaky door.
examples.zh: 机械师给吱吱作响的门上了润滑剂。

definitions.en: n. a lightweight waterproof (usually rubberized) fabric
definitions.zh: n. 马金托什防水布, 马金托什雨衣
[化] 防水胶布; 胶布雨衣

examples.en: She wore a mackintosh to stay dry in the rain.
examples.zh: 她穿了件雨衣以在雨中保持干燥。

examples.en: His old mackintosh was made of rubberized fabric.
examples.zh: 他的旧雨衣是用防水胶布做的。

definitions.en: a. (of taxes) adjusted so that the rate decreases as the amount of income increases
definitions.zh: a. 后退的, 退化的, 回归的

definitions.en: a. opposing progress; returning to a former less advanced state
definitions.zh: [医] 退化的, 退行的, 消退的, 回归的

examples.en: The tax system is regressive for low-income people.
examples.zh: 这个税收制度对低收入人群是倒退的。

examples.en: His regressive behavior made him seem younger.
examples.zh: 他退化的行为让他显得更年轻。

definitions.en: n. a clan or tribe identified by their kinship to a common totemic object
definitions.zh: n. 图腾, 标志物, 崇拜物

examples.en: The tribe used a totem pole to tell stories.
examples.zh: 部落用图腾柱来讲述故事。

examples.en: Each family has its own totem animal for protection.
examples.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的图腾动物以求保护。

definitions.en: n. sudden violent winds; often accompanied by precipitation
definitions.zh: n. 飑, 喊叫

definitions.en: v. make high-pitched, whiney noises
definitions.zh: vi. 起飑, 嚎啕, 叫嚷

definitions.en: v. blow in a squall
definitions.zh: vt. 尖叫

examples.en: A sudden squall hit the boat during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中一阵突然的飑袭击了船。

examples.en: The baby began to squall loudly for attention.
examples.zh: 婴儿开始大声哭闹以引起注意。

definitions.en: n. a massive inexorable force that seems to crush everything in its way
definitions.zh: n. 世界主宰

examples.en: The company became a juggernaut in the industry.
examples.zh: 那家公司成了行业中的主宰力量。

examples.en: The juggernaut of change crushed all opposition.
examples.zh: 变革的巨力碾压了所有反对。

definitions.en: v. become weaker, in strength, value, or magnitude
definitions.zh: a. 纤细的, 稀薄的, 稀释的

definitions.en: s. reduced in strength
definitions.zh: vt. 使减弱, 使纤细
vi. 变稀薄, 变纤细, 减少

examples.en: The medicine helps attenuate the pain over time.
examples.zh: 这种药随时间推移有助于减轻疼痛。

examples.en: The signal will attenuate if you go too far.
examples.zh: 如果你走得太远，信号会减弱。

definitions.en: n. a figure of speech that expresses a resemblance between things of different kinds (usually formed with `like' or `as')
definitions.zh: n. 明喻, 明喻说法

examples.en: A simile uses 'like' or 'as' to compare things.
examples.zh: 明喻用‘像’或‘如同’来比较事物。

examples.en: Her smile was like sunshine is a common simile.
examples.zh: 她的笑容像阳光是一个常见的明喻。

definitions.en: n a cruel wicked and inhuman person
definitions.zh: n. 魔鬼, 邪神, 能手, 成癖者

examples.en: The villain in the story was a cruel fiend.
examples.zh: 故事中的反派是个残忍的魔鬼。

examples.en: He is a fiend for chocolate and eats it daily.
examples.zh: 他是个巧克力狂，每天都吃。

definitions.en: n. shears for cutting grass or shrubbery (often used in the plural)
definitions.zh: [电] 截割器

examples.en: He trimmed the hedge with a clipper.
examples.zh: 他用大剪刀修剪了树篱。

examples.en: The clipper sailed across the ocean fast.
examples.zh: 这艘快速帆船快速穿越大洋。

definitions.en: n. a subordinate incident of little importance relative to the main event
definitions.zh: n. 杂耍, 附属活动, 枝节问题

examples.en: The main event was just a sideshow.
examples.zh: 主要事件只是一个附属活动。

examples.en: Don't get distracted by this sideshow.
examples.zh: 不要被这个枝节问题分心。

definitions.en: s. represented or appearing as such; pretended
definitions.zh: a. 表面的, 假装的, 看得出的
[经] 表面的, 诡称的

examples.en: His ostensible reason was to help us.
examples.zh: 他表面的理由是帮助我们。

examples.en: The ostensible leader had no real power.
examples.zh: 表面的领导者没有真正的权力。

definitions.en: n. a floor covering
definitions.zh: n. 油地毡, 漆布
[化] 油毡; 亚麻油毡

examples.en: The kitchen floor is covered with linoleum.
examples.zh: 厨房地板铺着油地毡。

examples.en: She cleaned the linoleum every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上清洁漆布。

definitions.en: v. startle with amazement or fear
definitions.zh: vi. 犹豫, 踌躇, 吃惊, 搪塞

definitions.en: v. hesitate when confronted with a problem, or when in doubt or fear
definitions.zh: vt. 搞坏
n. 犹豫, 吃惊

examples.en: The complex math problem made him boggle.
examples.zh: 复杂的数学问题让他犹豫。

examples.en: Don't boggle at the new technology.
examples.zh: 不要对新科技感到吃惊。

definitions.en: n. a straight line at right angles to another line
definitions.zh: n. 垂直线, 垂直的位置, 直立(姿势), 刚正, 垂规

definitions.en: n. a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
definitions.zh: a. 垂直的, 直立的, 陡峭的

examples.en: The wall is perpendicular to the floor.
examples.zh: 墙与地板垂直。

examples.en: Draw a line perpendicular to this one.
examples.zh: 画一条与这条线垂直的线。

definitions.en: a characterized by asymmetry in the spatial arrangement or placement of parts or components
definitions.zh: a. 不对称的, 偏位的
[计] 非对称的, 不对称的, 不平衡的

examples.en: The design is asymmetric but beautiful.
examples.zh: 这个设计不对称但美丽。

examples.en: Her haircut is intentionally asymmetric.
examples.zh: 她的发型故意不对称。

definitions.en: n. (botany) a plant having a life cycle that normally takes two seasons from germination to death to complete; flowering biennials usually bloom and fruit in the second season
definitions.zh: n. 两年生植物, 两年一次的事

definitions.en: a. having a life cycle lasting two seasons
definitions.zh: a. 两年生的, 两年一次的

examples.en: The art fair is a biennial event.
examples.zh: 艺术博览会是一个两年一次的活动。

examples.en: This biennial plant flowers in its second year.
examples.zh: 这种两年生植物在第二年开花。

definitions.en: n. an illegal action inciting resistance to lawful authority and tending to cause the disruption or overthrow of the government
definitions.zh: n. 煽动骚乱, 暴动, 妨害治安, 骚动
[法] 煽动, 煽动叛逆罪, 暴动

examples.en: He was arrested for sedition against the state.
examples.zh: 他因煽动叛乱罪被捕。

examples.en: The speech was considered an act of sedition.
examples.zh: 这次演讲被视为煽动骚乱的行为。

definitions.en: v. cause to vibrate in a definite pattern
definitions.zh: v. (使)偏振, (使)极化, (使)两极分化

examples.en: The issue tends to polarize the community.
examples.zh: 这个问题倾向于使社区两极分化。

examples.en: Light can polarize when passing through a filter.
examples.zh: 光通过滤光器时可以极化。

definitions.en: n. a disinclination to work or exert yourself
definitions.zh: n. 怠惰, 懒惰

examples.en: Sloth is one of the seven deadly sins.
examples.zh: 懒惰是七宗罪之一。

examples.en: His sloth caused him to fail the exam.
examples.zh: 他的懒惰导致他考试不及格。

definitions.en: n. flesh of quail; suitable for roasting or broiling if young; otherwise must be braised
definitions.zh: n. 鹌鹑

definitions.en: n. small gallinaceous game birds
definitions.zh: vi. 胆怯, 畏缩

examples.en: She saw a quail in the field.
examples.zh: 她在田野里看到一只鹌鹑。

examples.en: He began to quail at the loud noise.
examples.zh: 他开始因巨大的噪音而畏缩。

definitions.en: n. a junction where two things (as paper or film or magnetic tape) have been joined together
definitions.zh: vt. 接合, 捻接, 胶接, 使结婚

definitions.en: v. join the ends of
definitions.zh: n. 接合, 胶接, 结婚

definitions.en: v. join together so as to form new genetic combinations
definitions.zh: [计] 接头

examples.en: He learned how to splice ropes together.
examples.zh: 他学会了如何接合绳子。

examples.en: The film editor made a clean splice.
examples.zh: 电影编辑做了一个干净的接合。

definitions.en: n. a sweet liquid secretion that is attractive to pollinators
definitions.zh: n. 神酒, 甜美饮料, 甘露

examples.en: Bees collect nectar from flowers.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂从花朵收集甘露。

examples.en: The drink tasted like sweet nectar.
examples.zh: 这饮料尝起来像甜美的神酒。

definitions.en: s. being present everywhere at once
definitions.zh: a. 无所不在的, 普通存在的

examples.en: In the city, cameras seem omnipresent.
examples.zh: 在城市里，摄像头似乎无所不在。

examples.en: The smell of coffee was omnipresent in the café.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味在咖啡馆里无所不在。

definitions.en: v combine into one
definitions.zh: vi. 混入, 渗入, 掺杂
vt. 使混合

examples.en: The two cultures intermingle in this city.
examples.zh: 两种文化在这个城市里混合。

examples.en: Don't intermingle the different types of waste.
examples.zh: 不要混合不同类型的垃圾。

definitions.en: v. spread negative information about
definitions.zh: vt. 诽谤, 贬低
[法] 诋毁, 中伤, 诽谤

examples.en: The politician tried to vilify his opponent.
examples.zh: 这位政治家试图诽谤他的对手。

examples.en: They vilify her in the press.
examples.zh: 他们在媒体上贬低她。

definitions.en: n. the state of being more than full
definitions.zh: n. 过食, 过度, 恶心

definitions.en: v. supply or feed to surfeit
definitions.zh: vt. 使厌腻, 使沉溺于

definitions.en: v. indulge (one's appetite) to satiety
definitions.zh: vi. 饮食过度

examples.en: A surfeit of sweets made him sick.
examples.zh: 过食甜食让他恶心。

examples.en: Don't surfeit yourself with rich food.
examples.zh: 不要让自己沉溺于油腻食物。

definitions.en: n. someone who rebels and becomes an outlaw
definitions.zh: n. 背教者, 变节者, 脱党者
a. 背弃的, 脱离的, 叛徒的
vi. 背叛, 背弃, 脱离

examples.en: The renegade soldier left the army.
examples.zh: 变节者离开了军队。

examples.en: He became a renegade in the group.
examples.zh: 他成了小组里的叛徒。

definitions.en: n a soft wet area of low-lying land that sinks underfoot
definitions.zh: n. 沼泽地, 泥坑, 泥潭, 泥沼, 沼泽, 困境

examples.en: The heavy rain turned the field into a quagmire.
examples.zh: 大雨把田野变成了泥沼。

examples.en: The project became a quagmire of problems.
examples.zh: 这个项目变成了问题的困境。

definitions.en: s. showing little emotion
definitions.zh: a. 粘液质的, (正式)平静的, 不动情的, 不动感情的, 冷漠的, 冷淡的, 迟钝的
[医] 粘液质的, 迟钝的

examples.en: He remained phlegmatic during the crisis.
examples.zh: 他在危机中保持平静。

examples.en: Her phlegmatic nature made her a good nurse.
examples.zh: 她冷漠的天性使她成为好护士。

definitions.en: s. brilliant
definitions.zh: a. 有光泽的, 光辉的

examples.en: Her hair was lustrous and healthy.
examples.zh: 她的头发有光泽且健康。

examples.en: The pearl had a lustrous shine.
examples.zh: 这颗珍珠有光辉的光泽。

definitions.en: s. having a play of lustrous rainbow colors
definitions.zh: a. 彩虹色的, 闪光的
[医] 虹色的, 晕色的

examples.en: The soap bubble was iridescent in the sun.
examples.zh: 肥皂泡在阳光下是彩虹色的。

examples.en: The butterfly's wings are iridescent.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀是闪光的。

definitions.en: s habitually disposed to disobedience and opposition
definitions.zh: a. 顽固的, 刚愎的, 任性的

examples.en: The headstrong child refused to listen.
examples.zh: 任性的孩子拒绝听。

examples.en: Her headstrong attitude caused problems.
examples.zh: 她顽固的态度导致了问题。

definitions.en: n. the location of a planet in the zodiac at which it is believed to exert its maximum influence
definitions.zh: n. 提升, 提高, 得意洋洋

definitions.en: n. a flock of larks (especially a flock of larks in flight overhead)
definitions.zh: [医] [异常]兴奋, 激越

examples.en: The exaltation of the team was clear after winning.
examples.zh: 胜利后队伍的得意洋洋显而易见。

examples.en: She felt great exaltation at the good news.
examples.zh: 她听到好消息感到非常兴奋。

definitions.en: n. a person of exceptional importance and reputation
definitions.zh: n. 巨像, 巨人

examples.en: He is a colossus in the world of science.
examples.zh: 他是科学界的巨人。

examples.en: The ancient statue was a true colossus.
examples.zh: 那座古代雕像是一个真正的巨像。

definitions.en: n a person who becomes aware (of things or events) through the senses
definitions.zh: n. 观看者

examples.en: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
examples.zh: 美在观看者的眼中。

examples.en: The beholder admired the painting for hours.
examples.zh: 观看者欣赏那幅画好几个小时。

definitions.en: n. (ancient Rome) a religious official who interpreted omens to guide public policy
definitions.zh: n. 占卜官, 预言者

definitions.en: v. predict from an omen
definitions.zh: v. 预示, 预言

examples.en: The dark clouds augur a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着一场暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: This success augurs well for the future.
examples.zh: 这次成功预示着未来会很好。

definitions.en: s. commanding attention
definitions.zh: a. 引人注意的
[计] 定位

examples.en: Her dress was very arresting at the party.
examples.zh: 她的裙子在派对上非常引人注意。

examples.en: The painting had an arresting use of color.
examples.zh: 那幅画使用了引人注意的色彩。

definitions.en: v. act in an arrogant, overly self-assured, or conceited manner
definitions.zh: n. 大摇大摆, 吹牛, 妄自尊大, 威吓
vi. 虚张声势吓人, 大摇大摆, 吹牛
vt. 吓唬, 恫吓

examples.en: He walked into the room with a swagger.
examples.zh: 他大摇大摆地走进房间。

examples.en: Don't swagger about your achievements.
examples.zh: 不要吹嘘你的成就。

definitions.en: s. displaying brilliance and virtuosity
definitions.zh: a. 艳丽的, 炫耀的

examples.en: Her showy jewelry attracted everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她艳丽的珠宝吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.en: He wore a showy suit to the event.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套炫耀的西装去参加活动。

definitions.en: n blasphemous behavior; the act of depriving something of its sacred character
definitions.zh: n. 亵渎圣物, 冒渎, 渎圣行为
[法] 橇门入教堂行窃, 窃取圣物

examples.en: Burning the flag is considered a sacrilege.
examples.zh: 焚烧国旗被视为亵渎圣物。

examples.en: It would be a sacrilege to destroy this temple.
examples.zh: 摧毁这座寺庙将是冒渎行为。

definitions.en: a. of or infected by rabies
definitions.zh: a. 猛烈的, 热烈的, 急进的, 狂怒的, 偏激的, 疯狂的
[医] 狂犬病的, 咬病的

examples.en: The dog was rabid and had to be caught.
examples.zh: 那只狗患了狂犬病，必须被抓住。

examples.en: He is a rabid fan of that football team.
examples.zh: 他是那支足球队的狂热粉丝。

definitions.en: v. strike, usually with the fist
definitions.zh: vt. 击, 打, 揍

examples.en: The boxer began to pummel his opponent.
examples.zh: 拳击手开始猛击他的对手。

examples.en: She pummeled the pillow in frustration.
examples.zh: 她沮丧地捶打枕头。

definitions.en: n a dissolute man in fashionable society
definitions.zh: a. 放荡的, 不检点的, 浪费的

definitions.en: n a recklessly extravagant consumer
definitions.zh: n. 放荡者, 享乐者

examples.en: His profligate spending left him in debt.
examples.zh: 他浪费的开销使他负债累累。

examples.en: The profligate man wasted all his money.
examples.zh: 那个放荡的人挥霍了所有钱。

definitions.en: s. showing pensive sadness
definitions.zh: a. 沉思的, 哀思的, 忧郁的

examples.en: She looked pensive as she stared out the window.
examples.zh: 她凝视窗外，显得沉思忧郁。

examples.en: His pensive mood worried his friends.
examples.zh: 他忧郁的情绪让朋友们担心。

definitions.en: n injustice by virtue of not conforming with rules or standards
definitions.zh: n. 不公平, 不公正

examples.en: The law aims to reduce social inequity.
examples.zh: 这项法律旨在减少社会不公。

examples.en: Inequity in education harms many children.
examples.zh: 教育上的不公平伤害了许多孩子。

definitions.en: s. lacking social polish
definitions.zh: a. 缺乏社经验的, 笨拙的, 粗鲁的, 无礼的, 偏转的

examples.en: His gauche behavior embarrassed everyone at dinner.
examples.zh: 他笨拙的行为让晚餐上的每个人都尴尬。

examples.en: She felt gauche at the formal party.
examples.zh: 她在正式派对上感到笨拙无礼。

definitions.en: v hold spellbound
definitions.zh: a. 迷人的

examples.en: The movie was absolutely enthralling from start to finish.
examples.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都绝对迷人。

examples.en: She told an enthralling story about her travels.
examples.zh: 她讲了一个关于她旅行的迷人故事。

definitions.en: s young and inexperienced
definitions.zh: a. 年轻而无经验的, (鸟)羽毛未丰的
[机] 无羽毛的

examples.en: The callow youth made many mistakes.
examples.zh: 那个年轻无经验的青年犯了很多错误。

examples.en: His callow attitude showed his inexperience.
examples.zh: 他年轻无经验的态度显示了他的不成熟。

definitions.en: n. pancake batter baked in a waffle iron
definitions.zh: vi. 胡扯, 闲聊
n. 华夫饼干, 胡扯
[计] Waffle程序

examples.en: I ate a waffle for breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上早餐吃了华夫饼干。

examples.en: Stop waffling and give me a straight answer.
examples.zh: 别胡扯了，给我一个直接的回答。

definitions.en: n. anything that resembles a vagabond in having no fixed place
definitions.zh: n. 流浪者, 浪子, 流氓
vi. 到处流浪
a. 流浪的, 漂泊的, 浪荡的, 流浪者的

examples.en: The vagabond traveled from town to town.
examples.zh: 那个流浪者从一个城镇旅行到另一个。

examples.en: He lived like a vagabond for many years.
examples.zh: 他像流浪汉一样生活了很多年。

definitions.en: v make saw-toothed or jag the edge of
definitions.zh: a. 锯齿状的

definitions.en: s notched like a saw with teeth pointing toward the apex
definitions.zh: [医] 锯齿状的

examples.en: The knife has a serrated edge for cutting bread.
examples.zh: 这把刀有锯齿状边缘用于切面包。

examples.en: The leaf has a serrated margin.
examples.zh: 这片叶子有锯齿状的边缘。

definitions.en: n an inclination to retreat from unpleasant realities through diversion or fantasy
definitions.zh: n. 逃避现实, 逃避主义

examples.en: Reading books is a form of escapism for her.
examples.zh: 读书对她来说是一种逃避现实的方式。

examples.en: Some people use video games as escapism.
examples.zh: 有些人用电子游戏作为逃避主义。

definitions.en: n. a state of peace agreed to between opponents so they can discuss peace terms
definitions.zh: n. 休战, 停战
[法] 休战, 停战, 停火

examples.en: The two countries signed an armistice to end the war.
examples.zh: 两国签署了停战协议以结束战争。

examples.en: The armistice brought peace to the region.
examples.zh: 休战给该地区带来了和平。

definitions.en: n. an angular shape characterized by sharp turns in alternating directions
definitions.zh: n. 曲折线条, Z字形道路

definitions.en: v. travel along a zigzag path
definitions.zh: a. 之字形的, 曲折的, 锯齿形的

definitions.en: s. having short sharp turns or angles
definitions.zh: adv. 之字形地, 曲折地, 成锯齿形地

examples.en: The path went up the mountain in a zigzag.
examples.zh: 小路呈之字形通向山上。

examples.en: The car zigzagged through the traffic.
examples.zh: 汽车在车流中曲折穿行。

definitions.en: a. lacking principles or moral scruples
definitions.zh: a. 不讲道德的, 不正直的

examples.en: His unprincipled behavior shocked everyone.
examples.zh: 他不讲道德的行为震惊了所有人。

examples.en: An unprincipled person cannot be trusted.
examples.zh: 一个不正直的人不可信任。

definitions.en: n a sponsor who books and stages public entertainments
definitions.zh: n. 演出者, 主持人

examples.en: The impresario organized a wonderful concert.
examples.zh: 那位演出者组织了一场精彩的音乐会。

examples.en: She worked as an impresario for the theater.
examples.zh: 她为剧院担任主持人。

definitions.en: n. a delay in enforcing rights or claims or privileges; refraining from acting
definitions.zh: n. 节制, 自制, 忍耐
[法] 债务偿还期的延展, 忍耐, 宽容

examples.en: She showed great forbearance during the long wait.
examples.zh: 她在漫长的等待中表现出极大的忍耐。

examples.en: The bank granted forbearance on the loan payments.
examples.zh: 银行批准了贷款还款的延展。

definitions.en: a. (of plants and shrubs) shedding foliage at the end of the growing season
definitions.zh: a. 每年落叶的, 非永久性的

definitions.en: s. (of teeth, antlers, etc.) being shed at the end of a period of growth
definitions.zh: [医] 脱落的

examples.en: Deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn.
examples.zh: 落叶树在秋天掉叶子。

examples.en: The forest is full of deciduous plants.
examples.zh: 森林里满是每年落叶的植物。

definitions.en: n. a fear of foreigners or strangers
definitions.zh: n. 无端畏惧和憎恨外国人/陌生人, 对外国人的畏惧和憎恨
[医] 生客恐怖

examples.en: Xenophobia can lead to discrimination against immigrants.
examples.zh: 对外国人的恐惧会导致对移民的歧视。

examples.en: The country struggled with rising xenophobia.
examples.zh: 这个国家与日益增长的仇外心理作斗争。

definitions.en: n. the act of swindling by some fraudulent scheme
definitions.zh: n. 骗取, 欺诈, 骗局
v. 骗取, 诈取

examples.en: He tried to swindle the old man out of his money.
examples.zh: 他试图骗取老人的钱。

examples.en: The investment turned out to be a swindle.
examples.zh: 那个投资原来是个骗局。

definitions.en: n. a broken piece of a brittle artifact
definitions.zh: n. 陶瓷碎片, 鞘翅, 薄硬壳

examples.en: She found a shard of glass on the floor.
examples.zh: 她在地板上发现了一块玻璃碎片。

examples.en: The potter picked up a shard of the broken vase.
examples.zh: 陶工捡起破碎花瓶的一块陶瓷碎片。

definitions.en: n. a feeling of agitation expressed in continual motion
definitions.zh: vi. 坐卧不安, 摆弄

definitions.en: v. move restlessly
definitions.zh: vt. 使烦乱, 使不安
n. 烦躁不安, 坐立不安的人

examples.en: The child began to fidget during the long speech.
examples.zh: 孩子在漫长的演讲中开始坐立不安。

examples.en: Stop that fidget and sit still.
examples.zh: 别那样摆弄了，坐好。

definitions.en: v ask for or request earnestly
definitions.zh: v. 恳求, 哀求

examples.en: I beseech you to help me in this matter.
examples.zh: 我恳求你在这件事上帮助我。

examples.en: She beseeched him to stay a little longer.
examples.zh: 她哀求他再待一会儿。

definitions.en: v influence by slyness
definitions.zh: vt. 诱骗

examples.en: He tried to beguile her with sweet words.
examples.zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语诱骗她。

examples.en: The magician beguiled the audience with his tricks.
examples.zh: 魔术师用他的把戏诱骗了观众。

definitions.en: s. being of questionable authenticity
definitions.zh: a. 伪的, 不足凭信的

examples.en: The story is likely apocryphal and not true.
examples.zh: 这个故事很可能是伪的，不是真的。

examples.en: Many apocryphal tales surround the ancient king.
examples.zh: 许多不足凭信的传说围绕着这位古代国王。

definitions.en: v. revoke formally
definitions.zh: vt. 废除, 取消
[经] 取消, 废除, 不生效(的法令)

examples.en: The government decided to abrogate the old law.
examples.zh: 政府决定废除旧法律。

examples.en: They voted to abrogate the treaty.
examples.zh: 他们投票取消该条约。

definitions.en: n. a concluding summary (as in presenting a case before a law court)
definitions.zh: n. 总和, 和, 合计

definitions.en: n. (physiology) the process whereby multiple stimuli can produce a response (in a muscle or nerve or other part) that one stimulus alone does not produce
definitions.zh: [医] 总和, 总合

examples.en: The lawyer gave a powerful summation to the jury.
examples.zh: 律师向陪审团做了有力的总结。

examples.en: The summation of the costs was over a million dollars.
examples.zh: 成本总和超过一百万美元。

definitions.en: n someone who drives a herd
definitions.zh: n. 牧人, 牧主

examples.en: The herdsman led the cattle to the river.
examples.zh: 牧人把牛群领到河边。

examples.en: A herdsman lives a simple life in the mountains.
examples.zh: 牧人在山里过着简单的生活。

definitions.en: n. apparatus consisting of a box designed to maintain a constant temperature by the use of a thermostat; used for chicks or premature infants
definitions.zh: n. 孵卵器, 细菌培养器, 早产儿保育器
[化] 恒温箱; 孵化箱

examples.en: The premature baby was placed in an incubator.
examples.zh: 早产儿被放在保育器里。

examples.en: The farmer used an incubator to hatch the eggs.
examples.zh: 农民用孵卵器来孵化鸡蛋。

definitions.en: v. expel air
definitions.zh: v. 呼气, 发出, 散发

examples.en: Take a deep breath and then exhale slowly.
examples.zh: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼气。

examples.en: She exhaled in relief after the exam.
examples.zh: 考试后她如释重负地呼了口气。

definitions.en: n. a secret look
definitions.zh: vi. 偷看, 窥视
n. 偷看, 看一眼

examples.en: He took a quick peek at the answer sheet.
examples.zh: 他快速偷看了一眼答案纸。

examples.en: She peeked through the curtains to see who was there.
examples.zh: 她透过窗帘偷看是谁在那里。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to marriage or to the relationship between a wife and husband
definitions.zh: a. 婚姻的, 配偶的
[医] 夫妇的

examples.en: They enjoyed many years of conjugal bliss.
examples.zh: 他们享受了多年的婚姻幸福。

examples.en: Conjugal rights are protected by law.
examples.zh: 配偶的权利受法律保护。

definitions.en: n. a sports implement with a long handle and a head like a hammer; used in sports (polo or croquet) to hit a ball
definitions.zh: n. 木槌, 球棍, 棒

definitions.en: n. a light drumstick with a rounded head that is used to strike such percussion instruments as chimes, kettledrums, marimbas, glockenspiels, etc.
definitions.zh: [化] 大锤; 手锤

examples.en: He used a mallet to hit the croquet ball.
examples.zh: 他用木槌击打槌球。

examples.en: The drummer struck the chime with a mallet.
examples.zh: 鼓手用槌敲击钟琴。

definitions.en: n. incorporation by joining or uniting
definitions.zh: n. 合并, 附加, 附加物

definitions.en: n. the formal act of acquiring something (especially territory) by conquest or occupation
definitions.zh: [法] 兼并, 侵吞, 附加物

examples.en: The annexation of the territory was controversial.
examples.zh: 对该领土的吞并是有争议的。

examples.en: Annexation often leads to political tension.
examples.zh: 吞并常常导致政治紧张。

definitions.en: n. a variety show with topical sketches and songs and dancing and comedians
definitions.zh: n. 时事剧, 活报剧

examples.en: The revue featured funny sketches and songs.
examples.zh: 这场时事剧包含有趣的短剧和歌曲。

examples.en: We enjoyed a lively revue at the theater.
examples.zh: 我们在剧院欣赏了一场生动的时事剧。

definitions.en: a. used of animals that move seasonally
definitions.zh: a. 迁移的, 流浪的

examples.en: Migratory birds fly south for the winter.
examples.zh: 候鸟冬天飞往南方。

examples.en: These migratory animals travel long distances.
examples.zh: 这些迁徙动物长途跋涉。

definitions.en: n. a small carved or molded figure
definitions.zh: n. 小雕像

examples.en: She keeps a small figurine on her desk.
examples.zh: 她在桌上放了一个小雕像。

examples.en: The figurine is made of carved wood.
examples.zh: 这个小雕像是用木头雕刻的。

definitions.en: n. a loop formed in a cord or rope by means of a slipknot; it binds tighter as the cord or rope is pulled
definitions.zh: n. 套索, 束缚, 陷阱

definitions.en: v. make a noose in or of
definitions.zh: vt. 用套索捉

examples.en: He tied a noose in the rope carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地在绳子上打了个套索。

examples.en: The cowboy used a noose to catch the horse.
examples.zh: 牛仔用套索抓住了马。

definitions.en: s. wild and menacing
definitions.zh: a. 野生的, 凶猛的, 野兽的
[医] 凶猛的, 野生的

examples.en: Feral cats live in the abandoned building.
examples.zh: 野猫住在废弃的大楼里。

examples.en: The feral dog looked hungry and scared.
examples.zh: 那只野狗看起来又饿又害怕。

definitions.en: v. eliminate from the body
definitions.zh: vt. 排泄, 分泌
[医] 排泄, 分泌

examples.en: The body excretes waste through sweat.
examples.zh: 身体通过汗液排泄废物。

examples.en: Plants excrete oxygen during photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 植物在光合作用中分泌氧气。

definitions.en: n. gown (especially ceremonial garments) worn by the clergy
definitions.zh: n. 衣服, 衣裳, 礼服, 法衣, 祭服

examples.en: The priest wore a white vestment during mass.
examples.zh: 神父在弥撒时穿着白色法衣。

examples.en: Her vestment was decorated with gold thread.
examples.zh: 她的法衣上装饰着金线。

definitions.en: n. one who is playfully mischievous
definitions.zh: n. 顽童
vt. 加强, 给...装上翅膀
[计] 图象处理程序, 接口信息处理器

examples.en: The little imp hid his sister's toy.
examples.zh: 那个小顽童藏起了他妹妹的玩具。

examples.en: He is a playful imp who loves tricks.
examples.zh: 他是个爱恶作剧的顽童。

definitions.en: n the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
definitions.zh: n. 现场, 场所
[计] 场所

examples.en: The movie was filmed in a beautiful locale.
examples.zh: 这部电影在一个美丽的地方拍摄。

examples.en: They chose a quiet locale for the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们选了一个安静的地方开会。

definitions.en: n. one who is absent from school without permission
definitions.zh: n. 懒惰的人, 玩忽职守者, 旷课者

definitions.en: s. absent without permission
definitions.zh: a. 偷懒的, 旷课的, 游荡的
vi. 偷懒, 旷课

examples.en: The truant student skipped school again.
examples.zh: 那个旷课的学生又逃学了。

examples.en: He was a truant and often played outside.
examples.zh: 他是个旷课者，经常在外面玩。

definitions.en: n an organism that has the characteristics of a more primitive type of that organism
definitions.zh: n. 掷回, 挫折, 阻止

definitions.en: n a reappearance of an earlier characteristic
definitions.zh: [医] 返祖者, 隔代遗传者

examples.en: His behavior is a throwback to earlier times.
examples.zh: 他的行为是早期时代的返祖现象。

examples.en: The design is a throwback to the 1950s.
examples.zh: 这个设计是20世纪50年代的回归。

definitions.en: n. a cloth covering (a legging) that covers the instep and ankles
definitions.zh: n. 蚝卵, 口角, 拍打

definitions.en: n. a young oyster or other bivalve
definitions.zh: vi. 拍打, 争吵

definitions.en: v. come down like raindrops
definitions.zh: spit的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: They had a spat over the broken vase.
examples.zh: 他们因为打碎的花瓶吵了一架。

examples.en: The spat between the two friends was brief.
examples.zh: 两个朋友之间的争吵很短暂。

definitions.en: a. immune to attack; impregnable
definitions.zh: a. 不会受伤害的, 刀枪不入的, 无懈可击的, 无可反驳的

examples.en: The fortress seemed invulnerable to attack.
examples.zh: 这座堡垒似乎坚不可摧。

examples.en: He felt invulnerable after winning the match.
examples.zh: 赢得比赛后，他觉得自己无懈可击。

definitions.en: s. impossible to deny or disprove
definitions.zh: a. 无争论余地的, 无疑的, 明白的
[法] 不可辩驳的, 不容置疑的

examples.en: The evidence is incontrovertible and clear.
examples.zh: 证据确凿无疑。

examples.en: Her argument was incontrovertible in court.
examples.zh: 她的论点在法庭上无可辩驳。

definitions.en: s. containing or based on a fallacy
definitions.zh: a. 使人误解的, 谬误的, 不合理的, 骗人的

examples.en: His reasoning was fallacious and misleading.
examples.zh: 他的推理是谬误且误导人的。

examples.en: The fallacious argument fooled many people.
examples.zh: 这个谬误的论点欺骗了很多人。

definitions.en: v. violate the sacred character of a place or language
definitions.zh: vt. 供俗用, 亵渎, 轻蔑地对待

examples.en: Vandals tried to desecrate the old church.
examples.zh: 破坏者试图亵渎这座老教堂。

examples.en: Do not desecrate this sacred place.
examples.zh: 不要亵渎这个神圣的地方。

definitions.en: v. confuse or put into disorder
definitions.zh: vt. 使道德败坏, 使堕落, 挫折锐气

examples.en: The bad news will demoralize the team.
examples.zh: 坏消息会使团队士气低落。

examples.en: Constant criticism can demoralize a person.
examples.zh: 不断的批评会使人意志消沉。

definitions.en: v reduce in worth or character, usually verbally
definitions.zh: vt. 贬低身分, 贬损

examples.en: He would not demean himself by lying.
examples.zh: 他不会通过说谎来贬低自己。

examples.en: Such behavior will demean your reputation.
examples.zh: 这种行为会贬损你的声誉。

definitions.en: s marked by quiet and caution and secrecy; taking pains to avoid being observed
definitions.zh: a. 秘密的, 暗中的, 偷偷摸摸的

definitions.en: s conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods
definitions.zh: [法] 鬼鬼祟祟的, 秘密的, 欺骗的

examples.en: She took a surreptitious glance at the note.
examples.zh: 她偷偷瞥了一眼纸条。

examples.en: His surreptitious actions made everyone suspicious.
examples.zh: 他偷偷摸摸的行为让所有人起疑。

definitions.en: s expressing offensive reproach
definitions.zh: a. 说话粗鄙恶劣的, 下流的
[法] 语言粗鄙的, 庸俗的

examples.en: The article contained scurrilous remarks about her.
examples.zh: 那篇文章包含对她的粗鄙言论。

examples.en: He made scurrilous accusations against his rival.
examples.zh: 他对对手进行了下流的指控。

definitions.en: n. a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)
definitions.zh: n. 回答, 答辩, 答复

definitions.en: n. (law) a pleading made by a defendant in response to the plaintiff's replication
definitions.zh: [法] 答辩, 反驳, 第二次答辩

examples.en: Her quick rejoinder silenced the critic.
examples.zh: 她迅速的反驳让批评者哑口无言。

examples.en: He had no rejoinder to her clever question.
examples.zh: 他对她巧妙的问题无言以对。

definitions.en: s. (used of decomposing oils or fats) having a rank smell or taste usually due to a chemical change or decomposition
definitions.zh: a. 像油脂腐臭味的, 腐臭的
[医] 酸败的

examples.en: The butter had gone rancid and smelled bad.
examples.zh: 黄油已经酸败，闻起来很臭。

examples.en: Do not eat rancid nuts; they are harmful.
examples.zh: 不要吃酸败的坚果，它们有害。

definitions.en: v irritate or vex
definitions.zh: vt. 使厌倦, 使苦恼

examples.en: The constant noise began to irk him.
examples.zh: 持续的噪音开始让他厌烦。

examples.en: It irks me when people are late.
examples.zh: 别人迟到让我很恼火。

definitions.en: n. the action of interjecting or interposing an action or remark that interrupts
definitions.zh: n. 感叹词, 插入语

examples.en: An interjection like 'Wow' shows surprise.
examples.zh: 像“哇”这样的感叹词表示惊讶。

examples.en: She used an interjection to express joy.
examples.zh: 她用了一个感叹词来表达喜悦。

definitions.en: n. a ritual recitation of words or sounds believed to have a magical effect
definitions.zh: n. 咒语

examples.en: The witch recited a powerful incantation.
examples.zh: 女巫念了一段强大的咒语。

examples.en: The incantation was meant to break the spell.
examples.zh: 这段咒语旨在破除魔法。

definitions.en: n. a small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin
definitions.zh: n. 雀斑, 斑点

definitions.en: v. become freckled
definitions.zh: [医] 非曝露部雀斑

examples.en: She has a small freckle on her nose.
examples.zh: 她鼻子上有一个小雀斑。

examples.en: His face freckles when he stays in the sun.
examples.zh: 他在阳光下待着时脸上会长雀斑。

definitions.en: n. a formal expression of praise for someone who has died recently
definitions.zh: n. 赞词, 称颂

examples.en: He gave a heartfelt eulogy at the funeral.
examples.zh: 他在葬礼上发表了感人的悼词。

examples.en: The eulogy praised her kindness and courage.
examples.zh: 悼词赞扬了她的善良和勇气。

definitions.en: v give encouragement to
definitions.zh: vt. 使大胆, 使有胆量

examples.en: Her success emboldened him to try harder.
examples.zh: 她的成功鼓励他更加努力。

examples.en: The praise emboldened the young artist.
examples.zh: 赞扬使这位年轻艺术家更有胆量。

definitions.en: v be a mystery or bewildering to
definitions.zh: vt. 使...惊讶得发呆

examples.en: The news will dumbfound everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 这个消息会让房间里所有人目瞪口呆。

examples.en: His sudden resignation dumbfounded his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他突然辞职让同事们惊愕不已。

definitions.en: s dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
definitions.zh: a. 谷类的, 乡巴佬似的, 粗野的
[建] 角制的, 角(质)的

examples.en: The movie had a corny and predictable plot.
examples.zh: 这部电影情节老套且可预测。

examples.en: He told a corny joke that made everyone groan.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个老掉牙的笑话，让大家直叹气。

definitions.en: s. marked by obliqueness or indirection in speech or conduct
definitions.zh: a. 迂回的, 间接的, 绕行的

examples.en: We took a circuitous route to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我们绕道而行以避开交通拥堵。

examples.en: His circuitous explanation confused the students.
examples.zh: 他迂回的解释让学生们困惑。

definitions.en: s. large in capacity
definitions.zh: a. 容积大的, 广阔的, 宽敞的

examples.en: The capacious bag held all her books.
examples.zh: 这个宽敞的包能装下她所有的书。

examples.en: They rented a capacious hall for the event.
examples.zh: 他们为活动租了一个宽敞的大厅。

definitions.en: v wait in hiding to attack
definitions.zh: vt. 伏击, 埋伏
[法] 挡路抢劫, 挡路, 挡截

examples.en: Thieves tried to waylay the travelers on the road.
examples.zh: 强盗试图在路上伏击旅行者。

examples.en: He was waylaid by reporters after the speech.
examples.zh: 演讲后他被记者拦截。

definitions.en: s not left to spoil
definitions.zh: a. 未损坏的；未宠坏的

examples.en: The beach remains unspoiled by tourism.
examples.zh: 这片海滩未被旅游业破坏。

examples.en: She is an unspoiled child with good manners.
examples.zh: 她是个未被宠坏、有礼貌的孩子。

definitions.en: v disturb the composure of
definitions.zh: a. 扰乱的, 使人不安的

examples.en: The unsettling news made everyone worried.
examples.zh: 这个令人不安的消息让所有人担忧。

examples.en: His unsettling silence filled the room.
examples.zh: 他令人不安的沉默充满了整个房间。

definitions.en: n. a state of motor and mental inactivity with a partial suspension of sensibility
definitions.zh: n. 麻木, 无感觉, 迟钝
[医] 迟钝, 不活泼

examples.en: The heat induced a state of torpor in him.
examples.zh: 炎热使他陷入麻木状态。

examples.en: She shook off her torpor and started working.
examples.zh: 她摆脱了迟钝，开始工作。

definitions.en: v. drink moderately but regularly
definitions.zh: vt. (习惯性地)少量饮(酒)
vi. 饮酒
n. 酒, 含酒饮料

examples.en: He would tipple a little wine every evening.
examples.zh: 他每晚都会少量喝点酒。

examples.en: Her favorite tipple is a glass of red wine.
examples.zh: 她最喜欢的酒是一杯红葡萄酒。

definitions.en: n. a sermon on a moral or religious topic
definitions.zh: n. 说教, 训诫

examples.en: The priest gave a short homily on kindness.
examples.zh: 神父就仁慈做了简短的说教。

examples.en: His homily about hard work bored the children.
examples.zh: 他关于努力工作的说教让孩子们厌烦。

definitions.en: s extremely hungry
definitions.zh: a. 贪婪的, 饿极的, 狼吞虎咽的

examples.en: After the hike, he was ravenous and ate quickly.
examples.zh: 徒步后，他饿极了，吃得很快。

examples.en: The ravenous wolf hunted for food all night.
examples.zh: 那只饿极的狼整夜觅食。

definitions.en: n. a message written in a secret code
definitions.zh: n. 零, 暗号, 密码, 无用的东西, 阿拉伯数字

definitions.en: n. a person of no influence
definitions.zh: v. 计算, 做算术

examples.en: The spy wrote a message in cipher.
examples.zh: 间谍用密码写了一则消息。

examples.en: He felt like a cipher in the big company.
examples.zh: 他在大公司里感觉自己像个无足轻重的人。

definitions.en: s occurring without motivation or provocation
definitions.zh: a. 未受挑衅的, 无正当理由的
[法] 无正当理由的, 无缘无故的, 未受刺激的

examples.en: The dog gave an unprovoked attack.
examples.zh: 那条狗无缘无故地发起攻击。

examples.en: Her unprovoked anger surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她无端的愤怒让所有人都很惊讶。

definitions.en: a. containing or resulting from disease-causing organisms
definitions.zh: a. 腐败的, 脓毒性的

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or caused by putrefaction
definitions.zh: n. 引起腐败的物质

examples.en: The wound became septic and needed treatment.
examples.zh: 伤口感染了，需要治疗。

examples.en: A septic tank stores waste underground.
examples.zh: 化粪池将废物储存在地下。

definitions.en: s arousing to action or rebellion
definitions.zh: a. 煽动性的, 妨害治安的

definitions.en: s in opposition to a civil authority or government
definitions.zh: [法] 妨害治安罪的, 煽动性的, 危及治安的

examples.en: The seditious speech angered the government.
examples.zh: 煽动性的言论激怒了政府。

examples.en: He was arrested for seditious activities.
examples.zh: 他因煽动性活动被捕。

definitions.en: n a collection containing a variety of sorts of things
definitions.zh: n. 杂集, 杂录, 混杂

examples.en: The book is a miscellany of short stories.
examples.zh: 这本书是短篇故事的杂集。

examples.en: She enjoys reading a miscellany of articles.
examples.zh: 她喜欢阅读各种文章的杂集。

definitions.en: n a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling
definitions.zh: n. 栏杆的支柱, 楼梯的扶栏
