examples.zh: 小鹅跟着它的妈妈。

examples.en: A young goose is called a gosling.
examples.zh: 小鹅被称为gosling。

definitions.en: v. hand over to the authorities of another country
definitions.zh: vt. 引渡, 获取(逃犯等)的引渡
[法] 引渡, 使被引渡

examples.en: The country agreed to extradite the criminal.
examples.zh: 该国同意引渡这名罪犯。

examples.en: They want to extradite him for trial.
examples.zh: 他们想引渡他进行审判。

definitions.en: n. a clay-like mineral; the chief ore of aluminum; composed of aluminum oxides and aluminum hydroxides; used as an abrasive and catalyst
definitions.zh: n. 铝矾土, 铝土矿
[化] 铝土矿

examples.en: Bauxite is the main ore of aluminum.
examples.zh: 铝土矿是铝的主要矿石。

examples.en: They mine bauxite in this region.
examples.zh: 他们在这个地区开采铝土矿。

definitions.en: n. a doctor who specializes in the physiology and pathology of the skin
definitions.zh: n. 皮肤学者, 皮肤科医生
[医] 皮肤病学家, 皮肤科医师

examples.en: A dermatologist treats skin problems.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生治疗皮肤问题。

examples.en: I have an appointment with a dermatologist.
examples.zh: 我和皮肤科医生有个预约。

definitions.en: s affecting or characteristic of the body as opposed to the mind or spirit
definitions.zh: a. 身体的, 肉体的, 壁体的
[医] 躯体的, 体壁的

examples.en: Somatic pain is felt in the body.
examples.zh: 躯体疼痛在身体上感觉到。

examples.en: Exercise improves somatic health.
examples.zh: 锻炼改善躯体健康。

definitions.en: n. a short amusing opera
definitions.zh: n. 小歌剧, 轻歌剧

examples.en: We enjoyed a light operetta last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚欣赏了一部轻歌剧。

examples.en: An operetta is a short amusing opera.
examples.zh: 轻歌剧是短小有趣的歌剧。

definitions.en: n. having only one spouse at a time
definitions.zh: n. 一夫一妻制
[医] 单配

examples.en: Monogamy means having one spouse.
examples.zh: 一夫一妻制意味着只有一个配偶。

examples.en: Many cultures practice monogamy.
examples.zh: 许多文化实行一夫一妻制。

definitions.en: v. fertilize by transfering pollen
definitions.zh: vt. 对...授粉

examples.en: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。

examples.en: Wind can also pollinate some plants.
examples.zh: 风也能给一些植物授粉。

definitions.en: n. the state of being not yet evident or active
definitions.zh: n. 潜伏, 潜在
[计] 传输时间, 传输延迟时间

examples.en: The virus has a long latency period.
examples.zh: 这种病毒有很长的潜伏期。

examples.en: Network latency can slow down the game.
examples.zh: 网络延迟会减慢游戏速度。

definitions.en: n. (ethics) the theory that the pursuit of your own welfare in the basis of morality
definitions.zh: n. 自我主义, 利己主义

examples.en: Egoism is thinking only of yourself.
examples.zh: 利己主义是只考虑自己。

examples.en: His egoism made him unpopular.
examples.zh: 他的利己主义让他不受欢迎。

definitions.en: a. able to refract light without spectral color separation
definitions.zh: a. 彩色的, 色品的, 易染色的

definitions.en: a. based on a scale consisting of 12 semitones
definitions.zh: [医] 色的, 易染的, 核染质的

examples.en: The rainbow has many chromatic colors.
examples.zh: 彩虹有许多彩色。

examples.en: She played a chromatic scale on the piano.
examples.zh: 她在钢琴上弹奏了半音阶。

definitions.en: n. container into which liquid is poured to create a given shape when it hardens
definitions.zh: n. 模子, 模型, 霉

definitions.en: n. loose soil rich in organic matter
definitions.zh: v. 形成, 塑造, 发霉

examples.en: Bread can grow mold in damp places.
examples.zh: 面包在潮湿的地方会发霉。

examples.en: She used a mold to make a cake.
examples.zh: 她用模具做蛋糕。

definitions.en: n a person regarded as arrogant and annoying
definitions.zh: n. 一本正经的人, 纨绔子弟

examples.en: Don't be such a prig about rules.
examples.zh: 别对规则那么一本正经。

examples.en: A prig often annoys other people.
examples.zh: 一本正经的人常惹人烦。

definitions.en: n. a double-reed instrument; the tenor of the oboe family
definitions.zh: n. 低音管, 巴松管

examples.en: He plays the bassoon in the orchestra.
examples.zh: 他在管弦乐队中演奏巴松管。

examples.en: The bassoon has a deep, rich sound.
examples.zh: 巴松管有深沉丰富的声音。

definitions.en: n. a tremulous sound
definitions.zh: vi. 发颤音, 颤抖

definitions.en: v. give off unsteady sounds, alternating in amplitude or frequency
definitions.zh: vt. 颤抖地说, 用颤声唱出
n. 颤抖, 颤声, 八分音符

examples.en: Her voice began to quaver with fear.
examples.zh: 她的声音因恐惧而开始颤抖。

examples.en: He sang the note with a quaver.
examples.zh: 他用颤音唱了那个音符。

definitions.en: a. (of genes) producing its characteristic phenotype only when its allele is identical
definitions.zh: a. 后退的, 逆行的, 隐性的
n. 隐性性状

examples.en: Blue eyes are a recessive trait.
examples.zh: 蓝眼睛是隐性特征。

examples.en: A recessive gene needs two copies.
examples.zh: 隐性基因需要两个副本。

definitions.en: n. mammals of which the females have a pouch (the marsupium) containing the teats where the young are fed and carried
definitions.zh: n. 有袋类动物

definitions.en: a. of or relating to the marsupials
definitions.zh: a. 有袋的, 袋状的

examples.en: A kangaroo is a marsupial animal.
examples.zh: 袋鼠是有袋类动物。

examples.en: Marsupials carry their young in a pouch.
examples.zh: 有袋类动物把幼崽放在育儿袋里。

definitions.en: v. analyze syntactically by assigning a constituent structure to (a sentence)
definitions.zh: vt. 从语法上分析
[计] 分列

examples.en: The computer can parse this sentence.
examples.zh: 计算机能分析这个句子。

examples.en: Students learn to parse Latin texts.
examples.zh: 学生学习分析拉丁文文本。

definitions.en: n. the right to take another's property if an obligation is not discharged
definitions.zh: n. 留置权, 扣押权
[医] 脾

examples.en: The bank has a lien on the house.
examples.zh: 银行对这所房子有留置权。

examples.en: He filed a lien against the property.
examples.zh: 他对该财产提出了留置权。

definitions.en: n. address to an absent or imaginary person
definitions.zh: n. 撇号, 呼语法

examples.en: Use an apostrophe for contractions.
examples.zh: 在缩写中使用撇号。

examples.en: The poet used an apostrophe to address the moon.
examples.zh: 诗人用呼语向月亮致辞。

definitions.en: n. a musical composition for voices and orchestra based on a religious text
definitions.zh: n. 康塔塔, 大合唱

examples.en: The choir performed a beautiful cantata.
examples.zh: 合唱团表演了一首优美的康塔塔。

examples.en: Bach wrote many famous cantatas.
examples.zh: 巴赫写了许多著名的康塔塔。

definitions.en: n. an act causing pain or damage
definitions.zh: [法] 处罚, 加刑, 刑罚

examples.en: The infliction of pain is cruel.
examples.zh: 施加痛苦是残忍的。

examples.en: He was guilty of infliction of harm.
examples.zh: 他犯有施加伤害罪。

definitions.en: n. an unborn or unhatched vertebrate in the later stages of development showing the main recognizable features of the mature animal
definitions.zh: n. 胎儿
[医] 胎, 胎儿

examples.en: The fetus develops in the womb.
examples.zh: 胎儿在子宫中发育。

examples.en: A healthy fetus grows quickly.
examples.zh: 健康的胎儿生长很快。

definitions.en: n. any substance that produces cancer
definitions.zh: n. 致癌物质
[化] 致癌物

examples.en: Smoking is a known carcinogen.
examples.zh: 吸烟是已知的致癌物。

examples.en: Avoid exposure to this carcinogen.
examples.zh: 避免接触这种致癌物。

definitions.en: n. compensation received by virtue of holding an office or having employment (usually in the form of wages or fees)
definitions.zh: n. 薪水, 报酬

examples.en: The job offers a good emolument.
examples.zh: 这份工作提供丰厚的报酬。

examples.en: His emolument includes salary and benefits.
examples.zh: 他的报酬包括薪水和福利。

definitions.en: n the humanistic study of language and literature
definitions.zh: n. 语文学, 文献学

examples.en: Philology is the study of language history.
examples.zh: 语文学是研究语言历史的学科。

examples.en: She studied philology at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习语文学。

definitions.en: a. relating to or suggesting swine
definitions.zh: a. 猪的, 猪似的
[医] 猪的

examples.en: The pig has a porcine appearance.
examples.zh: 猪有猪的外貌。

examples.en: Porcine diseases can affect farms.
examples.zh: 猪的疾病会影响农场。

definitions.en: n. a covered walkway (as in a cloister)
definitions.zh: a. 步行的, 走动的, 流动的, 非固定的

definitions.en: a. relating to or adapted for walking
definitions.zh: n. 回廊

examples.en: The patient is ambulatory after surgery.
examples.zh: 病人手术后可以走动。

examples.en: They walked along the ambulatory corridor.
examples.zh: 他们沿着回廊走道行走。

definitions.en: n. a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process
definitions.zh: n. 超新星

examples.en: A supernova is an exploding star.
examples.zh: 超新星是爆炸的恒星。

examples.en: Scientists observed a bright supernova.
examples.zh: 科学家观测到一颗明亮的超新星。

definitions.en: n a long steep slope or cliff at the edge of a plateau or ridge; usually formed by erosion
definitions.zh: n. 悬崖

definitions.en: n a steep artificial slope in front of a fortification
definitions.zh: vt. 使成陡坡

examples.en: The hiker carefully climbed the steep scarp.
examples.zh: 徒步者小心地爬上了陡峭的悬崖。

examples.en: A long scarp formed the edge of the plateau.
examples.zh: 一道长长的陡坡形成了高原的边缘。

definitions.en: n. the state of a serf
definitions.zh: n. 农权制, 农奴地位, 农奴境遇, 奴役

examples.en: Serfdom was common in medieval Europe.
examples.zh: 农奴制在中世纪欧洲很常见。

examples.en: Many people suffered under serfdom for centuries.
examples.zh: 许多人在农奴制下受苦了几个世纪。

definitions.en: n. the outer layer of the skin covering the exterior body surface of vertebrates
definitions.zh: n. 表皮, (昆虫的)真皮
[医] 表皮

examples.en: The epidermis protects your body from germs.
examples.zh: 表皮保护你的身体免受细菌侵害。

examples.en: Sunburn damages the outer layer of the epidermis.
examples.zh: 晒伤会损害表皮的外层。

definitions.en: n. a stately court dance in the 17th century
definitions.zh: n. 小步舞, 小步舞曲

examples.en: They danced a graceful minuet at the ball.
examples.zh: 他们在舞会上跳了一支优雅的小步舞。

examples.en: The composer wrote a beautiful minuet for piano.
examples.zh: 作曲家为钢琴写了一首优美的小步舞曲。

definitions.en: n the process of forming semisolid lumps in a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 凝结, 凝结物
[化] 聚沉; 凝结作用; 凝聚法

examples.en: Coagulation helps stop bleeding from a cut.
examples.zh: 凝结有助于止住伤口的出血。

examples.en: Blood coagulation is a natural healing process.
examples.zh: 血液凝结是一个自然的愈合过程。

definitions.en: n. the act of moving along swiftly (as before a gale)
definitions.zh: vi. 飞奔, 疾行

definitions.en: v. run before a gale
definitions.zh: n. 飞奔, 飞云, 小阵雨, 皮垢

examples.en: Clouds scud across the sky before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨前云朵飞奔过天空。

examples.en: The boat began to scud before the strong wind.
examples.zh: 船开始在强风前疾行。

definitions.en: n. an ecclesiastical censure by the Roman Catholic Church withdrawing certain sacraments and Christian burial from a person or all persons in a particular district
definitions.zh: vt. 禁止, 封锁, 停止, 制止

definitions.en: n. a court order prohibiting a party from doing a certain activity
definitions.zh: n. 禁令, 禁止

examples.en: The court issued an interdict to stop construction.
examples.zh: 法院发布了禁令以停止施工。

examples.en: The church placed an interdict on the town.
examples.zh: 教会对该镇实施了禁令。

definitions.en: s. having successive letter joined together
definitions.zh: a. 草书的, 草书体的
n. 草书, 草书原稿

examples.en: She writes in beautiful cursive handwriting.
examples.zh: 她用漂亮的草书书写。

examples.en: Learning cursive can improve your writing speed.
examples.zh: 学习草书可以提高你的书写速度。

definitions.en: n. absence of the sense of pain without loss of consciousness
definitions.zh: n. 止痛, 痛觉缺失
[医] 痛觉缺失, 无痛法, 止痛法

examples.en: The medicine provides analgesia for severe pain.
examples.zh: 这种药为剧痛提供止痛效果。

examples.en: Analgesia allows patients to remain conscious during surgery.
examples.zh: 止痛法让患者在手术中保持清醒。

definitions.en: n. fortification consisting of a fence made of a line of stout posts set firmly for defense
definitions.zh: n. 栅栏, 围起的地方

definitions.en: v. surround with a stockade in order to fortify
definitions.zh: vt. 用栅栏围住

examples.en: The settlers built a wooden stockade for protection.
examples.zh: 定居者建造了一个木栅栏用于保护。

examples.en: The fort had a strong stockade around it.
examples.zh: 堡垒周围有坚固的栅栏。

definitions.en: n. a chemical substance that is present at the start of a chemical reaction
definitions.zh: n. 反应物
[化] 反应物

examples.en: A reactant is used up in a chemical reaction.
examples.zh: 反应物在化学反应中被消耗。

examples.en: Hydrogen and oxygen are reactants in water formation.
examples.zh: 氢和氧是形成水的反应物。

definitions.en: n. the point of intersection of lines or the point opposite the base of a figure
definitions.zh: n. 顶点, 最高点, 头顶, 天顶

definitions.en: n. the highest point (of something)
definitions.zh: [计] 顶点

examples.en: The vertex of the triangle is point A.
examples.zh: 三角形的顶点是A点。

examples.en: The mountain's vertex is covered with snow.
examples.zh: 山的顶点覆盖着雪。

definitions.en: v. appoint as a substitute
definitions.zh: vt. 指定代理人, 委以代理人, 委任
[法] 代表, 代理人

examples.en: The manager will depute someone to handle the task.
examples.zh: 经理将委派某人处理这项任务。

examples.en: She decided to depute her assistant for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她决定委派她的助手参加会议。

definitions.en: v. administer a pontifical office
definitions.zh: vi. 自负地谈论, 执行教皇职务

examples.en: He tends to pontificate about politics at dinner.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在晚餐时自负地谈论政治。

examples.en: The professor would pontificate for hours on history.
examples.zh: 教授会自负地谈论历史几个小时。

definitions.en: n. the branch of biology that studies the microscopic structure of animal or plant tissues
definitions.zh: n. 组织学
[化] 组织学

examples.en: Histology studies the microscopic structure of tissues.
examples.zh: 组织学研究组织的微观结构。

examples.en: She took a course in histology at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学修了一门组织学课程。

definitions.en: n. someone who has been admitted to a college or university
definitions.zh: vt. 准许入学, 录取

definitions.en: v. enroll as a student
definitions.zh: vi. 入学, 进大学
n. 获准入学者

examples.en: He will matriculate at the university next fall.
examples.zh: 他将于明年秋天入学该大学。

examples.en: Students must matriculate before attending classes.
examples.zh: 学生必须先入学才能上课。

definitions.en: n. the branch of biology that studies the structure and function of cells
definitions.zh: n. 细胞学
[医] 细胞学

examples.en: Cytology examines the structure and function of cells.
examples.zh: 细胞学研究细胞的结构和功能。

examples.en: The lab specializes in cytology for cancer detection.
examples.zh: 该实验室专门从事用于癌症检测的细胞学。

definitions.en: n. flat tableland with steep edges
definitions.zh: n. 台面, 岩滩, 平顶山

examples.en: The mesa rose sharply from the desert floor.
examples.zh: 平顶山从沙漠地面陡峭升起。

examples.en: We hiked to the top of the flat mesa.
examples.zh: 我们徒步到了平顶山的顶部。

definitions.en: n (law) the act of rescinding; the cancellation of a contract and the return of the parties to the positions they would have had if the contract had not been made
definitions.zh: n. 废止, 取消, 使无效, 撤消
[经] 解除, 取消

examples.en: The court ordered rescission of the unfair contract.
examples.zh: 法院命令取消不公平的合同。

examples.en: Rescission returned both parties to their original positions.
examples.zh: 取消合同使双方回到原来的位置。

definitions.en: n. the side of a right triangle opposite the right angle
definitions.zh: n. (直角三角形之)斜边

examples.en: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a triangle.
examples.zh: 斜边是三角形中最长的边。

examples.en: Calculate the length of the hypotenuse using Pythagoras.
examples.zh: 用勾股定理计算斜边的长度。

definitions.en: v. speak haltingly
definitions.zh: vi. 结结巴巴地说, 犯大错, 踉跄, 跌倒

examples.en: He tends to bumble when speaking in public.
examples.zh: 他在公开演讲时容易结结巴巴。

examples.en: Don't bumble through your presentation; practice first.
examples.zh: 不要结结巴巴地做演示；先练习。

definitions.en: n the act of expanding by pressure from within
definitions.zh: n. 扩张, 膨胀

examples.en: Abdominal distension can be caused by gas.
examples.zh: 腹部膨胀可能由气体引起。

examples.en: The balloon showed distension as it filled with air.
examples.zh: 气球充气时显示出膨胀。

definitions.en: v remove by erasing or crossing out or as if by drawing a line
definitions.zh: vt. 擦掉, 删掉, 除去

examples.en: The teacher will expunge the error from the record.
examples.zh: 老师将从记录中删除这个错误。

examples.en: He wanted to expunge all traces of his past.
examples.zh: 他想抹去所有过去的痕迹。

definitions.en: n. fear of the unknown or unfamiliar or fear of making decisions
definitions.zh: n. 胆小, 胆怯, 羞怯

examples.en: Her timidity prevented her from speaking up.
examples.zh: 她的胆怯阻止她大声说话。

examples.en: Timidity can hold you back in new situations.
examples.zh: 胆怯会在新环境中阻碍你。

definitions.en: v. subject to foreclosing procedures; take away the right of mortgagors to redeem their mortgage
definitions.zh: vt. 阻止, 排除, 预先处理, 取消抵押品赎回权
vi. 取消抵押品赎回权

examples.en: The bank will foreclose on the unpaid mortgage.
examples.zh: 银行将取消未付抵押品的赎回权。

examples.en: They lost their home when the bank foreclosed.
examples.zh: 银行取消赎回权时他们失去了家。

definitions.en: v. lay bare
definitions.zh: vt. 使裸露, 剥下, 剥夺
[医] 剥露, 剥脱

examples.en: The storm denuded the trees of their leaves.
examples.zh: 暴风雨剥光了树的叶子。

examples.en: Deforestation can denude large areas of land.
examples.zh: 砍伐森林会使大片土地裸露。

definitions.en: s. not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic
definitions.zh: a. 堂吉诃德式的, 愚侠的, 狂热而侠义的, 理想而不实际的, 充满幻想的

examples.en: His quixotic plan to save the world failed.
examples.zh: 他拯救世界的堂吉诃德式计划失败了。

examples.en: She had a quixotic dream of perfect justice.
examples.zh: 她有一个关于完美正义的幻想。

definitions.en: s. having an agreeably pungent taste
definitions.zh: a. 辛辣的, 开胃的, 刺激的, 活泼的, 调皮的, 淘气的, 可爱的

examples.en: The sauce has a piquant and spicy flavor.
examples.zh: 这酱汁有辛辣开胃的味道。

examples.en: She enjoyed the piquant taste of the dish.
examples.zh: 她喜欢这道菜的辛辣味道。

definitions.en: s. having one side lower or smaller or lighter than the other
definitions.zh: a. 倾向一方的, 不平衡的

examples.en: The old table had a lopsided leg.
examples.zh: 旧桌子有一条腿不平衡。

examples.en: His smile was lopsided after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后他的微笑变得不平衡。

definitions.en: s. excessively greedy and grasping
definitions.zh: a. 强夺的, 贪欲的, 贪婪的

examples.en: The rapacious businessman took all the profits.
examples.zh: 贪婪的商人拿走了所有利润。

examples.en: Rapacious wolves hunted in the forest at night.
examples.zh: 贪婪的狼在夜间森林中捕猎。

definitions.en: n a goat's horn filled with grain and flowers and fruit symbolizing prosperity
definitions.zh: n. 丰盛

definitions.en: n the property of being extremely abundant
definitions.zh: [医] 外侧隐窝(第四脑室)

examples.en: The market offered a cornucopia of fresh fruits.
examples.zh: 市场提供了丰盛的新鲜水果。

examples.en: Her garden is a cornucopia of beautiful flowers.
examples.zh: 她的花园是美丽花朵的丰盛之地。

definitions.en: v. make children
definitions.zh: vt. 为某人之生父, 招致, 产生, 引起

examples.en: Hard work can beget success in life.
examples.zh: 努力工作可以带来生活中的成功。

examples.en: Violence often begets more violence in conflicts.
examples.zh: 暴力常常在冲突中招致更多暴力。

definitions.en: s. spherical in shape
definitions.zh: a. 圆的, 圆胖的, 洪亮的, (表现)华丽的

examples.en: The rotund man had a cheerful laugh.
examples.zh: 圆胖的男人有愉快的笑声。

examples.en: She drew a rotund shape on the paper.
examples.zh: 她在纸上画了一个圆胖的形状。

definitions.en: s. ancient
definitions.zh: a. 灰白的, 陈旧的
[医] 灰发的, 白发的

examples.en: The hoary old tree stood in the field.
examples.zh: 灰白的老树矗立在田野里。

examples.en: He told a hoary joke that everyone knew.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个人人都知道的陈旧笑话。

definitions.en: a. impervious to correction by punishment
definitions.zh: a. 无药可救的, 积习难改的
n. 不可救药的人

examples.en: The incorrigible child never listened to his parents.
examples.zh: 这个不可救药的孩子从不听父母的话。

examples.en: She is an incorrigible optimist despite all problems.
examples.zh: 尽管问题重重，她是个不可救药的乐观主义者。

definitions.en: n a state of dishonor
definitions.zh: n. 耻辱, 无耻行为, 不体面
[法] 无耻行为, 丑行, 耻辱

examples.en: He suffered the ignominy of public failure.
examples.zh: 他遭受了公开失败的耻辱。

examples.en: The team faced ignominy after losing the match.
examples.zh: 球队在输掉比赛后面对耻辱。

definitions.en: n. informal terms for objecting
definitions.zh: n. 紧握, 柄, 把手, 控制

definitions.en: v. complain
definitions.zh: vt. 抓紧, 抱住, 使肠痛, 激怒
vi. 肠绞痛, 抱怨

examples.en: He always has a gripe about the weather.
examples.zh: 他总是抱怨天气。

examples.en: Don't gripe about the work; just do it.
examples.zh: 不要抱怨工作；去做就是了。

definitions.en: n. hostile or warlike attitude or nature
definitions.zh: n. 交战, 好战性, 斗争性

examples.en: His belligerence made the argument worse.
examples.zh: 他的好战性使争论恶化。

examples.en: The country's belligerence worried its neighbors.
examples.zh: 该国的好战性让邻国担忧。

definitions.en: s. widely separated especially in space
definitions.zh: adv. 分开, 散, 碎

examples.en: The earthquake tore the building asunder.
examples.zh: 地震把建筑物撕成碎片。

examples.en: They were torn asunder by the war.
examples.zh: 他们被战争分开了。

definitions.en: v supply with provisions
definitions.zh: v. 供给, 供应

examples.en: The company purveys fresh food to local restaurants.
examples.zh: 这家公司向当地餐馆供应新鲜食物。

examples.en: They purvey high-quality goods to their customers.
examples.zh: 他们向顾客供应高质量的商品。

definitions.en: n. a feeling of excessive concern
definitions.zh: n. 焦虑, 关心, 担心, 挂念, 渴望, 担心的事情

examples.en: Her solicitude for the sick child was touching.
examples.zh: 她对生病孩子的关心令人感动。

examples.en: He showed great solicitude about her health.
examples.zh: 他对她的健康表现出极大的挂念。

definitions.en: n adroitness in using the hands
definitions.zh: n. 技巧, 诡计, 熟练

examples.en: The magician performed a clever sleight of hand.
examples.zh: 魔术师表演了巧妙的手法技巧。

examples.en: His sleight with cards amazed everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 他玩牌的技巧让派对上的每个人惊讶。

definitions.en: s repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
definitions.zh: a. 使用过于频繁的, 常见的, 陈腐的

examples.en: That phrase is too hackneyed to use now.
examples.zh: 那个短语现在用太陈腐了。

examples.en: His speech was full of hackneyed expressions.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈腐的表达。

definitions.en: s. relevant and appropriate
definitions.zh: a. 关系密切的, 有关的, 同样的, 恰当的, 贴切的
[机] 锗烷

examples.en: Your comment is not germane to our discussion.
examples.zh: 你的评论与我们的讨论无关。

examples.en: Please keep your questions germane to the topic.
examples.zh: 请让你的问题与主题相关。

definitions.en: v cause to lose one's composure
definitions.zh: vt. 打乱, 挫败, 使破灭

examples.en: The unexpected question discomfited the speaker.
examples.zh: 这个意外的问题让演讲者感到挫败。

examples.en: She tried not to discomfit her guests with bad news.
examples.zh: 她尽量不用坏消息打乱客人的心情。

definitions.en: n a medicine used to relieve pain
definitions.zh: n. 止痛药, 镇痛剂

definitions.en: s capable of relieving pain
definitions.zh: a. 止痛的

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an anodyne for the pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了止痛药来缓解疼痛。

examples.en: His anodyne comments did not help the situation.
examples.zh: 他止痛药般的评论没有帮助情况。

definitions.en: v. give false or misleading information to
definitions.zh: vt. 提供错误消息

examples.en: Do not misinform the public about the facts.
examples.zh: 不要向公众提供错误的事实信息。

examples.en: They tried to misinform us about the event.
examples.zh: 他们试图就这个事件向我们提供错误消息。

definitions.en: n. the likelihood of making errors
definitions.zh: n. 易错, 易误, 出错性

examples.en: We must accept human fallibility in all decisions.
examples.zh: 我们必须接受人类在所有决策中的易错性。

examples.en: His fallibility became clear after the mistake.
examples.zh: 错误之后，他的易误性变得明显。

definitions.en: n an irritable petulant feeling
definitions.zh: n. 易怒, 坏脾气, 使性子

examples.en: Her petulance annoyed everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的坏脾气惹恼了房间里的每个人。

examples.en: He spoke with petulance when he didn't get his way.
examples.zh: 当他不顺心时，他说话带着易怒。

definitions.en: n the state of not existing
definitions.zh: n. 不存在, 非实在, 虚无

examples.en: The idea was dismissed as a complete nonentity.
examples.zh: 这个想法被认为完全不存在而被驳回。

examples.en: He felt like a nonentity in the large crowd.
examples.zh: 他在人群中感觉自己像个虚无。

definitions.en: v. express strong disapproval of; deplore
definitions.zh: vt. 声明不赞成, 抗议, 反对

definitions.en: v. belittle
definitions.zh: [法] 对...表示不赞成, 反对

examples.en: Many people deprecate the use of violence.
examples.zh: 许多人反对使用暴力。

examples.en: She deprecates his rude behavior in public.
examples.zh: 她反对他在公共场合的粗鲁行为。

definitions.en: a. relating to or associated with a coma
definitions.zh: a. 昏睡的, 昏睡状态的

definitions.en: s. in a state of deep and usually prolonged unconsciousness; unable to respond to external stimuli
definitions.zh: [医] 昏迷的

examples.en: The patient remained comatose after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后病人一直处于昏迷状态。

examples.en: He was comatose from the medication for hours.
examples.zh: 药物让他昏睡了几个小时。

definitions.en: s. having a difficult and contrary disposition
definitions.zh: a. 专爱唱反调的, 爱吵架的

examples.en: The old man is known for his cantankerous nature.
examples.zh: 这个老人以爱吵架的性格闻名。

examples.en: She became cantankerous when she was tired.
examples.zh: 她累的时候变得专爱唱反调。

definitions.en: s not special in any way
definitions.zh: a. 非例外的, 平常的, 不特别的, 不容许有例外的

examples.en: The movie was unexceptional and quickly forgotten.
examples.zh: 这部电影很平常，很快被遗忘。

examples.en: His performance was unexceptional but acceptable.
examples.zh: 他的表现不特别但可以接受。

definitions.en: n. piece of solid food for dipping in a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 面包片, 湿透的东西, 一滩(液体), 小贿赂, 懦夫

definitions.en: n. a concession given to mollify or placate
definitions.zh: vt. 浸湿, 吸水, 贿赂

definitions.en: v. give a conciliatory gift or bribe to
definitions.zh: vi. 渗透, 湿透

examples.en: He gave a small sop to calm the angry customer.
examples.zh: 他给了点小贿赂来安抚生气的顾客。

examples.en: The sop of bread soaked up the soup.
examples.zh: 面包片吸收了汤。

definitions.en: n. a ribald person; someone who uses vulgar and offensive language
definitions.zh: a. 说话猥亵的, 下流的, 粗俗的
n. 说下流话的人

examples.en: His ribald jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他下流的笑话让每个人都不舒服。

examples.en: She avoided his ribald comments at the party.
examples.zh: 她在派对上避开他粗俗的评论。

definitions.en: s. ready and able to resort to force or violence
definitions.zh: a. 好斗的

examples.en: The pugnacious dog barked at every stranger.
examples.zh: 好斗的狗对着每个陌生人吠叫。

examples.en: He has a pugnacious attitude in debates.
examples.zh: 他在辩论中有好斗的态度。

definitions.en: v. cause to be annoyed
definitions.zh: n. 小争执, 愠怒
vt. 使恼怒
vi. 恼羞成怒

examples.en: She had a miff with her friend over a small thing.
examples.zh: 她因为一件小事和朋友发生了小争执。

examples.en: His rude comment caused a miff between them.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的评论引起了他们之间的愠怒。

definitions.en: v. deprive of strength or vigor
definitions.zh: vt. 阉割, 使柔弱

definitions.en: v. remove the testicles of a male animal
definitions.zh: a. 阉割了的, 柔弱的

examples.en: The new law could emasculate the agency's power.
examples.zh: 新法律可能会削弱该机构的权力。

examples.en: He felt the criticism emasculated his authority.
examples.zh: 他觉得批评削弱了他的权威。

definitions.en: s. (of tumors, e.g.) slow to heal or develop and usually painless
definitions.zh: a. 懒惰的, 无痛的
[医] 无痛的

examples.en: The indolent student never finished his homework.
examples.zh: 懒惰的学生从不完成作业。

examples.en: She was too indolent to get out of bed early.
examples.zh: 她太懒惰了，不愿早起。

definitions.en: s. serving as a visible symbol for something abstract
definitions.zh: a. 象征的, 典型的

examples.en: The dove is emblematic of peace and hope.
examples.zh: 鸽子是和平与希望的象征。

examples.en: His actions were emblematic of his true character.
examples.zh: 他的行为是他真实性格的典型体现。

definitions.en: n a wild or unrefined state
definitions.zh: n. 简陋, 粗糙, 不成熟状态

examples.en: The crudity of the painting surprised the critics.
examples.zh: 这幅画的粗糙让评论家惊讶。

examples.en: He was embarrassed by the crudity of his jokes.
examples.zh: 他为自己笑话的粗俗感到尴尬。

definitions.en: n a person who is rejected (from society or home)
definitions.zh: n. 贱民(印度的最低阶级), 被放逐者

examples.en: After the scandal, he became a social pariah.
examples.zh: 丑闻之后，他成了社会上的被放逐者。

examples.en: She felt like a pariah in her own community.
examples.zh: 她在自己的社区里感觉像个贱民。

definitions.en: s. favorable to health of mind or body
definitions.zh: a. 有益健康的, 健康的
[医] 增进健康的, 适于卫生的

examples.en: The mountain air is very salubrious for health.
examples.zh: 山里的空气对健康非常有益。

examples.en: They moved to a salubrious climate for their son.
examples.zh: 他们为了儿子搬到了有益健康的气候区。

definitions.en: s full of trivial conversation
definitions.zh: a. 饶舌的, 多嘴的, 喋喋不休的

examples.en: The garrulous old man talked for hours.
examples.zh: 饶舌的老人聊了几个小时。

examples.en: She is too garrulous to keep a secret.
examples.zh: 她太多嘴了，守不住秘密。

definitions.en: a. exhibiting an agreeably appropriate manner or style
definitions.zh: a. 巧妙的, 极为适当的, 善于措辞的, 可喜的

examples.en: Her felicitous choice of words impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 她巧妙的措辞给每个人留下了印象。

examples.en: The timing of his arrival was felicitous.
examples.zh: 他到达的时机极为适当。

definitions.en: n. pejorative terms for an insane asylum
definitions.zh: n. 混乱, 喧闹, 疯人院
[医] 精神病院, 精神病

examples.en: The classroom was complete bedlam after the bell.
examples.zh: 铃响后教室里一片混乱。

examples.en: The protest turned into bedlam very quickly.
examples.zh: 抗议很快变成了喧闹。

definitions.en: s extremely wicked
definitions.zh: a. 坏人似的, 恶棍的, 罪恶的, 极坏的
[法] 歹徒的:邪恶的, 恶的

examples.en: The villainous character was hated by all.
examples.zh: 罪恶的角色被所有人憎恨。

examples.en: He played a villainous role in the movie.
examples.zh: 他在电影中扮演了一个恶棍的角色。

definitions.en: v fill to satisfaction
definitions.zh: vt. 充分满足, 过分满意, 使厌腻

examples.en: A big meal will sate your hunger for hours.
examples.zh: 一顿大餐会让你饱几个小时。

examples.en: He could not sate his thirst for knowledge.
examples.zh: 他无法满足对知识的渴望。

definitions.en: v excrete perspiration through the pores in the skin
definitions.zh: v. 出汗, 流汗, 分泌, 渗出

examples.en: People perspire when they exercise heavily.
examples.zh: 人们剧烈运动时会出汗。

examples.en: She began to perspire in the hot sun.
examples.zh: 她在炎热的太阳下开始流汗。

definitions.en: n. a male servant (especially a footman)
definitions.zh: n. 仆人, 侍从, 马屁精
vt. 服侍, 侍候, 奉承

examples.en: The rich man had a lackey to do his chores.
examples.zh: 那个富人有个仆人做杂务。

examples.en: He acted like a lackey to gain favor.
examples.zh: 他表现得像个马屁精以获取好感。

definitions.en: v. impart vigor, strength, or vitality to
definitions.zh: vt. 使精力充沛, 鼓舞, 搞活, 使健壮

examples.en: A cold shower can invigorate you in the morning.
examples.zh: 冷水澡能在早晨让你精力充沛。

examples.en: The fresh air invigorated the tired hikers.
examples.zh: 新鲜空气鼓舞了疲惫的徒步者。

definitions.en: s. not easily deciphered
definitions.zh: a. 辨读不出的, 破译不出的, 无法解释的

examples.en: His handwriting is completely indecipherable.
examples.zh: 他的笔迹完全辨读不出。

examples.en: The code was indecipherable without the key.
examples.zh: 没有密钥，密码无法破译。

definitions.en: n worthless or dangerous material that should be removed
definitions.zh: n. 浮渣, 碎屑, 渣滓

definitions.en: n the scum formed by oxidation at the surface of molten metals
definitions.zh: [化] 浮渣

examples.en: The gold was separated from the dross.
examples.zh: 黄金与浮渣分离开来。

examples.en: We must remove the dross from the metal.
examples.zh: 我们必须去除金属中的渣滓。

definitions.en: s. (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous;
definitions.zh: a. (妇女)丰满的, 健美的

examples.en: The buxom woman had a cheerful smile.
examples.zh: 丰满的女人有着愉快的笑容。

examples.en: She was described as buxom and healthy.
examples.zh: 她被描述为健美而丰满。

definitions.en: s sour or bitter in taste
definitions.zh: a. 酸的, 尖刻的

examples.en: His acerbic wit often offended people.
examples.zh: 他尖刻的机智常常冒犯别人。

examples.en: The lemon had an acerbic taste.
examples.zh: 柠檬有一种酸的味道。

definitions.en: s. capable of winning favor
definitions.zh: a. 逢迎的, 迎合的

examples.en: She gave an ingratiating smile to the boss.
examples.zh: 她对老板露出了逢迎的微笑。

examples.en: His ingratiating manner made others suspicious.
examples.zh: 他迎合的态度让别人起疑。

definitions.en: s. drooping without elasticity; wanting in stiffness
definitions.zh: a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 无活力的
[医] 弛缓的

examples.en: The flaccid balloon lay on the floor.
examples.zh: 软塌塌的气球躺在地板上。

examples.en: His muscles became flaccid after the illness.
examples.zh: 生病后他的肌肉变得松弛无力。

definitions.en: a. serenely self-possessed and free from agitation especially in times of stress
definitions.zh: a. 镇静的, 沉着的

examples.en: She remained composed during the crisis.
examples.zh: 她在危机中保持镇静。

examples.en: He was composed and ready to answer questions.
examples.zh: 他沉着冷静，准备好回答问题。

definitions.en: n. extreme care in spending money; reluctance to spend money unnecessarily
definitions.zh: n. 过度节俭, 吝啬, 惜墨如金

examples.en: His parsimony made him save every penny.
examples.zh: 他的吝啬让他省下每一分钱。

examples.en: The parsimony of the budget caused problems.
examples.zh: 预算的过度节俭导致了问题。

definitions.en: n. the pivot about which a lever turns
definitions.zh: n. 杠杆支点, 支点
[机] 支点

examples.en: The seesaw needs a fulcrum to work.
examples.zh: 跷跷板需要一个支点才能工作。

examples.en: A lever rotates around its fulcrum.
examples.zh: 杠杆围绕其支点旋转。

definitions.en: n. a painful injury to a joint caused by a sudden wrenching of its ligaments
definitions.zh: vt. 挫伤, 扭筋, 错筋
n. 扭伤, 扭筋

examples.en: She suffered a bad ankle sprain.
examples.zh: 她脚踝严重扭伤。

examples.en: He tried to sprain his wrist playing tennis.
examples.zh: 他打网球时试图扭伤手腕。

definitions.en: s. not openly expressed
definitions.zh: a. 偷偷逃走的, 暗中的, 卑微的
[法] 隐密的, 鬼祟的, 卑怯的

examples.en: He had a sneaking suspicion about her.
examples.zh: 他对她有一种暗中的怀疑。

examples.en: A sneaking feeling told him to leave.
examples.zh: 一种隐秘的感觉告诉他离开。

definitions.en: n. a gaudy outward display
definitions.zh: n. 虚饰, 虚有其表, 卖弄

examples.en: His wealth was shown with great ostentation.
examples.zh: 他的财富被大肆炫耀。

examples.en: She disliked the ostentation of the party.
examples.zh: 她不喜欢派对的虚饰。

definitions.en: s. immoderately desirous of acquiring e.g. wealth
definitions.zh: a. 贪婪的

examples.en: The avaricious man wanted more money.
examples.zh: 那个贪婪的人想要更多钱。

examples.en: Her avaricious nature made her unpopular.
examples.zh: 她贪婪的本性让她不受欢迎。

definitions.en: v. shine brighter than
definitions.zh: vt. 光亮强过..., 使相形见绌, 使失色

definitions.en: v. attract more attention and praise than others
definitions.zh: vi. 发光

examples.en: Her talent will outshine everyone else.
examples.zh: 她的才华将使其他人相形见绌。

examples.en: He hopes to outshine his older brother.
examples.zh: 他希望超越他的哥哥。

definitions.en: s (used of persons or behavior) characterized by or indicative of lack of generosity
definitions.zh: a. 吝啬的, 贪婪的

examples.en: The miserly man never shared his food.
examples.zh: 那个吝啬的人从不分享食物。

examples.en: Her miserly habits annoyed her friends.
examples.zh: 她吝啬的习惯惹恼了朋友。

definitions.en: v. gain favor with somebody by deliberate efforts
definitions.zh: vt. 使迎合, 使讨好

examples.en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the boss.
examples.zh: 他试图讨好老板。

examples.en: She ingratiated herself by bringing gifts.
examples.zh: 她通过带礼物来讨好别人。

definitions.en: v ask for or request earnestly
definitions.zh: v. 恳求, 乞求

examples.en: I entreat you to help me now.
examples.zh: 我恳求你现在帮助我。

examples.en: She entreated him to stay a little longer.
examples.zh: 她恳求他再多待一会儿。

definitions.en: a. having or expressing desire for something
definitions.zh: a. 想要的, 想望的, 渴望的

examples.en: She is desirous of a new job.
examples.zh: 她渴望一份新工作。

examples.en: He felt desirous of her attention.
examples.zh: 他渴望得到她的注意。

definitions.en: v. bear the expenses of
definitions.zh: vt. 支付, 支出
[经] 支付或准备支付

examples.en: The company will defray your travel costs.
examples.zh: 公司将支付你的旅行费用。

examples.en: He used savings to defray the expenses.
examples.zh: 他用储蓄来支付开支。

definitions.en: n an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
definitions.zh: n. 部下, 下手, 下属

examples.en: The manager gave orders to his underling.
examples.zh: 经理给他的下属下命令。

examples.en: She treated every underling with respect.
examples.zh: 她尊重每一个下属。

definitions.en: n. lack of depth of knowledge or thought or feeling
definitions.zh: n. 表面性的事物, 肤浅, 浅薄

examples.en: His superficiality was clear in his speech.
examples.zh: 他的肤浅在讲话中很明显。

examples.en: She criticized the superficiality of the report.
examples.zh: 她批评了报告的肤浅。

definitions.en: n a state of extreme poverty or destitution
definitions.zh: n. 贫困, 贫穷, 拮据, 馈乏
[法] 赤贫, 缺乏

examples.en: They lived in penury after losing their jobs.
examples.zh: 失业后他们生活在贫困中。

examples.en: Penury forced him to beg on the streets.
examples.zh: 贫困迫使他上街乞讨。

definitions.en: n. an inhabitant of Hell
definitions.zh: a. 阴间的, 恶魔的

examples.en: The infernal noise kept me awake.
examples.zh: 那恶魔般的噪音让我睡不着。

examples.en: He spoke of infernal creatures in the story.
examples.zh: 他故事里提到了阴间的生物。

definitions.en: s not having enough money to pay for necessities
definitions.zh: a. 没有钱的, 身无分文的, 贫穷的

examples.en: The impecunious student could not pay rent.
examples.zh: 那个身无分文的学生付不起房租。

examples.en: He remained impecunious despite working hard.
examples.zh: 尽管努力工作，他仍然贫穷。

definitions.en: s. characteristic of acting or a stage performance; often affected
definitions.zh: a. 演员的, 演剧的, 矫揉造作的
n. 演员, 演剧, 戏剧性

examples.en: Her histrionic behavior annoyed the audience.
examples.zh: 她矫揉造作的行为惹恼了观众。

examples.en: He gave a histrionic performance on stage.
examples.zh: 他在舞台上进行了戏剧性的表演。

definitions.en: v. hide under a false appearance
definitions.zh: v. 掩饰, 假装不知道

examples.en: He tried to dissemble his true feelings.
examples.zh: 他试图掩饰真实感受。

examples.en: She dissembled her anger with a smile.
examples.zh: 她用微笑掩饰愤怒。

definitions.en: n anger produced by some annoying irritation
definitions.zh: n. 恼怒, 烦恼, 令人恼火的事情

definitions.en: n the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
definitions.zh: [法] 招人烦恼的事物, 烦恼, 苦闷

examples.en: The delay caused him great vexation.
examples.zh: 延误让他非常烦恼。

examples.en: Her vexation was clear from her frown.
examples.zh: 她的烦恼从皱眉中可见。

definitions.en: s characterized by violent emotions or behavior
definitions.zh: a. 有暴风雨的, 暴乱的

examples.en: Their tempestuous relationship ended quickly.
examples.zh: 他们暴风雨般的关系很快结束了。

examples.en: The tempestuous sea frightened the sailors.
examples.zh: 狂暴的大海吓坏了水手。

definitions.en: a. habitually reserved and uncommunicative
definitions.zh: a. 沉默寡言的, 不太说话的, 无言的

examples.en: The taciturn man rarely spoke at meetings.
examples.zh: 那个沉默寡言的人在会上很少说话。

examples.en: Her taciturn nature made her seem unfriendly.
examples.zh: 她沉默寡言的性格让她显得不友好。

definitions.en: s. heavy and starchy and hard to digest
definitions.zh: a. 易吃饱的, 塞满的, 平凡的, 庸俗的, 步履艰难的

examples.en: The stodgy pudding was hard to digest.
examples.zh: 那油腻的布丁很难消化。

examples.en: He disliked the stodgy food at the party.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢派对上油腻的食物。

definitions.en: n an act or expression of criticism and censure
definitions.zh: n. 谴责, 非难

definitions.en: v censure severely or angrily
definitions.zh: [法] 谴责, 申诉, 责备

examples.en: She received a sharp reproof from her boss.
examples.zh: 她受到了老板的严厉谴责。

examples.en: His reproof made her feel ashamed.
examples.zh: 他的责备让她感到羞愧。

definitions.en: a. helpful in bringing about a harmonious adaptation
definitions.zh: a. 与人方便的, 肯通融的

examples.en: The accommodating host offered us a room.
examples.zh: 好客的主人给了我们一个房间。

examples.en: She was very accommodating to our needs.
examples.zh: 她非常通融地满足我们的需求。

definitions.en: v report or maintain
definitions.zh: vt. 断言, 坚称

definitions.en: v to declare or affirm solemnly and formally as true
definitions.zh: [法] 立证, 证明, 确证

examples.en: He averred that he was telling the truth.
examples.zh: 他坚称自己说的是实话。

examples.en: She averred her innocence in court.
examples.zh: 她在法庭上坚称自己无罪。

definitions.en: n. a sharp sound made by small birds or insects
definitions.zh: n. 喳喳声, 唧唧声
v. 吱喳而鸣

examples.en: The birds chirp happily in the morning.
examples.zh: 鸟儿在早晨快乐地吱喳叫。

examples.en: I heard a chirp from the small bird.
examples.zh: 我听到小鸟的唧唧声。

definitions.en: a. quick or skillful or adept in action or thought
definitions.zh: a. 灵巧的, 敏捷的, 聪明的

examples.en: She is adroit at solving complex problems.
examples.zh: 她善于解决复杂问题。

examples.en: His adroit handling of the situation impressed us.
examples.zh: 他灵巧处理情况的方式让我们印象深刻。

definitions.en: n. a lumpy abscess under the hide of domestic mammals caused by larvae of a botfly or warble fly
definitions.zh: n. 用颤音唱的歌, 鸟啭, 颤声

definitions.en: v. sing or play with trills, alternating with the half note above or below
definitions.zh: v. 鸟鸣, 用柔和的颤声唱

examples.en: The bird began to warble a sweet song.
examples.zh: 鸟儿开始用颤音唱甜美的歌。

examples.en: She could warble like a nightingale.
examples.zh: 她能像夜莺一样颤声歌唱。

definitions.en: v. prove to be of unsound mind or demonstrate someone's incompetence
definitions.zh: vt. 使显得愚笨, 使变无效

examples.en: The boring lecture seemed to stultify the class.
examples.zh: 无聊的讲座似乎让全班变得愚钝。

examples.en: Repetitive tasks can stultify the mind.
examples.zh: 重复的任务会使人思维迟钝。

definitions.en: n. moderation in or abstinence from alcohol or other drugs
definitions.zh: n. 节制饮酒, 戒酒, 节制, 一本正经, 庄重

examples.en: He maintained sobriety after quitting alcohol.
examples.zh: 戒酒后他保持了节制。

examples.en: Sobriety is important for safe driving.
examples.zh: 清醒对安全驾驶很重要。

definitions.en: s. fraught with danger
definitions.zh: a. 危险的, 不易对付的, 精明的, 麻烦的
adv. 非常地, 极度地

examples.en: The parlous state of the economy worried everyone.
examples.zh: 经济的危险状态让每个人担忧。

examples.en: They faced a parlous journey through the mountains.
examples.zh: 他们面临穿越山区的危险旅程。

definitions.en: s. deserving reward or praise
definitions.zh: a. 有功绩的, 有价值的, 可称赞的
[法] 有功的, 值得称赞的, 善意的

examples.en: Her meritorious service earned her a medal.
examples.zh: 她有功绩的服务赢得了奖章。

examples.en: The meritorious student received a scholarship.
examples.zh: 那个值得称赞的学生获得了奖学金。

definitions.en: s. characterized by iniquity; wicked because it is believed to be a sin
definitions.zh: a. 不公正的, 邪恶的

examples.en: The iniquitous system oppressed the poor.
examples.zh: 不公正的制度压迫穷人。

examples.en: He condemned the iniquitous practices of the company.
examples.zh: 他谴责公司邪恶的做法。

definitions.en: v. drink greedily or as if with great thirst
definitions.zh: v. 狂饮, 暴食, 喝酒化掉(钱)

examples.en: He guzzled down the entire bottle of water.
examples.zh: 他狂饮了整瓶水。

examples.en: The thirsty dog guzzled from the bowl.
examples.zh: 口渴的狗从碗里狂饮。

definitions.en: s. suited to or suggestive of a grave or burial
definitions.zh: a. 送葬的, 适合葬礼的, 悲哀的

examples.en: The funereal atmosphere made everyone sad.
examples.zh: 葬礼般的气氛让每个人都悲伤。

examples.en: She wore a funereal black dress to the event.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件葬礼般的黑色连衣裙参加活动。

definitions.en: n archaic terms for a wedding or wedding feast
definitions.zh: n. 拥护, 订婚, 婚礼

examples.en: Their espousal was celebrated with a feast.
examples.zh: 他们的订婚用宴会庆祝。

examples.en: The espousal of the cause united the group.
examples.zh: 对这个事业的拥护团结了团体。

definitions.en: s. difficult to penetrate; incomprehensible to one of ordinary understanding or knowledge
definitions.zh: a. 难解的, 深奥的

examples.en: The abstruse theory confused the students.
examples.zh: 深奥的理论让学生困惑。

examples.en: He wrote an abstruse article on philosophy.
examples.zh: 他写了一篇关于哲学的深奥文章。

definitions.en: a. easily managed (controlled or taught or molded)
definitions.zh: a. 驯服的, 易于管教的
[经] 易加工的, 易处理的

examples.en: The tractable horse obeyed every command.
examples.zh: 驯服的马服从每个命令。

examples.en: She found the child tractable and easy to teach.
examples.zh: 她发现孩子听话且容易教。

definitions.en: n a quarrel about petty points
definitions.zh: n. 一口淡酒, 小争吵, 小口角, 淡酒
vi. 小争吵, 生气

examples.en: They had a tiff over a small issue.
examples.zh: 他们因小事发生了小争吵。

examples.en: The tiff between friends was quickly resolved.
examples.zh: 朋友间的小争吵很快解决了。

definitions.en: a. incapable of being transgressed or dishonored
definitions.zh: a. 不可亵渎的, 不可侵犯的, 神圣的

definitions.en: s. must be kept sacred
definitions.zh: [法] 不可侵犯的, 神圣的

examples.en: The law considers human rights inviolable.
examples.zh: 法律认为人权不可侵犯。

examples.en: This sacred place is inviolable to all.
examples.zh: 这个神圣之地对所有人不可亵渎。

definitions.en: v. teach doctrines to; teach uncritically
definitions.zh: vt. 教训, 教导, 灌输

examples.en: The regime tried to indoctrinate the youth.
examples.zh: 政权试图灌输思想给年轻人。

examples.en: They indoctrinate new members with strict rules.
examples.zh: 他们用严格规则教导新成员。

definitions.en: n. a gauze fabric with an extremely fine texture
definitions.zh: n. 小蜘蛛网, 蛛丝, 薄纱
a. 薄弱的, 轻飘飘的

examples.en: The morning dew hung on gossamer threads.
examples.zh: 晨露挂在蛛丝上。

examples.en: She wore a dress of fine gossamer.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件薄纱裙。

definitions.en: v. grow weak and thin or waste away physically
definitions.zh: vt. 使消瘦, 使憔悴
vi. 消瘦

examples.en: The illness caused him to emaciate quickly.
examples.zh: 疾病使他迅速消瘦。

examples.en: Without food, the animal began to emaciate.
examples.zh: 没有食物，动物开始消瘦。

definitions.en: s resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility
definitions.zh: a. 似野兽的, 残忍的, 卑劣的

examples.en: His bestial behavior shocked everyone.
examples.zh: 他野兽般的行为震惊了所有人。

examples.en: The crime was truly bestial in nature.
examples.zh: 这罪行本质极其残忍。

definitions.en: s intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
definitions.zh: a. 多管闲事的, 非官方的
[法] 非官方的, 非正式的

examples.en: The officious clerk annoyed the customers.
examples.zh: 多管闲事的职员惹恼了顾客。

examples.en: She gave officious advice to strangers.
examples.zh: 她向陌生人提供多管闲事的建议。

definitions.en: n a person without moral scruples
definitions.zh: a. 邪恶的, 邪道的, 异端的
n. 罪大恶极的人, 恶棍, 异端

examples.en: The miscreant was caught by the police.
examples.zh: 那个恶棍被警察抓住了。

examples.en: No one trusted the known miscreant.
examples.zh: 没人信任那个臭名昭著的恶棍。

definitions.en: s. marked by casual disrespect
definitions.zh: a. 鲁莽的, 卑鄙的, 厚颜无耻的

examples.en: The impudent child talked back to his teacher.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽的孩子顶撞老师。

examples.en: Her impudent remark made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 她厚颜无耻的评论让所有人不舒服。

definitions.en: v influence by slyness
definitions.zh: vt. 遮眼, 蒙蔽, 欺骗

examples.en: The con artist hoodwinked the old man.
examples.zh: 那个骗子蒙蔽了老人。

examples.en: They tried to hoodwink the investors.
examples.zh: 他们试图欺骗投资者。

definitions.en: a. preventing especially liquids to pass or diffuse through
definitions.zh: a. 不能渗透的, 不能通过的
[医] 不[渗]透性

examples.en: This jacket is impermeable to water.
examples.zh: 这件夹克防水。

examples.en: The rock is impermeable to liquids.
examples.zh: 这块岩石不透液体。

definitions.en: v. make less mysterious or remove the mystery from
definitions.zh: vt. 使非神秘化

examples.en: The teacher helped demystify the math problem.
examples.zh: 老师帮助解开了数学题的神秘面纱。

examples.en: We need to demystify the process for beginners.
examples.zh: 我们需要为初学者简化过程。

definitions.en: v. imagine or consider beforehand
definitions.zh: vt. 预示, 预见, 预想

examples.en: The early signs prefigure a big change.
examples.zh: 早期迹象预示着一场大变化。

examples.en: This event prefigures future success.
examples.zh: 这个事件预示着未来的成功。

definitions.en: n. the quality of not being open or truthful; deceitful or hypocritical
definitions.zh: n. 不诚实, 无诚意, 伪善
[经] 不诚实

examples.en: I could sense his insincerity in the apology.
examples.zh: 我能感觉到他道歉中的不诚实。

examples.en: Her insincerity made the compliment feel fake.
examples.zh: 她的不诚实让赞美显得虚假。

definitions.en: n an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
definitions.zh: n. 怪念头, 离奇的东西, 反复无常, 绞盘

examples.en: The story was full of whimsy and charm.
examples.zh: 故事充满了怪念头和魅力。

examples.en: She added a touch of whimsy to the room.
examples.zh: 她给房间增添了一丝离奇。

definitions.en: v be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action
definitions.zh: vi. 游移不定, 踌躇, 犹豫, 摇摆

examples.en: He tends to vacillate between two choices.
examples.zh: 他倾向于在两个选择之间摇摆不定。

examples.en: Don't vacillate; make a decision now.
examples.zh: 别犹豫了，现在就做决定。

definitions.en: s not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
definitions.zh: a. 不适合的, 不合体的, 不相配的

examples.en: Such behavior is unbecoming of a leader.
examples.zh: 这种行为不适合一个领导者。

examples.en: Her dress was unbecoming for the formal event.
examples.zh: 她的裙子不适合这个正式场合。

definitions.en: n. someone who insists on something
definitions.zh: n. 坚持要求某种品质的人, 坚持要求一丝不苟者, 难题, 费解的事物

examples.en: He is a stickler for punctuality.
examples.zh: 他坚持要求准时。

examples.en: My boss is a stickler about details.
examples.zh: 我老板对细节一丝不苟。

definitions.en: s exaggeratedly proper
definitions.zh: a. 拘守礼仪的, 过分规矩的, 表面正经的

examples.en: She was too prudish to discuss the topic.
examples.zh: 她过于拘谨，不愿讨论这个话题。

examples.en: His prudish attitude surprised his friends.
examples.zh: 他过分规矩的态度让朋友们惊讶。

definitions.en: a. (of weather or climate) severe
definitions.zh: a. 险恶的, 严酷的

examples.en: The inclement weather forced us indoors.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们待在室内。

examples.en: They canceled the hike due to inclement conditions.
examples.zh: 由于天气恶劣，他们取消了远足。

definitions.en: n. a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves
definitions.zh: n. 圆锥形纸袋, 短号
[医] 小助听筒

examples.en: He played the cornet in the band.
examples.zh: 他在乐队里吹短号。

examples.en: The cornet has a bright, clear sound.
examples.zh: 短号有明亮清晰的声音。

definitions.en: n. a member of the ancient Greek school of philosophy founded by Zeno
definitions.zh: a. 斯多葛派的, 禁欲主义的, 不以苦乐为意的, 坚忍的, 淡泊的

definitions.en: n. someone who is seemingly indifferent to emotions
definitions.zh: n. 斯多葛派学者, 画廊派的人, 禁欲主义者, 不介意苦乐的人, 高度自制的人

examples.en: He remained stoic during the crisis.
examples.zh: 他在危机中保持坚忍。

examples.en: A stoic person does not show much emotion.
examples.zh: 淡泊的人不轻易表露情感。

definitions.en: a. lacking spiny processes
definitions.zh: a. 无脊椎的, 没有骨气的, 懦弱的

examples.en: The spineless manager never defended his team.
examples.zh: 懦弱的经理从不维护他的团队。

examples.en: She called him spineless for giving in so easily.
examples.zh: 她骂他懦弱，因为他轻易屈服。

definitions.en: n. a drug that induces sleep
definitions.zh: a. 催眠的, 想睡的, 令人麻木不仁的

definitions.en: s. sleep inducing
definitions.zh: n. 催眠剂, 安眠药

examples.en: The lecture had a soporific effect on the students.
examples.zh: 讲座对学生有催眠效果。

examples.en: This warm milk is almost soporific.
examples.zh: 这热牛奶几乎让人想睡。

definitions.en: s excessively or hypocritically pious
definitions.zh: a. 假装圣洁的, 假装虔诚的, 假装诚实的

examples.en: His sanctimonious tone annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他假装虔诚的语气惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: She gave a sanctimonious speech about honesty.
examples.zh: 她发表了一篇关于诚实的伪善演讲。

definitions.en: n. a set of confused and meaningless statements
definitions.zh: n. 冗长的废话, 繁琐费时的手续

definitions.en: n. a long and complicated and confusing procedure
definitions.zh: a. 冗长的, 无条理的

examples.en: We had to go through a lot of rigmarole.
examples.zh: 我们不得不经历许多繁琐手续。

examples.en: He told a long rigmarole about his trip.
examples.zh: 他讲了一大堆关于旅行的废话。

definitions.en: n a person skilled in telling anecdotes
definitions.zh: n. 说书者, 擅长讲故事的人, 健谈者

examples.en: My grandfather was a wonderful raconteur.
examples.zh: 我祖父是个很棒的讲故事的人。

examples.en: The raconteur kept everyone entertained all night.
examples.zh: 那个健谈者让所有人整晚都很开心。

definitions.en: n a small figure of a person operated from above with strings by a puppeteer
definitions.zh: n. 牵线木偶

examples.en: The children watched the marionette show.
examples.zh: 孩子们看了牵线木偶表演。

examples.en: He moved like a marionette on strings.
examples.zh: 他像牵线木偶一样移动。

definitions.en: n the state of being isolated or detached
definitions.zh: n. 岛屿生活状况, 孤立, 岛国性质

examples.en: The island's insularity kept it unique.
examples.zh: 岛屿的孤立使其保持独特。

examples.en: Their insularity made them resistant to new ideas.
examples.zh: 他们的孤立使他们抗拒新思想。

definitions.en: a. completely lacking nobility in character or quality or purpose
definitions.zh: a. 卑贱的, 卑鄙的, 低级的

examples.en: His ignoble actions brought shame to the family.
examples.zh: 他卑鄙的行为给家族带来了耻辱。

examples.en: Stealing is an ignoble act.
examples.zh: 偷窃是卑鄙的行为。

definitions.en: v dig up for reburial or for medical investigation; of dead bodies
definitions.zh: vt. 掘出, 发掘

examples.en: The police decided to exhume the body.
examples.zh: 警方决定掘出尸体。

examples.en: They will exhume the remains for testing.
examples.zh: 他们将发掘遗骸进行检测。

definitions.en: v decorate
definitions.zh: vt. 装饰, 修饰

examples.en: They bedeck the hall with flowers.
examples.zh: 他们用鲜花装饰大厅。

examples.en: The bride was bedecked in jewels.
examples.zh: 新娘佩戴着珠宝装饰。

definitions.en: s. not fully developed in mature animals
definitions.zh: a. 残留的, 遗留的, 退化的
[医] 遗迹的, 剩余的

examples.en: The human appendix is a vestigial organ.
examples.zh: 人类阑尾是残留器官。

examples.en: Some birds have vestigial wings.
examples.zh: 有些鸟有退化的翅膀。

definitions.en: v regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
definitions.zh: vt. 尊敬, 崇敬, 崇拜

examples.en: Many cultures venerate their ancestors.
examples.zh: 许多文化崇敬祖先。

examples.en: They venerate the old temple as sacred.
examples.zh: 他们崇敬这座古庙为圣地。

definitions.en: a. resembling hieroglyphic writing
definitions.zh: n. 象形文字；象形文字写的文章

examples.en: Ancient Egyptians used hieroglyphic writing.
examples.zh: 古埃及人使用象形文字。

examples.en: The wall was covered in hieroglyphic symbols.
examples.zh: 墙上布满了象形文字符号。

definitions.en: s. offensively malodorous
definitions.zh: a. 恶臭的
[医] 恶臭的

examples.en: The fetid smell came from the swamp.
examples.zh: 恶臭来自沼泽。

examples.en: The room was filled with fetid air.
examples.zh: 房间里充满了恶臭的空气。

definitions.en: s. deviating from what is considered moral or right or proper or good
definitions.zh: a. 堕落的, 腐化的, 道德败坏的
[医] 恶化的, 变坏的

examples.en: The villain had a depraved mind.
examples.zh: 那个恶棍思想堕落。

examples.en: Such depraved behavior is unacceptable.
examples.zh: 这种道德败坏的行为不可接受。

definitions.zh: a. 不属于道德范畴的, 无从区分是非的

examples.en: Young children are often amoral.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子通常不分是非。

examples.en: The amoral character cared only about profit.
examples.zh: 那个不分是非的角色只关心利润。

definitions.en: a. consisting of or containing starch
definitions.zh: a. 淀粉的, 浆糊的, 浆糊状的, 古板的

examples.en: Potatoes are a starchy vegetable.
examples.zh: 土豆是一种淀粉类蔬菜。

examples.en: He prefers starchy foods like bread and rice.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢面包和米饭这类淀粉食物。

definitions.en: n. word of greeting used to begin a letter
definitions.zh: n. 招呼, 寒喧, 问候

examples.en: The letter began with a warm salutation.
examples.zh: 信以温暖的问候开头。

examples.en: He nodded as a salutation to his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他点头向邻居打招呼。

definitions.en: s lying down; in a position of comfort or rest
definitions.zh: a. 斜靠着的, 躺着的, 不活泼的, 休息着的
[医] 斜卧的, 躺着的

examples.en: She was recumbent on the sofa, resting.
examples.zh: 她斜靠在沙发上休息。

examples.en: The recumbent figure in the painting looked peaceful.
examples.zh: 画中躺着的形象看起来很平静。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being fixed in place as by some firm attachment
definitions.zh: n. 要塞, 巩固, 迅速
[医] 抗拒性

examples.en: The castle was a secure fastness.
examples.zh: 城堡是一个坚固的要塞。

examples.en: They retreated to their mountain fastness.
examples.zh: 他们撤退到山中的要塞。

definitions.en: n. the process of becoming dilapidated
definitions.zh: n. 荒废, 破损, 崩塌
[法] 倒塌, 毁坏

examples.en: The old house was in a state of dilapidation.
examples.zh: 老房子处于荒废状态。

examples.en: Years of neglect led to the building's dilapidation.
examples.zh: 多年的忽视导致建筑破损。

definitions.en: s. exhibiting restrained good taste
definitions.zh: a. 轻描淡写的；低调的；朴素的；不夸张的

examples.en: Her dress was elegant and understated.
examples.zh: 她的裙子优雅而低调。

examples.en: He preferred an understated style of decoration.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢朴素的装饰风格。

definitions.en: n (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
definitions.zh: n. 行为, 举止

examples.en: Her deportment at the party was excellent.
examples.zh: 她在聚会上的举止非常得体。

examples.en: Good deportment is important in formal settings.
examples.zh: 良好的举止在正式场合很重要。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to persons convinced of the superiority of their own gender or kind
definitions.zh: a. 本民族(或本性别)第一主义的, 沙文主义的

examples.en: His chauvinistic views offended many people.
examples.zh: 他的沙文主义观点冒犯了许多人。

examples.en: She criticized the chauvinistic attitude in the office.
examples.zh: 她批评了办公室里的性别歧视态度。

definitions.en: n. someone motivated by desires for sensual pleasures
definitions.zh: n. 快乐主义者, 享乐主义者

examples.en: He is a hedonist who loves luxury and pleasure.
examples.zh: 他是一个热爱奢华和享乐的享乐主义者。

examples.en: The hedonist spent all his money on vacations.
examples.zh: 那个享乐主义者把所有钱都花在度假上。

definitions.en: s. having or marked by a strong tendency especially a controversial one
definitions.zh: a. 有偏见的, 有倾向的, 淘气的

examples.en: The article was tendentious and unfair.
examples.zh: 那篇文章有偏见且不公平。

examples.en: His tendentious remarks caused a heated debate.
examples.zh: 他有倾向性的言论引发了激烈辩论。

definitions.en: a. unwilling to spend
definitions.zh: a. 小气的, 吝啬的, 缺乏的, 有刺的

examples.en: He is too stingy to buy his friends gifts.
examples.zh: 他太小气，不给朋友买礼物。

examples.en: The stingy man never tips the waiter.
examples.zh: 那个吝啬的人从不给服务员小费。

definitions.en: v steal goods; take as spoils
definitions.zh: vt. 夺取, 掠夺

examples.en: The invaders despoiled the village of its treasures.
examples.zh: 入侵者掠夺了村庄的财宝。

examples.en: They despoiled the forest for valuable timber.
examples.zh: 他们为了珍贵木材掠夺了森林。

definitions.en: a. marked by a ready flow of speech
definitions.zh: a. 流利的, 健谈的, 易旋转的, 缠绕的

examples.en: She is a voluble speaker who never stops talking.
examples.zh: 她是个健谈的演讲者，从不停嘴。

examples.en: His voluble explanation confused the audience.
examples.zh: 他流利的解释让观众困惑。

definitions.en: v harass with persistent criticism or carping
definitions.zh: vt. 逗弄, 使干着急

examples.en: The smell of food tantalized the hungry children.
examples.zh: 食物的香味逗弄着饥饿的孩子们。

examples.en: She tantalized him with a promise she never kept.
examples.zh: 她用从未兑现的承诺逗弄他。

definitions.en: n unrestrained merrymaking
definitions.zh: n. 闹饮, 狂欢

examples.en: The streets were filled with revelry during the festival.
examples.zh: 节日期间，街上充满了狂欢。

examples.en: Their revelry kept the neighbors awake all night.
examples.zh: 他们的狂欢让邻居整夜未眠。

definitions.en: n. adroitness and cleverness in reply
definitions.zh: n. 机敏巧妙的回答, 妙语, 机智的反驳, 巧辩, 敏捷答辩的才能

examples.en: Her quick repartee made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 她机智的妙语让大家都笑了。

examples.en: He is known for his clever repartee in conversations.
examples.zh: 他以对话中的巧妙反驳而闻名。

definitions.en: n bending the head or body or knee as a sign of reverence or submission or shame or greeting
definitions.zh: n. 敬礼, 鞠躬, 敬重

examples.en: The servant made a deep obeisance to the king.
examples.zh: 仆人对国王深深鞠躬。

examples.en: They paid obeisance to the ancient tradition.
examples.zh: 他们对古老传统表示敬意。

definitions.en: s. not genuine
definitions.zh: a. 假的, 做作的, 捏造的
[法] 伪造的, 假装的, 虚构的

examples.en: She gave a feigned smile to hide her sadness.
examples.zh: 她假装微笑以掩饰悲伤。

examples.en: His feigned interest in the topic was obvious.
examples.zh: 他对这个话题假装感兴趣是显而易见的。

definitions.en: v. make a mess of, destroy or ruin
definitions.zh: v. 拙笨地修补, 糟蹋
n. 拙笨的修补, 难看的补缀

examples.en: He botched the repair and made it worse.
examples.zh: 他拙劣地修补，反而弄得更糟。

examples.en: The chef botched the recipe and ruined the dish.
examples.zh: 厨师搞砸了食谱，毁了这道菜。

definitions.en: v be a signal for or a symptom of
definitions.zh: vt. 预示

examples.en: Dark clouds betoken a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: His smile betokens a good mood today.
examples.zh: 他的微笑预示着今天心情不错。

definitions.en: n. a disappointing decline after a previous rise
definitions.zh: n. 突降法, 虎头蛇尾

examples.en: The movie's ending was a big anticlimax.
examples.zh: 电影的结局是个大虎头蛇尾。

examples.en: After the excitement, the quiet dinner felt like an anticlimax.
examples.zh: 兴奋过后，安静的晚餐感觉像是个突降。

definitions.en: a. characterized by deliberate purpose and some degree of planning
definitions.zh: a. 预先考虑的, 预谋的
[法] 经预先计划的, 预谋的

examples.en: The crime was clearly premeditated and planned.
examples.zh: 这起犯罪显然是预谋和计划好的。

examples.en: She made a premeditated decision to leave early.
examples.zh: 她做了预先考虑好的决定，提前离开。

definitions.en: s deeply agitated especially from emotion
definitions.zh: a. 过分劳累的, 过度紧张的, 神经质的, 过度兴奋的, 过分推敲的, 不自然的

examples.en: She was overwrought after the long argument.
examples.zh: 长时间争论后，她过度紧张。

examples.en: His overwrought emotions made him cry easily.
examples.zh: 他过度激动的情绪让他容易哭泣。

definitions.en: s stubbornly persistent in wrongdoing
definitions.zh: a. 顽固的, 执拗的, 冷酷的

definitions.en: s showing unfeeling resistance to tender feelings
definitions.zh: [法] 执迷不悟的, 毫不悔改的, 无情的

examples.en: He remained obdurate and refused to apologize.
examples.zh: 他仍然顽固，拒绝道歉。

examples.en: The obdurate child would not listen to reason.
examples.zh: 那个执拗的孩子不听道理。

definitions.en: a. characterized by an inability to mask your feelings; not devious
definitions.zh: a. 坦白的, 正直的, 天真的

examples.en: Her ingenuous smile showed her true feelings.
examples.zh: 她天真的微笑显露了真实感受。

examples.en: He was too ingenuous to hide his disappointment.
examples.zh: 他太坦白了，无法掩饰失望。

definitions.en: v. make or shape as with an axe
definitions.zh: vt. 砍, 砍倒, 砍成

definitions.en: v. strike with an axe; cut down, strike
definitions.zh: vi. 砍, 劈, 坚持

examples.en: He used an axe to hew the wood.
examples.zh: 他用斧头砍木头。

examples.en: They hew the stone to build a wall.
examples.zh: 他们劈开石头来建墙。

definitions.en: v. cause to be bitter or resentful
definitions.zh: vt. 使受苦, 使(更)恶化, 使怨恨, 加苦味于

examples.en: Failure can embitter a person over time.
examples.zh: 失败会逐渐使一个人怨恨。

examples.en: His harsh words embittered her for years.
examples.zh: 他严厉的话语让她怨恨多年。

definitions.en: s. having unsuitable feminine qualities
definitions.zh: a. 柔弱的, 女人气的

examples.en: Some people wrongly call him effeminate.
examples.zh: 有些人错误地称他女人气。

examples.en: His effeminate gestures were mocked by others.
examples.zh: 他柔弱的姿态被他人嘲笑。

definitions.en: n sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation
definitions.zh: n. 完全悔悟, 悔改, 悔罪

examples.en: He showed deep contrition for his mistake.
examples.zh: 他对自己的错误表现出深深的悔悟。

examples.en: Her contrition was evident in her tears.
examples.zh: 她的悔改在眼泪中显而易见。

definitions.en: s. lacking or showing a lack of due concern
definitions.zh: a. 愉快的, 高兴的

examples.en: She had a blithe attitude about the risks.
examples.zh: 她对风险抱着无忧无虑的态度。

examples.en: His blithe disregard for rules annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他轻率地无视规则，惹恼了大家。

definitions.en: s lacking in schooling
definitions.zh: a. 未受教育的, 粗野的, 天真的

examples.en: He is untutored in the ways of business.
examples.zh: 他对商业之道未受教育。

examples.en: Her untutored talent amazed the music teacher.
examples.zh: 她未经训练的天赋让音乐老师惊讶。

definitions.en: a. endowed with feeling and unstructured consciousness
definitions.zh: a. 有感觉力的, 意识到的

definitions.en: s. consciously perceiving
definitions.zh: n. 有知觉的人

examples.en: Humans are sentient beings with feelings.
examples.zh: 人类是有感觉力的生物。

examples.en: The robot was designed to be sentient.
examples.zh: 这个机器人被设计成有知觉。

definitions.en: n the news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television
definitions.zh: n. 新闻报道, 报告文学

examples.en: The reportage covered the event in detail.
examples.zh: 新闻报道详细报道了该事件。

examples.en: Good reportage requires accurate facts.
examples.zh: 好的新闻报道需要准确的事实。

definitions.en: n. (Christianity) the act of mortifying the lusts of the flesh by self-denial and privation (especially by bodily pain or discomfort inflicted on yourself)
definitions.zh: n. 坏疽, 丢失面子的感觉, 禁欲
[医] 坏疽

examples.en: He felt great mortification after his public failure.
examples.zh: 公开失败后，他感到极大的丢面子。

examples.en: The monk practiced mortification through fasting.
examples.zh: 僧侣通过禁食来实践禁欲。

definitions.en: v. estimate the value of
definitions.zh: v. 篡改, 插入新语句, 添写进去

examples.en: The editor tried to interpolate new data.
examples.zh: 编辑试图插入新数据。

examples.en: He interpolated a comment into the discussion.
examples.zh: 他在讨论中插入了一句评论。

definitions.en: n the cheerful feeling you have when nothing is troubling you
definitions.zh: n. 无忧无虑

examples.en: She faced the exam with insouciance.
examples.zh: 她无忧无虑地面对考试。

examples.en: His insouciance about the deadline worried us.
examples.zh: 他对截止日期的无忧无虑让我们担心。

definitions.en: s. tall and thin and having long slender limbs
definitions.zh: a. 瘦长难看的

examples.en: The gangling teenager tripped over his own feet.
examples.zh: 那个瘦长难看的少年被自己的脚绊倒了。

examples.en: She was tall and gangling, like a giraffe.
examples.zh: 她又高又瘦长，像只长颈鹿。

definitions.en: n. reprehensible acquisitiveness; insatiable desire for wealth (personified as one of the deadly sins)
definitions.zh: n. 贪婪

examples.en: His avarice for money knew no bounds.
examples.zh: 他对金钱的贪婪无止境。

examples.en: Avarice drove him to cheat his friends.
examples.zh: 贪婪驱使他欺骗朋友。

definitions.en: s. beyond doubt or reproach
definitions.zh: a. 无懈可击的, 无可指责的, 无过失的

examples.en: Her reputation is unimpeachable in the community.
examples.zh: 她在社区中的声誉无可指责。

examples.en: He provided unimpeachable evidence for his claim.
examples.zh: 他为自己的主张提供了无懈可击的证据。

definitions.en: n a cruel and oppressive dictator
definitions.zh: n. 独裁者

examples.en: The autocrat ruled the country with an iron fist.
examples.zh: 独裁者用铁腕统治国家。

examples.en: People rebelled against the cruel autocrat.
examples.zh: 人民反抗残酷的独裁者。

definitions.en: n. bowl-shaped strainer; used to wash or drain foods
definitions.zh: n. 滤器
[建] 滤器

examples.en: She used a colander to drain the pasta.
examples.zh: 她用滤器沥干意大利面。

examples.en: Wash the vegetables in a colander.
examples.zh: 在滤器里洗蔬菜。

definitions.en: n. a small natural hill
definitions.zh: n. 小山, 圆丘
vt. 敲钟
vi. 敲响

examples.en: They climbed the grassy knoll to see the view.
examples.zh: 他们爬上草坡看风景。

examples.en: A small knoll stood in the middle of the field.
examples.zh: 田野中央有一个小圆丘。

definitions.en: v. deprive through death
definitions.zh: vt. 使孤寂, 使丧失, 使失去

examples.en: The accident bereaved her of her husband.
examples.zh: 事故使她失去了丈夫。

examples.en: War bereaves many families of their loved ones.
examples.zh: 战争使许多家庭失去亲人。

definitions.en: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
definitions.zh: a. 使疲倦的, 使厌倦的, 乏味的

examples.en: The long lecture was wearisome and boring.
examples.zh: 漫长的讲座令人疲倦且乏味。

examples.en: His wearisome complaints annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他令人厌倦的抱怨惹恼了大家。

definitions.en: v. keep away from others
definitions.zh: vt. 使隔离, 使孤立, 隔开

examples.en: She decided to seclude herself in the mountains.
examples.zh: 她决定隐居在山区。

examples.en: He wanted to seclude from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 他想远离喧嚣的城市。

definitions.en: v. make off with belongings of others
definitions.zh: v. 盗取, 小偷小摸, 剽窃

examples.en: He tried to pilfer a candy from the store.
examples.zh: 他试图从商店偷一颗糖。

examples.en: Someone pilfered my pen from the desk.
examples.zh: 有人从桌子上偷走了我的笔。

definitions.en: v. be preoccupied with something
definitions.zh: vt. 迷住, 使困扰

examples.en: She tends to obsess over small details.
examples.zh: 她容易在小细节上纠结。

examples.en: Don't let fear obsess your mind.
examples.zh: 别让恐惧占据你的思绪。

definitions.en: v complain bitterly
definitions.zh: vi. 痛骂, 漫骂, 臭骂

examples.en: He began to inveigh against the new policy.
examples.zh: 他开始痛骂新政策。

examples.en: The speaker inveighed loudly about corruption.
examples.zh: 演讲者大声痛斥腐败。

definitions.en: n. a small structural space between tissues or parts of an organ
definitions.zh: n. 空隙, 裂缝

definitions.en: n. small opening between things
definitions.zh: [医] 小间隙

examples.en: Light shone through an interstice in the wall.
examples.zh: 光线从墙上的缝隙中透进来。

examples.en: There is an interstice between the two rocks.
examples.zh: 两块岩石之间有一个空隙。

definitions.en: a. tending to increase knowledge or dissipate ignorance
definitions.zh: a. 有启发作用的, 使人领悟的

examples.en: The lecture was very enlightening for everyone.
examples.zh: 这个讲座对大家很有启发。

examples.en: I found her book truly enlightening.
examples.zh: 我发现她的书确实发人深省。

definitions.en: n. a drug that causes contraction of body tissues and canals
definitions.zh: n. 收敛剂

definitions.en: a. tending to draw together or constrict soft organic tissue
definitions.zh: a. 收敛性的, 严厉的, 涩的

examples.en: The doctor used an astringent on the wound.
examples.zh: 医生在伤口上用了收敛剂。

examples.en: This fruit has an astringent taste.
examples.zh: 这种水果有涩味。
