definitions.zh: n. 精萃, 精华, 典范

definitions.en: n. the purest and most concentrated essence of something
definitions.zh: [医] 浓浸膏, 精华

examples.en: This painting is the quintessence of beauty.
examples.zh: 这幅画是美的精华。

examples.en: Her speech captured the quintessence of the issue.
examples.zh: 她的演讲抓住了问题的精髓。

definitions.en: n. a two-wheeled horse-drawn vehicle used to pull a field gun or caisson
definitions.zh: a. 柔软的, 敏捷的, 富于弹性的

definitions.en: v. attach the limber
definitions.zh: vt. 使柔软

definitions.en: v. cause to become limber
definitions.zh: vi. 做准备活动

examples.en: She does stretches to keep her body limber.
examples.zh: 她做拉伸以保持身体柔软。

examples.en: The dancer is very limber and flexible.
examples.zh: 这位舞者非常柔软灵活。

definitions.en: n. feeling an inappropriate lack of seriousness
definitions.zh: n. 轻率, 轻浮, 不稳定

examples.en: His levity during the meeting annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的轻浮惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: We need seriousness, not levity, right now.
examples.zh: 我们现在需要严肃，而不是轻率。

definitions.en: a. large and roomy (`convenient' is archaic in this sense)
definitions.zh: a. 宽敞的, 方便的

examples.en: The new house has a commodious living room.
examples.zh: 新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。

examples.en: This closet is commodious enough for all clothes.
examples.zh: 这个壁橱足够宽敞，能放所有衣服。

definitions.en: n. a bottle with a stopper; for serving wine or water
definitions.zh: n. 卡拉夫瓶

examples.en: Please bring a carafe of water to the table.
examples.zh: 请带一瓶水到桌上。

examples.en: She poured wine from the glass carafe.
examples.zh: 她从玻璃瓶里倒出酒。

definitions.en: a. simple and natural; without cunning or deceit
definitions.zh: a. 无虚饰的, 单纯的, 自然的

examples.en: Her artless smile made everyone feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她天真的微笑让每个人都感到受欢迎。

examples.en: The child's artless honesty was refreshing.
examples.zh: 孩子单纯的诚实令人耳目一新。

definitions.en: s slender and graceful
definitions.zh: a. 柳树多的, 易弯的, 苗条的, 优雅的

examples.en: The model has a willowy figure.
examples.zh: 这位模特身材苗条。

examples.en: She moved with a willowy grace.
examples.zh: 她以优雅苗条的姿态移动。

definitions.en: n. an instance of accomplishing something by scheming or trickery
definitions.zh: vi. 设法脱身, 用诡计获得

definitions.en: v. achieve something by means of trickery or devious methods
definitions.zh: vt. 用计获得, 扭身挤出, 哄骗, 伪造
n. 欺诈行为, 哄骗, 假造

examples.en: He managed to wangle a free ticket.
examples.zh: 他设法弄到了一张免费票。

examples.en: She wangled her way into the exclusive party.
examples.zh: 她耍手段进入了独家派对。

definitions.en: n. a severe blow
definitions.zh: vi. 乱窜, 猛冲

definitions.en: v. defeat soundly and utterly
definitions.zh: vt. 猛击, 击溃
n. 重击, 冲击力, 快感

examples.en: He gave the ball a powerful wallop.
examples.zh: 他给了球一记重击。

examples.en: The boxer walloped his opponent in the ring.
examples.zh: 拳击手在台上猛击对手。

definitions.en: s. creating an unfavorable or neutral first impression
definitions.zh: a. 不讨人喜欢的, 不吸引人的

examples.en: The restaurant looks unprepossessing from outside.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅从外面看起来不吸引人。

examples.en: Despite his unprepossessing appearance, he is kind.
examples.zh: 尽管他外表不起眼，但他很善良。

definitions.en: v. tear or be torn violently
definitions.zh: vt. 分裂, 劈开, 强夺, 撕碎, 划破
vi. 撕开, 裂开

examples.en: The loud noise rent the silence of the night.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音划破了夜晚的寂静。

examples.en: The storm rent the old tree in two.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把老树劈成了两半。

definitions.en: s habitually complaining
definitions.zh: a. 抱怨的, 爱发牢骚的, 易怒的

examples.en: The querulous child complained about everything.
examples.zh: 那个爱发牢骚的孩子抱怨一切。

examples.en: His querulous tone irritated his coworkers.
examples.zh: 他抱怨的语气惹恼了同事。

definitions.en: n. a heavy tool of stone or iron (usually with a flat base and a handle) that is used to grind and mix material (as grain or drugs or pigments) against a slab of stone
definitions.zh: n. 槌, 杵

definitions.en: n. a club-shaped hand tool for grinding and mixing substances in a mortar
definitions.zh: v. 用槌磨, 用杵捣

examples.en: She used a pestle to grind the spices.
examples.zh: 她用杵研磨香料。

examples.en: The chemist ground the powder with a pestle.
examples.zh: 化学家用杵把粉末磨碎。

definitions.en: s. having or as if having especially high-pitched spots
definitions.zh: a. 有峰的, 多峰的, 尖的, 消瘦的

examples.en: He looked peaky after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后他看起来很消瘦。

examples.en: The child's peaky face worried his mother.
examples.zh: 孩子消瘦的脸让母亲担心。

definitions.en: n. a revolutionary doctrine that advocates destruction of the social system for its own sake
definitions.zh: n. 虚无主义, 无政府主义

definitions.en: n. complete denial of all established authority and institutions
definitions.zh: [医] 虚无妄想; 虚无主义

examples.en: Nihilism rejects all moral and religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 虚无主义拒绝所有道德和宗教信仰。

examples.en: His philosophy of nihilism left him feeling empty.
examples.zh: 他的虚无主义哲学让他感到空虚。

definitions.en: s. hot or warm and humid
definitions.zh: a. 闷热的

examples.en: The weather is muggy and uncomfortable today.
examples.zh: 今天天气闷热不舒服。

examples.en: I hate the muggy summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 我讨厌闷热的夏日午后。

definitions.en: s only partly in existence; imperfectly formed
definitions.zh: a. 刚开始的, 不成熟的, 未发达的
[经] 不完整

examples.en: Her plan was still inchoate and unclear.
examples.zh: 她的计划仍然不成熟且不明确。

examples.en: The inchoate idea needed more development.
examples.zh: 这个初步的想法需要更多发展。

definitions.en: n a piece of wood that has been burned or is burning
definitions.zh: n. 火把, 在燃烧的木柴, 煽动叛乱者

examples.en: He is a political firebrand who stirs up trouble.
examples.zh: 他是个煽动麻烦的政治煽动者。

examples.en: The firebrand threw a burning log into the crowd.
examples.zh: 煽动者把燃烧的木棍扔进人群。

definitions.en: n. a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence
definitions.zh: n. 智力迟钝的学生, 傻瓜

examples.en: The teacher called him a dunce for failing.
examples.zh: 老师因他不及格而叫他傻瓜。

examples.en: Don't be a dunce; study for the test.
examples.zh: 别当傻瓜；为考试学习。

definitions.en: v. admit openly and bluntly; make no bones about
definitions.zh: vt. 坦率承认, 断言
[法] 公开宣称, 声明, 供认

examples.en: He avowed his love for her publicly.
examples.zh: 他公开承认了对她的爱。

examples.en: She avowed that she had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 她坦率承认自己犯了错误。

definitions.en: n. the large trunk artery that carries blood from the left ventricle of the heart to branch arteries
definitions.zh: n. 主动脉
[医] 主动脉

examples.en: The aorta carries blood from the heart.
examples.zh: 主动脉输送来自心脏的血液。

examples.en: A blockage in the aorta is very dangerous.
examples.zh: 主动脉堵塞非常危险。

definitions.en: v describe roughly or briefly or give the main points or summary of
definitions.zh: vt. 画...的轮廓, 预示

examples.en: The speaker adumbrated the main points of the talk.
examples.zh: 演讲者概述了谈话的要点。

examples.en: He adumbrated his plan in a few sentences.
examples.zh: 他用几句话概括了他的计划。

definitions.en: n. shuffling by splitting the pack and interweaving the two halves at their corners
definitions.zh: n. 浅滩, 急流, 涟漪, 弹洗

definitions.en: v. shuffle (playing cards) by separating the deck into two parts and riffling with the thumbs so the cards intermix
definitions.zh: vt. 使起涟漪, 迅速翻阅, 弹洗洗牌
vi. 成涟漪, 飞快翻书

examples.en: He riffled through the pages of the book.
examples.zh: 他迅速翻阅书页。

examples.en: She riffled the deck of cards before dealing.
examples.zh: 她在发牌前弹洗了牌。

definitions.en: s. long and thin and often limp
definitions.zh: a. 瘦的, 细长的, 长而柔软的

examples.en: Her hair was lank and lifeless after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后她的头发又细又无生气。

examples.en: The lank grass lay flat on the ground.
examples.zh: 细长的草平躺在地上。

definitions.en: n. an artificial or inferior substitute or imitation
definitions.zh: n. 代用品

examples.en: They drank ersatz coffee during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间他们喝代用咖啡。

examples.en: The ersatz leather felt cheap and fake.
examples.zh: 代用皮革摸起来廉价又假。

definitions.en: s. abundantly covered or supplied with; often used in combination
definitions.zh: a. 湿透的; 充满的
v. 使湿透( drench的过去式和过去分词 ); 在某人（某物）上大量使用（某液体）

examples.en: He got drenched in the sudden rainstorm.
examples.zh: 他在突如其来的暴雨中湿透了。

examples.en: Her clothes were drenched with sweat after running.
examples.zh: 跑步后她的衣服被汗水湿透。

definitions.zh: n. 副业, 署名报道

examples.en: The article has a byline from a famous journalist.
examples.zh: 这篇文章有著名记者的署名。

examples.en: She earned a byline for her investigative report.
examples.zh: 她因调查报告获得了署名。

definitions.en: n a rude or vulgar fool
definitions.zh: n. 小丑

examples.en: The buffoon made everyone laugh at the party.
examples.zh: 小丑在派对上让所有人笑。

examples.en: Stop acting like a buffoon and be serious.
examples.zh: 别像小丑一样，严肃点。

definitions.en: n. music with a syncopated melody (usually for the piano)
definitions.zh: n. 雷格泰姆旋律, 散拍乐
a. 滑稽的

examples.en: Ragtime music was popular in the early 1900s.
examples.zh: 雷格泰姆音乐在20世纪初很流行。

examples.en: He played a lively ragtime tune on the piano.
examples.zh: 他在钢琴上弹奏了一首活泼的雷格泰姆曲调。

definitions.en: n. hand tool for boring holes
definitions.zh: n. 螺旋钻, 木螺钻
[机] 木螺钻

examples.en: He used an auger to drill a hole in the wood.
examples.zh: 他用螺旋钻在木头上钻孔。

examples.en: The auger made clean holes for the fence posts.
examples.zh: 螺旋钻为栅栏桩钻出了干净的洞。

definitions.en: a. closest in degree or order (space or time) especially in a chain of causes and effects
definitions.zh: a. 最近的, 将临的, 近似的

definitions.en: s. very close in space or time
definitions.zh: [医] 近接的, 邻近的

examples.en: The proximate cause of the accident was speed.
examples.zh: 事故的近因是超速。

examples.en: We need to find the proximate solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要找到问题的最近解决方案。

definitions.en: n. a primary subtractive color for light; a dark purple-red color; the dye for magenta was discovered in 1859, the year of the battle of Magenta
definitions.zh: n. 品红色, 洋红

definitions.en: n. a battle in 1859 in which the French and Sardinian forces under Napoleon III defeated the Austrians under Francis Joseph I
definitions.zh: [化] (碱性)品红; 洋红

examples.en: She painted the room a bright magenta color.
examples.zh: 她把房间漆成了亮品红色。

examples.en: The flowers were a deep shade of magenta.
examples.zh: 花朵是深品红色。

definitions.en: v make off with belongings of others
definitions.zh: vt. 偷窃, 窃取

examples.en: He tried to filch a cookie from the jar.
examples.zh: 他试图从罐子里偷一块饼干。

examples.en: Someone filched my pen from the desk.
examples.zh: 有人从桌上偷了我的笔。

definitions.en: s. having the attention diverted especially because of anxiety
definitions.zh: a. 心烦意乱的

examples.en: She was distracted by the noise outside.
examples.zh: 她被外面的噪音弄得心烦意乱。

examples.en: He felt distracted and couldn't focus on work.
examples.zh: 他感到心烦意乱，无法专注于工作。

definitions.en: n. an exorbitant or unlawful rate of interest
definitions.zh: n. 高利贷

definitions.en: n. the act of lending money at an exorbitant rate of interest
definitions.zh: [经] 高利贷, 高利

examples.en: The loan shark charged usury on the debt.
examples.zh: 高利贷者对债务收取高利。

examples.en: Usury is illegal in many countries.
examples.zh: 高利贷在许多国家是非法的。

definitions.en: n. a relatively narrow strip of land (with water on both sides) connecting two larger land areas
definitions.zh: n. 地峡, 峡部

definitions.en: n. a cord-like tissue connecting two larger parts of an anatomical structure
definitions.zh: [医] 峡

examples.en: The Panama Canal connects the isthmus of Panama.
examples.zh: 巴拿马运河连接巴拿马地峡。

examples.en: They crossed the narrow isthmus to reach the island.
examples.zh: 他们穿过狭窄的地峡到达岛屿。

definitions.en: n. someone who operates a forge
definitions.zh: n. 铁匠, 伪造者, 赝造者

definitions.en: n. someone who makes copies illegally
definitions.zh: [法] 伪造者, 伪造犯

examples.en: The forger was arrested for making fake passports.
examples.zh: 伪造者因制作假护照被捕。

examples.en: He worked as a forger in the criminal ring.
examples.zh: 他在犯罪团伙中做伪造者。

definitions.en: s. completely sealed; completely airtight
definitions.zh: a. 奥妙的, 密封的, 不透气的, 不漏气的, 与外界隔绝的
[计] 全密封的

examples.en: The container is hermetic to keep air out.
examples.zh: 容器是密封的以隔绝空气。

examples.en: The laboratory maintains a hermetic environment.
examples.zh: 实验室保持密封环境。

definitions.en: n. one of the common people
definitions.zh: n. 平民, 庶民, 大众, 平庸的人
a. 平民的, 一般的, 普通的, 粗俗的

examples.en: He had plebeian tastes and simple habits.
examples.zh: 他有平民的品味和简单的习惯。

examples.en: The plebeian crowd cheered for the performer.
examples.zh: 平民人群为表演者欢呼。

definitions.en: s. of or providing nourishment
definitions.zh: a. 饮食的, 供养的
[化] 营养的

examples.en: The alimentary canal helps digest food.
examples.zh: 消化道帮助消化食物。

examples.en: Good alimentary habits keep you healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的饮食习惯让你保持健康。

definitions.en: s. unpredictably excitable (especially of horses)
definitions.zh: a. 易惊的, 轻佻的, 三心二意的, 不可靠的, 羞怯的, 活泼的, 爱蹦跳的, 活跃的

examples.en: The skittish horse ran from the noise.
examples.zh: 那匹易惊的马被噪音吓跑了。

examples.en: She is skittish about trying new things.
examples.zh: 她对尝试新事物感到紧张不安。

definitions.en: s. ostentatiously lofty in style
definitions.zh: a. 夸大的, 夸夸其谈的

examples.en: His bombastic speech bored the audience.
examples.zh: 他夸夸其谈的演讲让观众厌烦。

examples.en: Avoid bombastic language in simple writing.
examples.zh: 在简单的写作中避免夸大的语言。

definitions.en: s. completely acceptable; not open to exception or reproach
definitions.zh: a. 无懈可击的, 极好的, 完美无缺的

examples.en: Her behavior was unexceptionable at the party.
examples.zh: 她在聚会上的行为无可挑剔。

examples.en: The plan seemed unexceptionable to everyone.
examples.zh: 这个计划对每个人来说都无懈可击。

definitions.en: n. good luck in making unexpected and fortunate discoveries
definitions.zh: n. 偶然发现珍宝的运气/才能, 易遇奇缘的运气

examples.en: Finding that book was pure serendipity.
examples.zh: 找到那本书纯属意外之喜。

examples.en: Serendipity led her to a new career.
examples.zh: 机缘巧合让她找到了新职业。

definitions.en: n. state of disgrace resulting from detestable behavior
definitions.zh: n. 憎恶, 讨厌, 臭名

examples.en: The politician faced public odium for lying.
examples.zh: 那位政客因撒谎而招致公众憎恶。

examples.en: His actions brought odium upon the family.
examples.zh: 他的行为给家族带来了耻辱。

definitions.en: v upset and make nauseated
definitions.zh: vi. 作呕, 产生恶感, 厌恶

definitions.en: v cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of
definitions.zh: vt. 使厌恶, 使恶心

examples.en: The smell of rotten eggs nauseates me.
examples.zh: 臭鸡蛋的气味让我恶心。

examples.en: Violence in movies can nauseate some people.
examples.zh: 电影中的暴力会让一些人感到厌恶。

definitions.en: n. a substance used to produce fermentation in dough or a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 酵母, 促使渐变的因素

definitions.en: n. an influence that works subtly to lighten or modify something
definitions.zh: vt. 使发酵, 渐变

examples.en: Add leaven to the dough to make it rise.
examples.zh: 在面团中加入酵母使其发酵。

examples.en: Humor can leaven a serious conversation.
examples.zh: 幽默可以缓和严肃的谈话。

definitions.en: n. a factor whose effects cannot be accurately assessed
definitions.zh: a. 无重量的, 无法计算的, 不可估价的

definitions.en: a. difficult or impossible to evaluate with precision
definitions.zh: n. 无法衡量的事物

examples.en: The outcome depends on many imponderable factors.
examples.zh: 结果取决于许多无法估量的因素。

examples.en: Luck is an imponderable in any success.
examples.zh: 运气是任何成功中无法衡量的因素。

definitions.en: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious
definitions.zh: n. 倦怠, 厌倦
[医] 厌倦

examples.en: He felt a deep ennui during the long meeting.
examples.zh: 在漫长的会议中他感到深深的倦怠。

examples.en: Ennui set in after weeks of doing nothing.
examples.zh: 几周无所事事之后，厌倦感袭来。

definitions.en: n. a worthless message
definitions.zh: vi. 淌口水, 说傻话

definitions.en: v. let saliva drivel from the mouth
definitions.zh: vt. 胡说
n. 胡言乱语, 糊涂话

examples.en: Stop talking drivel and be serious.
examples.zh: 别胡说八道了，认真点。

examples.en: His speech was nothing but drivel.
examples.zh: 他的演讲全是胡言乱语。

definitions.en: n. a style that involves indirect ways of expressing things
definitions.zh: n. 迂回的说法

examples.en: He used circumlocution to avoid answering directly.
examples.zh: 他使用迂回的说法来避免直接回答。

examples.en: Circumlocution can make a simple point confusing.
examples.zh: 迂回的说法会让简单的观点变得令人困惑。

definitions.en: v. conceal one's true motives from especially by elaborately feigning good intentions so as to gain an end
definitions.zh: vt. 欺骗, 迷惑

examples.en: The scammer tried to bamboozle the old man.
examples.zh: 骗子试图欺骗那位老人。

examples.en: Don't let his charm bamboozle you.
examples.zh: 别让他的魅力迷惑了你。

definitions.en: n. the ritual washing of a priest's hands or of sacred vessels
definitions.zh: n. 洗澡, 洗礼, 斋戒沐浴
[化] 洗净; 洗净液

examples.en: The priest performed the ritual ablution before prayer.
examples.zh: 牧师在祈祷前进行了仪式性的沐浴。

examples.en: Ablution is part of many religious traditions.
examples.zh: 沐浴是许多宗教传统的一部分。

definitions.en: s after the expected or usual time; delayed
definitions.zh: a. 慢的, 迟到的, 勉强的, 拖拉的, 迟的

examples.en: She was tardy for the morning class again.
examples.zh: 她早上上课又迟到了。

examples.en: A tardy response can cause problems.
examples.zh: 迟到的回复可能会引发问题。

definitions.en: n a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness)
definitions.zh: n. 疲倦, 疲乏, 无精神

definitions.en: n a feeling of lack of interest or energy
definitions.zh: [医] 倦怠

examples.en: A feeling of lassitude came over him after work.
examples.zh: 下班后他感到一阵倦怠。

examples.en: Lassitude made it hard to get out of bed.
examples.zh: 疲倦让他难以起床。

definitions.en: v influence or urge by gentle urging, caressing, or flattering
definitions.zh: vt. 诱骗；诱使

examples.en: He inveigled her into joining the club.
examples.zh: 他诱骗她加入了俱乐部。

examples.en: They tried to inveigle him with promises of money.
examples.zh: 他们试图用金钱的承诺诱骗他。

definitions.en: n audacious (even arrogant) behavior that you have no right to
definitions.zh: n. 厚颜无耻

examples.en: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise.
examples.zh: 他厚颜无耻地要求加薪。

examples.en: Her effrontery shocked everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的厚颜无耻震惊了房间里的每个人。

definitions.en: a. disposed to believe on little evidence
definitions.zh: a. 轻信的, 易受骗的

examples.en: Credulous people often fall for scams.
examples.zh: 轻信的人常常上当受骗。

examples.en: She is too credulous to question his story.
examples.zh: 她太轻信了，不会质疑他的说法。

definitions.en: n. total certainty or greater certainty than circumstances warrant
definitions.zh: n. 确实性, 确信

examples.en: He spoke with certitude about the future.
examples.zh: 他带着确信谈论未来。

examples.en: Certitude can sometimes lead to stubbornness.
examples.zh: 确信有时会导致固执。

definitions.en: v. wear away
definitions.zh: vt. 擦伤, 磨损, 磨
[医] 擦除, 擦破; 磨损, 磨除

examples.en: The rough surface will abrade your skin.
examples.zh: 粗糙的表面会擦伤你的皮肤。

examples.en: Wind and sand abrade the ancient stones.
examples.zh: 风和沙磨损了古老的石头。

definitions.en: n. someone who spends money prodigally
definitions.zh: n. 浪费的人
a. 浪费的, 挥霍无度的

examples.en: A spendthrift quickly wastes all his money.
examples.zh: 挥霍无度的人很快就会花光所有的钱。

examples.en: She is a spendthrift who loves shopping.
examples.zh: 她是个挥霍无度的人，喜欢购物。

definitions.en: n. a person lacking intelligence or common sense
definitions.zh: n. 笨蛋, 傻子

examples.en: Don't be a simpleton and believe everything.
examples.zh: 别像个傻子一样什么都信。

examples.en: He was called a simpleton for his naive ideas.
examples.zh: 他因为天真的想法而被叫做笨蛋。

definitions.en: v. become wrinkled or crumpled or creased
definitions.zh: v. 弄皱, 弄得乱七八糟
n. 皱纹, 皱褶

examples.en: The wind rumpled her hair as she walked.
examples.zh: 她走路时风吹乱了她的头发。

examples.en: Don't rumple the clean sheets on the bed.
examples.zh: 别把床上的干净床单弄皱。

definitions.en: v play boisterously
definitions.zh: a. 欢乐的；喧闹的

examples.en: The children had a rollicking time at the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园里玩得欢闹。

examples.en: It was a rollicking party full of laughter.
examples.zh: 那是一个充满笑声的欢乐派对。

definitions.en: s. taking on different forms
definitions.zh: a. 千变万化的, 变化不定的, (海神)普罗透斯的

examples.en: His protean talents include acting and writing.
examples.zh: 他多变的才华包括表演和写作。

examples.en: The protean nature of the cloud makes it fascinating.
examples.zh: 云朵千变万化的特性令人着迷。

definitions.en: s. becoming obsolete
definitions.zh: a. 在逐步废弃的

examples.en: This technology is obsolescent and rarely used.
examples.zh: 这项技术正在被淘汰，很少使用了。

examples.en: Obsolescent machines are replaced by new ones.
examples.zh: 过时的机器被新机器取代。

definitions.en: s. (of paper money) not convertible into coin at the pleasure of the holder
definitions.zh: a. 不能赎回的
[经] 不能偿还的, 不能兑现的

examples.en: The debt was considered irredeemable by the bank.
examples.zh: 银行认为这笔债务无法偿还。

examples.en: His reputation is irredeemable after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻之后他的名誉无法挽回。

definitions.en: n a person who makes deceitful pretenses
definitions.zh: n. 冒名顶替者, 骗子, 冒牌

examples.en: The impostor pretended to be a doctor.
examples.zh: 那个冒名顶替者假装成医生。

examples.en: They caught the impostor before he could steal anything.
examples.zh: 他们在他偷东西之前抓住了那个骗子。

definitions.en: n the quality of being exact
definitions.zh: n. 正确(性), 精密, 精确(性), 严格

examples.en: The scientist values exactitude in measurements.
examples.zh: 科学家重视测量的精确性。

examples.en: Exactitude is important in legal documents.
examples.zh: 精确性在法律文件中很重要。

definitions.en: v. remove
definitions.zh: vt. 脱, 丢弃, 摆脱

examples.en: He doffed his hat as a sign of respect.
examples.zh: 他脱帽以示尊敬。

examples.en: Please doff your coat when entering the house.
examples.zh: 进屋时请脱掉外套。

definitions.en: n. a cordial disposition
definitions.zh: n. 友好, 亲善关系

examples.en: The two countries signed a treaty of amity.
examples.zh: 两国签署了友好条约。

examples.en: Amity between neighbors makes life pleasant.
examples.zh: 邻里之间的友好让生活愉快。

definitions.en: n. (Christian theology) the love of God or Christ for mankind
definitions.zh: a. 张口发呆的, 目瞪口呆的

definitions.en: n. selfless love of one person for another without sexual implications (especially love that is spiritual in nature)
definitions.zh: adv. 张口发呆地, 目瞪口呆地

examples.en: The children stood agape at the magic show.
examples.zh: 孩子们在魔术表演前目瞪口呆。

examples.en: He stared agape at the unexpected news.
examples.zh: 他目瞪口呆地盯着这个意外的消息。

definitions.en: v. make rough or rougher
definitions.zh: v. (使)变粗糙

examples.en: Cold weather can roughen your skin.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天气会使你的皮肤变粗糙。

examples.en: The sandpaper will roughen the wood surface.
examples.zh: 砂纸会使木头表面变粗糙。

definitions.en: v block passage through
definitions.zh: vt. 使闭塞, 隔断, 挡住
vi. 咬合

examples.en: A blood clot can occlude an artery.
examples.zh: 血块会阻塞动脉。

examples.en: The clouds occlude the sun completely.
examples.zh: 云层完全遮住了太阳。

definitions.en: s. incapable of being morally corrupted
definitions.zh: a. 不腐败的, 不能收买的, 清廉的

examples.en: The judge was known to be incorruptible.
examples.zh: 那位法官以清廉著称。

examples.en: An incorruptible leader earns the people's trust.
examples.zh: 一个清廉的领导者赢得人民的信任。

definitions.en: s offensive to the mind
definitions.zh: a. 可憎的, 可恶的

examples.en: Lying is a detestable habit.
examples.zh: 撒谎是一种可憎的习惯。

examples.en: His detestable behavior made everyone angry.
examples.zh: 他可憎的行为让每个人都生气。

definitions.en: n the state of being weak in health or body (especially from old age)
definitions.zh: n. 衰弱, 体弱
[医] 虚弱

examples.en: Old age often brings physical debility.
examples.zh: 老年常常带来身体虚弱。

examples.en: The illness left him in a state of debility.
examples.zh: 疾病使他处于虚弱状态。

definitions.en: s. highly excited
definitions.zh: a. 兴奋着的, 急切的
adv. 急切地, 渴望

examples.en: The children were agog with excitement.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋不已。

examples.en: She was agog to hear the latest news.
examples.zh: 她急切地想听到最新消息。

definitions.en: n. intense aversion
definitions.zh: n. 反感, 厌恶, 不一致, 矛盾, 抵触
[法] 不一致, 矛盾, 不一致之处

examples.en: She felt repugnance at the sight of blood.
examples.zh: 她看到血感到厌恶。

examples.en: His repugnance for violence is well known.
examples.zh: 他对暴力的厌恶是众所周知的。

definitions.en: n. upright consisting of a vertical side member of a door or window frame
definitions.zh: n. 门窗侧壁, 侧柱

examples.en: He leaned against the door jamb.
examples.zh: 他靠在门框上。

examples.en: The window jamb needs painting.
examples.zh: 窗框需要刷漆。

definitions.en: v. behave in a patronizing and condescending manner
definitions.zh: vi. 谦逊, 屈就, 堕落

examples.en: She would not condescend to speak to us.
examples.zh: 她不肯屈尊和我们说话。

examples.en: Don't condescend to your classmates.
examples.zh: 不要对你的同学摆架子。

definitions.en: a. Not bidden; not commanded.
definitions.zh: a. 未奉命的, 未受指使的, 自发的, 未受邀请的

examples.en: Tears came unbidden to her eyes.
examples.zh: 泪水不由自主地涌上她的眼眶。

examples.en: He arrived unbidden at the party.
examples.zh: 他未经邀请就来到了派对。

definitions.en: v. make free from bacteria
definitions.zh: vt. 使成不毛, 使绝育, 杀菌, 使不起作用

definitions.en: v. make infertile
definitions.zh: [医] 灭菌, 消毒; 绝育

examples.en: Doctors sterilize surgical tools before use.
examples.zh: 医生在使用前消毒手术工具。

examples.en: You should sterilize the baby's bottle.
examples.zh: 你应该给婴儿的奶瓶消毒。

definitions.en: n someone who helps to gather the harvest
definitions.zh: n. 收割者, 收割机

examples.en: The reaper worked hard in the field.
examples.zh: 收割者在田里辛勤劳作。

examples.en: A modern reaper can harvest quickly.
examples.zh: 现代收割机能快速收割。

definitions.en: v. acquire for oneself before others can do so
definitions.zh: vt. 先买, 先取

definitions.en: v. take the place of or have precedence over
definitions.zh: vi. 先发制人地叫牌

examples.en: The news will preempt regular programming.
examples.zh: 新闻将取代常规节目。

examples.en: She tried to preempt their criticism.
examples.zh: 她试图先发制人地阻止他们的批评。

definitions.en: v expose to fresh air
definitions.zh: vt. 使暴露于空气中, 使充满气体

definitions.en: v aerate (sewage) so as to favor the growth of organisms that decompose organic matter
definitions.zh: [化] 曝气; 充气; 吹气

examples.en: You should aerate the soil for plants.
examples.zh: 你应该给土壤通气以利植物生长。

examples.en: The machine helps aerate the wine.
examples.zh: 这台机器帮助给葡萄酒充气。

definitions.en: v. postpone doing what one should be doing
definitions.zh: v. 延迟, 耽搁

examples.en: Do not procrastinate on your homework.
examples.zh: 不要拖延做作业。

examples.en: He tends to procrastinate when stressed.
examples.zh: 他压力大时容易拖延。

definitions.en: a. capable of being dispensed with or done without
definitions.zh: a. 不是必要的, 可有可无的

examples.en: This old chair is dispensable now.
examples.zh: 这把旧椅子现在可有可无。

examples.en: Some items in the kit are dispensable.
examples.zh: 工具箱里有些物品不是必需的。

definitions.en: v. eject semen
definitions.zh: vt. 突然说出, 射出
vi. 射出, 射精
n. 精液

examples.en: He ejaculated a sudden cry of surprise.
examples.zh: 他突然发出一声惊叫。

examples.en: The doctor studied how men ejaculate.
examples.zh: 医生研究男性如何射精。

definitions.en: n. a swing used by circus acrobats
definitions.zh: n. 吊秋千

examples.en: The acrobat swung on the trapeze.
examples.zh: 杂技演员在秋千上荡来荡去。

examples.en: She learned to fly on a trapeze.
examples.zh: 她学会了在吊秋千上飞翔。

definitions.en: s unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech
definitions.zh: a. 油的, 油质的, 油腻的, 虚情假意的
[医] 油滑的, 油样的

examples.en: His unctuous manner made me uneasy.
examples.zh: 他虚情假意的态度让我不安。

examples.en: She gave an unctuous smile to the boss.
examples.zh: 她对老板露出谄媚的微笑。

definitions.en: v make off with belongings of others
definitions.zh: v. 偷窃, 盗取

examples.en: Someone purloined my wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 有人在公交车上偷了我的钱包。

examples.en: He purloined a cookie from the jar.
examples.zh: 他从罐子里偷了一块饼干。

definitions.en: s. obstinate in your opinions
definitions.zh: a. 固执己见的, 武断的

examples.en: He is very opinionated about politics.
examples.zh: 他对政治非常固执己见。

examples.en: An opinionated person rarely listens.
examples.zh: 固执己见的人很少听别人意见。

definitions.en: s full of trivial conversation
definitions.zh: a. 多嘴的, 好辩的, 吵闹的, 潺潺的

examples.en: The loquacious man talked for hours.
examples.zh: 那个多嘴的男人聊了好几个小时。

examples.en: She is loquacious at every meeting.
examples.zh: 她在每次会议上都很健谈。

definitions.en: a. deserving of respect or high regard
definitions.zh: a. 可尊敬的, 可估计的

examples.en: She is an estimable teacher in our school.
examples.zh: 她是我们学校一位可敬的老师。

examples.en: His estimable work earned him respect.
examples.zh: 他可敬的工作赢得了尊重。

definitions.en: s. of great mass; huge and bulky
definitions.zh: a. 象的, 巨大的, 粗笨的

examples.en: The elephantine creature moved slowly.
examples.zh: 那个巨大的生物缓慢移动。

examples.en: His elephantine footsteps shook the floor.
examples.zh: 他笨重的脚步震动了地板。

definitions.en: v. make inconspicuous
definitions.zh: vt. 抹去, 消除, 忘却

examples.en: Time will efface the painful memories.
examples.zh: 时间会抹去痛苦的记忆。

examples.en: She tried to efface herself from the group.
examples.zh: 她试图在群体中不引人注目。

definitions.en: n. someone who has the power of clairvoyance
definitions.zh: a. 神视的, 有洞察力的

definitions.en: s. perceiving things beyond the natural range of the senses
definitions.zh: n. 有洞察力的人, 千里眼

examples.en: The clairvoyant predicted the future.
examples.zh: 那个有洞察力的人预测了未来。

examples.en: She has a clairvoyant ability to see truths.
examples.zh: 她有洞察真相的能力。

definitions.en: v make amends for
definitions.zh: vi. 补偿, 弥补

definitions.en: v turn away from sin or do penitence
definitions.zh: [法] 赔偿, 补偿, 偿还

examples.en: He tried to atone for his mistake.
examples.zh: 他试图弥补自己的错误。

examples.en: She atoned by helping the community.
examples.zh: 她通过帮助社区来赎罪。

definitions.en: v. destroy wantonly, as through acts of vandalism
definitions.zh: vt. 肆意破坏
[法] 摧残文化, 破坏财产

examples.en: Someone vandalized the park bench.
examples.zh: 有人破坏了公园的长椅。

examples.en: Do not vandalize public property.
examples.zh: 不要破坏公共财产。

definitions.en: v indicate by signs
definitions.zh: vt. 成为...的前兆, 预知, 给与...的警告

examples.en: Dark clouds portend a coming storm.
examples.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: This event may portend future trouble.
examples.zh: 这个事件可能预示着未来的麻烦。

definitions.en: s. stubbornly conservative and narrow-minded
definitions.zh: a. 思想偏狭顽固的, 死板的, 量小的
[医] 绷紧的, 包紧的(皮肤)

examples.en: His hidebound views prevent progress.
examples.zh: 他顽固的观点阻碍了进步。

examples.en: She is too hidebound to try new things.
examples.zh: 她太死板，不愿尝试新事物。

definitions.en: v. to wind or move in a spiral course
definitions.zh: a. 旋涡状的
vi. 旋转, 不停地转动

examples.en: The dancer began to gyrate on stage.
examples.zh: 舞者在舞台上开始旋转。

examples.en: The helicopter blades gyrate rapidly.
examples.zh: 直升机的旋翼快速旋转。

definitions.en: s. marked by speed and efficiency
definitions.zh: a. 迅速的, 敏捷的

examples.en: We need an expeditious solution to this.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个迅速的解决方案。

examples.en: The expeditious delivery pleased the customer.
examples.zh: 迅速的送货让顾客满意。

definitions.en: s. tending to vanish like vapor
definitions.zh: a. 逐渐消失的, 容易消散的, 短暂的
[医] 易消灭的, 渐消失的, 挥发性的

examples.en: The beauty of a sunset is evanescent.
examples.zh: 日落之美是短暂的。

examples.en: Her evanescent smile faded quickly.
examples.zh: 她转瞬即逝的微笑很快消失了。

definitions.en: n a sudden violent change in the earth's surface
definitions.zh: n. 大洪水, 地震, (社会政治的)大变动

definitions.en: n an event resulting in great loss and misfortune
definitions.zh: [医] 渗出, 渗液, 猝变, 聚变

examples.en: The earthquake was a terrible cataclysm.
examples.zh: 地震是一场可怕的灾难。

examples.en: War can cause a social cataclysm.
examples.zh: 战争可能导致社会大变动。

definitions.en: v. formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure
definitions.zh: vt. 发誓断绝, 公开放弃
[法] 誓绝, 弃绝, 公开放弃

examples.en: He abjured his former beliefs publicly.
examples.zh: 他公开宣布放弃以前的信仰。

examples.en: She abjured violence in her speech.
examples.zh: 她在演讲中发誓放弃暴力。

definitions.en: n. the product of vaporization of a solid
definitions.zh: vt. 使升华, 使高尚

definitions.en: v. direct energy or urges into useful activities
definitions.zh: vi. 升华, 纯化

definitions.en: s. made pure
definitions.zh: a. 纯净化的, 高尚的, 理想化的

examples.en: Art can sublimate strong emotions.
examples.zh: 艺术可以升华强烈的情感。

examples.en: He sublimated his anger into creative work.
examples.zh: 他把愤怒升华为创造性工作。

definitions.en: n. a benefice to which no spiritual or pastoral duties are attached
definitions.zh: n. 闲职

definitions.en: n. an office that involves minimal duties
definitions.zh: [经] 领干俸的职位

examples.en: His job is a sinecure with little work.
examples.zh: 他的工作是个闲职，几乎没活干。

examples.en: She found a sinecure at the office.
examples.zh: 她在办公室找了个闲差。

definitions.en: v. make sensitive or aware
definitions.zh: vt. 使敏感, 使具有感光性

definitions.en: v. cause to sense; make sensitive
definitions.zh: vi. 变得敏感

examples.en: The campaign aims to sensitize the public.
examples.zh: 这项运动旨在提高公众的敏感度。

examples.en: We need to sensitize people to this issue.
examples.zh: 我们需要让人们对此问题敏感起来。

definitions.en: v. make peace with
definitions.zh: vt. 慰抚, 安抚, 和解, 谋求...的好感

examples.en: They offered gifts to propitiate the gods.
examples.zh: 他们献上礼物以安抚神灵。

examples.en: He tried to propitiate his angry boss.
examples.zh: 他试图安抚生气的老板。

definitions.en: n an unaccented beat (especially the last beat of a measure)
definitions.zh: a. 不平常的, 离奇的, 不落俗套的

definitions.en: s informal terms; strikingly unconventional
definitions.zh: n. 弱拍

examples.en: She has an offbeat sense of humor.
examples.zh: 她有一种不落俗套的幽默感。

examples.en: The movie has an offbeat storyline.
examples.zh: 这部电影的情节很离奇。

definitions.en: n a tract of land used for burials
definitions.zh: n. 大墓地, 史前坟场

examples.en: The ancient necropolis was discovered here.
examples.zh: 古代大墓地在这里被发现。

examples.en: Tourists visited the old necropolis.
examples.zh: 游客参观了古老的坟场。

definitions.en: n. rapid and indistinct speech
definitions.zh: v. 快而含糊地说, 吱吱喳喳地叫
n. 快而含糊不清的话

examples.en: The children jabbered excitedly in the room.
examples.zh: 孩子们在房间里兴奋地叽叽喳喳。

examples.en: I could not understand his jabber.
examples.zh: 我听不懂他含糊不清的话。

definitions.en: n. massive thick-skinned herbivorous animal living in or around rivers of tropical Africa
definitions.zh: n. 河马

examples.en: The hippopotamus lives in the river.
examples.zh: 河马生活在河里。

examples.en: A hippopotamus can be very dangerous.
examples.zh: 河马可能非常危险。

definitions.en: s easily broken into small fragments or reduced to powder
definitions.zh: a. 易碎的, 易成粉末的, 脆弱的
[医] 易碎的, 脆的

examples.en: The dry soil is friable and crumbly.
examples.zh: 干燥的土壤易碎且松散。

examples.en: Friable rocks break apart easily.
examples.zh: 易碎的岩石很容易碎裂。

definitions.en: n. an expert manner of speaking involving control of voice and gesture
definitions.zh: n. 雄辩术, 演说法

examples.en: She took lessons to improve her elocution.
examples.zh: 她上课来提高自己的演讲技巧。

examples.en: His elocution was clear and powerful.
examples.zh: 他的演说清晰而有力。

definitions.en: v ask for and get free; be a parasite
definitions.zh: v. 行乞, 乞讨, 贩卖

examples.en: He always tries to cadge a free meal.
examples.zh: 他总是试图讨一顿免费饭。

examples.en: She cadged a ride from her friend.
examples.zh: 她向朋友讨了个便车。

definitions.en: s marked by great carelessness
definitions.zh: a. 破烂的, 马虎的, 潦草的

examples.en: His slipshod work disappointed the teacher.
examples.zh: 他马虎的工作让老师失望。

examples.en: A slipshod attitude leads to mistakes.
examples.zh: 马虎的态度会导致错误。

definitions.en: n. a person who pays more attention to formal rules and book learning than they merit
definitions.zh: n. 自夸学问的人, 空谈家, 书呆子

examples.en: The pedant corrected every small grammar mistake.
examples.zh: 那个书呆子纠正了每一个小的语法错误。

examples.en: Don't be such a pedant about the rules.
examples.zh: 别对规则这么死板。

definitions.en: v. fail by aiming too high or trying too hard
definitions.zh: vt. 扩展...以上, 过度伸张, 走过头
vi. 伸得过远, 过分, 过火

examples.en: He tried to overreach and lost everything.
examples.zh: 他试图做得过头，结果失去了一切。

examples.en: The company overreached by expanding too fast.
examples.zh: 公司扩张过快，做得过火了。

definitions.en: n a secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence
definitions.zh: n. 副产品

examples.en: Honey is a byproduct of flower pollination.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜是花朵授粉的副产品。

examples.en: Stress can be a byproduct of hard work.
examples.zh: 压力可能是努力工作的副产品。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or characterized by fever
definitions.zh: a. 发热的, 热病的, 热性的
[医] 热性的, 发热的

examples.en: The child felt febrile and stayed in bed.
examples.zh: 孩子发烧了，躺在床上。

examples.en: A febrile patient needs plenty of water.
examples.zh: 发热的病人需要多喝水。

definitions.en: v. put someone through a debriefing and make him report
definitions.zh: vt. 听取报告, 盘问

examples.en: The pilot will debrief after the mission.
examples.zh: 飞行员将在任务后汇报情况。

examples.en: We need to debrief the team about the project.
examples.zh: 我们需要向团队听取项目报告。

definitions.en: n. the state of having rejected your religious beliefs or your political party or a cause (often in favor of opposing beliefs or causes)
definitions.zh: n. 叛教, 变节, 脱党

definitions.en: n. the act of abandoning a party for cause
definitions.zh: [法] 叛教, 背教, 脱党

examples.en: His apostasy shocked the entire community.
examples.zh: 他的叛教震惊了整个社区。

examples.en: Apostasy is rare in that strict religion.
examples.zh: 在那个严格的宗教中，背教很少见。

definitions.en: v. elevate or idealize, in allusion to Christ's transfiguration
definitions.zh: vt. 使变形, 使改观, 美化

examples.en: The sunset transfigured the sky with colors.
examples.zh: 日落用色彩改变了天空。

examples.en: Love can transfigure a person's life completely.
examples.zh: 爱能彻底改变一个人的生活。

definitions.en: n. lens for correcting defective vision in one eye; held in place by facial muscles
definitions.zh: n. 单片眼镜
[医] 单眼镜, 单眼绷带

examples.en: He wore a monocle to read the small print.
examples.zh: 他戴着单片眼镜看小字。

examples.en: The old gentleman adjusted his monocle carefully.
examples.zh: 那位老先生小心地调整了他的单片眼镜。

definitions.en: n a surface on which an organism grows or is attached
definitions.zh: n. 基础, 根据, 下层, 基层, 基质, 培养基, 胶层

definitions.en: n any stratum or layer lying underneath another
definitions.zh: [计] 基底

examples.en: The soil has a rocky substratum underneath.
examples.zh: 土壤下面有一个岩石基层。

examples.en: Trust is the substratum of any friendship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何友谊的基础。

definitions.en: n. a kind of heavy jacket (`windcheater' is a British term)
definitions.zh: n. 皮制连帽大衣, 派克大衣

examples.en: She wore a warm parka in the snow.
examples.zh: 她在雪地里穿了一件温暖的派克大衣。

examples.en: His parka has a hood for the rain.
examples.zh: 他的派克大衣有防雨的帽子。

definitions.en: n. a psychological state characterized by delusions of grandeur
definitions.zh: n. 夸大狂
[医] 夸大狂

examples.en: His megalomania made him think he was a king.
examples.zh: 他的夸大狂让他以为自己是个国王。

examples.en: Megalomania can lead to unrealistic ambitions.
examples.zh: 夸大狂会导致不切实际的野心。

definitions.en: n. the time between two reigns, governments, etc.
definitions.zh: n. 空位期间, 过渡期, 中断

examples.en: The country had an interregnum after the king died.
examples.zh: 国王死后，国家有一段空位期。

examples.en: During the interregnum, no one was in charge.
examples.zh: 在过渡期，没有人负责。

definitions.en: n a man who is much concerned with his dress and appearance
definitions.zh: n. 自高自大的人, 花花公子

examples.en: That fop spends hours on his appearance.
examples.zh: 那个花花公子花几个小时打扮自己。

examples.en: He is a fop who only cares about fashion.
examples.zh: 他是个只关心时尚的花花公子。

definitions.en: n. a correction made by erasing
definitions.zh: n. 擦除, 抹掉

definitions.en: n. a surface area where something has been erased
definitions.zh: [电] 擦掉

examples.en: The erasure of the mistake took time.
examples.zh: 擦除错误花了时间。

examples.en: She noticed an erasure on the paper.
examples.zh: 她注意到纸上有一处擦除的痕迹。

definitions.en: n. the act of excluding someone from society by general consent
definitions.zh: n. 流放, 放逐, 排斥
[法] 流放, 放逐, 排斥

examples.en: Ostracism from the group hurt her deeply.
examples.zh: 被团体排斥深深伤害了她。

examples.en: He faced ostracism for his unpopular opinions.
examples.zh: 他因不受欢迎的观点而遭到排斥。

definitions.en: a. not enlightened; ignorant
definitions.zh: a. 愚昧无知的, 未受启发的

examples.en: The unenlightened villagers feared new ideas.
examples.zh: 愚昧无知的村民害怕新思想。

examples.en: An unenlightened person may reject science.
examples.zh: 未受启发的人可能会拒绝科学。

definitions.en: n. an impermanence that suggests the inevitability of ending or dying
definitions.zh: n. 顷刻, 无常, 短暂

examples.en: The transience of youth makes it precious.
examples.zh: 青春的短暂使它珍贵。

examples.en: He accepted the transience of all things.
examples.zh: 他接受了万物的无常。

definitions.en: s slow and apathetic
definitions.zh: a. 麻痹的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 蛰伏的

definitions.en: s in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
definitions.zh: [医] 迟钝的, 不活泼的, 缓慢的

examples.en: The bear was torpid during winter hibernation.
examples.zh: 熊在冬眠期间是迟钝的。

examples.en: He felt torpid after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后他感到迟缓无力。

definitions.en: v. engrave by means of dots and flicks
definitions.zh: n. 点刻法, 点画, 点彩

definitions.en: v. make by small short touches that together produce an even or softly graded shadow, as in paint or ink
definitions.zh: vt. 点刻, 点画, 点彩

examples.en: The artist used stipple to create texture.
examples.zh: 艺术家用点刻法创造纹理。

examples.en: She learned to stipple with a fine brush.
examples.zh: 她学会了用细刷子点画。

definitions.en: s extremely pleasing to the sense of taste
definitions.zh: a. 可口的, 绝妙的, 缩紧的

examples.en: The cake was absolutely scrumptious and rich.
examples.zh: 蛋糕非常可口且浓郁。

examples.en: She made a scrumptious dinner for everyone.
examples.zh: 她为大家做了一顿可口的晚餐。

definitions.en: v. consider, ponder, or plan (an action) beforehand
definitions.zh: v. 预谋, 预先考虑

examples.en: He did not premeditate the crime at all.
examples.zh: 他完全没有预谋这起犯罪。

examples.en: They premeditate every step of the plan.
examples.zh: 他们预先考虑了计划的每一步。

definitions.en: n overflowing with eager enjoyment or approval
definitions.zh: n. 沸腾, 热情, 热情洋溢
[医] 沸腾

examples.en: Her ebullience filled the room with joy.
examples.zh: 她的热情洋溢让房间充满欢乐。

examples.en: The child's ebullience was contagious to all.
examples.zh: 孩子的热情洋溢感染了所有人。

definitions.en: s not easily perturbed or excited or upset; marked by extreme calm and composure
definitions.zh: a. 不慌张的, 镇定的

examples.en: She remained unflappable during the crisis.
examples.zh: 她在危机中保持镇定。

examples.en: An unflappable pilot can handle emergencies well.
examples.zh: 镇定的飞行员能很好地处理紧急情况。

definitions.en: v push to thrust outward
definitions.zh: vt. 逼使, 强迫, 伸出

definitions.en: v thrust oneself in as if by force
definitions.zh: vi. 打扰, 强行闯入

examples.en: He tends to obtrude his opinions on others.
examples.zh: 他倾向于把自己的意见强加给别人。

examples.en: Don't obtrude into their private conversation.
examples.zh: 不要强行闯入他们的私人谈话。

definitions.en: s in the current fashion or style
definitions.zh: a. 流行的, 时髦的

examples.en: She wore a modish dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条时髦的裙子去派对。

examples.en: His modish haircut attracted many compliments.
examples.zh: 他时髦的发型吸引了许多赞美。

definitions.en: n. glove that encases the thumb separately and the other four fingers together
definitions.zh: n. 连指手套, 拳击手套

examples.en: She wore a warm mitten on each hand.
examples.zh: 她每只手上戴着一只温暖的手套。

examples.en: The child lost one mitten in the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子在雪地里丢了一只连指手套。

definitions.en: n. a destroyer of images used in religious worship
definitions.zh: n. 反对偶象崇拜者, 提倡打破旧习的人

examples.en: The artist was an iconoclast who broke traditions.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家是个打破传统的反对偶像崇拜者。

examples.en: An iconoclast often challenges popular beliefs.
examples.zh: 提倡打破旧习的人常常挑战流行信仰。

definitions.en: v. treat with fumes, expose to fumes, especially with the aim of disinfecting or eradicating pests
definitions.zh: vt. 熏制
[医] 熏烟

examples.en: They fumigate the house to kill pests.
examples.zh: 他们熏制房子以杀死害虫。

examples.en: The doctor will fumigate the hospital room.
examples.zh: 医生将熏蒸医院房间。

definitions.en: v. reason with (somebody) for the purpose of dissuasion
definitions.zh: vi. 劝诫, 告诫；忠告

examples.en: She tried to expostulate with him about his plan.
examples.zh: 她试图劝诫他关于他的计划。

examples.en: He would expostulate against risky decisions.
examples.zh: 他会告诫反对冒险的决定。

definitions.en: v. make weak
definitions.zh: vt. 使衰弱

examples.en: The disease can enfeeble even strong people.
examples.zh: 疾病甚至能使强壮的人衰弱。

examples.en: Age will enfeeble the body over time.
examples.zh: 年龄会逐渐使身体衰弱。

definitions.en: s unrestrained by convention or morality
definitions.zh: a. 放荡的, 风流的

examples.en: He led a dissolute life full of parties.
examples.zh: 他过着放荡的生活，充满派对。

examples.en: The dissolute man spent all his money on fun.
examples.zh: 那个放荡的人把所有钱都花在享乐上。

definitions.en: n. the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
definitions.zh: n. 顶点, 极度, 最高点
[医] 极期

examples.en: She reached the acme of her career at forty.
examples.zh: 她在四十岁达到了事业的顶点。

examples.en: The acme of his success was winning the award.
examples.zh: 他成功的顶点是赢得奖项。

definitions.en: n. a feeling of anger caused by being offended
definitions.zh: n. 不快, 生气, 阴影, 树荫, 怀疑等模糊感觉

examples.en: He took umbrage at her critical comments.
examples.zh: 他对她的批评感到不快。

examples.en: She felt umbrage when they ignored her idea.
examples.zh: 当他们忽视她的想法时，她感到生气。

definitions.en: s timid by nature or revealing timidity
definitions.zh: a. 胆怯的, 胆小的, 羞怯的

examples.en: The timorous rabbit hid behind the bush.
examples.zh: 胆怯的兔子躲在灌木丛后面。

examples.en: She gave a timorous smile to the stranger.
examples.zh: 她向陌生人羞怯地笑了笑。

definitions.en: s easily irritated or annoyed
definitions.zh: a. 易怒的, 暴躁的

examples.en: He became testy when he didn't get enough sleep.
examples.zh: 他睡眠不足时变得易怒。

examples.en: The testy old man complained about everything.
examples.zh: 那个暴躁的老人抱怨一切。

definitions.en: n. a person engaged in slave trade
definitions.zh: n. 奴隶商人, 奴隶贩卖船, 口水
vi. 垂涎, 淌口水, 奉承
vt. 淌口水弄脏

examples.en: The slaver transported people across the ocean.
examples.zh: 奴隶贩子把人运过海洋。

examples.en: He was a cruel slaver in the history books.
examples.zh: 他在历史书中是个残忍的奴隶商人。

definitions.en: n. the power to foresee the future
definitions.zh: n. 预知, 先见

examples.en: Her prescience about the storm saved many lives.
examples.zh: 她对风暴的预知挽救了许多生命。

examples.en: He had the prescience to invest early in tech.
examples.zh: 他有先见之明，早早投资科技。

definitions.en: v make a hole into or between, as for ease of separation
definitions.zh: vt. 穿孔于, 刺穿, 打孔穿透

definitions.en: v pass into or through, often by overcoming resistance
definitions.zh: vi. 穿孔, 穿过

definitions.en: s having a hole cut through
definitions.zh: a. 有孔的, 穿孔的

examples.en: The machine will perforate the paper for you.
examples.zh: 机器会为你打孔纸张。

examples.en: The bullet can perforate the metal sheet easily.
examples.zh: 子弹能轻易穿透金属板。

definitions.en: n a humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter
definitions.zh: n. 戏言, 笑料, 嘲弄
vi. 开玩笑
vt. 嘲弄

examples.en: His jape made everyone laugh at the party.
examples.zh: 他的戏言让派对上所有人都笑了。

examples.en: She told a jape about a talking dog.
examples.zh: 她讲了一个关于会说话的狗的笑料。

definitions.en: n. (astronomy) the disappearance of a celestial body prior to an eclipse
definitions.zh: n. 进入, 入口, 准许进入
[法] 进入, 入境, 入口

examples.en: The ingress to the cave was narrow and dark.
examples.zh: 洞穴的入口又窄又暗。

examples.en: They blocked the ingress to the building.
examples.zh: 他们封锁了建筑物的入口。

definitions.en: v. enclose in a corral
definitions.zh: n. 畜栏

definitions.en: v. arrange wagons so that they form a corral
definitions.zh: vt. 把...关进畜栏

examples.en: The farmer built a corral for the horses.
examples.zh: 农夫为马建了一个畜栏。

examples.en: They corral the cattle before the storm comes.
examples.zh: 他们在暴风雨来临前把牛关进畜栏。

definitions.en: s. excessively fat
definitions.zh: a. 肥大的, 肥胖的
[医] 肥胖的

examples.en: The corpulent man struggled to climb the stairs.
examples.zh: 那个肥胖的男人爬楼梯很吃力。

examples.en: A corpulent cat sat lazily on the sofa.
examples.zh: 一只肥猫懒洋洋地坐在沙发上。

definitions.en: n a crime less serious than a felony
definitions.zh: n. 违反, 侵害
[医] 不全骨折

examples.en: He received a fine for a minor infraction.
examples.zh: 他因一次轻微违规被罚款。

examples.en: Speeding is a common traffic infraction.
examples.zh: 超速是一种常见的交通违规。

definitions.en: n. any distracting or deceptive maneuver (as a mock attack)
definitions.zh: n. 伪装, 假装, 假托, 佯攻

definitions.en: v. deceive by a mock action
definitions.zh: vi. 装作, 假装, 佯攻
a. 假的, 虚饰的

examples.en: The boxer made a feint to the left.
examples.zh: 拳击手向左做了一个假动作。

examples.en: She feinted a pass and then shot the ball.
examples.zh: 她佯装传球，然后射门。

definitions.en: n. goods whose importation or exportation or possession is prohibited by law
definitions.zh: n. 违禁品, 走私
a. 禁运的, 非法买卖的

examples.en: The police found contraband in the car.
examples.zh: 警察在车里发现了违禁品。

examples.en: Smuggling contraband is against the law.
examples.zh: 走私违禁品是违法的。

definitions.en: n. a female actor in a comedy
definitions.zh: n. 喜剧女演员

examples.en: The comedienne told a very funny joke.
examples.zh: 那位女喜剧演员讲了一个非常好笑的笑话。

examples.en: She is a famous comedienne on television.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名的电视女喜剧演员。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to an occasion or expression of farewell
definitions.zh: a. 告别的

definitions.en: s. of a speech expressing leave-taking
definitions.zh: n. 告别辞

examples.en: He gave a valedictory speech at graduation.
examples.zh: 他在毕业典礼上发表了告别演说。

examples.en: Her valedictory words moved everyone to tears.
examples.zh: 她的告别辞让所有人感动落泪。

definitions.en: v. give retouches to (hair)
definitions.zh: v. 润饰, 修整
n. 润饰, 修整, 修整部分

examples.en: The photographer will retouch the portrait.
examples.zh: 摄影师会润饰这张肖像照。

examples.en: She asked the artist to retouch the painting.
examples.zh: 她请艺术家修整这幅画。

definitions.en: s easily irritated or annoyed
definitions.zh: a. 易怒的, 暴躁的, 带怒气的, 撒娇的

examples.en: The peevish child refused to eat dinner.
examples.zh: 那个易怒的孩子拒绝吃晚饭。

examples.en: He became peevish when he was tired.
examples.zh: 他累的时候变得很暴躁。

definitions.en: v interlace by or as if by weaving
definitions.zh: v. (使)交织, 织进, (使)混杂

examples.en: The artist interweaves different colors in the fabric.
examples.zh: 艺术家在布料中交织不同的颜色。

examples.en: Their stories interweave in a beautiful way.
examples.zh: 他们的故事以美妙的方式交织在一起。

definitions.en: n. any of several trees of the genus Populus having leaves on flattened stalks so that they flutter in the lightest wind
definitions.zh: n. 山杨
a. 山杨的, 颤抖的

examples.en: The aspen leaves trembled in the wind.
examples.zh: 山杨的叶子在风中颤抖。

examples.en: We camped under a tall aspen tree.
examples.zh: 我们在一棵高大的山杨树下露营。

definitions.en: v. become liquid
definitions.zh: v. (使)溶解, (使)液化

examples.en: The ice will liquefy in the warm sun.
examples.zh: 冰在温暖的阳光下会液化。

examples.en: Heat can liquefy solid wax into liquid.
examples.zh: 热量可以将固体蜡液化成液体。

definitions.en: n. a scolding (even vicious) old woman
definitions.zh: n. 凶恶的老妇, 丑婆, 鬼婆

examples.en: The old harridan shouted at the children.
examples.zh: 那个凶恶的老妇对着孩子们大喊。

examples.en: Nobody liked the harridan who lived next door.
examples.zh: 没人喜欢住在隔壁的那个丑婆。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or resulting in redemption
definitions.zh: a. 赎回的, 救世的, 赎身的

examples.en: His redemptive act saved the company.
examples.zh: 他的救赎行为挽救了公司。

examples.en: She found redemptive power in forgiveness.
examples.zh: 她在宽恕中找到了救赎的力量。

definitions.en: v. undergo genetic recombination
definitions.zh: vt. 再结合, 重组

examples.en: Scientists recombine genes to create new traits.
