examples.zh: 他们举行会谈以结束冲突。

definitions.en: n. a pampered darling; an effeminate man
definitions.zh: n. 女性化的男人, 娇生惯养的人, 伪善的人
vt. 溺爱, 娇养

examples.en: Don't mollycoddle your child too much.
examples.zh: 不要过分溺爱你的孩子。

examples.en: He is a mollycoddle who never works hard.
examples.zh: 他是个娇生惯养的人，从不努力工作。

definitions.en: n dignified manner or conduct
definitions.zh: n. 风采, 态度, 样子, 外表, 面条

examples.en: Her calm mien impressed everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她平静的风度给会议上的每个人留下了印象。

examples.en: He has a serious mien when working.
examples.zh: 他工作时态度严肃。

definitions.en: a. in a straight unbroken line of descent from parent to child
definitions.zh: a. 直系的, 正统的, 嫡出的

definitions.en: s. arranged in a line
definitions.zh: [法] 直系的, 世袭的, 继承的

examples.en: He is a lineal descendant of the king.
examples.zh: 他是国王的直系后裔。

examples.en: The family follows a lineal inheritance system.
examples.zh: 这个家族遵循直系继承制度。

definitions.en: s marked by blithe unconcern
definitions.zh: a. 漫不经心的, 无忧虑的, 不在意的, 满不在乎的

examples.en: She remained insouciant despite the problems.
examples.zh: 尽管有问题，她仍然漫不经心。

examples.en: His insouciant attitude annoyed his boss.
examples.zh: 他满不在乎的态度惹恼了老板。

definitions.en: v lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
definitions.zh: vt. 监禁, 禁闭

examples.en: The prisoner was immured in a dark cell.
examples.zh: 囚犯被监禁在黑暗的牢房里。

examples.en: They immured themselves in the library to study.
examples.zh: 他们把自己关在图书馆里学习。

definitions.en: n. a formal expression of praise
definitions.zh: n. 赞辞, 称赞, 赞美

examples.en: The teacher gave an encomium to the student.
examples.zh: 老师给了这个学生一番赞美。

examples.en: Her speech was full of encomium for the team.
examples.zh: 她的演讲充满了对团队的赞美。

definitions.en: v. discourage or frighten with threats or a domineering manner; intimidate
definitions.zh: vt. 对...吹胡子瞪眼睛, 吓唬

examples.en: He tried to browbeat his younger brother.
examples.zh: 他试图吓唬他的弟弟。

examples.en: Don't let anyone browbeat you into silence.
examples.zh: 不要让任何人吓唬你保持沉默。

definitions.en: n. something hard to endure
definitions.zh: n. 粗暴, 严酷, 粗糙

examples.en: He spoke with asperity to the rude customer.
examples.zh: 他粗暴地对那个粗鲁的顾客说话。

examples.en: The asperity of winter made travel difficult.
examples.zh: 冬天的严酷使旅行变得困难。

definitions.en: v. break apart or in two, using violence
definitions.zh: v. 切开, 分离

examples.en: The storm sunder the old bridge in two.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把旧桥劈成两半。

examples.en: Nothing can sunder their strong friendship.
examples.zh: 没有什么能分离他们坚固的友谊。

definitions.en: a. of or characteristic of a child
definitions.zh: a. 孩子气的, 天真的, 未成熟的
[医] 儿童的, 幼稚的

examples.en: His puerile jokes annoyed the adults.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的笑话惹恼了成年人。

examples.en: Stop being so puerile and act mature.
examples.zh: 别那么幼稚，表现得成熟点。

definitions.en: s having sections or patches colored differently and usually brightly
definitions.zh: a. 花斑的, 杂色的, 杂种的
n. 花斑马

examples.en: The piebald horse ran across the field.
examples.zh: 那匹花斑马跑过田野。

examples.en: She adopted a piebald cat from the shelter.
examples.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只花斑猫。

definitions.en: s. narrow-minded about cherished opinions
definitions.zh: a. 狭隘的, 无教养的, 吝啬的

examples.en: His illiberal views shocked his friends.
examples.zh: 他狭隘的观点震惊了他的朋友。

examples.en: The policy was criticized as illiberal.
examples.zh: 这项政策被批评为狭隘。

definitions.en: n failure to reach a minimum required performance
definitions.zh: n. 失败, 不及格

definitions.en: v fail to get a passing grade
definitions.zh: vi. 失败, 考试不及格, 放弃
vt. 使不及格

examples.en: He flunked the math exam last semester.
examples.zh: 他上学期数学考试不及格。

examples.en: If you don't study, you will flunk the test.
examples.zh: 如果你不学习，考试就会不及格。

definitions.en: v. remove from active military status or reassign
definitions.zh: vt. 撤消遣散, 复员, 使无效, 使不活动

examples.en: The soldier was deactivated after the war.
examples.zh: 战后这名士兵被撤消了现役。

examples.en: Please deactivate your account before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前请停用你的账户。

definitions.en: s. transformed from a liquid into a soft semisolid or solid mass
definitions.zh: v. (使)凝结
a. 凝结的

examples.en: Blood will coagulate when exposed to air.
examples.zh: 血液暴露在空气中会凝结。

examples.en: The milk began to coagulate in the heat.
examples.zh: 牛奶在高温下开始凝结。

definitions.en: n a heavy rain
definitions.zh: n. 倾盆大雨, 豪雨

examples.en: A sudden cloudburst soaked everyone outside.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨淋湿了外面所有人。

examples.en: The cloudburst caused flooding in the streets.
examples.zh: 这场豪雨导致街道洪水泛滥。

definitions.en: s. humbly entreating
definitions.zh: a. 恳求的, 哀求的
n. 恳求者, 哀求者

examples.en: The suppliant begged for mercy from the king.
examples.zh: 恳求者向国王乞求怜悯。

examples.en: She knelt as a suppliant before the altar.
examples.zh: 她作为恳求者跪在祭坛前。

definitions.en: n the cognitive condition of someone who understands
definitions.zh: v. 理解, 领悟

definitions.en: v get the meaning of something
definitions.zh: n. 理解能力, 机智, 悟性

examples.en: She has a lot of business savvy.
examples.zh: 她很有商业头脑。

examples.en: He is savvy about technology trends.
examples.zh: 他对技术趋势很了解。

definitions.en: v. ridicule with satire
definitions.zh: vt. 讽刺, 挖苦
vi. 写讽刺作品

examples.en: The cartoon satirizes political corruption.
examples.zh: 这幅漫画讽刺政治腐败。

examples.en: Writers often satirize social norms.
examples.zh: 作家经常讽刺社会规范。

definitions.en: a. feeding on both plants and animals
definitions.zh: a. 无所不吃的, 杂食的, 什么都喜欢的

examples.en: Bears are omnivorous animals that eat plants and meat.
examples.zh: 熊是杂食动物，吃植物和肉。

examples.en: She is an omnivorous reader of many genres.
examples.zh: 她是一个什么书都读的读者。

definitions.en: n an appeal intended to arouse patriotic emotions
definitions.zh: n. 侵略主义, 大国沙文主义

examples.en: Jingoism often leads to unnecessary wars.
examples.zh: 沙文主义常常导致不必要的战争。

examples.en: The politician's speech was full of jingoism.
examples.zh: 这位政治家的演讲充满了沙文主义。

definitions.en: n. a writer or artist who sells services to different employers without a long-term contract with any of them
definitions.zh: n. 自由记者；自由作家

examples.en: She works as a freelancer for several magazines.
examples.zh: 她为几家杂志做自由撰稿人。

examples.en: The freelancer enjoys flexible working hours.
examples.zh: 这个自由职业者享受灵活的工作时间。

definitions.en: n. a fee paid for a nominally free service
definitions.zh: n. 酬金, 谢礼
[经] 酬金, 谢礼

examples.en: The speaker received an honorarium for the talk.
examples.zh: 演讲者因演讲获得了一笔酬金。

examples.en: They paid a small honorarium to the guest.
examples.zh: 他们付给客人一小笔谢礼。

definitions.en: s. of places; characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder
definitions.zh: a. 整洁干净的, 整整齐齐的
adv. 整洁地, 整齐地

examples.en: The kitchen is always kept shipshape.
examples.zh: 厨房总是保持整洁干净。

examples.en: He likes everything in his room shipshape.
examples.zh: 他喜欢房间里的一切都整整齐齐。

definitions.en: v. avoid speaking to or dealing with
definitions.zh: vt. 流放, 放逐, 排斥

examples.en: The group decided to ostracize the troublemaker.
examples.zh: 这个团体决定排斥那个惹麻烦的人。

examples.en: She felt ostracized by her former friends.
examples.zh: 她感到被以前的朋友排斥了。

definitions.en: v. make psychologically or physically used (to something)
definitions.zh: vt. 使习惯于, 使熟习于

examples.en: You need to habituate yourself to the cold.
examples.zh: 你需要让自己习惯于寒冷。

examples.en: The animals habituate to the noise quickly.
examples.zh: 动物们很快就习惯了噪音。

definitions.en: v. add oxygen to or combine with oxygen
definitions.zh: vt. 使氧化, 使生锈
vi. 氧化

examples.en: Iron will oxidize when exposed to air.
examples.zh: 铁暴露在空气中会氧化。

examples.en: The chemical reaction will oxidize the metal.
examples.zh: 这个化学反应会使金属氧化。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or obtained from milk (especially sour milk or whey)
definitions.zh: a. 乳的, 乳汁的, 由乳汁取得的
[医] 乳的

examples.en: Lactic acid builds up in muscles after exercise.
examples.zh: 运动后肌肉中会积累乳酸。

examples.en: This yogurt contains lactic acid bacteria.
examples.zh: 这种酸奶含有乳酸菌。

definitions.en: n. a journalist who writes for a gazette
definitions.zh: n. 地名辞典, 公报作者

examples.en: The gazetteer listed all the towns in the region.
examples.zh: 地名辞典列出了该地区所有城镇。

examples.en: He worked as a gazetteer for the local paper.
examples.zh: 他曾为当地报纸担任公报作者。

definitions.en: v express strong disapproval of
definitions.zh: vt. 剥皮, 擦破皮肤, 严厉的责难

examples.en: The critic excoriated the new movie harshly.
examples.zh: 评论家严厉地批评了这部新电影。

examples.en: She excoriated him for his careless mistake.
examples.zh: 她因他粗心的错误而严厉责难他。

definitions.en: a. inhabiting or frequenting trees
definitions.zh: a. 树的, 栖于树木的

definitions.en: s. resembling a tree in form and branching structure
definitions.zh: [医] 树的, 树上生活的

examples.en: Monkeys are arboreal animals living in trees.
examples.zh: 猴子是生活在树上的树栖动物。

examples.en: The arboreal habitat is rich in biodiversity.
examples.zh: 树栖栖息地生物多样性丰富。

definitions.en: n. omission or suppression of parts of words or sentences
definitions.zh: n. 省略, 省略符号
[计] 省略号

examples.en: Use an ellipsis to show omitted words.
examples.zh: 用省略号表示省略的词语。

examples.en: The ellipsis in the text indicates a pause.
examples.zh: 文本中的省略号表示停顿。

definitions.en: n. vehement oratory
definitions.zh: n. 慷慨激昂的演说, 雄辩, 慷慨激昂的演说词

examples.en: His declamation moved the audience deeply.
examples.zh: 他慷慨激昂的演说深深打动了观众。

examples.en: She practiced her declamation for the contest.
examples.zh: 她为比赛练习慷慨激昂的演说。

definitions.en: n. a plant that is found in an area where it had not been recorded previously
definitions.zh: n. 新入教者, 新信徒

examples.en: The neophyte joined the church last year.
examples.zh: 这位新入教者去年加入了教会。

examples.en: She is a neophyte in this field.
examples.zh: 她在这个领域是个新手。

definitions.en: s. offensively self-assertive
definitions.zh: a. 瞎自夸的, 瞎自大的, 傲慢的

examples.en: His bumptious attitude annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他傲慢的态度惹恼了所有人。

examples.en: She is too bumptious for a beginner.
examples.zh: 她作为初学者太自大了。

definitions.en: n extreme excess
definitions.zh: n. 多余, 过剩, 多余物, 过剩品, 奢侈

examples.en: The kitchen has a superfluity of spices.
examples.zh: 厨房里有过多的香料。

examples.en: Superfluity of wealth can cause waste.
examples.zh: 财富过剩会导致浪费。

definitions.en: n. a manner of speaking that is distinctive of a particular group of people
definitions.zh: n. 暗语, 暗号, 口令, 口号, 行话, 术语, 习俗, 习惯, 陈词滥调, 过时的信仰

examples.en: They used a shibboleth to identify members.
examples.zh: 他们用一个暗号来识别成员。

examples.en: That phrase is a shibboleth of the group.
examples.zh: 那个短语是这个群体的行话。

definitions.en: s affecting extreme elegance in dress and manner
definitions.zh: a. 浮华的, 矫饰的, 纨绔的, 傻的

examples.en: His foppish clothes drew many stares.
examples.zh: 他浮华的衣着引来了许多目光。

examples.en: She found his foppish manner ridiculous.
examples.zh: 她觉得他矫饰的举止很可笑。

definitions.en: s wet with light rain
definitions.zh: a. 下毛毛雨的

examples.en: The drizzly morning made me stay inside.
examples.zh: 下毛毛雨的早晨让我待在室内。

examples.en: We walked in the drizzly weather.
examples.zh: 我们在毛毛雨的天气里散步。

definitions.en: n a healthy capacity for vigorous activity
definitions.zh: n. 精力；活力；力量

definitions.en: n an imaginative lively style (especially style of writing)
definitions.zh: [网络] 波形蛋白(vimentin)；文本编辑器；真空感应熔炼(vacuum induction melting)

examples.en: She worked with great vim and vigor.
examples.zh: 她以极大的精力工作。

examples.en: His writing is full of vim and style.
examples.zh: 他的写作充满活力和风格。

definitions.en: n a selfish person who is unwilling to give or spend
definitions.zh: n. 吝啬鬼

examples.en: The skinflint refused to donate any money.
examples.zh: 那个吝啬鬼拒绝捐任何钱。

examples.en: He is such a skinflint he never tips.
examples.zh: 他真是个吝啬鬼，从不给小费。

definitions.en: s according with custom or propriety
definitions.zh: a. 适当的, 恰当的, 合适的, 好看的

examples.en: It is seemly to dress for the occasion.
examples.zh: 根据场合着装是恰当的。

examples.en: Her behavior was always seemly and polite.
examples.zh: 她的行为总是得体和礼貌的。

definitions.en: s. noisily and stubbornly defiant
definitions.zh: a. 吵闹的, 喧嚣的, 骚乱的, 不守秩序的

examples.en: The obstreperous children disrupted the class.
examples.zh: 吵闹的孩子们扰乱了课堂。

examples.en: He became obstreperous after drinking too much.
examples.zh: 他喝太多后变得不守秩序。

definitions.en: n. a simplified cursive form of the ancient hieratic script
definitions.zh: a. 人民的, 民众的, 通俗的

examples.en: The demotic language is used by common people.
examples.zh: 通俗语言被普通人使用。

examples.en: He wrote in a demotic style for everyone.
examples.zh: 他以通俗的风格为所有人写作。

definitions.en: v. cook in nearly boiling water
definitions.zh: vt. 娇养, 溺爱, 用文火煮(蛋)

examples.en: Parents should not coddle their children too much.
examples.zh: 父母不应过分溺爱孩子。

examples.en: She likes to coddle eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她喜欢用文火煮鸡蛋当早餐。

definitions.en: s. experiencing or bestowing celestial joy
definitions.zh: a. 至福的, 赐福的, 极乐的

examples.en: She had a beatific smile on her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上带着至福的微笑。

examples.en: The beatific vision brought him peace.
examples.zh: 这赐福的景象给他带来了平静。

definitions.en: n. a statement asserting the existence or the truth of something
definitions.zh: n. 公开表示, 坦率承认
[法] 声明, 公开宣布, 供认

examples.en: His avowal of love surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他公开表示爱意让所有人惊讶。

examples.en: She made an avowal of her innocence.
examples.zh: 她坦率承认自己的清白。

definitions.en: s. mixed with impurities
definitions.zh: vt. 掺杂
a. 掺假的, 假的, 通奸的

examples.en: They adulterate the milk with water.
examples.zh: 他们在牛奶中掺水。

examples.en: Do not adulterate the wine with cheap alcohol.
examples.zh: 不要用廉价酒精掺杂葡萄酒。

definitions.en: s. abounding in or given to pompous or aphoristic moralizing
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 警句的, 富于格言的

examples.en: His sententious remarks bored the audience.
examples.zh: 他警句式的言论让观众厌烦。

examples.en: She gave a sententious speech full of morals.
examples.zh: 她做了一个充满格言的简洁演讲。

definitions.en: n. someone who commits crimes for profit (especially one who obtains money by fraud or extortion)
definitions.zh: n. 敲诈者, 骗子

definitions.en: v. carry on illegal business activities involving crime
definitions.zh: v. 诈骗钱财

examples.en: The racketeer was arrested for fraud.
examples.zh: 那个敲诈者因诈骗被捕。

examples.en: He operates as a racketeer in the city.
examples.zh: 他在城里以诈骗为生。

definitions.en: r. in a set manner without serious attention
definitions.zh: adv. 敷衍地, 马虎地, 潦草地, 表面地

examples.en: He perfunctorily checked the documents.
examples.zh: 他敷衍地检查了文件。

examples.en: She perfunctorily greeted the guests.
examples.zh: 她马虎地招呼了客人。

definitions.en: s causing or able to cause nausea
definitions.zh: a. 有害的, 恶臭的, 有毒的, 可厌的, 令人不快的

examples.en: The noisome smell came from the garbage.
examples.zh: 恶臭的气味来自垃圾。

examples.en: They avoided the noisome swamp area.
examples.zh: 他们避开了那个有害的沼泽区域。

definitions.en: n. a scarf worn around the neck
definitions.zh: n. 围巾, 头巾, 无指手套, 消声器
[化] 消声器; 消音器

examples.en: She wore a warm muffler around her neck.
examples.zh: 她脖子上围着一条温暖的围巾。

examples.en: The car's muffler needs to be replaced.
examples.zh: 汽车的消声器需要更换。

definitions.en: a. lacking courage or vitality
definitions.zh: a. 无胆量的

examples.en: He is too gutless to speak up.
examples.zh: 他太无胆量，不敢说出来。

examples.en: The gutless decision disappointed the team.
examples.zh: 这个无胆量的决定让团队失望。

definitions.en: n. a state of quiet (but possibly temporary) inaction
definitions.zh: n. 不活动性, 休眠, 蛰伏
[医] 休眠, 不活动, 休止

examples.en: The seeds remain in dormancy during winter.
examples.zh: 种子在冬季保持休眠。

examples.en: The volcano is in a state of dormancy.
examples.zh: 火山处于不活动状态。

definitions.en: n. an elaborate analytical or explanatory essay or discussion
definitions.zh: n. 专题论文, 研究, 探讨

examples.en: He wrote a disquisition on ancient history.
examples.zh: 他写了一篇关于古代史的专题论文。

examples.en: The professor's disquisition was very detailed.
examples.zh: 教授的探讨非常详细。

definitions.en: n. a mass of snow heaped up by the wind
definitions.zh: n. (被风刮在一起的)雪堆, 随风飘飞的雪

examples.en: The car got stuck in a snowdrift.
examples.zh: 汽车陷在雪堆里了。

examples.en: Children played in the large snowdrift.
examples.zh: 孩子们在大雪堆里玩耍。

definitions.en: n. mental infirmity as a consequence of old age; sometimes shown by foolish infatuations
definitions.zh: n. 老耄, 老迷糊, 溺爱
[医] 衰老, 老耄

examples.en: He is in his dotage and needs care.
examples.zh: 他处于老耄状态，需要照顾。

examples.en: Her dotage shows in her forgetfulness.
examples.zh: 她的老迷糊表现在健忘上。

definitions.en: n. the outermost region of the sun's atmosphere; visible as a white halo during a solar eclipse
definitions.zh: n. 光轮, 光环

examples.en: The saint had an aureole around his head.
examples.zh: 圣人头上有光环。

examples.en: We saw the aureole during the eclipse.
examples.zh: 我们在日食期间看到了光晕。

definitions.en: v be earlier in time; go back further
definitions.zh: vt. 先于, 前于

definitions.en: v establish something as being earlier relative to something else
definitions.zh: [经] 提前日期(比实际毋早的日期)

examples.en: This artifact antedates the Roman era.
examples.zh: 这件人工制品先于罗马时代。

examples.en: The document antedates the contract by a week.
examples.zh: 这份文件比合同早一周。

definitions.en: n a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
definitions.zh: n. 谄媚者, 马屁精

definitions.en: v try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
definitions.zh: v. 谄媚, 拍马屁

examples.en: He is a toady who flatters the boss.
examples.zh: 他是个谄媚老板的马屁精。

examples.en: She toadies to the manager for favors.
examples.zh: 她拍经理马屁以求好处。

definitions.en: s (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
definitions.zh: a. 中伤性的, 中伤的, 挖苦人的
[法] 诽谤的, 造谣中伤的, 诋毁的

examples.en: The slanderous rumors hurt her reputation.
examples.zh: 中伤性的谣言损害了她的声誉。

examples.en: He made slanderous statements about his rival.
examples.zh: 他对对手做了诽谤性的陈述。

definitions.en: n the act of expressing earnest opposition or protest
definitions.zh: n. 抗议, 忠告, 规劝
[法] 抗议, 抗辩, 规劝

examples.en: They filed a remonstrance against the policy.
examples.zh: 他们对该政策提出了抗议。

examples.en: His remonstrance was ignored by the council.
examples.zh: 他的规劝被议会忽视了。

definitions.en: n. patent medicine whose efficacy is questionable
definitions.zh: n. 万能药, 成药, 妙方
[医] 秘方

examples.en: He sells a nostrum that claims to cure all.
examples.zh: 他卖一种声称能治百病的万能药。

examples.en: That nostrum is not approved by doctors.
examples.zh: 那种成药未经医生批准。

definitions.en: a. not permanent; not lasting
definitions.zh: a. 暂时的, 非永久的

examples.en: All things in life are impermanent.
examples.zh: 生活中所有事物都是暂时的。

examples.en: The beauty of flowers is impermanent.
examples.zh: 花朵的美是非永久的。

definitions.en: s characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards
definitions.zh: a. 非正统的, 异端的

examples.en: His heterodox views challenged the tradition.
examples.zh: 他非正统的观点挑战了传统。

examples.en: The heterodox theory was rejected by many.
examples.zh: 这个异端理论被许多人拒绝。

definitions.en: n. an erratic deflection from an intended course
definitions.zh: vi. (船)偏荡, 偏航

definitions.en: v. deviate erratically from a set course
definitions.zh: n. 偏航, 偏荡, 摇首

examples.en: The ship began to yaw in the storm.
examples.zh: 船在风暴中开始偏荡。

examples.en: The pilot corrected the yaw of the plane.
examples.zh: 飞行员纠正了飞机的偏航。

definitions.en: n extreme leanness (usually caused by starvation or disease)
definitions.zh: n. 瘦弱, 憔悴, 衰弱
[医] 消瘦

examples.en: The illness caused severe emaciation.
examples.zh: 疾病导致了严重的消瘦。

examples.en: Emaciation is a sign of malnutrition.
examples.zh: 瘦弱是营养不良的迹象。

definitions.en: n. apparent power to perceive things that are not present to the senses
definitions.zh: n. 神视, 超人的视力, 洞察力
[医] 千里眼, 神视

examples.en: She claimed to have clairvoyance powers.
examples.zh: 她声称有神视能力。

examples.en: His clairvoyance helped solve the mystery.
examples.zh: 他的洞察力帮助解开了谜团。

definitions.en: v cause to seem less serious; play down
definitions.zh: v. 贬损, 毁损

examples.en: Do not derogate his achievements unfairly.
examples.zh: 不要不公平地贬损他的成就。

examples.en: Her comments derogate the value of the work.
examples.zh: 她的评论贬损了工作的价值。

definitions.en: n someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field
definitions.zh: n. 学者, 专家

examples.en: The savant is an expert in mathematics.
examples.zh: 这位学者是数学专家。

examples.en: She is a savant in ancient languages.
examples.zh: 她是古代语言的学者。

definitions.en: n (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
definitions.zh: n. 细胞, 血球, 微粒

definitions.en: n either of two types of cells (erythrocytes and leukocytes) and sometimes including platelets
definitions.zh: [计] 微粒, 粒子

examples.en: A red blood corpuscle carries oxygen.
examples.zh: 红血球携带氧气。

examples.en: The microscope showed a tiny corpuscle.
examples.zh: 显微镜显示了一个微小的微粒。

definitions.en: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
definitions.zh: a. 奢侈享乐的, 耽于奢侈逸乐的, 骄奢淫逸的

examples.en: He leads a sybaritic life of luxury.
examples.zh: 他过着奢侈享乐的生活。

examples.en: The sybaritic resort attracted wealthy guests.
examples.zh: 这个骄奢淫逸的度假胜地吸引了富有的客人。

definitions.en: n. someone who dissipates resources self-indulgently
definitions.zh: n. 浪费者, 饭桶, 浪子, 废品, 流浪者

examples.en: The wastrel spent all his money on games.
examples.zh: 这个浪子把所有的钱都花在游戏上。

examples.en: She called him a wastrel for wasting food.
examples.zh: 她叫他饭桶，因为他浪费食物。

definitions.en: v. cut with or as if with scissors
definitions.zh: vt. 剪, 剪取, 删除, 削减
n. 剪刀

examples.en: Please scissor the paper along the line.
examples.zh: 请沿着线剪开纸张。

examples.en: He used a tool to scissor the wire.
examples.zh: 他用工具剪断了电线。

definitions.en: v. convert to another faith or religion
definitions.zh: vt. 使改变宗教信仰
vi. 劝诱改变宗教信仰

examples.en: They tried to proselytize their neighbors.
examples.zh: 他们试图劝诱邻居改变信仰。

examples.en: He does not like to proselytize at work.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢在工作中劝人改变信仰。

definitions.en: n. a fringe region of partial shadow around an umbra
definitions.zh: n. 半影, 明暗交界部分, 边缘部分, 周围的气氛
[化] 半影

examples.en: The penumbra of the eclipse was visible.
examples.zh: 日食的半影是可见的。

examples.en: She stood in the penumbra of the tree.
examples.zh: 她站在树的半影中。

definitions.en: s. presumptuously arrogant
definitions.zh: a. 骄傲的, 自负的, 过于自信的, 过分的

examples.en: His overweening pride made him unpopular.
examples.zh: 他过分的骄傲使他不受欢迎。

examples.en: She had an overweening confidence in her plan.
examples.zh: 她对她的计划过于自信。

definitions.en: v occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion
definitions.zh: v. 玩耍, 娱乐

definitions.en: v play boisterously
definitions.zh: n. 娱乐

examples.en: The children disport themselves in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园里玩耍。

examples.en: They disport on the beach all afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们整个下午在海滩上娱乐。

definitions.en: s showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil
definitions.zh: a. 恶魔的, 恶毒的, 凶暴的, 恶魔似的, (非正式)非常可憎的

examples.en: The villain had a diabolic plan.
examples.zh: 这个恶棍有一个恶毒的计划。

examples.en: His diabolic laugh scared everyone.
examples.zh: 他恶魔般的笑声吓坏了所有人。

definitions.en: s. out of the ordinary
definitions.zh: a. 不习惯的, 不寻常的, 非惯常的

examples.en: She showed unwonted kindness to strangers.
examples.zh: 她对陌生人表现出不寻常的友善。

examples.en: His unwonted silence worried his friends.
examples.zh: 他不寻常的沉默让朋友们担心。

definitions.en: n. someone who steals livestock (especially cattle)
definitions.zh: n. 活跃分子, 偷家畜贼

examples.en: The rustler stole cattle from the farm.
examples.zh: 偷家畜贼从农场偷了牛。

examples.en: Police caught the rustler near the river.
examples.zh: 警察在河边抓住了偷家畜贼。

definitions.en: s. of no real value
definitions.zh: a. 无价值的, 无用的, 无效的, 琐碎的

examples.en: The old contract is now nugatory.
examples.zh: 旧合同现在无效了。

examples.en: His efforts proved nugatory in the end.
examples.zh: 他的努力最终证明是无用的。

definitions.en: s. (chemistry, physics, biology) readily undergoing change or breakdown
definitions.zh: a. 不安定的, 易发生变化的

definitions.en: s. liable to change
definitions.zh: [医] 不稳定的, 易变的

examples.en: Her mood is labile and changes quickly.
examples.zh: 她的情绪不稳定，变化很快。

examples.en: The chemical compound is highly labile.
examples.zh: 这种化合物非常不稳定。

definitions.en: s marked by deliberate deceptiveness especially by pretending one set of feelings and acting under the influence of another
definitions.zh: a. 奸诈的；双重的；搞两面派的

examples.en: He is a duplicitous person you cannot trust.
examples.zh: 他是一个你不能信任的奸诈之人。

examples.en: Her duplicitous behavior surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她搞两面派的行为让所有人惊讶。

definitions.en: s skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
definitions.zh: a. 灵巧的, 惯用右手的

examples.en: The artist is dexterous with her hands.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家双手灵巧。

examples.en: He made a dexterous move to catch the ball.
examples.zh: 他灵巧地移动接住了球。

definitions.en: v cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of
definitions.zh: vt. 降低...的地位, 降低...的品格, 贬抑, 使谦卑

examples.en: Do not abase yourself for anyone.
examples.zh: 不要为任何人贬低自己。

examples.en: He tried to abase his rival publicly.
examples.zh: 他试图公开贬低他的对手。

definitions.en: n. (Greek mythology) the Greek god of the west wind
definitions.zh: n. 西风, 和风, 徐风

examples.en: A gentle zephyr blew through the garden.
examples.zh: 一阵和风吹过花园。

examples.en: The zephyr carried the scent of flowers.
examples.zh: 和风带来了花香。

definitions.en: n a feeling of evil to come
definitions.zh: n. 预感

examples.en: She had a presentiment of danger ahead.
examples.zh: 她对前方的危险有一种预感。

examples.en: His presentiment turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他的预感结果是对的。

definitions.en: n the branch of medical science that deals with diseases and problems specific to old people
definitions.zh: n. 老年医学, 老人学
[医] 老年医学, 老年病学, 老人学

examples.en: She studies gerontology at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习老年医学。

examples.en: Gerontology helps us understand aging better.
examples.zh: 老年医学帮助我们更好地理解衰老。

definitions.en: v. bend the knees and bow in church or before a religious superior or image
definitions.zh: vi. 曲膝, 跪, 屈服

examples.en: They genuflect before the altar in church.
examples.zh: 他们在教堂的祭坛前屈膝跪拜。

examples.en: He refused to genuflect to the king.
examples.zh: 他拒绝向国王屈服。

definitions.en: n. rapid simultaneous discharge of firearms
definitions.zh: n. 枪炮的齐射, 以连续齐发的炮火攻击, 猛射

definitions.en: v. attack with fusillade
definitions.zh: vt. 齐射

examples.en: A fusillade of bullets rang out suddenly.
examples.zh: 一阵齐射的子弹突然响起。

examples.en: The soldiers faced a fusillade from the enemy.
examples.zh: 士兵们面对敌人的齐射。

definitions.en: n a person who is not very bright
definitions.zh: n. 蠢人, 笨蛋

examples.en: He is a dullard who never learns anything.
examples.zh: 他是个从不学任何东西的笨蛋。

examples.en: Don't be a dullard; think before you act.
examples.zh: 别做蠢人，行动前先思考。

definitions.en: a. having an unpleasant sound
definitions.zh: a. 发音不和谐的, 粗腔横调的

examples.en: The cacophonous noise hurt my ears.
examples.zh: 不和谐的声音伤害了我的耳朵。

examples.en: Their singing was cacophonous and unpleasant.
examples.zh: 他们的歌声不和谐且令人不快。

definitions.en: n. a tool for tamping (e.g., for tamping tobacco into a pipe bowl or a charge into a drill hole etc.)
definitions.zh: vt. 用粘土填塞, 捣固, 夯实
n. 捣棒, 夯

examples.en: He used a tool to tamp the soil firmly.
examples.zh: 他用工具把土壤夯实。

examples.en: Please tamp the tobacco into the pipe.
examples.zh: 请把烟草捣进烟斗里。

definitions.en: n. a crystalline substance 500 times sweeter than sugar; used as a calorie-free sweetener
definitions.zh: n. 糖精
[化] 糖精; 邻磺酰苯甲酰亚胺

examples.en: She uses saccharin instead of sugar in tea.
examples.zh: 她在茶里用糖精代替糖。

examples.en: Saccharin is a calorie-free sweetener.
examples.zh: 糖精是一种无热量的甜味剂。

definitions.en: n. a small mallet used by a presiding officer or a judge
definitions.zh: n. 槌
[法] 赋税或租金, 议事槌, 小木槌

examples.en: The judge banged his gavel for silence.
examples.zh: 法官敲击他的小木槌要求安静。

examples.en: The auctioneer used a gavel to close the sale.
examples.zh: 拍卖商用木槌结束了拍卖。

definitions.en: s. imposingly fashionable and elegant
definitions.zh: vi. 出风头, 炫耀
n. 出风头, 炫耀, 虚张声势, 优雅

examples.en: He likes to swank about his new car.
examples.zh: 他喜欢炫耀他的新车。

examples.en: Her swank dress impressed everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 她优雅的裙子给派对上的每个人留下了印象。

definitions.en: s having superior power and influence
definitions.zh: a. 占优势的, 多数的, 主要的, 突出的

examples.en: The preponderant opinion favored the new law.
examples.zh: 占优势的意见支持新法律。

examples.en: Her influence was preponderant in the group.
examples.zh: 她的影响在团体中是主要的。

definitions.en: n. young bird not yet fledged
definitions.zh: n. 刚孵出的雏, 未离巢的雏, 幼儿

examples.en: The nestling waited for its mother to return.
examples.zh: 雏鸟等待它的母亲回来。

examples.en: A nestling fell from the tree yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天一只雏鸟从树上掉了下来。

definitions.en: s indistinct or hazy in outline
definitions.zh: a. 发呆的, 无精神的, 含糊的

examples.en: I feel muzzy after taking the medicine.
examples.zh: 服药后我感到昏昏沉沉。

examples.en: His memory of the event is muzzy.
examples.zh: 他对那件事的记忆是模糊的。

definitions.en: v bite or chew on with the teeth
definitions.zh: n. 咬, 不断的苦痛

definitions.en: v become ground down or deteriorate
definitions.zh: a. 咬的, 令人苦恼的

examples.en: The dog is gnawing on a bone in the yard.
examples.zh: 狗在院子里啃骨头。

examples.en: She felt a gnawing pain in her stomach.
examples.zh: 她感到胃里一阵咬痛。

definitions.en: v. become taut or tauter
definitions.zh: v. 使绷紧, 拉紧

examples.en: The rope will tauten when you pull it hard.
examples.zh: 当你用力拉时，绳子会绷紧。

examples.en: Her muscles tauten as she lifts the weight.
examples.zh: 她举重时肌肉绷紧了。

definitions.en: s. associated by chance and not an integral part
definitions.zh: a. 偶然的, 外来的
[医] 偶生的, 偶发的; 异位的

examples.en: The discovery was adventitious, not planned.
examples.zh: 这个发现是偶然的，不是计划好的。

examples.en: Adventitious roots grow from the stem.
examples.zh: 不定根从茎上生长出来。

definitions.en: n. range of what one can know or understand
definitions.zh: n. 认识, 察知, 审理

examples.en: He took cognizance of the new rules.
examples.zh: 他注意到了新规则。

examples.en: The court has cognizance of this case.
examples.zh: 法院对此案有审理权。

definitions.en: n. young hen usually less than a year old
definitions.zh: n. 小母鸡

examples.en: The pullet laid its first egg today.
examples.zh: 小母鸡今天下了第一个蛋。

examples.en: She bought a pullet from the farmer.
examples.zh: 她从农民那里买了一只小母鸡。

definitions.en: n. a medicine used to treat allergies and hypersensitive reactions and colds; works by counteracting the effects of histamine on a receptor site
definitions.zh: n. 抗组胺药

examples.en: She took an antihistamine for her allergies.
examples.zh: 她服用了抗组胺药来治疗过敏。

examples.en: Antihistamine can help reduce sneezing.
examples.zh: 抗组胺药有助于减少打喷嚏。

definitions.en: n. a person without moral scruples
definitions.zh: n. 堕落的人, 恶棍, 被神遗弃的人

definitions.en: v. reject (documents) as invalid
definitions.zh: a. 堕落的, 邪恶的

definitions.en: v. abandon to eternal damnation
definitions.zh: vt. 斥责, 非难, 拒绝

examples.en: The reprobate was known for his bad deeds.
examples.zh: 这个恶棍以其恶行而闻名。

examples.en: He is a reprobate who lies all the time.
examples.zh: 他是一个总是说谎的堕落之人。

definitions.en: n. a strong north wind that blows in France during the winter
definitions.zh: n. 密史脱拉风

examples.en: The mistral blows strongly in winter here.
examples.zh: 这里的密史脱拉风在冬天吹得很猛。

examples.en: Farmers fear the mistral during harvest time.
examples.zh: 农民在收获季节害怕密史脱拉风。

definitions.en: n. an academic meeting or seminar usually led by a different lecturer and on a different topic at each meeting
definitions.zh: n. 讨论会

examples.en: The colloquium on science was very interesting.
examples.zh: 关于科学的讨论会非常有趣。

examples.en: She presented her research at the colloquium.
examples.zh: 她在讨论会上展示了她的研究。

definitions.en: v. convert to a fossil
definitions.zh: vt. 使成化石, 使陈腐

definitions.en: v. become mentally inflexible
definitions.zh: vi. 变成化石, 变陈腐

examples.en: The bones began to fossilize over time.
examples.zh: 骨头随着时间的推移开始变成化石。

examples.en: His ideas fossilize and never change.
examples.zh: 他的想法变得陈腐，从不改变。

definitions.en: n. a student of musicology
definitions.zh: n. 音乐学者

examples.en: The musicologist studied ancient songs.
examples.zh: 这位音乐学者研究了古代歌曲。

examples.en: A musicologist gave a lecture on jazz.
examples.zh: 一位音乐学者就爵士乐做了讲座。

definitions.en: n. the branch of anthropology that deals with the division of humankind into races and with their origins and distribution and distinctive characteristics
definitions.zh: n. 人种学
[医] 人种学

examples.en: Ethnology studies different human cultures.
examples.zh: 人种学研究不同的人类文化。

examples.en: She is a professor of ethnology at college.
examples.zh: 她是大学的人种学教授。

definitions.en: n any liquid suitable for drinking
definitions.zh: a. 适于饮用的

definitions.en: a suitable for drinking
definitions.zh: n. 饮料

examples.en: Is this water potable?
examples.zh: 这水能喝吗？

examples.en: We need potable water for camping.
examples.zh: 露营需要可饮用的水。

definitions.en: s. not faithful to religion or party or cause
definitions.zh: n. 叛教者, 变节者, 脱党者
a. 叛教的, 变节的, 脱党的

examples.en: He was called an apostate for leaving.
examples.zh: 他因离开而被称作叛教者。

examples.en: The apostate leader lost all support.
examples.zh: 那位变节领袖失去了所有支持。

definitions.en: v. grow together (of plants and organs)
definitions.zh: vi. 连生, 合生, 附依

definitions.en: v. grow or become attached by accretion
definitions.zh: vt. 使依附, 使连接
a. 合生的

examples.en: Minerals accrete around the rock.
examples.zh: 矿物在岩石周围附着生长。

examples.en: The crystals accrete over time.
examples.zh: 晶体随时间逐渐合生。

definitions.en: n. any of various cud-chewing hoofed mammals having a stomach divided into four (occasionally three) compartments
definitions.zh: a. 反刍类的, 沉思的, 默想的

definitions.en: a. related to or characteristic of animals of the suborder Ruminantia or any other animal that chews a cud
definitions.zh: n. 反刍动物

examples.en: Cows are ruminant animals.
examples.zh: 牛是反刍动物。

examples.en: Sheep are common ruminant mammals.
examples.zh: 羊是常见的反刍哺乳动物。

definitions.en: a. relating to or consisting of runes
definitions.zh: a. 如尼文字的

examples.en: The stone had runic carvings.
examples.zh: 石头上刻有如尼文字。

examples.en: He studied ancient runic symbols.
examples.zh: 他研究了古代如尼符号。

definitions.en: n. a large moving van (especially one used for moving furniture)

examples.zh: 家具搬运车搬走了我们的家具。

definitions.en: n. state of disgrace resulting from public abuse

examples.zh: 他的行为招致了公众辱骂。

examples.zh: 那位政客忍受了许多毁谤。

definitions.en: s. extremely scanty
definitions.zh: a. 稀少的, 细微的, 细小的

examples.zh: 那顿稀少的饭让他饿着。

examples.zh: 他努力不在学习上退步。

examples.zh: 好的开始后，她开始堕落。

definitions.en: s so thin as to transmit light

examples.zh: 雾状的薄雾笼罩了山谷。

examples.en: Her ideas were vaporous and unclear.
examples.zh: 她的想法空想而不清晰。

definitions.en: s. skillful in statecraft or management
definitions.zh: a. 睿智的, 聪明的, 贤明的, 伶俐的

examples.en: The sagacious leader made wise decisions.
examples.zh: 睿智的领导者做出了明智的决定。

examples.en: She is a sagacious businesswoman.
examples.zh: 她是一位聪明的女商人。

definitions.en: v. make an official inspection on foot of (the bounds of a property)

definitions.en: v. walk with no particular goal
definitions.zh: vi. 漫步, 闲荡, 迂回

examples.zh: 他们每天早晨在公园漫步。

examples.en: He likes to perambulate around the city.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在城市里闲逛。

definitions.en: s. given to lying
definitions.zh: a. 虚假的, 说谎的

definitions.en: s. intentionally untrue
definitions.zh: [法] 不诚实的, 好说谎的, 虚假的

examples.zh: 他虚假的故事骗不了任何人。

examples.en: She is a mendacious person.
examples.zh: 她是一个说谎的人。

definitions.en: v. lessen or to try to lessen the seriousness or extent of

examples.en: Nothing can extenuate his crime.
examples.zh: 没有什么能减轻他的罪行。

examples.en: She tried to extenuate her mistake.
examples.zh: 她试图为自己的错误找借口。

definitions.en: s showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience

examples.zh: 她穿着新裙子显得苗条。

examples.en: The svelte model walked gracefully.
examples.zh: 苗条的模特优雅地走着。

definitions.en: v waste time; spend one's time idly or inefficiently
definitions.zh: a. 不重要的, 琐屑的

examples.zh: 他把时间浪费在琐屑的任务上。

examples.en: The amount was piddling and insignificant.
examples.zh: 那数量微不足道且不重要。

definitions.en: v. cause to become stonelike or stiff or dazed and stunned
definitions.zh: vt. (非正式)使惊呆, 使吓得要死, 使发呆

examples.zh: 巨大的声响把孩子吓呆了。

definitions.en: s. acutely insightful and wise

examples.zh: 她是一位敏锐的性格判断者。

examples.en: His perspicacious remarks impressed everyone.
examples.zh: 他聪颖的评论给所有人留下了印象。

definitions.en: n. an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge

examples.en: She is just a dabbler in painting.
examples.zh: 她在绘画上只是个戏水者。

definitions.en: v. raise trivial objections

examples.zh: 他倾向于挑剔小细节。

definitions.en: n. frivolous banter

examples.zh: 他的评论对讨论很恰当。

examples.en: She spoke apropos of the current situation.
examples.zh: 她恰当地谈论了当前局势。

definitions.en: n. an optical instrument that provides a view of an otherwise obstructed field

examples.zh: 潜艇用潜望镜观察上方。

examples.zh: 他透过潜望镜看风景。

definitions.en: s. stale and unclean smelling
definitions.zh: a. 发霉的, 守旧的, 陈腐的

examples.zh: 旧房间闻起来发霉而潮湿。

examples.en: His fusty ideas are outdated.
examples.zh: 他守旧的想法已经过时了。

examples.en: Her frigidity made conversation difficult.

definitions.en: v. cause to become an emulsion; make into an emulsion

examples.zh: 搅拌机帮助乳化油和水。

examples.zh: 你需要慢慢乳化这些成分。

definitions.en: v. be a signal for or a symptom of

examples.zh: 这辆豪车表示财富。

examples.zh: 他因改变立场而被称作背叛者。

examples.en: The turncoat betrayed his former allies.
examples.zh: 那位变节者背叛了从前的盟友。

definitions.en: v refrain from harming
definitions.zh: a. 节约的, 节制的, 吝啬的, 爱惜的, 吝惜的, 节省的, 贫乏的, 少量的

examples.en: She was sparing in her use of salt.
examples.zh: 她使用盐很节省。

examples.zh: 她用长柄浅锅煎鸡蛋。

examples.en: The skillet was hot on the stove.
examples.zh: 煮锅在炉子上很烫。

definitions.en: n. the branch of geology that studies rocks: their origin and formation and mineral composition and classification

examples.zh: 他在大学学习岩石学。

examples.zh: 他的徒步旅行带他穿越了欧洲。

examples.zh: 她写了关于亚洲旅程的文章。

examples.zh: 一只金花鼠跑过花园小径。

examples.zh: 她百科全书式的记忆力让所有人惊讶。

examples.zh: 拳击手为冠军赛刻苦训练。

examples.zh: 他在自己的国家成了著名的拳击手。

examples.zh: 我用耳塞来隔绝噪音。

examples.en: She put an earplug in before swimming.
examples.zh: 她游泳前戴上了耳塞。

definitions.en: a. Alt. of Numismatical
definitions.zh: a. 货币的, 奖章的, 古币学的

examples.en: He has a numismatic collection of old coins.
examples.zh: 他有一个古币收藏。

examples.en: Numismatic societies study ancient currency.
examples.zh: 古币学会研究古代货币。

definitions.en: n. the trait of appreciating (and being able to express) the humorous
definitions.zh: n. 幽默, 诙谐, 心情

definitions.en: n. the quality of being funny
definitions.zh: vt. 迎合, 牵就, 顺应

examples.en: His humor makes everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 他的幽默让每个人笑。

examples.en: She has a great sense of humor.
examples.zh: 她很有幽默感。

definitions.en: n. a strong cotton and linen fabric with a slight nap
definitions.zh: n. 棉麻粗布, 浮夸的话
a. 棉麻粗布的, 浮夸的

examples.en: His speech was full of fustian and nonsense.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了浮夸的话和废话。

examples.en: The coat was made of heavy fustian.
examples.zh: 这件外套是用厚棉麻粗布做的。

definitions.en: s. annoyed and irritable
definitions.zh: a. 潦草的, 难懂的, 易怒的, 倔强的

examples.en: The old man had a crabbed temper.
examples.zh: 那个老人脾气易怒。

examples.en: Her crabbed handwriting was hard to read.
examples.zh: 她潦草的笔迹很难辨认。

definitions.en: n. a disrespectful laugh
definitions.zh: n. 窃笑

definitions.en: v. laugh quietly
definitions.zh: vi. 窃笑
vt. 窃笑着说

examples.en: He tried to hide a snicker during class.
examples.zh: 他试图在课堂上隐藏窃笑。

examples.en: The children snicker at the funny joke.
examples.zh: 孩子们听到有趣的笑话窃笑。

definitions.en: s of very poor quality or condition
definitions.zh: a. 该咒的, 可憎恨的, 讨厌的

examples.en: The food at that restaurant was execrable.
examples.zh: 那家餐厅的食物质量极差。

examples.en: His execrable taste in music annoyed us.
examples.zh: 他糟糕的音乐品味让我们恼火。

definitions.en: n. (physiology) metabolic equilibrium actively maintained by several complex biological mechanisms that operate via the autonomic nervous system to offset disrupting changes
definitions.zh: n. 体内平衡, 内环境稳定
[计] 动态静止; 动态平衡

examples.en: The body maintains homeostasis through sweating.
examples.zh: 身体通过出汗维持体内平衡。

examples.en: Homeostasis is crucial for good health.
examples.zh: 体内平衡对健康至关重要。

definitions.en: n. a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things
definitions.zh: n. 目录, 大学概况手册

definitions.en: n. a complete list of things; usually arranged systematically
definitions.zh: vt. 编目录
[计] 目录; 编目

examples.en: I ordered from the online catalog.
examples.zh: 我从在线目录订购了。

examples.en: The catalog lists all the products.
examples.zh: 目录列出了所有产品。

definitions.en: v. pour out of one vessel into another
definitions.zh: vt. 输血, 充满

definitions.en: v. give a transfusion (e.g., of blood) to
definitions.zh: [医] 输血, 输液

examples.en: Doctors transfuse blood to save lives.
examples.zh: 医生输血来挽救生命。

examples.en: They will transfuse plasma into the patient.
examples.zh: 他们将给病人输血浆。

definitions.en: s. having a grey or brown streak or a pattern or a patchy coloring; used especially of the patterned fur of cats
definitions.zh: a. 有斑的, 有斑纹的

examples.en: The cat had a brindled coat of gray and black.
examples.zh: 那只猫有灰色和黑色的斑纹毛皮。

examples.en: A brindled dog ran across the field.
examples.zh: 一只带斑纹的狗跑过田野。

definitions.en: n. person who resembles a nonhuman primate
definitions.zh: n. 类人猿

definitions.en: n. any member of the suborder Anthropoidea including monkeys and apes and hominids
definitions.zh: a. 似人的

examples.en: Anthropoid apes include gorillas and chimpanzees.
examples.zh: 类人猿包括大猩猩和黑猩猩。

examples.en: The robot had an anthropoid appearance.
examples.zh: 那个机器人有类似人的外观。

definitions.en: n. the property of something that cannot be pervaded by a liquid
definitions.zh: n. 不渗透性, 不透过性
[医] 不[渗]透性

examples.en: The impermeability of the coat keeps you dry.
examples.zh: 外套的不渗透性让你保持干燥。

examples.en: Clay has high impermeability to water.
examples.zh: 黏土对水有很高的不渗透性。

definitions.en: v fill to satisfaction
definitions.zh: a. [对...厌倦的；充分满足的；生腻的[with]

examples.en: After the meal, I felt completely satiated.
examples.zh: 饭后，我感到完全满足了。

examples.en: He was satiated with too much dessert.
examples.zh: 他因为甜点太多而生腻了。

definitions.en: n. a protozoan with a microscopic appendage extending from the surface of the cell
definitions.zh: a. 有睫的, 有纤毛的

definitions.en: s. having a margin or fringe of hairlike projections
definitions.zh: n. 纤毛纲的动物, 纤毛虫

examples.en: A ciliate is a tiny organism with hair-like structures.
examples.zh: 纤毛虫是一种有毛发状结构的微小生物。

examples.en: The ciliate moved quickly under the microscope.
examples.zh: 纤毛虫在显微镜下快速移动。

definitions.en: n. having more than one husband at a time
definitions.zh: n. 一妻多夫, 多雄蕊式
[医] [一雌]多雄配合, [一妻]多夫配合

examples.en: Polyandry is rare in most societies.
examples.zh: 一妻多夫在大多数社会中很罕见。

examples.en: Some cultures practice polyandry for economic reasons.
examples.zh: 一些文化因经济原因实行一妻多夫。

definitions.en: v. t. To set, place, or establish, as in a rank, office, or
definitions.zh: vt. 任命

definitions.en: condition; to install; to invest; as, to instate a person in greatness
definitions.zh: [法] 授予人职位, 任命, 安置

examples.en: The board will instate a new president.
examples.zh: 董事会将任命一位新校长。

examples.en: They instated him as the team captain.
examples.zh: 他们任命他为队长。

definitions.zh: n. 电影爱好者, 电影制作人员

examples.en: She is a passionate cineaste who loves old films.
examples.zh: 她是个热爱老电影的电影爱好者。

examples.en: The cineaste discussed the director's style.
examples.zh: 电影制作人员讨论了导演的风格。

definitions.en: n. a collector and student of money (and coins in particular)
definitions.zh: n. 钱币(或奖章)收藏家

examples.en: The numismatist showed us his rare coin collection.
examples.zh: 钱币收藏家向我们展示了他稀有的硬币收藏。

examples.en: My uncle is an avid numismatist.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是个狂热的钱币收藏家。

definitions.en: a. resembling or characteristic of a fox
definitions.zh: a. 狐狸的, 狐狸似的, 诡计多端的

examples.en: The vulpine creature crept through the forest.
examples.zh: 那只狐狸似的生物悄悄穿过森林。

examples.en: His vulpine grin made me suspicious.
examples.zh: 他诡计多端的笑容让我怀疑。

definitions.en: n a person of nearly the same age as another
definitions.zh: a. 同时代的

definitions.en: s of the same period
definitions.zh: n. 同时代的人

examples.en: The two artists were coeval in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 这两位艺术家在19世纪是同时代的。

examples.en: She is my coeval; we were born the same year.
examples.zh: 她是我的同龄人；我们同年出生。

definitions.en: s. capable of being inferred on slight grounds
definitions.zh: a. 可推测的, 可能有的, 似真的
[法] 可假定的:可推测的, 可推定的:可能的

examples.en: It is presumable that he will arrive late.
examples.zh: 可以推测他会迟到。

examples.en: The presumable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 火灾可能的原因是线路故障。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being gregarious--having a dislike of being alone
definitions.zh: 集群性; 簇聚性

examples.en: Her gregariousness makes her popular at parties.
examples.zh: 她的合群使她在聚会上受欢迎。

examples.en: Gregariousness is common in social animals.
examples.zh: 集群性在群居动物中很常见。

definitions.en: v. make improvements or corrections to
definitions.zh: vt. 修订, 校勘

examples.en: The editor will emend the manuscript for errors.
examples.zh: 编辑将修订手稿中的错误。

examples.en: Scholars emend ancient texts to restore meaning.
examples.zh: 学者们修订古代文本以恢复原意。

definitions.en: s. powerful
definitions.zh: a. 强有力的, 强盛的, 有权力的

examples.en: The puissant king ruled with an iron fist.
examples.zh: 强有力的国王以铁腕统治。

examples.en: A puissant army defended the nation.
examples.zh: 一支强大的军队保卫了国家。

definitions.en: a. harmful or evil in intent or effect
definitions.zh: a. 有害的, 做坏事的, 犯罪的

examples.en: The maleficent witch cast a dark spell.
examples.zh: 那个有害的女巫施了一个黑暗的咒语。

examples.en: His maleficent actions hurt many people.
examples.zh: 他有害的行为伤害了很多人。

definitions.en: v make a prediction about; tell in advance
definitions.zh: vt. 预兆, 预言, 预测

definitions.en: v indicate by signs
definitions.zh: [医] 预测(疾病的结局)

examples.en: The clouds prognosticate a coming storm.
examples.zh: 这些云预兆着一场即将到来的风暴。

examples.en: Experts prognosticate a rise in prices.
examples.zh: 专家预测价格会上涨。

definitions.en: s. witty or joking
definitions.zh: a. 爱开玩笑的, 诙谐的

examples.en: He gave a waggish smile to his friend.
examples.zh: 他对朋友露出了一个诙谐的微笑。

examples.en: Her waggish comment made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 她诙谐的评论让所有人都笑了。

definitions.en: n. the branch of theology that deals with sermons and homilies
definitions.zh: n. 说教术

examples.en: He studied homiletics to become a preacher.
examples.zh: 他学习说教术以成为一名传教士。

examples.en: Homiletics helps pastors write better sermons.
examples.zh: 说教术帮助牧师写出更好的布道词。

definitions.en: n. a usually nonphotosynthetic free-living protozoan with whiplike appendages; some are pathogens of humans and other animals
definitions.zh: vt. 鞭打, 鞭挞

definitions.en: v. whip
definitions.zh: a. 鞭状的, 鞭索形的, 有鞭毛的

definitions.en: a. having or resembling a lash or whip (as does a flagellum)
definitions.zh: n. 鞭毛虫

examples.en: The monk would flagellate himself as penance.
examples.zh: 那个僧人会鞭打自己作为忏悔。

examples.en: Do not flagellate the horse so harshly.
examples.zh: 不要如此严厉地鞭打那匹马。

definitions.en: v. march out (as from a defile) into open ground
definitions.zh: vi. 走出, 流出

definitions.en: v. pass out or emerge; especially of rivers
definitions.zh: vt. 使流出

examples.en: The river debouches into the wide ocean.
examples.zh: 这条河流入广阔的海洋。

examples.en: Soldiers debouch from the narrow valley.
examples.zh: 士兵们从狭窄的山谷中走出。

definitions.en: v. give life to
definitions.zh: vt. 赋予生命, 给予活力, 使有生气

definitions.en: v. make more lively or vigorous
definitions.zh: [医] 使有生机, 活力化

examples.en: Exercise can vitalize your body and mind.
examples.zh: 锻炼能赋予你的身体和心灵活力。

examples.en: Music tends to vitalize the tired spirit.
examples.zh: 音乐往往能赋予疲惫的精神活力。

definitions.en: n. something that provides guidance (as Polaris guides mariners)
definitions.zh: n. 小熊座, 北极星, 众目之的

examples.en: She was the cynosure of all eyes.
examples.zh: 她是众人瞩目的焦点。

examples.en: The star is a cynosure for sailors.
examples.zh: 那颗星是水手们的指引。

definitions.en: a. corresponding in character or kind
definitions.zh: a. 一致的, 适合的, 符合的

examples.en: His actions are congruous with his words.
examples.zh: 他的行为与他的言语一致。

examples.en: The colors are congruous in the painting.
examples.zh: 这幅画中的颜色是协调一致的。

definitions.en: n. a comic incident or series of incidents
definitions.zh: n. 玩笑

examples.en: His drollery lightened the serious meeting.
examples.zh: 他的玩笑使严肃的会议轻松起来。

examples.en: The comedian's drollery amused the audience.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员的玩笑逗乐了观众。

definitions.en: n. a decrease in the density of something
definitions.zh: n. 稀薄化, 稀薄
[医] 稀疏[状态], 疏松[状态]

examples.en: Rarefaction of air occurs at high altitudes.
examples.zh: 空气稀薄化发生在高海拔地区。

examples.en: The rarefaction of gas reduces its pressure.
examples.zh: 气体的稀薄化降低了它的压力。

definitions.en: n the time and process of budding and unfolding of blossoms
definitions.zh: n. 开花, 花期, 全盛期
[医] 开花期, 花候

examples.en: Spring is the florescence of many flowers.
examples.zh: 春天是许多花的开花期。

examples.en: The garden reached its florescence in June.
examples.zh: 花园在六月达到了全盛期。

definitions.en: n. logical and methodical reasoning
definitions.zh: n. 推理, 推论

examples.en: His ratiocination led to a clear conclusion.
examples.zh: 他的推理得出了一个清晰的结论。

examples.en: Ratiocination is important in solving puzzles.
examples.zh: 推理在解谜中很重要。

definitions.en: n food for domestic livestock
definitions.zh: n. 粮草, 秣, 食物

examples.en: The farmer stored provender for the winter.
examples.zh: 农民为冬天储存了粮草。

examples.en: Horses need fresh provender every day.
examples.zh: 马每天需要新鲜的粮草。

definitions.en: n. a deliberately invalid argument displaying ingenuity in reasoning in the hope of deceiving someone
definitions.zh: n. 诡辩

examples.en: His argument was a clever sophism.
examples.zh: 他的论点是一个巧妙的诡辩。

examples.en: Don't be fooled by that sophism.
examples.zh: 不要被那个诡辩所迷惑。

definitions.en: n. feeling easily irritated
definitions.zh: n. 易怒, 暴躁

examples.en: His testiness made the team uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他的暴躁让团队感到不舒服。

examples.en: Testiness often comes from lack of sleep.
examples.zh: 暴躁常常源于睡眠不足。

definitions.en: s very generous
definitions.zh: a. 无限制的, 慷慨的

examples.en: She gave unstinting support to the project.
examples.zh: 她对这个项目给予了慷慨的支持。

examples.en: His unstinting generosity amazed everyone.
examples.zh: 他慷慨的慷慨让每个人惊讶。

definitions.en: s. extremely pleasing to the taste; sweet and fragrant
definitions.zh: a. 特别美味的

examples.en: The cake had an ambrosial flavor.
examples.zh: 这块蛋糕有一种特别美味的味道。

examples.en: The ambrosial scent filled the room.
examples.zh: 特别美味的香味充满了房间。

definitions.en: a. having a pleasant sound
definitions.zh: a. 音响好的, 悦耳的, 声音和谐的

examples.en: The music was soft and euphonious.
examples.zh: 音乐柔和而悦耳。

examples.en: Her voice is clear and euphonious.
examples.zh: 她的声音清晰而悦耳。

definitions.en: s. showing a cheerful willingness to do favors for others
definitions.zh: a. 谦恭的, 殷勤的, 顺从的

examples.en: He is a complaisant and helpful neighbor.
examples.zh: 他是一个谦恭且乐于助人的邻居。

examples.en: The complaisant waiter fulfilled our requests.
examples.zh: 殷勤的服务员满足了我们的要求。

definitions.en: s unreasonably rigid in the face of argument or entreaty or attack
definitions.zh: a. 似骡的, 执拗的, 顽固的

examples.en: He is too mulish to change his mind.
examples.zh: 他太顽固了，不肯改变主意。

examples.en: Her mulish attitude frustrated the teacher.
examples.zh: 她顽固的态度让老师感到沮丧。

definitions.en: s given to merry frolicking
definitions.zh: a. 嬉戏的, 爱闹着玩的

examples.en: The frolicsome puppy ran around the yard.
examples.zh: 嬉戏的小狗在院子里跑来跑去。

examples.en: Children are frolicsome on the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子们在操场上嬉戏。

definitions.en: n the act of calling down a curse that invokes evil (and usually serves as an insult)
definitions.zh: n. 咒, 坏话

examples.en: The witch uttered a terrible malediction.
examples.zh: 女巫念了一个可怕的咒语。

examples.en: His malediction was heard by everyone.
examples.zh: 他的咒骂被每个人听到了。

definitions.en: n. something desired as a necessity
definitions.zh: n. 所愿望之物, 迫切需要之物

examples.en: Peace is a desideratum for all nations.
examples.zh: 和平是所有国家所愿望之物。

examples.en: Clean water is a basic desideratum.
examples.zh: 清洁的水是基本迫切需要之物。

definitions.en: v fill to satisfaction
definitions.zh: a. <正>厌腻的

examples.en: After the feast, he felt completely sated.
examples.zh: 盛宴之后，他感到完全厌腻了。

examples.en: The sated cat slept on the sofa.
examples.zh: 厌腻的猫在沙发上睡着了。

definitions.en: a. composed of or containing bone
definitions.zh: a. 骨的, 骨质的, 多骨的
[医] 骨的, 骨性的

examples.en: The skeleton is made of osseous tissue.
examples.zh: 骨骼由骨组织构成。

examples.en: Osseous fish have bony skeletons.
examples.zh: 硬骨鱼有骨质的骨架。

definitions.en: n. an idle slothful person
definitions.zh: n. 偷懒者, 游手好闲的人, 懒鬼

examples.en: The sluggard never finishes his work on time.
examples.zh: 那个懒鬼从不按时完成工作。

examples.en: Don't be a sluggard; get up and work.
examples.zh: 别做个懒鬼；起来工作。

definitions.en: n. a person devoted to refined sensuous enjoyment (especially good food and drink)
definitions.zh: n. 美食家, 讲究饮食的人

examples.en: The epicure enjoyed the fine French cuisine.
examples.zh: 美食家享用了精美的法国菜。

examples.en: As an epicure, he knows the best restaurants.
examples.zh: 作为美食家，他知道最好的餐馆。

definitions.en: v attract; cause to be enamored
definitions.zh: a. 使人神魂颠倒的, 使人入神的, 令人欣喜的

examples.en: The dancer gave an entrancing performance.
examples.zh: 舞者进行了一场使人神魂颠倒的表演。

examples.en: Her voice is truly entrancing to listen to.
examples.zh: 她的声音听起来确实使人入神。

definitions.en: v. t. Literally, those who are enlightened
definitions.zh: n. 先觉者

examples.en: The illuminati were believed to be enlightened.
examples.zh: 先觉者被认为是有觉悟的。

examples.en: Some think the illuminati control the world.
examples.zh: 有些人认为先觉者控制着世界。

definitions.en: n. a shed containing a number of beehives
definitions.zh: n. 养蜂场

examples.en: The beekeeper has an apiary in his garden.
examples.zh: 养蜂人在他的花园里有一个养蜂场。

examples.en: Bees produce honey in the apiary.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在养蜂场里产蜜。

definitions.en: a. not provident; not providing for the future
definitions.zh: a. 无远见的, 浪费的

examples.en: His improvident spending left him broke.
examples.zh: 他浪费的开销让他破产了。

examples.en: An improvident person does not save money.
examples.zh: 一个无远见的人不存钱。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to the mythical giant Procrustes or the mode of torture practiced by him
definitions.zh: a. 普罗克汝斯忒斯的, 强求一致的

examples.en: The rules were Procrustean and unfair.
examples.zh: 这些规则是强求一致且不公平的。

examples.en: Avoid a Procrustean approach to education.
examples.zh: 避免在教育中采取强求一致的方法。

definitions.en: v. formulate in regular order; to reduce to a scheme or formula
definitions.zh: vt. 把...图式化, 将...列入计划

examples.en: We need to schematize the project plan.
examples.zh: 我们需要将项目计划图式化。

examples.en: The teacher helped schematize the lesson.
examples.zh: 老师帮助将课程图式化。

definitions.en: s very lively and profitable
definitions.zh: a. 棕榈的, 多棕榈的, 繁荣的, 从棕榈中提取的

examples.en: Those were the palmy days of the empire.
examples.zh: 那些是帝国的繁荣时期。

examples.en: The company is in a palmy state now.
examples.zh: 公司现在处于繁荣的状态。

definitions.en: n. a puzzle where you decode a message consisting of pictures representing syllables and words
definitions.zh: n. 谜, 画谜

examples.en: The children solved the rebus in class.
examples.zh: 孩子们在课堂上解开了画谜。

examples.en: A rebus uses pictures to represent words.
examples.zh: 画谜用图片代表词语。

definitions.en: s. apt to speak irritably
definitions.zh: a. 要咬人的, 厉声说话的, 没好气的

examples.en: She was snappish after a long day.
examples.zh: 漫长的一天后，她没好气。

examples.en: His snappish tone annoyed his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他厉声说话的语气惹恼了同事。

definitions.en: n. a political system governed by old men
definitions.zh: n. 老人统治, 老人管理, 老人集团

examples.en: The tribe was ruled by a gerontocracy.
examples.zh: 这个部落由老人统治。

examples.en: Gerontocracy can slow down decision-making.
examples.zh: 老人统治可能会减慢决策过程。

definitions.en: n. a young eagle

examples.en: The eaglet learned to fly from the nest.
examples.zh: 小鹰学会了从巢里飞出来。

examples.en: An eaglet stays with its parents for months.
examples.zh: 小鹰和父母待在一起好几个月。

definitions.en: a. having no hue
definitions.zh: a. 无色的, 不分光的, 消色差的, 非染色质的
[化] 消色差的

examples.zh: 这个镜头是无色的，减少了畸变。

examples.en: Achromatic colors include black and white.
examples.zh: 无色的颜色包括黑色和白色。

definitions.en: n. the act of expanding by pressure from within
definitions.zh: n. 扩张, 膨胀
[医] 膨胀, 扩张

examples.en: The doctor noticed abdominal distention after the meal.
examples.zh: 医生注意到饭后腹部膨胀。

examples.en: Gas can cause painful distention in the stomach.
examples.zh: 气体会导致胃部疼痛性膨胀。

definitions.en: n. power to influence or coerce
definitions.zh: n. 力, 势, 权力

examples.en: The king's puissance was felt across the land.
examples.zh: 国王的权力遍及全国。

examples.en: Her puissance in politics grew quickly.
examples.zh: 她在政治上的势力增长迅速。

definitions.en: s acutely insightful and wise
definitions.zh: a. 装聪明样的, 聪明的, 伶俐的, 有见识的

examples.en: The sapient old man gave wise advice.
examples.zh: 那位聪明的老人给出了明智的建议。

examples.en: A sapient leader listens to all opinions.
examples.zh: 一位有见识的领导者会听取所有意见。

definitions.en: n. an irregular arrangement of patches of color
definitions.zh: vt. 使呈杂色

definitions.en: v. mark with spots or blotches of different color or shades of color as if stained
definitions.zh: n. 杂色, 斑点

examples.en: The artist used paint to mottle the canvas.
examples.zh: 艺术家用颜料使画布呈现杂色。

examples.en: Sunlight can mottle the leaves with shadows.
examples.zh: 阳光会使树叶上出现斑驳的阴影。

definitions.en: n. a state of extreme poverty or destitution
definitions.zh: n. 贫乏, 穷困的人们

examples.en: The charity helps families in indigence.
examples.zh: 慈善机构帮助贫困家庭。

examples.en: Indigence forced them to live on the streets.
examples.zh: 贫困迫使他们流落街头。

definitions.en: s not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed
definitions.zh: a. 非假装的, 真实的, 诚实的

examples.en: Her smile was unfeigned and full of joy.
examples.zh: 她的笑容是真实的，充满喜悦。

examples.en: He showed unfeigned concern for his friend.
examples.zh: 他对朋友表现出真诚的关心。

definitions.en: s too obvious to be doubted
definitions.zh: a. 无疑的, 确实的, 明显的
[法] 不容置疑的, 明确的

examples.en: The evidence was indubitable and clear.
examples.zh: 证据是明确无疑的。

examples.en: It is indubitable that the sun rises.
examples.zh: 太阳升起是毋庸置疑的。

definitions.en: s. blemished by injury or rough wear
definitions.zh: v. 毁坏, 损坏, 玷污( mar的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The beautiful painting was marred by a scratch.
examples.zh: 这幅美丽的画被一道划痕损坏了。

examples.en: His reputation was marred by the scandal.
examples.zh: 他的声誉被丑闻玷污了。

definitions.en: a of or relating to marriage or to the relationship between a wife and husband
definitions.zh: a. 结婚的, 夫妇的, 配偶的

examples.en: They enjoyed many years of connubial bliss.
examples.zh: 他们享受了多年的婚姻幸福。

examples.en: Connubial love is a strong bond.
examples.zh: 夫妻之爱是一种牢固的纽带。

definitions.en: v. consider carefully and deeply; reflect upon; turn over in one's mind
definitions.zh: v. 思考, 考虑

examples.en: He needed time to cogitate on the problem.
examples.zh: 他需要时间思考这个问题。

examples.en: She would cogitate before making a decision.
examples.zh: 她在做决定前会仔细考虑。

definitions.en: n. the act of contributing to the funds of a church or charity
definitions.zh: n. 向上帝的供奉, 祭献, (对宗教、慈善业的)损献, 祭品

examples.en: They made an oblation to the church.
examples.zh: 他们向教堂做了捐献。

examples.en: The priest accepted the oblation with gratitude.
examples.zh: 牧师感激地接受了祭品。

definitions.en: v. birth
definitions.zh: n. 小狗
v. 下崽

examples.zh: 这只狗下周会下崽。

examples.en: A tiny whelp slept in the basket.
examples.zh: 一只小狗崽在篮子里睡觉。

definitions.en: v. separate into constituents by soaking
definitions.zh: vi. 浸软, 消瘦

definitions.en: v. become soft or separate and disintegrate as a result of excessive soaking
definitions.zh: vt. 把...浸软, 使消瘦

examples.zh: 浸泡水果使其变软来做果酱。

examples.en: The herbs macerate in water for hours.
examples.zh: 草药在水中浸泡数小时。

definitions.en: s. given to merry frolicking
definitions.zh: a. 小马似的, 蹦蹦跳跳的, 不守纪律的

examples.en: The coltish puppy ran around the yard.
examples.zh: 那只蹦蹦跳跳的小狗在院子里跑来跑去。

examples.en: Her coltish energy made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 她活泼的精力让每个人都笑了。

definitions.en: v reflect brightly
definitions.zh: vi. 闪烁, 熠熠生辉, 焕发

examples.en: The stars coruscate in the night sky.
examples.zh: 星星在夜空中闪烁。

examples.en: Her eyes coruscate with excitement.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛因兴奋而熠熠生辉。

definitions.en: n. physical beauty (especially of a woman)
definitions.zh: n. 美丽

examples.en: Her pulchritude was admired by all.
examples.zh: 她的美丽受到所有人的赞赏。

examples.en: The painting captured the pulchritude of nature.
examples.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了大自然的美丽。

definitions.en: a. not adroit
definitions.zh: a. 笨拙的, 拙劣的, 愚钝的

examples.zh: 他笨拙的处理打碎了花瓶。

examples.en: She felt maladroit in social situations.
examples.zh: 她在社交场合感到笨拙。

definitions.en: v be resistant to
definitions.zh: vt. 议论, 辩驳, 驳击

definitions.en: v prove to be false or incorrect
definitions.zh: vi. 参加辩论

examples.en: They controvert the theory with new data.
examples.zh: 他们用新数据驳斥这个理论。

examples.en: It is hard to controvert his argument.
examples.zh: 很难辩驳他的论点。

definitions.en: v tell or spread rumors
definitions.zh: vt. 散播
[医] [杂]音

examples.zh: 他们在镇上散播这个消息。

examples.en: Rumors bruit about his sudden departure.
examples.zh: 关于他突然离开的谣言在散播。

definitions.en: n. the branch of dentistry dealing with the prevention or correction of irregularities of the teeth
definitions.zh: [医] 正牙学

examples.zh: 她学习正牙学来矫正牙齿。

examples.en: Orthodontics can improve your smile.
examples.zh: 正牙学可以改善你的笑容。

definitions.en: v. call together

examples.zh: 总统将召集一次会议。

examples.en: They convoke the council for an emergency.
examples.zh: 他们召集委员会处理紧急情况。

definitions.en: n the property of being cohesive and sticky
definitions.zh: n. 粘着性

examples.zh: 胶水的粘着性使其牢固。

examples.en: I dislike the tackiness of this tape.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢这胶带的粘性。

definitions.en: n. one bound by vows to a religion or life of worship or service
definitions.zh: n. (天主教)立誓献身者, 崇拜者, 支持者, 信徒

examples.zh: 她是当地寺庙的信徒。

examples.en: A votary dedicates life to service.
examples.zh: 献身者将生命奉献给服务。

definitions.en: n. a short poem descriptive of rural or pastoral life
definitions.zh: n. 牧歌, 田园诗

examples.zh: 他写了一首关于乡村生活的田园诗。

examples.en: The eclogue described shepherds in the field.
examples.zh: 这首牧歌描述了田野里的牧羊人。

definitions.en: n. one whose prevailing mental imagery takes the form of inner feelings of action
definitions.zh: a. 能动的, 运动表象型的

definitions.en: s. (of spores or microorganisms) capable of movement
definitions.zh: n. 运动表象型

examples.zh: 有些细菌是能动的，可以自由移动。

examples.en: The motile sperm swim toward the egg.
examples.zh: 能动的精子游向卵子。

examples.zh: 他的贪婪导致他偷钱。

examples.zh: 对财富的贪婪毁了他们的友谊。

definitions.en: s having or showing valor
definitions.zh: a. 勇敢的, 勇武的, 刚勇的

examples.zh: 勇敢的士兵救了许多人。

examples.en: Her valorous act was praised by all.
examples.zh: 她勇敢的行为受到所有人的赞扬。

examples.zh: 他的愤怒因侮辱而合理。

examples.zh: 散发气味的奶酪充满了房间。

examples.zh: 一朵散发气味的花在花园里盛开。

definitions.en: s. moving and bending with ease

examples.zh: 舞者柔软而优雅。

examples.zh: 一只敏捷的猫跳上了篱笆。

examples.zh: 她保留了这首诗的亲笔手稿。

examples.zh: 心跳是心律失常且不规则的。

examples.zh: 他会把鱼浸入盐水中。

examples.en: They souse themselves in cold water.
examples.zh: 他们把自己浸入冷水中。

definitions.en: n. a file of memoranda or notices that remind of things to be done

examples.zh: 她有一个备忘录记录重要日期。

examples.en: The tickler reminded him of the meeting.
examples.zh: 备忘录提醒他会议的事。

definitions.en: s. showing sorrow
definitions.zh: a. 忧伤的, 悲痛的

examples.zh: 这首忧伤的歌让每个人都哭了。

examples.en: His dolorous expression showed his grief.
examples.zh: 他悲伤的表情显示了他的悲痛。

definitions.zh: n. 爱奢侈享乐的人, 奢侈逸乐之徒, 骄奢淫逸的人

examples.zh: 他是个爱奢侈享乐的人，喜欢美酒。

examples.en: The sybarite spent all his money on luxuries.
examples.zh: 这个奢侈逸乐之徒把钱全花在奢侈品上。

definitions.en: v go ashore

examples.zh: 我们很快就要下船了。

examples.en: Passengers debark at the port safely.
examples.zh: 乘客们安全登陆港口。

definitions.en: s. having characteristics of the stage especially an artificial and mannered quality

examples.zh: 他的表演对这部电影来说太做作了。

examples.en: The stagy dialogue felt unnatural to me.
examples.zh: 那戏剧般的对话让我觉得不自然。

definitions.en: n. the unintentional misuse of a word by confusion with one that sounds similar
definitions.zh: n. 文字的错用

examples.zh: 她在课堂上犯了一个好笑的文字错用。

examples.en: His malapropism confused everyone listening.
examples.zh: 他的文字错用让所有听众都困惑了。

examples.zh: 她在艺术界是举世无双的人。

examples.zh: 他向国王恳求帮助。

examples.en: They supplicate the gods for rain.
examples.zh: 他们恳求神灵降雨。

definitions.en: n. a person who worships idols
definitions.zh: n. 偶像崇拜者, 崇拜者, 皈依者

examples.zh: 偶像崇拜者向雕像鞠躬。

examples.en: She is an idolater of ancient gods.
examples.zh: 她是古代神灵的崇拜者。

definitions.en: s curving outward
definitions.zh: a. 突起的, 招人注意的

examples.zh: 他突起的眼睛让他看起来很惊讶。

examples.en: The tree had a protuberant root above ground.
examples.zh: 那棵树在地面上有突起的根。

definitions.en: v. bid lower than a competing bidder
definitions.zh: vi. 喊价过低, 叫牌过低

examples.zh: 他为这份工作出价低于其他承包商。

examples.en: She underbid her hand and lost the game.
examples.zh: 她叫牌过低，输掉了比赛。

definitions.en: n the faculty that enables us to distinguish scents
definitions.zh: n. 嗅觉

examples.zh: 狗有很强的嗅觉。

examples.en: Olfaction helps us enjoy food more.
examples.zh: 嗅觉帮助我们更好地享受食物。

definitions.zh: v. (使)化脓, (使)腐烂, (使)堕落

examples.zh: 肉如果放在外面会腐烂。

examples.en: Leaves putrefy quickly in warm weather.
examples.zh: 叶子在温暖的天气里很快腐烂。

definitions.en: a. without water; especially without water of crystallization

examples.zh: 这种化学物质是无水的，非常干燥。

examples.en: Anhydrous ammonia is used in fertilizers.
examples.zh: 无水氨用于肥料中。

definitions.en: n excessive desire to eat
definitions.zh: n. 贪食, 贪婪

examples.zh: 他晚餐时的贪食让所有人惊讶。

examples.en: The wolf ate with great voracity.
examples.zh: 狼以极大的贪婪进食。

examples.zh: 文字出现以前的社会使用口头传统。

examples.zh: 这个孩子还不识字，但很好奇。
