examples.zh: 石头是无感觉的，什么也感觉不到。

examples.en: He was insensate to the pain after the shock.
examples.zh: 震惊之后他对疼痛无感觉。

definitions.en: s. characteristic of a clan especially in being unified
definitions.zh: a. 氏族的, 宗族的, 团结心很强的

examples.en: The group is very clannish and keeps to itself.
examples.zh: 这个团体非常团结心强，只和自己人相处。

examples.en: Their clannish behavior excluded outsiders.
examples.zh: 他们宗族式的行为排斥了外人。

definitions.en: n. a flattering commendation (especially when used for promotional purposes)
definitions.zh: n. 夸大广告, 吹捧

examples.en: The ad was full of puffery and hype.
examples.zh: 广告充满了夸大广告和炒作。

examples.en: Don't believe the puffery in commercials.
examples.zh: 不要相信广告中的吹捧。

definitions.en: v. cause to wither or parch from exposure to heat
definitions.zh: vt. 烤, 烘, 使干透
vi. 烤干, 焦干

examples.en: The sun will parch the dry soil.
examples.zh: 太阳会烤干干燥的土壤。

examples.en: Heat can parch your skin quickly.
examples.zh: 热量会很快使你的皮肤干透。

definitions.en: n. the scientific study of food preparation and intake
definitions.zh: n. 饮食学
[医] 饮食学

examples.en: She studies dietetics to help people eat well.
examples.zh: 她学习饮食学以帮助人们吃得好。

examples.en: Dietetics is important for healthy living.
examples.zh: 饮食学对健康生活很重要。

definitions.en: n. an expert on precious stones and the art of cutting and engraving them
definitions.zh: n. 宝石工艺匠, 宝石鉴定家

definitions.en: n. a skilled worker who cuts and engraves precious stones
definitions.zh: a. 宝石雕刻的, 宝石的

examples.en: The lapidary cut the gem beautifully.
examples.zh: 宝石工艺匠把宝石切割得很美。

examples.en: He works as a lapidary in a jewelry shop.
examples.zh: 他在珠宝店做宝石鉴定家。

definitions.en: n. a severe scolding
definitions.zh: n. 惩罚, 苛评, 修订

examples.en: The teacher's castigation was harsh but fair.
examples.zh: 老师的惩罚严厉但公平。

examples.en: He received castigation for his mistake.
examples.zh: 他因错误受到了苛评。

definitions.en: v add details to
definitions.zh: vt. 增加, 夸大

examples.en: He tried to aggrandize his own importance.
examples.zh: 他试图夸大自己的重要性。

examples.en: The story aggrandized the hero's deeds.
examples.zh: 故事夸大了英雄的事迹。

definitions.en: n someone who engages in drinking bouts
definitions.zh: a. 酒神的, 酒神节的, 狂饮作乐的

definitions.en: n a drunken reveller; a devotee of Bacchus
definitions.zh: n. 酒神崇拜者, 狂饮作乐

examples.en: The party turned into a wild bacchanal.
examples.zh: 派对变成了一场狂饮作乐。

examples.en: He was a bacchanal at the festival.
examples.zh: 他在节日里是个狂饮作乐的人。

definitions.en: n. an agent that produces coagulation
definitions.zh: n. 凝结剂
[化] 凝结剂

examples.en: The coagulant helped the milk thicken.
examples.zh: 凝结剂帮助牛奶变稠。

examples.en: Add a coagulant to make the jelly set.
examples.zh: 加入凝结剂使果冻凝固。

definitions.en: v. run or be performed again
definitions.zh: vt. 反复说, 重复
[计] 迭代

examples.en: Please iterate the process until it works.
examples.zh: 请重复这个过程直到它有效。

examples.en: The program will iterate the calculation.
examples.zh: 程序将迭代计算。

definitions.en: s. not capable of living or developing successfully
definitions.zh: a. 无法生活的
[医] 不能生活的

examples.en: The plan is nonviable without more funds.
examples.zh: 没有更多资金，这个计划无法生活。

examples.en: The seed was nonviable and did not grow.
examples.zh: 种子无法生活，没有生长。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or happening in a river
definitions.zh: a. 河流的

examples.en: Fluvial deposits form along riverbanks.
examples.zh: 河流沉积物沿河岸形成。

examples.en: The fluvial ecosystem supports many fish.
examples.zh: 河流生态系统支持许多鱼类。

definitions.en: v. incite to commit a crime or an evil deed
definitions.zh: vt. 使作伪证, 唆使, 怂恿, 收买

examples.en: He tried to suborn the witness to lie.
examples.zh: 他试图唆使证人撒谎。

examples.en: They suborned him to commit the crime.
examples.zh: 他们怂恿他犯罪。

definitions.en: v. speak as if delivering a sermon; express moral judgements
definitions.zh: v. 说教, 布道, 说大道理与人听

examples.en: He likes to sermonize about good behavior.
examples.zh: 他喜欢说教关于良好行为。

examples.en: Don't sermonize to me about my choices.
examples.zh: 不要对我的选择说教。

definitions.en: n. annihilation by vaporizing something
definitions.zh: n. 蒸发, 汽化

definitions.en: n. the process of becoming a vapor
definitions.zh: [化] 汽化

examples.en: Water vaporization happens when it boils.
examples.zh: 水沸腾时发生汽化。

examples.en: The vaporization of the liquid was quick.
examples.zh: 液体的蒸发很快。

definitions.en: a. relating to or perceived by or shaped like the organ of hearing; I must hear what I read"- George Santayana
definitions.zh: n. 耳的, 私下对人说的, 耳状的

definitions.en: a. pertaining to an auricle of the heart
definitions.zh: [医] 耳的; 心耳的; 心房

examples.en: He gave an auricular confession to the priest.
examples.zh: 他向牧师私下告解。

examples.en: The auricular nerve helps with hearing.
examples.zh: 耳神经有助于听觉。

definitions.en: s. requiring precise accuracy
definitions.zh: a. 紧急的, 迫切的, 苛求的
[法] 催告书, 勒令, 限令

examples.en: The exigent situation required immediate action.
examples.zh: 紧急情况需要立即行动。

examples.en: Her exigent demands were hard to meet.
examples.zh: 她苛求的要求很难满足。

definitions.en: n a corrupt or depraved or degenerate act or practice
definitions.zh: n. 卑鄙行为, 卑鄙
[法] 邪恶, 可耻行为, 卑鄙

examples.en: His turpitude shocked the whole community.
examples.zh: 他的卑鄙行为震惊了整个社区。

examples.en: The crime showed great moral turpitude.
examples.zh: 这罪行显示了极大的道德卑鄙。

definitions.en: s given or giving freely
definitions.zh: a. 慷慨的, 充足的, 宽裕的

examples.en: The bounteous harvest fed the whole village.
examples.zh: 充足的收成养活了整个村庄。

examples.en: She gave a bounteous gift to charity.
examples.zh: 她给了慈善机构慷慨的礼物。

definitions.en: n a petty misdeed
definitions.zh: n. 轻罪, 小过, 小瑕疵

examples.en: His only peccadillo was being late sometimes.
examples.zh: 他唯一的小过是偶尔迟到。

examples.en: Don't worry about that small peccadillo.
examples.zh: 别担心那个小瑕疵。

definitions.en: v. remove from customary environment or associations
definitions.zh: vt. 使疏远, 离间, 使离开

examples.en: His behavior will estrange him from friends.
examples.zh: 他的行为会让他与朋友疏远。

examples.en: They estrange themselves from their family.
examples.zh: 他们使自己离开家庭。

definitions.en: v. cause to throb or beat rapidly
definitions.zh: vi. 悸动, 心跳, 发抖

definitions.en: v. beat rapidly
definitions.zh: [医] 心悸

examples.en: Her heart began to palpitate with fear.
examples.zh: 她的心因恐惧开始悸动。

examples.en: The excitement made his chest palpitate.
examples.zh: 兴奋让他的胸部悸动。

definitions.en: n. the quality of being changeable and variable
definitions.zh: n. 易变, 不定性, 反复无常

examples.en: Her inconstancy made it hard to trust her.
examples.zh: 她的反复无常让人难以信任她。

examples.en: The weather's inconstancy surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 天气的易变让所有人惊讶。

definitions.en: v beat with a cane
definitions.zh: vt. 痛打, 严责

examples.en: The critic lambasted the new movie harshly.
examples.zh: 评论家严厉痛批了这部新电影。

examples.en: He lambasted the boy for his mistake.
examples.zh: 他因错误痛打了那个男孩。

definitions.en: n verbal misrepresentation intended to take advantage of you in some way
definitions.zh: n. 欺骗, 诡计, 诈骗

examples.en: The election was full of skullduggery.
examples.zh: 选举充满了欺骗。

examples.en: They used skullduggery to win the contract.
examples.zh: 他们用诡计赢得了合同。

definitions.zh: a. 无香味的；无气味的

examples.en: I prefer unscented soap for sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢无香味的肥皂用于敏感肌肤。

examples.en: She bought unscented candles for the dinner party.
examples.zh: 她为晚宴买了无气味的蜡烛。

definitions.en: n. the quality possessed by something that you cannot possibly do without
definitions.zh: n. 不可缺少, 责无旁贷

examples.en: The indispensability of water is clear to everyone.
examples.zh: 水的不可缺少性对每个人都很清楚。

examples.en: His indispensability to the team was unquestionable.
examples.zh: 他对团队的重要性是毋庸置疑的。

definitions.en: v. mark with striae or striations
definitions.zh: a. 有条纹的

definitions.en: a. marked with stria or striations
definitions.zh: vt. 加条纹

examples.en: The artist will striate the clay with a tool.
examples.zh: 艺术家会用工具在黏土上加条纹。

examples.en: Some leaves striate naturally as they grow.
examples.zh: 有些叶子在生长过程中自然有条纹。

definitions.en: n. variability in coloration
definitions.zh: n. 斑驳, 彩色, 杂色, 多种多样

examples.en: The variegation of the leaves made them beautiful.
examples.zh: 叶子的斑驳使它们很美丽。

examples.en: Variegation in flowers attracts many gardeners.
examples.zh: 花朵的杂色吸引了许多园丁。

definitions.en: a. not submissive to authority
definitions.zh: a. 不顺从的, 地位不低的

examples.en: The insubordinate soldier refused to follow orders.
examples.zh: 那个不顺从的士兵拒绝服从命令。

examples.en: Her insubordinate attitude got her into trouble.
examples.zh: 她不顺从的态度给她带来了麻烦。

definitions.en: n. a form of social organization in which a female is the family head and title is traced through the female line
definitions.zh: n. 女家长制, 女族长制

examples.en: The tribe was a matriarchy led by women.
examples.zh: 这个部落是一个由女性领导的母系社会。

examples.en: Matriarchy is rare in modern societies.
examples.zh: 母系社会在现代社会中很少见。

definitions.en: n. a blue or green powder used as a paint pigment
definitions.zh: n. 铜绿

definitions.en: n. a green patina that forms on copper or brass or bronze that has been exposed to the air or water for long periods of time
definitions.zh: [化] 铜绿; 碱式碳酸铜

examples.en: The old statue had a layer of verdigris.
examples.zh: 那座旧雕像上有一层铜绿。

examples.en: Verdigris forms on copper over time.
examples.zh: 铜绿会随着时间的推移在铜上形成。

definitions.en: a. given to excess in consumption of especially food or drink
definitions.zh: a. 暴食的, 贪吃的, 贪心的

examples.en: The gluttonous boy ate all the cookies.
examples.zh: 那个贪吃的男孩吃光了所有饼干。

examples.en: Her gluttonous habits led to health problems.
examples.zh: 她暴食的习惯导致了健康问题。

definitions.en: n. periapsis in Earth orbit; the point in its orbit where a satellite is nearest to the Earth
definitions.zh: n. 近地点

examples.en: The moon is closest at perigee.
examples.zh: 月球在近地点时离地球最近。

examples.en: Scientists study the satellite's perigee carefully.
examples.zh: 科学家们仔细研究卫星的近地点。

definitions.en: n. a consonant that is produced with the tongue and other speech organs
definitions.zh: a. 舌的, 舌音的, 语言的

definitions.en: a. pertaining to or resembling or lying near the tongue
definitions.zh: n. 舌音

examples.en: She has strong lingual skills in French.
examples.zh: 她在法语方面有很强的语言能力。

examples.en: The lingual nerve helps with taste sensation.
examples.zh: 舌神经有助于味觉感受。

definitions.en: n an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers
definitions.zh: n. 戏法, 骗术, 诡辩

examples.en: The magician's legerdemain amazed the audience.
examples.zh: 魔术师的戏法让观众惊叹不已。

examples.en: He used legerdemain to trick his friends.
examples.zh: 他用骗术愚弄了他的朋友们。

definitions.en: v. draw out a discussion or process in order to gain time
definitions.zh: vi. 随潮流, 拖延, 妥协, 调停

examples.en: He tried to temporize until he had more information.
examples.zh: 他试图拖延直到获得更多信息。

examples.en: The politician would temporize on difficult questions.
examples.zh: 那位政客会在棘手问题上拖延时间。

definitions.en: n. the act of pulling up or out; uprooting; cutting off from existence
definitions.zh: n. 消灭, 根除, 毁灭
[医] 摘除

examples.en: The extirpation of the disease took many years.
examples.zh: 根除这种疾病花了很多年。

examples.en: They worked on the extirpation of invasive plants.
examples.zh: 他们致力于消灭入侵植物。

definitions.en: a. equally skillful with each hand
definitions.zh: a. 两手俱利的, 搞两面派的

definitions.en: s. marked by deliberate deceptiveness especially by pretending one set of feelings and acting under the influence of another
definitions.zh: [医] 两手同利的

examples.en: She is ambidextrous and can write with both hands.
examples.zh: 她两手俱利，能用双手写字。

examples.en: Being ambidextrous helps in many sports.
examples.zh: 两手俱利在许多运动中有帮助。

definitions.en: v. offer as a sacrifice by killing or by giving up to destruction
definitions.zh: vt. 为供神而宰杀, 牺牲, 杀死

examples.en: The ancient ritual required them to immolate a goat.
examples.zh: 古代仪式要求他们宰杀一只山羊作为牺牲。

examples.en: He would immolate his own interests for the cause.
examples.zh: 他会为了事业牺牲自己的利益。

definitions.en: a. capable of depressing physiological or psychological activity or response by a chemical agent
definitions.zh: a. 有镇静作用的
n. 镇静剂

examples.en: Alcohol is a common depressant drug.
examples.zh: 酒精是一种常见的镇静剂。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a depressant for his anxiety.
examples.zh: 医生为他的焦虑开了一种镇静剂。

definitions.en: s (used colloquially) overly conceited or arrogant
definitions.zh: a. 爱挑剔的, 吹毛求疵的, 精细的

examples.en: My persnickety aunt complains about everything.
examples.zh: 我爱挑剔的姑妈对每件事都抱怨。

examples.en: He is persnickety about the cleanliness of his room.
examples.zh: 他对房间的清洁非常挑剔。

definitions.en: n. the application of soil and plant sciences to land management and crop production
definitions.zh: n. 农艺学, 农学

examples.en: She studied agronomy to improve crop yields.
examples.zh: 她学习农学以提高作物产量。

examples.en: Agronomy is important for sustainable farming.
examples.zh: 农学对可持续农业很重要。

definitions.en: n. a person who shows no gratitude
definitions.zh: n. 忘恩者
a. 不知恩的, 忘恩的

examples.en: He is an ingrate who never says thank you.
examples.zh: 他是个忘恩负义的人，从不说谢谢。

examples.en: Don't be an ingrate; appreciate what you have.
examples.zh: 不要忘恩负义，要珍惜你所拥有的。

definitions.en: n. a lack of generosity; a general unwillingness to part with money
definitions.zh: n. 吝啬

examples.en: His stinginess made him unpopular with friends.
examples.zh: 他的吝啬使他在朋友中不受欢迎。

examples.en: Stinginess is not a good quality in a leader.
examples.zh: 吝啬不是领导者的好品质。

definitions.en: v. wash or flow against
definitions.zh: vt. 沐浴, 洗
n. 剩余物

examples.en: The waves lave the shore gently at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时海浪轻轻拍打着海岸。

examples.en: She would lave her face with cool water.
examples.zh: 她会用凉水洗脸。

definitions.en: v be specific about
definitions.zh: v. 详细说明, 列举, 使特殊

examples.en: Please particularize the steps in your plan.
examples.zh: 请详细说明你计划中的步骤。

examples.en: He particularized each item on the list.
examples.zh: 他列举了清单上的每一项。

definitions.en: n confusion resulting from failure to understand
definitions.zh: [医] 迷惘, 迷糊

examples.en: His befuddlement was clear from his confused look.
examples.zh: 从他困惑的表情可以看出他的迷惘。

examples.en: The complex instructions caused much befuddlement.
examples.zh: 复杂的说明导致了许多困惑。

definitions.en: s (used especially of vegetation) having lost all moisture
definitions.zh: a. 干枯的
n. 演替系列

examples.en: The sere leaves crunched under our feet.
examples.zh: 干枯的叶子在我们脚下嘎吱作响。

examples.en: After the drought, the land was sere and barren.
examples.zh: 干旱过后，土地干枯贫瘠。

definitions.en: v. have the idea for
definitions.zh: vt. 孕育

examples.en: The author gestated the novel for several years.
examples.zh: 这位作者孕育这部小说好几年了。

examples.en: Great ideas often gestate slowly in the mind.
examples.zh: 伟大的想法常常在脑海中慢慢孕育。

definitions.en: n. an early form of sextant
definitions.zh: n. 星盘

examples.en: Sailors used the astrolabe to navigate at sea.
examples.zh: 水手们用星盘在海上导航。

examples.en: The astrolabe is an ancient astronomical instrument.
examples.zh: 星盘是一种古老的天文仪器。

definitions.en: n the creation of artistic pictures or diagrams
definitions.zh: n. 制图术

examples.en: His draftsmanship is excellent in architectural plans.
examples.zh: 他的制图术在建筑图纸中非常出色。

examples.en: Good draftsmanship requires practice and patience.
examples.zh: 好的制图术需要练习和耐心。

definitions.en: s. intensely fashionable for a short time
definitions.zh: a. 趋于时尚的, 风行的, 流行的

examples.en: Faddish diets often don't last long.
examples.zh: 流行的饮食通常不会持续很久。

examples.en: She wears faddish clothes that change every season.
examples.zh: 她穿每季都变的时尚衣服。

definitions.en: v mark with striae or striations
definitions.zh: a. 有条纹的, 有线纹的
[医] 纹状的

examples.en: The striated muscle helps with voluntary movement.
examples.zh: 横纹肌有助于自主运动。

examples.en: Striated rocks show layers of sediment.
examples.zh: 有条纹的岩石显示出沉积层。

definitions.en: s. devoted to pleasure
definitions.zh: a. 快乐的, 快乐论的
n. 快乐论

examples.en: Hedonic pleasures are often short-lived.
examples.zh: 快乐论的快乐往往是短暂的。

examples.en: She pursued a hedonic lifestyle without worries.
examples.zh: 她追求无忧无虑的享乐生活。

definitions.en: s (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
definitions.zh: a. 诽谤的, 败坏名誉的, 爱诽谤的, 诽谤性的

examples.en: The article contained libelous statements about the actor.
examples.zh: 那篇文章包含对演员的诽谤性言论。

examples.en: Spreading libelous rumors is illegal.
examples.zh: 散布诽谤性谣言是违法的。

definitions.en: s with little or no preparation or forethought
definitions.zh: a. 无准备的, 即席的, 临时的
[医] 临时的, 当时的

examples.en: He gave an extemporaneous speech at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议上做了一次即席演讲。

examples.en: Her extemporaneous remarks were surprisingly insightful.
examples.zh: 她即席的评论出人意料地有见地。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to gustation
definitions.zh: a. 尝味的, 味觉的
[医] 味觉的, 味的

examples.en: The gustatory sense allows us to taste food.
examples.zh: 味觉使我们能够品尝食物。

examples.en: She has a keen gustatory appreciation for spices.
examples.zh: 她对香料有敏锐的味觉鉴赏力。

definitions.en: n. a literary composition of poor quality that was written quickly to make money (to boil the pot)
definitions.zh: n. (以糊口而写的)粗制滥造文艺作品, 粗制滥造作品的人

examples.en: The author wrote a potboiler to pay the bills.
examples.zh: 那位作者写了一部粗制滥造的作品来付账单。

examples.en: Critics dismissed the novel as a mere potboiler.
examples.zh: 评论家认为这部小说不过是粗制滥造之作。

definitions.en: s having a difficult and contrary disposition
definitions.zh: a. 有怪想的, 反复无常的, 想入非非的

examples.en: The crotchety old man complained about everything.
examples.zh: 那个反复无常的老人对每件事都抱怨。

examples.en: His crotchety behavior made him hard to work with.
examples.zh: 他反复无常的行为使他难以共事。

definitions.en: s. based on or having the nature of an illusion
definitions.zh: a. 幻影的, 错觉的, 迷惑人的

examples.en: The hope of quick wealth is often illusive.
examples.zh: 快速致富的希望往往是虚幻的。

examples.en: Illusive dreams can lead to disappointment.
examples.zh: 虚幻的梦想可能导致失望。

definitions.en: v. burn, sear, or freeze (tissue) using a hot iron or electric current or a caustic agent
definitions.zh: vt. 烧灼, 使麻木不仁
[医] 烧灼, 烙

examples.en: The doctor had to cauterize the wound to stop bleeding.
examples.zh: 医生不得不烧灼伤口以止血。

examples.en: They cauterize the tissue to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 他们烧灼组织以防止感染。

definitions.en: n. the state of being sensitive (as to an antigen)
definitions.zh: n. 敏感化, 致敏作用

definitions.en: n. (psychology) the process of becoming highly sensitive to specific events or situations (especially emotional events or situations)
definitions.zh: [化] 敏化作用; 致敏作用

examples.en: Sensitization to pollen can cause allergies.
examples.zh: 对花粉的敏感化会导致过敏。

examples.en: The program aims at sensitization to social issues.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在提高对社会问题的敏感度。

definitions.en: v explore, often with the goal of finding something or somebody
definitions.zh: vt. 侦察, 勘查

examples.en: The scouts went to reconnoiter the enemy camp.
examples.zh: 侦察兵去侦察敌方营地。

examples.en: We need to reconnoiter the area before hiking.
examples.zh: 我们需要在徒步前勘查这个区域。

definitions.en: v. perceive incorrectly
definitions.zh: vt. 误解；看错

examples.en: He tends to misperceive others' intentions.
examples.zh: 他往往误解他人的意图。

examples.en: Don't misperceive her kindness as weakness.
examples.zh: 不要误解她的善良为软弱。

definitions.en: a. Of or pertaining to a reporter or reporters; as, the
definitions.zh: a. 记者的, 报道的

examples.en: She has strong reportorial skills for news.
examples.zh: 她拥有很强的新闻报道技能。

examples.en: His reportorial style is very direct.
examples.zh: 他的报道风格非常直接。

definitions.en: a admitting of no doubt or misunderstanding; having only one meaning or interpretation and leading to only one conclusion
definitions.zh: a. 单一意思的, 意义明确的

examples.en: The law's meaning is univocal and clear.
examples.zh: 法律的含义是单一且明确的。

examples.en: We need a univocal answer to this question.
examples.zh: 我们需要对这个问题的明确答案。

definitions.en: s characterized by intense emotion
definitions.zh: a. 热的, 热心的

examples.en: He gave a fervid speech about freedom.
examples.zh: 他发表了一场关于自由的热情演讲。

examples.en: Her fervid love for music is inspiring.
examples.zh: 她对音乐的热情热爱令人鼓舞。

definitions.en: n. air-breathing arthropods characterized by simple eyes and four pairs of legs
definitions.zh: n. 蛛形纲动物
[医] 蜘蛛

examples.en: A spider is a common type of arachnid.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛是一种常见的蛛形纲动物。

examples.en: The arachnid has eight legs and two body parts.
examples.zh: 蛛形纲动物有八条腿和两个身体部分。

definitions.en: a. of or relating to the stars or constellations
definitions.zh: a. 星的, 恒星的, 恒星引起的, 根据星球运行测定的

examples.en: Sidereal time is based on star positions.
examples.zh: 恒星时基于恒星的位置。

examples.en: Astronomers study sidereal movements carefully.
examples.zh: 天文学家仔细研究恒星的运动。

definitions.en: n. a zoologist who studies reptiles and amphibians
definitions.zh: n. 爬虫学者

examples.en: The herpetologist studies snakes and frogs.
examples.zh: 爬虫学家研究蛇和青蛙。

examples.en: A herpetologist discovered a new lizard species.
examples.zh: 一位爬虫学家发现了一种新的蜥蜴物种。

definitions.en: n. the study of the supposed occult influence of numbers on human affairs
definitions.zh: n. 命理学；数字命理学

examples.en: She believes in numerology and lucky numbers.
examples.zh: 她相信命理学和幸运数字。

examples.en: Numerology claims numbers influence our lives.
examples.zh: 命理学声称数字影响我们的生活。

definitions.en: n the act of excluding someone by a negative vote or veto
definitions.zh: n. 反对票, 黑球

definitions.en: v expel from a community or group
definitions.zh: vt. 投票反对, 排斥

examples.en: The committee decided to blackball his application.
examples.zh: 委员会决定投票反对他的申请。

examples.en: They tried to blackball her from the club.
examples.zh: 他们试图排斥她加入俱乐部。

definitions.en: n. bony tissue formed during the healing of a fractured bone
definitions.zh: n. 皮肤的硬皮, 胼胝, (植物伤口的)愈合组织, 老茧

definitions.en: n. (botany) an isolated thickening of tissue, especially a stiff protuberance on the lip of an orchid
definitions.zh: [医] 胼胝; 骨痂

examples.en: He has a callus on his hand from working.
examples.zh: 他手上因工作长了老茧。

examples.en: The doctor checked the callus on his foot.
examples.zh: 医生检查了他脚上的胼胝。

definitions.en: n. someone who dislikes people in general
definitions.zh: n. 厌恶人类的人, 不愿与人来往者

examples.zh: 那位老人是个厌恶人类的人，避开人群。

examples.en: A misanthrope often prefers solitude to company.
examples.zh: 厌恶人类的人通常更喜欢独处而非陪伴。

definitions.en: s. worn or faded from being on display in a store
definitions.zh: a. 陈旧的

examples.zh: 那件陈旧的连衣裙打折出售。

examples.en: These shopworn items are no longer popular.
examples.zh: 这些陈旧的物品不再受欢迎。

definitions.en: v. heat food in order to kill harmful microorganisms
definitions.zh: vt. 用巴氏法灭菌
[医] 施行巴氏消毒

examples.en: We pasteurize milk to kill harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 我们巴氏消毒牛奶以杀死有害细菌。

examples.en: It is important to pasteurize juice for safety.
examples.zh: 为了安全，巴氏消毒果汁很重要。

definitions.en: s. evincing the presence of a deity
definitions.zh: a. 精神上的, 超自然的

examples.en: The temple had a numinous and peaceful atmosphere.
examples.zh: 那座寺庙有一种神圣而宁静的氛围。

examples.en: She felt a numinous presence in the forest.
examples.zh: 她在森林中感受到一种超自然的存在。

definitions.en: n. a bad-tempered person
definitions.zh: n. 脾气的发作, 坏脾气, 不高兴的人, 心怀不满

definitions.en: v. show one's unhappiness or critical attitude
definitions.zh: vi. 闹脾气, 发牢骚

examples.en: He is always a grouch in the morning.
examples.zh: 他早上总是一个坏脾气的人。

examples.en: Don't grouch about the small things in life.
examples.zh: 不要为生活中的小事发牢骚。

definitions.en: n someone who educates young people
definitions.zh: n. 小学教师, 教员, 学究

examples.en: The pedagogue taught the children with patience.
examples.zh: 那位教师耐心地教导孩子们。

examples.en: A good pedagogue inspires students to learn.
examples.zh: 一位好教师激励学生学习。

definitions.en: s. self-restraining; not indulging an appetite especially for food or drink
definitions.zh: a. 有节制的, 禁欲的
n. 禁欲者

examples.en: He is abstinent from alcohol for health reasons.
examples.zh: 他因健康原因戒酒。

examples.en: The abstinent monk lives a simple life.
examples.zh: 那位禁欲的僧人过着简朴的生活。

definitions.en: v. outdo someone in trickery
definitions.zh: vt. 以计取胜

examples.en: She managed to outfox her opponents in the game.
examples.zh: 她在游戏中设法以计取胜对手。

examples.en: The clever fox can outfox the hunters easily.
examples.zh: 聪明的狐狸能轻易以计取胜猎人。

definitions.en: a. of Epicurus or epicureanism
definitions.zh: n. 享乐主义者, 美食家

definitions.en: s. displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
definitions.zh: a. 贪口福的, 享乐主义的

examples.en: He leads an epicurean lifestyle full of luxury.
examples.zh: 他过着充满奢侈的享乐主义生活方式。

examples.en: The epicurean feast delighted all the guests.
examples.zh: 那场享乐主义的盛宴让所有客人高兴。

definitions.zh: n. 有屋顶的通路
[电] 吹风道

examples.en: The breezeway connects the house and garage.
examples.zh: 有屋顶的通路连接房子和车库。

examples.en: We sat in the breezeway to enjoy the breeze.
examples.zh: 我们坐在有屋顶的通路上享受微风。

definitions.en: n excessive intolerance of opposing views
definitions.zh: n. 过度热心, 狂热, 狂热行为

examples.en: His zealotry for the cause was extreme.
examples.zh: 他对事业的狂热是极端的。

examples.en: Zealotry can lead to intolerance of others.
examples.zh: 狂热会导致对他人的不容忍。

definitions.en: n. a crystalline compound that has the cool and minty taste and odor that occurs naturally in peppermint oil; used as a flavoring and in medicine to relieve itching, pain, and nasal congestion
definitions.zh: n. 薄荷醇

definitions.en: n. a lotion containing menthol which gives it the smell of mint
definitions.zh: [化] 薄荷醇; ┮醇

examples.zh: 这种止咳糖含有薄荷醇以缓解症状。

examples.en: Menthol gives a cool sensation to the skin.
examples.zh: 薄荷醇给皮肤带来清凉感。

definitions.en: n. an advocate of the extension of voting rights (especially to women)
definitions.zh: n. 参政权扩大论者, 妇女参政权论者

examples.zh: 这位妇女参政权论者为女性投票权而战。

examples.en: Many suffragists marched in the streets for equality.
examples.zh: 许多妇女参政权论者上街游行争取平等。

definitions.en: n. vain and empty boasting
definitions.zh: n. 自夸, 吹牛大王

examples.zh: 他的自夸惹恼了派对上的每个人。

examples.en: She saw through his braggadocio and lies.
examples.zh: 她看穿了他的自夸和谎言。

definitions.en: v. give expression or emotion to, in a stage or movie role
definitions.zh: vi. 装模作样, 表现感情

examples.zh: 那位演员学会了在舞台上有效表现感情。

examples.en: She can emote sadness with just a look.
examples.zh: 她仅用一个眼神就能表现悲伤。

definitions.en: n. the handle of a weapon or tool
definitions.zh: n. 柄, 把手
vt. 装上柄

examples.en: The knife's haft is made of wood.
examples.zh: 这把刀的柄是木头做的。

examples.en: He gripped the haft of the axe tightly.
examples.zh: 他紧紧握住斧头的柄。

definitions.en: n. an act of gerrymandering (dividing a voting area so as to give your own party an unfair advantage)

definitions.en: v. divide unfairly and to one's advantage; of voting districts
definitions.zh: vi. 不公正地划分选区
n. 改变选举区

examples.zh: 政客有时为利益不公正地划分选区。

examples.zh: 该党试图不公正地划分投票地图。

definitions.en: s. proved to be true

examples.zh: 信息已由专家证实。

examples.zh: 她的身份在进入大楼前已查清。

definitions.en: n. a very large pot that is used for boiling

examples.zh: 女巫在大锅里搅拌药剂。

examples.zh: 一大锅汤在火上煮着。

definitions.en: n knowledge of an event before it occurs
definitions.zh: n. 预知, 先见之明

examples.zh: 他预知了风暴的到来。

examples.zh: 对考试的预知帮助她做好了准备。

definitions.en: n a person who is devoted to eating and drinking to excess
definitions.zh: n. 美食家

examples.zh: 那位美食家在餐厅享用了一顿大餐。

examples.en: A gourmand loves fine food and drink.
examples.zh: 美食家热爱美食和饮品。

definitions.en: v. be overly critical; criticize minor details

examples.zh: 请不要挑剔每一个小错误。

examples.zh: 他在小组项目中往往吹毛求疵。

definitions.en: n. set of bells hung in a bell tower
definitions.zh: n. 排钟, 钟乐

examples.zh: 排钟在正午演奏了优美的旋律。

examples.en: We could hear the carillon from the church tower.
examples.zh: 我们能听到教堂塔楼传来的钟乐。

definitions.en: n. a pointed tool for marking surfaces or for punching small holes

examples.zh: 他用尖锥在皮革上打了一个孔。

examples.en: The shoemaker's awl is a sharp tool.
examples.zh: 鞋匠的钻子是一种锋利的工具。

definitions.en: n. adornment consisting of an ornamental cloth pad worn on the shoulder

examples.zh: 士兵的制服上戴着金色肩章。

examples.en: Her jacket had decorative epaulets on the shoulders.
examples.zh: 她的夹克在肩膀上有装饰性肩饰。

definitions.en: n a very boastful and talkative person

examples.zh: 那个吹牛大家整晚谈论他的成就。

examples.zh: 他的行为与言语不一致。

examples.en: The two shapes are incongruent in size.
examples.zh: 这两个形状在大小上不协调。

definitions.en: n disparaging terms for the common people

[法] 暴徒, 流氓

examples.zh: 公园里满是惹麻烦的流氓。

examples.en: She avoided the riffraff in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 她避开社区里的暴徒。

definitions.en: v. liquidate gradually
definitions.zh: vt. 摊还, 摊销, 分期偿还
[法] 把不动产让与, 转让, 分期偿还

examples.zh: 他们计划在十年内分期偿还贷款。

examples.en: The company will amortize its debt gradually.
examples.zh: 公司将逐步摊销债务。

definitions.en: n an awkward and inexperienced youth

examples.zh: 那个生手在第一天犯了很多错误。

examples.en: She is a greenhorn at this job but learns fast.
examples.zh: 她在这份工作上是生手但学得很快。

definitions.en: v. read for errors
definitions.zh: vt. 校正, 校对

examples.zh: 请发送前校对这份文件。

examples.en: She proofread her essay to fix errors.
examples.zh: 她校对文章以修正错误。

definitions.en: n. a source of concern

examples.zh: 黑暗的房间是孩子的恐惧来源。

examples.en: Taxes are a bugaboo for many people.
examples.zh: 税收是许多人的烦心事。

definitions.en: v trace the shape of
definitions.zh: vt. 描写, 描绘

examples.en: The artist limned the landscape beautifully.
examples.zh: 艺术家优美地描绘了风景。

examples.en: She limned her feelings in a poem.
examples.zh: 她在诗中描绘了自己的感受。

examples.zh: 那位政客试图回避问题。

examples.en: He stonewalls every time we discuss the issue.
examples.zh: 每次讨论这个问题他都阻挠。

definitions.en: a. relating to a single dimension or aspect; having no depth or scope

examples.en: A line is a unidimensional shape.
examples.zh: 线是一维的形状。

definitions.en: s. characterized by great swelling waves or surges

examples.zh: 汹涌的云朵飘过天空。

examples.en: The sea was billowy during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中海浪汹涌。

definitions.en: n. the act of exposing film to too much light or for too long a time

definitions.en: n. the act of exposing someone excessively to an influencing experience
definitions.zh: [医] 感光过度, 露光过度

examples.en: Overexposure ruined the photograph.
examples.zh: 曝光过度毁了这张照片。

examples.en: Too much sun causes overexposure to UV rays.
examples.zh: 过多日晒导致紫外线过度暴露。

definitions.en: n a mental representation of some haunting experience
definitions.zh: n. 幽灵, 妖怪, 凶兆

examples.zh: 战争的幽灵笼罩着这个国家。

examples.en: He saw a specter in the old house.
examples.zh: 他在老房子里看到了幽灵。

definitions.en: s. surpassing the ordinary or normal
definitions.zh: a. 超自然的, 异常的

examples.zh: 她有预测天气的超常能力。

examples.en: The silence in the room was preternatural.
examples.zh: 房间里的寂静异常。

examples.zh: 血友病是一种遗传性出血疾病。

examples.en: People with hemophilia need careful treatment.
examples.zh: 血友病患者需要仔细治疗。

definitions.en: v. assign great social importance to

examples.zh: 媒体把这位年轻运动员捧为名人。

examples.en: Fans lionize their favorite movie stars.
examples.zh: 粉丝们把最喜欢的电影明星当名人对待。

definitions.en: s. having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light
definitions.zh: a. 缎子似的, 柔软的, 光滑的

examples.en: Her skin had a satiny glow.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤有缎子般的光泽。

definitions.en: n. a state or atmosphere of harmony or mutual civility and respect
definitions.zh: n. 礼貌, 礼让

examples.zh: 国家间的礼让促进和平。

examples.en: The meeting was held in a spirit of comity.
examples.zh: 会议在礼让的精神下进行。

definitions.en: v stop the flow of a liquid
definitions.zh: vt. 使止血, 止住, 止血
a. 坚固的, 防水的, 忠实的

examples.zh: 护士用绷带止血。

examples.en: They tried to stanch the flow of water.
examples.zh: 他们试图止住水流。

definitions.en: n. a crusty irascible cantankerous old person full of stubborn ideas
definitions.zh: n. 脾气坏的人, 吝啬鬼
